title: Senior Integrated Marketing Program Manager
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a Senior Integrated Marketing Program Manager to lead the planning, coordination, and delivery of our most important marketing programs from one of our India office locations. This role leads integrated campaigns and go\-to\-market initiatives that build brand visibility, generate pipeline, and support product and segment growth.
   

  

 You will be marketing leadership’s trusted planning partner — turning priorities into operating cadences, decision\-ready materials, and clear owners, milestones, and outcomes.
   

  

 You will co\-own execution alongside functional leads across brand, product marketing, web, demand generation, events, and marketing operations, bringing the programmatic rigor that keeps complex work on track. Beyond individual programs, you will help define how marketing operates together, establishing the operating model, cadences, and ways of working that scale as the team grows.
   

  

 This is a senior role with direct exposure to the marketing senior leadership team. You will also serve as a senior leader within the India marketing operations team, partnering closely with the US\-based Marketing Operations lead and the US\-based process and program management counterpart.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Program Planning \& Delivery**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of complex, cross\-functional marketing programs, from intake and planning through launch, measurement, and optimization.
* Translate business and marketing priorities into integrated roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency maps, and risk registers.
* Co\-own execution alongside functional leads, partnering with product marketing on launches, brand on creative delivery, and demand generation on campaign activation.
* Ensure campaign briefs, objectives, audience definitions, content requirements, channel plans, measurement plans, and launch criteria are agreed before work enters execution.
* Manage portfolio\-level visibility across concurrent programs, including prioritization, capacity trade\-offs, escalation, and delivery risk mitigation.
* Own the integrated marketing calendar as the shared view of what marketing is delivering and when, using it to drive sequencing, prioritization, and capacity conversations.


**Operating Cadence \& Governance**
* Build and run the operating cadences that keep priorities, risks, dependencies, and next steps visible, including status reviews, planning cycles, and launch readiness forums.
* Help define how marketing operates together — establishing the operating model, rituals, and ways of working that scale as the team and its remit grow.
* Improve intake, prioritization, approval, and launch governance processes, and build the templates, checklists, and standards that make delivery repeatable.
* Facilitate senior stakeholder alignment, ensuring decisions, scope changes, approvals, and dependencies are documented, communicated, and resolved.
* Keep planning tools and the marketing calendar current and trusted, so conflicts, gaps, and over\-commitment surface before they affect delivery.


**Executive Engagement \& Reporting**
* Partner directly with the marketing senior leadership team on planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions, and bring forward the information they need to decide.
* Synthesize inputs from marketing, sales, product, and agency stakeholders into decision\-ready briefings and reporting for leadership.
* Provide executive\-ready visibility into program health, launch readiness, risks, blockers, trade\-offs, and decisions required.
* Partner with marketing operations and analytics to ensure tracking, measurement plans, and success metrics are defined and operational before launch.
* Communicate clearly and concisely with senior leaders, simplifying complex workstreams and presenting trade\-offs rather than escalating problems without options.


**Team Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Serve as a senior leader within the India marketing operations team, providing direction, review, and coaching to other team members and raising the standard of delivery across the group.
* Be accountable for the quality, timeliness, and consistency of the programs the India team delivers.
* Coordinate closely with the US\-based Marketing Operations lead on priorities, intake, status, escalations, and stakeholder communication.
* Partner with the US\-based process and program management counterpart to keep standards, templates, and ways of working consistent across regions.
* Build capability that outlasts any one individual — success is measured not only by what you deliver, but by how well the team can deliver without you.
* Apply AI tools practically to accelerate briefs, status reporting, documentation, and synthesis, and help the team adopt them in day\-to\-day ways of working.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and decision\-making.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 10\+ years of experience in marketing program or project management, integrated campaign delivery, or marketing operations, including significant time at a senior level.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-channel marketing programs in a fast\-paced B2B environment.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross\-functional teams, influence senior stakeholders, and drive accountability across functions.
* Experience running an integrated marketing calendar or equivalent planning system across multiple teams and channels.
* Experience working directly with senior marketing leadership on planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions.
* Strong working knowledge of how marketing moves from brief to content creation, channel activation, launch, and performance reporting.
* Practical fluency across core marketing channels, including email, web, webinars, events, paid media, organic social, and ABM programs.
* Experience overseeing delivery of marketing content such as emails, landing pages, ads, case studies, videos, event assets, and sales enablement materials.
* Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, present trade\-offs, and escalate risks with recommendations.
* Experience establishing or improving marketing execution processes, intake models, and governance cadences.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* PMP, agile, or equivalent program management certification is preferred.
* Experience in technology, financial services, SaaS, or other complex enterprise go\-to\-market environments is preferred.
* Experience with marketing automation, CRM, and work management platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or Workfront.
* Experience leading ABM or account\-focused programs, including target account prioritization, sales alignment, and account\-level performance tracking.
* Experience managing external agencies, media partners, freelancers, or offshore and shared\-services delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of campaign measurement, including engagement and conversion metrics, pipeline influence, attribution, and funnel movement.
* Experience building a new team, function, or delivery model from the ground up is a strong plus.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**How Success Will Be Measured**
*The measures this role will be held to*
**Measure**
**What Good Looks Like**
**On\-time delivery**
 High\-priority marketing programs and campaign launches delivered on schedule and within agreed scope.
   

  

**Program cycle time**
 Time from intake to launch reduces as intake, briefing, and approval processes mature.
   

  

**Launch readiness \& quality**
 Deliverables meet quality expectations with reduced rework and fewer late\-stage surprises.
   

  

**Stakeholder satisfaction**
 Marketing leadership and functional partners rate planning and program support as reliable and valuable.
   

  

**Executive visibility**
 Leaders consistently have clear, current insight into the marketing calendar, program health, risks, and decisions required.
   

  

**Operating model maturity**
 Execution processes become more scalable, documented, and repeatable, with less dependency on any one person.
   

  

**Business impact**
 Program delivery supports measurable improvement in audience engagement, pipeline contribution, and campaign velocity.
   

  

**What Will Make You Successful**
* Comfort leading through influence and shared ownership rather than relying on positional authority.
* The instinct to bring structure to ambiguity without adding bureaucracy for its own sake.
* Confidence and composure in front of senior leaders, including when the news is difficult.
* Judgment about what genuinely needs escalating, and what you should simply resolve.
* Credibility with specialists — enough marketing depth to ask the right questions and challenge constructively.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.

title: Manager, RA Publishing & Submissions
description:
**About Astellas**

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. **Required Qualifications:**

Bachelor’s degree (science or technology is preferred)

Strong ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally in English


Ability to multi\-task across multiple projects and deliverables


High integrity to maintain confidential and proprietary information


Ability to keep calm under pressure  



**Preferred Qualifications:**

Advanced degree (e.g., Masters, PhD, etc,)


Experience with managing IT systems or providing business operational support


Experience using document management, submission publishing, registration management, labeling and/or change control systems


Basic understanding of information taxonomies, master data management or other structured data concepts


Basic understanding of data warehousing, data lakes and reporting/analytics platforms or concepts


Proficiency in other language(s) – most common/useful are Dutch, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese, French, Russian, Chinese

Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like\-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide.

A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions.

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.


Behaviors: We come together as ‘One Astellas’, working with courage and a sense of urgency. We are outcome focused and consistently take accountability for our personal contribution.

title: GTM Architect
description:
**ABOUT JMAN:** 




 JMAN Group is a fast\-growing data engineering \& data science consultancy. We work primarily with Private Equity Funds and their Portfolio Companies to create commercial value using Data \& Artificial Intelligence. In addition, we also work with growth businesses, large corporates, multinationals, and charities.
 



  





 We are headquartered in London with Offices in New York, London and Chennai. Our team of over 450 people is a unique blend of individuals with skills across commercial consulting, data science and software engineering.
 



  





 We were founded by cousins Anush Newman (Co\-founder \& CEO) and Leo Valan (Co\-founder \& CTO) and have grown rapidly since 2019\. In May 2023 we took a minority investment from Baird Capital and in January 2024 we opened an office in New York with the ambition of growing our US business to be as large as, if not bigger than, our European business by 2027\.
 



  





**Why work at JMAN:** 




 Our vision is to ensure JMAN Group is the passport to our team’s future. We want our team to go on a fast\-paced, high\-growth journey with us – when our people want to do something else, the skills, training, exposure, and values that JMAN has instilled in them should open doors all over the world.
 



 Current Benefits:
 



 − Competitive annual bonus
 



 − Market\-leading private health insurance
 



 − Regular company socials
 



 − Annual company away days
 



 − Extensive training opportunities
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The GTM Architect will be the strategic bridge between JMAN product and delivery capabilities and our global client client partners (US/UK), driving sales enablement, value creation, and delivery alignment for the Private Equity and portfolio client ecosystem.
 



  





 While the primary focus is on sales enablement and value creation, this role will also oversee delivery management for active accounts to ensure solution promises translate into client outcomes.
 



  





 This position is ideal for senior professionals with technology presales experience with a MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School who can combine commercial acumen, solution storytelling, and operational discipline to scale our go\-to\-market efforts.
 



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 5–10 years in technology presales, GTM, or solution consulting roles in tech services, consulting, or SaaS/product firms.
* MBA from a reputed Indian B\-School (like, IIM, ISB, XLRI, SPJIMR, Great Lakes etc.) with strong exposure to GTM, consulting, or tech solutioning.
* Good understanding of Private Equity ecosystem and portfolio value creation levers (preferred).
* Proven ability to design value propositions linking solutions to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills. Ability to articulate impactful solution presentations.
* Experience in managing or overseeing delivery teams to ensure alignment with GTM objectives.
* Exposure to data, analytics, cloud, or AI\-led solutions is a plus.



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Sales Enablement \& Solution Readiness
 *(Core Focus)***



* Develop solution playbooks, value propositions, and proposal templates tailored for PE and portfolio clients.
* Partner with US/UK Client Partners to craft impactful client pitches, proposal response and data \& AI solution narratives.
* Lead solutioning workshops with Delivery, Labs, and CoEs for cross\-functional GTM alignment.
* Maintain a centralized repository of sales assets, proof points, and case studies.



**Value Creation Strategy
 *(Core Focus)***



* Map JMAN’s data \& AI solution offerings to portfolio business value drivers (e.g. top\-line growth, margin improvement, operational efficiency, etc).
* Quantify and articulate ROI outcomes for client proposals.
* Contribute to strategic account plans and market expansion strategies.



**Delivery Management
 *(Supporting Focus)***



* Work with Tech Delivery Leads and PMO to monitor project progress for strategic accounts.
* Ensure delivery outputs align with agreed solution value propositions, and business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to expand accounts through insights from delivery engagements.



**Global GTM Collaboration \& Governance** 



* Serve as the India\-based GTM anchor for global pursuits, ensuring quick turnaround and time zone coverage.
* Align with Marketing to drive campaigns and thought leadership tied to target accounts.
* Support PMO with pipeline tracking, conversion analytics, and win\-loss reviews.
* Run bi\-weekly GTM huddles with US/UK partners to review opportunity pipeline.

title: Marketing Practice Head
description:

title: Shopify CRO Manager
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Shopify CRO Manager to own our end\-to\-end conversion rate optimisation programme.
 



 The role is responsible for the complete process from insight and hypothesis through experiment design, tracking QA, launch, statistical evaluation, winner rollout and measurable CVR/revenue impact.
 



 This position is not limited to marketplace listing optimisation, paid advertising or campaign execution. The successful candidate will improve the Shopify customer journey by working closely with dedicated Data Analyst, UI/UX, development, content and merchandising teams.
 


 Key responsibilities
 * Own the Shopify CRO roadmap across product pages, category/collection pages, search, navigation, cart and checkout.
* Analyse customer behaviour, funnel performance, device performance, engagement data and commercial results to identify conversion opportunities.
* Create structured hypotheses supported by evidence and prioritise experiments based on expected impact, confidence and effort.
* Define primary KPIs, secondary metrics, guardrail metrics, target audience, test duration and success criteria before each experiment.
* Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure accurate event tracking, dashboards, data quality and reliable post\-test analysis.
* Brief UI/UX, content and development teams with clear experiment requirements and expected customer/business outcomes.
* Conduct pre\-launch QA including tracking validation, mobile/desktop review, browser testing, localisation, merchandising checks and rollback readiness.
* Launch and monitor A/B tests and other controlled experiments without disrupting customer experience or trading performance.
* Evaluate test outcomes using appropriate statistical methods; distinguish meaningful uplift from inconclusive or false\-positive results.
* Roll out confirmed winners, document learning, and ensure results are incorporated into future product and page templates.
* Maintain an experiment backlog, prioritisation framework, testing calendar, QA checklist and executive reporting.
* Present clear recommendations and revenue/CVR impact to senior stakeholders.


 Required qualifications and experience
 * 4\+ years of experience in conversion rate optimisation, e\-commerce growth, digital analytics, product experimentation or a related role.
* Proven experience personally owning website experiments from hypothesis to successful rollout.
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify and a strong understanding of D2C e\-commerce journeys.
* Strong knowledge of A/B testing, control/variant design, sample size, statistical significance, confidence levels and incremental impact.
* Experience using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Shopify Analytics and reporting tools such as Looker Studio, Power BI or Tableau.
* Ability to work effectively with Data, UI/UX, developers, content, merchandising and commercial stakeholders.
* Strong analytical thinking, structured communication and project\-management skills.
* Ability to prioritise high\-impact initiatives in a fast\-moving e\-commerce environment.


 Preferred qualifications
 * Experience with experimentation platforms such as VWO, Optimizely, Convert, AB Tasty or similar.
* SQL knowledge and experience working with product, customer or web\-behaviour datasets.
* Experience with heatmaps/session\-replay tools such as Hotjar, Contentsquare, Microsoft Clarity or similar.
* Experience improving international e\-commerce stores, localised content or multi\-market Shopify storefronts.
* Experience in fitness, consumer goods, retail or high\-consideration D2C products.


 How success will be measured
 * Conversion\-rate uplift across key Shopify journeys.
* Incremental revenue and profitability generated through experiments.
* Quality and speed of the hypothesis\-to\-launch process.
* Accuracy of tracking, QA and statistical evaluation.
* Number and impact of winning experiments successfully rolled out.
* Clear documentation and adoption of learnings across teams.


 Application requirement
 
 Candidates should share 2\-3 examples of experiments they personally owned, including:
 


* The hypothesis and business problem
* Primary KPI and test setup
* Test duration/sample size approach
* Result and statistical conclusion
* Final rollout decision and measurable business impact

title: Business Lead
description:
**Founding Business Development Lead**
 Build the Commercial Engine for an Indigenous Deep\-Tech Cooling Company
   

  

**About Us**
 Zerocubit is an indigenous sustainable ultra\-low temperature refrigeration company founded by IISc alumni bringing hands\-on R\&D and product engineering experience from Atlas Copco and IIT Madras Research Park \- grounding the company in deep technical rigor across mechanical design, thermal systems, and industrial product development, with a track record of taking engineering\-heavy products from concept to deployment \- building patentable, high\-performance cooling technology for pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, semiconductor manufacturing, defence, lyophilization, and advanced industrial cooling that matches global systems on engineering capability, reliability, sustainability, and performance; solving India's near\-total dependence on imported ULT equipment (steep distributor markups, long lead times, thin local service support) and the absence of any independent multi\-brand service network, through systems designed around low\-GWP refrigerants that cut environmental impact and help customers lower their own carbon footprint, on a phased roadmap from −40°C to −60°C in Pilot 1, extending to −100°C in Pilot 2 and −150°C in Pilot 3, toward becoming a single\-point stop for cryogenic products; currently pre\-launch and founder\-led.
   

 Now, we are looking for the person who will help build the business \& commercial side of the company from the ground up.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We are hiring our first Business Development Lead \- a builder, strategist, relationship creator, and commercial leader who wants to create a business function rather than inherit one.
   

 You will work directly with the founders to identify markets, open strategic doors, build customer relationships, develop partnerships, shape our go\-to\-market strategy, and convert early opportunities into long\-term business. This is not a traditional business development role where you inherit a CRM, sales scripts, established territories, and predefined targets.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad, India (base), with frequent travel across India.
   

  

**You will help create the playbook.**
 From identifying our highest\-potential customer segments to building the sales pipeline, refining pricing, developing partnerships, representing the company at major industry events, and eventually building your own team \- you will play a central role in defining how the company grows.
   

  

 We think of this role through a "
 **Cheetah \+ Elephant** 
 " mindset:
   

 Move like a cheetah when speed, experimentation, and decisive action matter.
   

 Think like an elephant when relationships, credibility, partnerships, and long\-term strategic positioning require patience and consistency. Some opportunities may convert in days. Others may take months. You should know the difference and know how to build both.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* Build and grow opportunities across pharma API manufacturing, biotech, lyophilization, semiconductors, defence, and industrial cooling.
* Own the full commercial cycle – from lead generation and customer discussions to proposals, negotiations, and contract conversion.
* Build strong relationships with plant leaders, engineering teams, procurement, business heads, and government stakeholders.
* Work closely with the founders and engineering team to translate customer needs into commercial and technical proposals.
* Gather market and competitor intelligence to support pricing, positioning, and product decisions.
* Create the sales pipeline through outbound outreach, partnerships, industry events, and strategic relationships.
* Represent the company at trade shows, conferences, industry forums, and relevant media opportunities.
* Help define the company's go\-to\-market strategy, sales process, pricing structure, collateral, and future business team.


**What We're Looking For**
* 3–5 years of experience in B2B, industrial, technical, deep\-tech, capital equipment, pharma, semiconductor, defence, refrigeration, or related markets.
* Can build relationships and opportunities from scratch.
* Is comfortable with complex, consultative sales cycles.
* Can understand technical products and communicate their business value.
* Works well in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity startup environment.
* Thinks strategically but is equally comfortable executing on the ground.
* Can manage both short\-term opportunities and long\-term customer relationships.
* Direct experience in ultra\-low\-temperature refrigeration is valuable, but not required.


 A builder's mindset, commercial judgment, and ability to create business matter more.
   

  

**Compensation**
 Competitive base salary (commensurate with experience) plus revenue\-linked incentives and meaningful equity.
   

  

**What You Get**
* A chance to build the commercial function from zero alongside the founders.
* High ownership and direct influence on company strategy and growth.
* Career progression based on results and impact, not tenure.
* The opportunity to commercialize cutting\-edge, sustainable Made\-in\-India deep\-tech technology.
* Direct exposure to customers, engineering, product strategy, and key company decisions.


**Culture**
 We are a small, founder\-led team with no existing playbook. We value people who are comfortable taking ownership, making decisions, moving fast, and building structure where none exists.
   

  

* Speed when it matters. Patience when it counts. Ownership throughout.


 If building a market and taking a deep\-tech product from innovation to commercial scale excites you, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 We welcome applicants from a range of backgrounds and career paths; if you meet most of the qualifications and are excited about the role, we encourage you to apply.

title: POD Manager
company: Digital Mojo - Branding and Digital Marketing Agency in Hyderabad
description:
**Company Description** 





 Digital Mojo is a results\-driven digital marketing agency based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. Since 2016, we have been helping brands scale through performance\-focused digital strategies, storytelling, lead generation, branding, and high\-impact marketing campaigns.
 




  





**Role Description** 




**We are looking for a highly ownership\-driven Pod Manager with 5\-7 years of agency experience to lead a pod of clients end\-to\-end.** 





 The Pod Manager is not a delivery coordinator. They are the business head of their pod. They own the P\&L of their accounts, drive client growth strategy, lead the pod team, and are the last point of escalation before it reaches the CEO. Every commercial decision, every retention risk, every growth opportunity within the pod runs through them.
 





 If something goes wrong in the pod, the Pod Manager owns it. If something goes right, the Pod Manager drove it.
 




**What This Role Is Not** 



* Not a senior Account Manager with a fancier title
* Not someone who only reviews reports and attends calls
* Not someone who escalates client problems to the CEO without first attempting resolution
* Not a task manager or execution coordinator
* Not someone who waits for strategy to come from above



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Pod P\&L Ownership** 



* Own the revenue, profitability, and commercial health of all accounts within the pod
* Track pod\-level billing, scope utilization, and team bandwidth against revenue
* Identify accounts where the agency is over\-servicing and course\-correct scope or pricing
* Protect agency margins by managing team allocation and delivery efficiency
* Flag accounts at commercial risk to the Founder with a clear plan, not just a problem
* Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities and close them in coordination with the Founder
* Own monthly pod revenue targets and report against them with clarity



**2\. Client Growth Strategy** 



* Go beyond delivery. Actively think about what is next for each client's business
* Develop quarterly growth plans for key accounts covering new campaigns, channels, and opportunities
* Proactively bring ideas to clients before they ask. Be the strategic voice in every client relationship
* Identify gaps in a client's current marketing mix and recommend solutions backed by data
* Lead strategic review meetings with clients, not just performance catch\-up calls
* Connect client business goals to marketing strategy and keep both aligned as the business evolves
* Be the person a client calls when they want a fresh perspective, not just a status update



**3\. Escalation Leadership** 



* Serve as the final internal escalation point before the CEO for all pod\-level issues
* Handle client escalations, conflicts, and difficult conversations directly and with confidence
* Resolve delivery failures, team gaps, and quality issues at the pod level without pushing them upward
* Make judgment calls on scope disputes, pricing conversations, and client dissatisfaction independently
* Know when to involve the Founder and walk in with context, options, and a recommendation
* Protect the Founder's bandwidth by resolving 90% of pod issues at the pod level



**4\. Team Leadership and Pod Management** 



* Lead and manage Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, and SEO Specialists within the pod
* Set clear expectations, review output quality, and hold team members accountable
* Run pod reviews, identify underperformance early, and address it directly
* Build a culture of ownership, speed, and quality within the pod
* Identify training or skill gaps in the team and flag them to the Founder
* Ensure Account Managers are handling day\-to\-day client communication so the Pod Manager can focus on strategy and commercial outcomes



**5\. Delivery and Quality Oversight** 



* Own the quality of everything that leaves the pod, from reports to creatives to campaign performance
* Ensure all client deliverables across social media, SEO, and performance marketing are on time and to standard
* Review monthly performance reports before they reach the client
* Maintain SLA adherence across the pod and flag risks before they impact delivery
* Coordinate with centralized teams including design, SEO, website, and automation for seamless execution



**6\. Performance and Campaign Strategy** 



* Understand performance marketing fundamentals including CPL, ROAS, CTR, lead quality, and funnel structure
* Review campaign performance across accounts and push for optimization when results are not meeting targets
* Work with Performance Marketers on budget planning, channel strategy, and campaign direction
* Ensure SEO, social, and paid strategies are aligned and working toward the same client business outcome
* The character in sitcom is Ross



**7\. Commercial Responsibility and Client Retention** 



* Own client retention across all pod accounts
* Conduct regular health checks on every account and know the status of each relationship at all times
* Identify at\-risk clients early and create a recovery plan before it becomes a churn situation
* Manage contract renewals, scope expansions, and pricing conversations
* Track client satisfaction and act on early signals before they escalate



  





**Key KPIs** 



* Pod Revenue vs Target
* Pod Gross Margin and Profitability
* Client Retention Rate
* Upsell and Cross\-sell Revenue Generated
* Client Satisfaction Score
* Escalations Reaching CEO (target: minimal)
* On\-Time Delivery Percentage
* Team Utilization and Bandwidth Efficiency
* Strategic Growth Plans Delivered per Quarter



  





**Required Skills and Qualifications** 



* 4\-7 years of experience in a digital marketing agency
* Proven experience managing multiple client accounts and cross\-functional teams
* Strong understanding of agency P\&L, billing, scope management, and margin control
* Deep knowledge of performance marketing, social media, SEO, and content marketing
* Experience handling client escalations and difficult commercial conversations independently
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to build and present growth plans for clients
* Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal
* Confident in senior client\-facing discussions and presentations
* Experience with project management and reporting tools
* Ability to lead, motivate, and hold a team accountable in a fast\-paced environment



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile** 



* **Agency experience is mandatory.**
* Has managed a revenue\-bearing portfolio of clients, not just a team of people
* Has had commercial conversations with clients around scope, pricing, and renewals
* Thinks in terms of client business growth, not just campaign delivery
* Is a problem\-solver who finds solutions before escalating
* Can lead a room whether it is a team standup or a senior client strategy session



  





**Reporting Structure** 



* Reports To: Founder / CEO
* Manages: Account Managers, Social Media Managers, Performance Marketers, SEO Specialists
* Coordinates With: Creative Team, SEO Team, Website Team, Automation Team
* Escalation Authority: Final internal point before the CEO

This work will accelerate growth through efficient positioning across price tiers, optimized channel\-based package types, right pricing, well directed commercial strategy and increase promotional ROI driven by enhanced and standardized insights.




This position will be part of the ICC \- Revenue growth Management organization. This position contributes to the success of the company and contribute to growth through strategy development, and implementation of RGM frameworks. The incumbement will work for different markets across the globe and work with different stakeholders to develop RGM playbooks and ensure analytics execution

Functional Responsibilities

* Collaborate with Market Cluster Leads to understand market dynamics and incorporate market feedback into analyses

* Implement continued improvements and simplifications of processes, standardization of reporting and optimal use of technology
* Create an inclusive and collaborative environment
* Adavanced Analytics – Price Elasticity, Promotion Effectiveness and knowledge of Python, R, Tableau/Power Bi


Key Activities


* Perform granular level analysis to identify growth opportunities
* Prepare data for the analyses to be performed (Data Pre\-processing Tools – Alteryx/KNIME exp preferred)
* Understand the nuances of the product category and market to tailor the output according to business needs
* Run the analyses and create visualizations (Power BI and Tableau experience preferred); prepare drill down analyses to derive insights
* Create a storyline out of various analyses output for the business to comprehend the output
* Meet the service level agreements and perform QC of the end\-to\-end analysis
* Expand playbook analytic pack scope to include additional analyses upon alignment with market

  


Qualifications:  

* \+7 years of experience in Retail Analytics/Category Management/Revenue Management
* 2\-3 years of relevant professional experience working with large data sets and experience in CPG /Consulting / ICC Organizations
* Experience in any of the RGM lever practices\- Pricing, Promo, Assortment, Trade Investment
* Strong analytics skills with expertise in data analytics and data visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI
* Strong Advanced Analytics acumen, Agile ways of working, managing high end data science
* Prior experience in data analytics to derive data driven insights and consolidate them to generate recommendations
* Experience in developing data\-driven models for sales and marketing function
* Ability to handle multiple work streams simultaneously and to tight deadlines in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment.
* Experience working with stakeholders in North America, LATAM, APAC, or EMEA markets (preferred)
* Very strong analytical skills – excellent competency in MS Excel is a must, as is experience of managing complex, incomplete \& inconsistent datasets and defining strategic analytics (market sizing/growth forecasts etc).
* Experience in Tableau / Power Bi is preferred
* Proven experience using PowerPoint and ability to producing visually compelling presentations (i.e. beyond just operating the software) that are impactful with a senior audience
* Clarity in communication (English language) to enable production of a very high standard of commentary that is impactful and credible amongst our most senior audiences.
* Bachelor’s in commerce/business administration/Engg., Master’s degree is a plus
* Best\-in\-class time management skills, ability to multitask, set priorities and plan

title: Global Campaign Manager
description:
Overview:
**About JAGGAER**  

JAGGAER provides an intelligent Source\-to\-Pay and Supplier Collaboration Platform that empowers organizations to manage and automate complex processes while enabling a highly resilient, responsible, and integrated supplier base. With 30 years of expertise, we specialize in solving complex procurement and supply chain challenges across various industries.  

Our 1,200\+ global employees are obsessed with ensuring customers get full value from our products \- ultimately enhancing and transforming their businesses.  

For more information, visit www.jaggaer.com **Role Summary:**  

The Global Nurture Campaigns Manager will own the execution, optimization, and governance of JAGGAER's marketing automation programs across Salesforce and Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). This role will be responsible for building scalable campaign infrastructure, managing automated journeys, maintaining data quality, and ensuring marketing programs move prospects and customers through the funnel effectively.  

This role will partner closely with Demand Generation, Lifecycle Marketing, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, Content, Digital, and regional marketing teams to translate campaign strategy into technically sound, measurable programs. The position will manage campaign setup, segmentation, lead routing, scoring, nurture programs, email execution, testing, reporting, and ongoing platform optimization.  

The ideal candidate combines strong hands\-on Pardot and Salesforce expertise with campaign operations discipline, lifecycle marketing knowledge, analytical thinking, and the ability to improve processes at scale.
Principal Responsibilities:
**Marketing Automation Platform Ownership:*** Serve as a primary owner and power user of Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement), ensuring the platform is configured, maintained, and used according to established marketing operations standards.
* Manage automation rules, engagement programs, dynamic lists, completion actions, scoring, grading, segmentation logic, suppression rules, and other core Pardot functionality.
* Maintain strong alignment between Pardot and Salesforce, including field mappings, campaign synchronization, lead and contact records, campaign membership, and activity visibility.
* Monitor platform health, sync errors, automation conflicts, data issues, and operational risks, resolving issues directly or coordinating with Sales Operations, IT, and external partners.

 **Campaign Management \& Execution*** Own the technical setup and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across email, webinars, events, paid media, content programs, and other demand generation channels.
* Build and manage Salesforce Campaigns and Pardot campaign assets, including emails, forms, landing pages, lists, automation rules, tracking links, and campaign member statuses.
* Establish repeatable campaign templates, naming conventions, QA checklists, and launch processes that improve speed, consistency, and reporting accuracy.
* Partner with campaign owners to translate campaign briefs into executable workflows, audience segments, routing logic, follow\-up actions, and measurement plans.
* Conduct pre\-launch and post\-launch QA for links, forms, personalization, segmentation, tracking, routing, suppression, rendering, and CRM synchronization.

 **Lifecycle Marketing \& Nurture Programs*** Support the lifecycle marketing strategy by building automated nurture journeys for prospects, leads, customers, and other key audiences.
* Develop and optimize Pardot Engagement Studio programs based on lifecycle stage, persona, product interest, engagement, buying signals, geography, and account characteristics.
* Partner with Demand Generation and Content teams to map content and messaging to stages of the buyer journey and create scalable always\-on nurture programs.
* Build re\-engagement, lead recycling, stalled\-opportunity, post\-event, customer engagement, and other lifecycle programs that improve progression and conversion.
* Continuously test cadence, subject lines, messaging, calls to action, segmentation, and journey logic to improve engagement and downstream pipeline impact.

 **Lead Management, Scoring \& Routing*** Manage and optimize lead scoring, grading, qualification, lifecycle stage progression, and handoff processes between Marketing and Sales.
* Support lead routing and assignment logic to ensure qualified prospects are delivered to the correct sales teams quickly and accurately.
* Monitor funnel movement and identify operational breakdowns between inquiry, qualification, nurture, MQL, sales acceptance, and opportunity stages.
* Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing Operations to improve lead status governance, campaign member statuses, attribution inputs, and CRM data consistency.

 **Data, Segmentation \& Personalization*** Build accurate audience segments using Salesforce and Pardot data, including demographic, firmographic, behavioral, campaign, account, and lifecycle attributes.
* Maintain suppression logic, consent requirements, subscription preferences, and data hygiene processes to improve deliverability and campaign quality.
* Use dynamic content, personalization, and segmentation to create more relevant experiences across lifecycle and demand generation programs.
* Identify duplicate, incomplete, stale, or inconsistent records and work with operations partners to improve
  

database quality and governance.

 **Reporting, Measurement \& Optimization*** Track campaign and lifecycle performance including delivery, engagement, conversion, MQL creation, funnel progression, pipeline influence, and other agreed KPIs.
* Build and maintain campaign reporting within Salesforce and Pardot, and partner with Analytics teams on dashboards and attribution reporting.
* Analyze program performance to identify bottlenecks, underperforming segments, nurture opportunities, and areas for campaign optimization.
* Provide actionable recommendations to campaign owners and marketing leadership based on performance data and funnel behavior.

 **Marketing Operations \& Governance*** Maintain documentation for campaign processes, automation logic, naming conventions, field usage, scoring models, routing, and lifecycle workflows.
* Support user access, platform governance, testing, release management, and change control across Salesforce and Pardot marketing workflows.
* Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, IT, and vendors on integrations, troubleshooting, platform enhancements, and process improvements.
* Stay current on Salesforce and Pardot capabilities and recommend improvements that increase automation, efficiency, scalability, and data quality.


Position Requirements:
* 5\+ years of experience in marketing automation, marketing operations, lifecycle marketing, campaign operations, or a related B2B marketing role.
* Hands\-on experience administering and executing campaigns in Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement.
* Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including Campaigns, Leads, Contacts, Accounts, Opportunities, campaign member statuses, and reporting.
* Experience building automated nurture programs, segmentation, lead scoring, grading, routing, email campaigns, forms, and landing pages.
* Strong understanding of B2B demand generation funnels, lifecycle stages, lead management, and Marketing to\-Sales handoff processes.
* Experience with campaign QA, data hygiene, consent and suppression logic, email deliverability, and marketing database management.
* Ability to troubleshoot automation, sync, routing, segmentation, tracking, and campaign execution issues independently.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign and funnel performance and turn findings into operational improvements.
* Excellent project management and communication skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to documentation, governance, and quality assurance.

 **Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting marketing automation within a B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, procurement, or complex global organization.
* Salesforce or Pardot / Marketing Cloud Account Engagement certifications.
* Experience with advanced Salesforce reporting, campaign attribution, dashboards, and funnel analytics.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, webinar platforms, paid media integrations, ABM platforms, and other marketing technology tools.
* Experience with HTML/CSS for email and landing page troubleshooting or customization.
* Experience supporting global campaigns, multiple regions, languages, business units, or complex routing structures.
 **Success Measures:*** Campaigns launch accurately, on time, and with consistent tracking, routing, and Salesforce campaign structure.
* Lifecycle and nurture programs increase engagement, qualification, funnel progression, and pipeline contribution.
* Lead scoring, routing, and Marketing\-to\-Sales handoffs operate reliably with fewer errors and faster follow\-up.
* Salesforce and Pardot data remains clean, synchronized, well governed, and usable for segmentation and reporting.
* Marketing teams gain scalable processes, templates, documentation, and automation that reduce manual campaign work and improve execution speed.
 **What We Offer:**  

At JAGGAER, we are committed to supporting you and your family's well\-being. Your health is a priority, and we offer a  

range of programs to help you stay well and thrive. Our benefits include Health, Accidental Insurance, and Term Life. **Our Values \- T.E.A.M:**  

At JAGGAER, our business is about people. Our products are built on intellectual property, but the real differentiator is the  

teams behind them \- the way we collaborate, innovate, solve problems and deliver for customers. TEAM gives us a common  

set of expectations for how we work together across products, cultures, and geographies.* **Transparency** \- Openness Builds Trust: Candor strengthens relationships, speeds decision\-making, and ensures  

problems are solved together \- with customers, teammates, and partners.
* **Entrepreneurial Spirit** \- Own It, Drive It, Make It: A scrappy, customer obsessed, problem\-solving mindset is at the  

cornerstone of both organizational and personal growth.
* **Accountability \-** Thumbs In, Not Fingers Out: We take responsibility ourselves before pointing elsewhere.
* **Metrics\-Driven Results** \- Outcomes Over Activities: Data and evidence guide our decisions, help us course\-correct  

quickly, and ensure we're delivering real impact.

**EEO:**  

JAGGAER is a proud equal opportunity/affirmative action employer supporting workforce diversity. We do not discriminate  

based upon race, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical  

conditions), marital status, caregiver status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender  

status, sexual stereotypes, age, genetic information, military, or veteran status, mental or physical disability, or other  

applicable legally protected characteristics **Great Place to Work® Certified 2026 – JAGGAER**  

Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration, and people come first.  

We are proud to announce that **JAGGAER has been certified as a Great Place to Work® for 2026**, recognizing our commitment to creating an inclusive, empowering, and high\-performing culture.

* Show strong understanding of IWPB products across assets, wealth and liabilities and what drives performance and profitability

 If you want to shape a cross\-border strategy with clear commercial impact this role offers the scope to make it happen. title: Senior Sales Manager
description:
The Senior Sales Manager (SSM) drives revenue growth by managing and expanding business with mid\-to\-high potential hearing aid dealers, independent audiology practices, and regional retail clinics. This role focuses on increasing share\-of\-wallet within an assigned territory, ensuring high product adoption, and delivering localized sales strategies.
   

  

 The SSM operates with a focused regional revenue target tailored to premium account management, which is structurally distinct from the macro\-level enterprise targets managed by our Business Development Managers (BDMs).
   

  

* Core Role Demarcation (SSM vs. BDM)


**Role**
 To maintain structural clarity across our sales vertical, this position is differentiated from the Business Development Manager (BDM) role across three primary pillars:
   

  

* Portfolio Scope: The SSM manages and nurtures existing mid\-to\-high tier retail dealers. The BDM focuses strictly on untapped corporate chains, hospital networks, and government tenders.
* Revenue Scale: The SSM target is scaled to regional dealer capacity, sitting structurally lower than national or macro\-level BDM revenue targets.
* Sales Cycle: The SSM handles high\-frequency, relationship\-driven monthly sales and restocking cycles. The BDM handles long\-cycle institutional contract acquisitions.
* Key Responsibilities


**Account Management \& Growth**
* Portfolio Ownership: Cultivate and expand a dedicated portfolio of mid\-to\-high potential hearing care professionals (HCPs) and independent dealers.
* Market Share Expansion: Increase product mix and "share of wallet" within accounts currently sourcing from multiple hearing aid manufacturers.
* Relationship Cultivation: Build deep, consultative partnerships with audiologists, clinic owners, and ENT specialists.


**Sales Execution \& Revenue**
* Revenue Generation: Consistently achieve assigned quarterly and annual sales volume and revenue targets for the specific territory.
* Commercial Negotiation: Manage commercial terms, discount structures, and volume rebates within pre\-approved regional parameters.
* Promotional Execution: Design and implement hyper\-local marketing campaigns, dispensing days, and consumer pull\-actions with retail partners.


**Enablement \& Market Intelligence**
* Training Coordination: Partner with internal Audiology Trainers to upskill dealer staff on new software, chip platforms, and fitting rationale.
* Competitor Intelligence: Monitor competitor pricing, product launch cycles, and dealer incentives to proactively protect market share.
* Requirements \& Qualifications


**Experience \& Education**
* Experience: 2–3 years of proven B2B sales experience specifically within the hearing aid industry, medical devices, or optical retail.
* Industry Track Record: Demonstrated success selling to independent audiologists, retail dispensers, or hearing care networks.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Sales Methodology: Strong relationship builder utilizing a consultative, value\-based selling approach rather than transactional sales.
* Technical Familiarity: Basic understanding of hearing aid fitting concepts and technology platforms.
* Tools \& Planning: Proficiency in territory planning and CRM software usage (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* Mobility: Willingness to travel up to 50–60% within the assigned territory to maintain high\-frequency, face\-to\-face contact with dealers.


**We are focused on an inclusive recruitment process**
 All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. As such, we encourage you to submit your CV without a photo to ensure an equal and fair application process.
   

  

 Should you have any special requirements for the interview, please let the Hiring Manager know upon accepting invitation to interview.
   

  

**How to apply?**
 Use the ‘APPLY’ link no later than September 30\. Applications are assessed on a continuous basis, so don’t wait to send yours.
   

  

**On a time crunch?** 
 Feel free to only submit your up\-to\-date CV including a few sentences outlining your motivation for applying – quick and easy.
   

  

 If you would like to know more about the position, please contact communication@gnhearing.com
   

  

**Join us in bringing people closer**
 GN brings people closer through our advanced intelligent hearing, audio, video, and gaming solutions. Inspired by people and motivated by innovation, we deliver technology that enhance the senses of hearing and sight. We enable people with hearing loss overcome real\-life problems, improve communication and collaboration for businesses and provide great experiences for audio and gaming enthusiasts.
   

  

**We hope you will join us on this journey and look forward to receiving your application.**

description:
**Job Description**
 Join our Sales Incentive Compensation team as a Sales Incentive Business Analyst, where you'll play a key role in driving compensation accuracy, operational excellence, and data\-driven decision\-making. In this role, you will partner with Sales, Finance, and cross\-functional teams to manage incentive programs, support compensation operations, and deliver actionable insights that influence business performance. This is an exciting opportunity for a detail\-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex problems, leveraging analytics, and contributing to the success of a high\-performing sales organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Administer sales compensation plans and incentive programs.
* Process Employee Action Forms (EAFs) and compensation adjustments accurately.

 Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. title: Sales specialist Panel Builder
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.



This Position reports to:



Sales Manager \#\#\#


**What we believe in**



At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.


**Your role and responsibilities**



In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.



The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite



The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at Mumbai, India.


**You will be mainly accountable for:**


* Communicate with customers regarding delivery timelines, payments, and terms in alignment with ABB’s strategy while ensuring a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.
* Facilitate marketing initiatives, promote ABB’s value proposition, and identify new market opportunities to expand business reach.
* Manage sales administration, support cash collection, and coordinate with project management to ensure smooth execution of orders.
* Build productive relationships with panel builders and industrial end users with experience in the Mumbai market


**Qualifications for the role:**


* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical / Electronic Engineering.
* Minimum of 8 years of relevant experience in sales or business development within the electrical industry.
* Proficient in building and maintaining long\-term relationships with customers by addressing their needs and ensuring satisfaction.
* Experience in handling panel builders and industrial end users, with extensive exposure to the Mumbai market.
* Skilled communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to enhance customer engagement and business growth.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across divisions and countries, promoting knowledge sharing and teamwork.
* Customer\-focused mindset with a history of resolving complex issues and delivering value\-added solutions.


**More about us**



ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.



Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Financial Controller - Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.


Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.




Job Responsibilities:


* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.
* Partner with Technology, P\&A, Business Management, and Procurement to align on project scope, in\-service dates, and cutover timing, and maintain SOX\-compliant controls and audit\-ready evidence.
* Perform ongoing review of work\-in\-process ledger balances, including aging analysis, root\-cause identification, and timely clearing to fixed assets or expense when criteria are met.
* Reconcile WIP balances to upstream project and procurement systems and validate against purchase orders, capitalization requests, and approvals.
* Capitalize qualifying assets by evaluating projects against thresholds and criteria and determining start/stop capitalization dates, place\-in\-service dates, useful lives, and residual values.
* Validate operational impacts and future benefit assumptions with Technology and business stakeholders and record entries accurately and timely in the general ledger.
* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.
* Document analytics through estimates, walk\-forwards, controller financial reviews, and flash reports.
* Analyze, communicate, and resolve material variances between the general ledger and upstream systems, as defined by the line of business.

Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* 3 years of related experience
* General Ledger experience
* Experience with financial reporting and month end close responsibilities
* Comfortable liaising with business and risk managers
* Able to build and maintain partnerships within the various product aligned businesses and across other corporate financial, treasury, and accounting groups
* Able to understand business drivers and requirements and influence middle and front office partners to deliver solutions to business issues and problems
* Strong analytical skills: Ability to quickly understand workings of a complex processing system and general ledger systems across the infrastructure and their interrelationships and dependencies
* Excellent desktop/spreadsheet/database skills
* Excellent organizational and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Able to multi\-task in a constantly changing environment

Able to critically challenge with the goal of identifying control issues  
* 

Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities

* Existing relationships and networks within the firm's IB community an advantage
* Shift Timing: Mid\-day shift 1pm to 10pm


**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  

  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.  

  

Global Finance \& Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

title: Senior Fragrance Development Manager / FDM
description:
##### **Ever dreamed of working where fragrances tell stories?**


At Eurofragance, we don’t just create fragrances — we create experiences. With passion, excellence and bold entrepreneurial spirit, we’re growing fast and want you to grow with us.  

Join a global team headquartered in Barcelona, with offices in Dubai, Singapore, Mexico, Turkey, India… and more!


Here, your work truly matters — and so do you.  

  



**What's your mission?**


The Senior Fragrance Development Manager – Fine Fragrance is responsible for leading and managing fine fragrance development projects, both proactive and reactive, in response to client briefs and strategic market opportunities. The role works in close collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Perfumers, and global HQ teams to define and implement fragrance strategies that strengthen the local fine fragrance portfolio and drive business growth, with a strong focus on the Indian market.

**️Here’s what you’ll be rocking every day**

* Lead fine fragrance development projects aligned with client briefs, category strategy, and commercial objectives.
* Evaluate fragrance developments and contribute to collection and concept build\-up in partnership with FDM team and Perfumers.
* Create, maintain, and continuously upgrade the local fine fragrance library in collaboration with HQ teams.
* Guide and support Perfumers during developments to ensure optimal fragrance outcomes, where required.
* Recommend fragrance submissions best adapted to brief parameters, market needs, and olfactive direction.
* Develop and maintain strong knowledge of competitive market products across relevant fine fragrance segments.
* Detect emerging olfactive trends and consumer preferences, working closely with Marketing to translate insights into fragrance solutions.
* Manage fragrance development projects end\-to\-end, ensuring timelines, quality, and internal alignment.
* Lead and contribute to proactive fragrance initiatives supporting portfolio development and innovation.
* Participate in and lead fragrance presentations to clients together with Sales teams.
* Develop deep olfactive and market understanding of the Indian fine fragrance landscape in key categories.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders including Sales, Marketing, Creation \& Development, Innovation \& Technology, and Regulatory teams.

**What you need to shine in this role**

* Degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Perfumery
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in Fragrance Development, with strong exposure to the Fine Fragrance category
* Proven experience working closely with Perfumers and cross\-functional global teams
* Fluent in English and Hindi

**What do we offer you at Eurofragance?**  

Much more than just a job! Take a look at everything we’ve prepared for you.

* Stability and growth in a solid company in full expansion.
* International environment with a multicultural team and language practice.
* Medical insurance for your peace of mind.
* Special prices on perfumes — because you’ll want to wear what we create.

**Why Eurofragance?**


We believe in diversity and in creating a space where everyone feels welcome — regardless of gender, age, background, orientation, or ability.  

We’re also deeply committed to sustainability: reducing our carbon footprint, enhancing energy efficiency and cultivating environmental respect.  

By joining us, you become part of a company that actively works to make a positive impact on the planet — and on people.

**Ready to join us on this sensorial adventure?**

title: Regional Sales Manager - North India
description:
**ABOUT AVERY DENNISON CORPORATION** 




 Avery Dennison Corporation (NYSE: AVY) is a global materials science and digital identification solutions company. We are Making Possible™ products and solutions that help advance the industries we serve, providing branding and information solutions that optimize labor and supply chain efficiency, reduce waste, advance sustainability, circularity and transparency, and better connect brands and consumers. We design and develop labeling and functional materials, radio\-frequency identification (RFID) inlays and tags, software applications that connect the physical and digital, and offerings that enhance branded packaging and carry or display information that improves the customer experience. Serving industries worldwide — including home and personal care, apparel, general retail, e\-commerce, logistics, food and grocery, pharmaceuticals and automotive — we employ approximately 35,000 employees in more than 50 countries. Our reported sales in 2024 were $8\.8 billion. Learn more at
 
 www.averydennison.com
 
 .
 



**Job Description** 




**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 The Regional Sales Manager will be responsible for driving the overall business performance of the North India region, delivering the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), managing channel partners, developing new business opportunities, and leading the regional sales team.
 



 The role will have end\-to\-end responsibility for top\-line growth, profitability, collections, market development, customer engagement, channel excellence, and people development.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 



* Deliver the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for the designated North India region.
* Drive sustainable top\-line growth through existing distributors/channel partners and new business generation.
* Develop and execute regional sales strategies aligned with business objectives and market opportunities.
* Deliver bottom\-line profitability through effective pricing, product\-mix optimization, and commercial discipline.
* Manage and improve timely collection of accounts receivables in line with company targets.
* Build strong relationships with distributors, printers, converters, and key decision\-makers.
* Strengthen channel partner engagement, capability, productivity, and business development.
* Identify opportunities for market expansion, share gain, new applications, and innovation\-led growth.
* Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction and ensure effective resolution of customer concerns.
* Lead negotiations with key customers and channel partners and convert discussions into sustainable business outcomes.
* Develop and coach the regional sales team to achieve business and individual objectives.
* Create a high\-performance culture through regular reviews, coaching, feedback, and capability development.
* Work as a strong team player with a high level of ownership, self\-motivation, and accountability.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen and proficiency in Excel, data analysis, and sales performance management.



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES WILL INCLUDE** 




  





**1\. Business \& Sales Management** 



* Own regional sales, volume, revenue, margin, and profitability targets.
* Develop and execute annual and quarterly regional business plans.
* Drive growth through existing channel partners while identifying and onboarding new partners where required.
* Identify white spaces and opportunities for geographic, customer, product, and application expansion.
* Monitor market trends, customer needs, competitor activity, pricing, and market dynamics.
* Track regional KPIs and take timely corrective actions to deliver business objectives.
* Maintain strong sales discipline through regular pipeline, forecast, and business reviews.



**2\. Channel Partner Management** 



* **D** 
 evelop strong strategic relationships with distributors and channel partners across North India.
* Establish clear business plans and growth objectives with key channel partners.
* Improve distributor productivity, inventory management, market coverage, and customer reach.
* Drive channel partner engagement initiatives, business reviews, capability\-building programs, and joint market development activities.
* Ensure healthy channel inventory and working\-capital discipline.
* Identify and resolve channel conflicts while maintaining a healthy and sustainable channel ecosystem.
* Develop new channel opportunities in underpenetrated markets.



  





**3\. People Management \& Leadership** 



* Lead, motivate, coach, and develop the regional sales team.
* Set clear objectives, KPIs, and performance expectations for team members.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback and coaching.
* Build team capability in consultative selling, negotiation, account management, market development, and commercial excellence.
* Encourage collaboration, accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
* Identify talent and develop succession plans for critical roles.
* Ensure effective communication of business priorities and company initiatives to the team.
* Lead by example and demonstrate strong ethical, customer\-focused, and performance\-oriented leadership.



  





**4\. Regional Travel** 



* Extensive travel across the North India region will be required.
* Regular visits to distributors, customers, printers/converters, and key market locations.
* Participate in customer meetings, channel partner reviews, market development activities, trials, exhibitions, and business events.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE** 




  




* BE / B.Tech or MBA in Sales/Marketing will be an added advantage.
* 10\+ years of experience in B2B Sales, preferably in labels, packaging, printing, chemicals, materials, or a related industry.
* Prior experience managing distributors/channel partners is essential.
* Prior people\-management/team\-leadership experience is preferred..



  





**Knowledge \& Personality Traits** 



* Strong interpersonal and relationship\-building skills with customers, channel partners, peers, and team members.
* Prior knowledge and understanding of the packaging or related B2B industry.



  





**Sales \& People Management** 



* Strong understanding of the end\-to\-end B2B selling process and ability to influence and coach the team in effective selling practices.
* Ability to effectively use sales tools, CRM, pipeline management, and structured selling techniques, including SPIN Selling.
* Strong negotiation and key\-account management skills.
* Understanding of pricing, costing, margin, and product\-mix models..



  





**Behavioral Attributes** 



* Go\-Getter: High energy, passion for excellence, bias for action, and strong ownership.
* People Leader: Ability to inspire, coach, develop, and motivate a diverse team.
* Customer Focused: Strong commitment to customer success and long\-term relationships.
* Resilient: Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic and competitive environment.
* Collaborative: Ability to work effectively across functions and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Commercially Minded: Strong understanding of business metrics, profitability, organizational linkages, and customer value.

description:
**Job Purpose:**
 Formulate and ensure realization of local sales strategy in order to meet the established sales quota for the area of responsibility, and lead the daily operation of Haworth’s sales and distribution functions ensuring that Haworth’s customers in the assigned market consistently receive high\-quality products and services in a timely manner.

* Prepare budgets, sales plans, forecasts, and relevant sales reporting.
* Develop sales strategies to meet the established area sales quota for the given area of responsibility.
* Develop and maintain Haworth’s image and brand positioning in the assigned market following Haworth’s global standards.

* Assist the sales staff members as required, in working with customers during the sales process and finalizing customer orders.
* Ensure that high\-quality tenders are prepared by the sales team.
* Leverage regional and global resources to provide training, marketing, technical, and customer service support to customers and end\-users in the assigned market.
* Assist the sales support team to ensure that product and customer service quality standards are consistently achieved.
* Provide input for the development of regional plans and major account\-winning strategies.
* Have strong connect with C\-level executives in the target accounts, and establish rapport with A\&D community, in alignment with the internal A\&D team.


**Your Qualifications:**
* Any Graduate, with MBA in Sales and Marketing.
* 12\-15 years of experience in managing cross\-functional teams including Sales and Marketing Functions. Minimum of 5 years of experience in the building material industry is a must.
* Must have experience of managing complex sales cycles with B\-to\-B selling processes in multinational companies.
* Demonstrated experience in identifying new and emerging opportunities, and developing and implementing strategic initiatives.
* Can apply an in\-depth understanding of the industry and competitors’ products to deliver value to customers and the organization.
* With learning agility, understand fast how other departments contribute to the overall business, and leverage to deliver high\-value products and services.
* Must have a high executive presence, connect with senior industry leaders, and ability to navigate through ambiguity. Strong contacts with A\&D and PMC would be an added advantage.
* Must have a strategic mind and ability to execute plans. Should be numbers\-driven, and results\-oriented, with a natural flair to collaborate at all levels, especially cross\-functional teams.
* Should be able to create and drive a high\-performing team.


**About Us**
 Haworth is one of the world's largest manufacturers of office furniture, providing solutions for tomorrow's customers worldwide. At the center of our work is the human being: What does a person need to work, what pushes them, motivate them and what makes people feel comfortable at work? Only if we can answer that question, we are able to introduce designs to our customers that will make them achieve their goals. To stay one step ahead, we invest in our own research, have a worldwide network of interesting partners and are part of think tanks around the world who are trying to think ahead. The family\-owned company, headquartered in Holland, Michigan/United States, employs more than 8,000 people and is represented in more than 150 countries in Asia, Europe and America with subsidiaries and partners.
