title: Sales Operations & AI Business Intelligence Manager
description:
SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.
   

  

*SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.*
**Who We Are**
 At SOTI, we are committed to delivering best in class mobile and IoT device management solutions. We are looking for out of the box thinkers that appreciate the art of creating great software.
   

  

 To us, being visionary is more important than doing things the way they’ve always been done.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 SOTI’s growth and success is a result of commitment to innovation through entrepreneurial culture and leadership. We’re looking for a Sales Operations \& AI Business Intelligence Manager who wants to do three things at once: run the operating engine behind a global sales organization, lead and grow a team of business analysts and operations professionals, and act as SOTI’s subject matter expert for AI\-driven reporting.
   

  

 This is an outstanding opportunity to decide how a global sales organization sees itself. You will own the numbers our sales leaders run the business on, the team that produces them, and the shift from manual reporting toward AI\-assisted, self\-serve intelligence. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, enjoy working with emerging technologies, and want your fingerprints on how a market leader sells, this role puts you at the centre of it.
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 The People – From our humble origins in our founder’s basement, to our industry leading position today, SOTI has worked hard to foster a company culture that we can all believe in. A culture that emphasizes personal growth, continuous innovation and fun.
   

  

 The Growth – Our environment fosters new ideas, fresh perspectives, and the ability to take them over the goal line. SOTI is a fast\-paced environment with a global reach that encourages you to make your mark and be part of something big!
   

  

 The Technology – You’ll get the chance to work with leading edge technologies and take on complex and interesting projects, as part of highly collaborative and agile teams. You will work alongside SOTI’s partners, which include leading tech giants that will keep you on the cusp of emerging technologies.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 Run the local sales operations engine
   

  

* Support execution of annual and quarterly business planning with India regional sales leaders, keeping the focus on plan execution and the ability to get to quarterly targets.
* Own forecast reporting, variance analysis, funnel reviews and top opportunity analysis for sales leaders, and drive accurate forecasting through sales process best practice, pipeline management and opportunity hygiene.
* Identify risk in the forecast, build mitigation plans and hold regional teams accountable to delivering their quarterly numbers.
* Provide analysis across pricing and deal structure trends, revenue streams and product sets to advise on future go\-to\-market initiatives, and act as a point on non\-standard deal structuring requests.
* Maintain a single, defensible set of definitions for pipeline, bookings, coverage, conversion and forecast accuracy, and hold the organization to them.
* Drive continual improvement of sales tools and process to streamline the sales cycle, and execute effective change management across the organization when process, systems or tools change.


**Lead and grow the India Data, Analytics, Reporting team**
* Lead, coach and develop a team of business analysts and sales operations professionals, setting clear standards for analytical rigour and delivery.
* Run a consistent people cadence: regular one\-on\-ones, documented goals, mid\-year and annual reviews, and honest, timely feedback.
* Plan capacity and assign work across competing priorities, protecting the team from thrash while keeping commitments to stakeholders.
* Build the team’s AI and analytics capability deliberately, through training, pairing and hands\-on projects, so that expertise is never concentrated in one person.
* Own team decisions and be accountable for team outcomes, including hiring, onboarding and retention of key talent.


**Lead AI reporting and business intelligence**
* Act as SOTI’s internal subject matter expert for AI\-driven business intelligence — evaluating platforms and capabilities, and making clear build, buy or defer recommendations.
* Own the reporting and dashboard roadmap, from source data in Salesforce and connected systems through to semantic models, dashboards and self\-serve analytics.
* Apply machine learning and generative AI where they demonstrably improve outcomes: forecast accuracy, pipeline risk detection, renewal and expansion signals, and narrative reporting.
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy and compliance across Salesforce and integrated systems, and participate in user acceptance testing to validate system changes.
* Drive adoption through enablement sessions and clear usage guidance, and measure whether the tools are genuinely changing how decisions get made.
* Establish guardrails for data quality, access, privacy and responsible AI use in partnership with IT and Security, and document how automated outputs are validated.


**Partner across the business**
* Facilitate stakeholder sessions to gather requirements, align expectations and drive consensus across functions with competing priorities.
* Lead complex projects from inception to closure, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, risk and deliverables.
* Work with sales enablement to train and onboard new sales team members on process, tooling and reporting.
* Translate between technical and non\-technical audiences, presenting the same insight credibly to a data engineer and to a regional sales leader.


**Experience You Will Bring**
* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 8\+ years of post\-MBA experience across sales, revenue or business operations within a high\-growth technology organisation; enterprise SaaS experience is a distinct advantage.
* Proven track record of leading teams of analysts or consultants, with direct people management accountability rather than project\-only leadership.
* Demonstrated depth in business intelligence, including hands\-on experience taking AI, machine learning or advanced analytics capabilities into production use — not only evaluating them.
* Strong business, commercial and financial acumen, with a proven ability to develop structured business plans, craft KPIs and implement metrics to manage sales execution and performance.
* Advanced Excel and BI platform skills with working fluency in SQL; Salesforce Administrator or Business Analyst certification preferred, along with a strong understanding of CRM processes.
* Strong initiative, intellectual curiosity and analytical capability, with a willingness to take ownership of complex problems and a resourceful approach to clearing obstacles.
* Exceptional organisational and time management skills, able to manage competing projects against tight deadlines.
* Collaborative team player with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, comfortable working with senior management and cultivating relationships across cross\-functional teams and peers.


**About SOTI**
 SOTI is the world's most trusted provider of mobile and IoT management solutions, with more than 17,000 enterprise customers and millions of devices managed worldwide. SOTI's innovative portfolio of solutions and services provide the tools organizations need to truly mobilize their operations and optimize their mobility investments. SOTI extends secure mobility management to provide a total, flexible solution for comprehensive management and security of all mobile devices and connected peripherals deployed in an organization.
   

  

 At SOTI, we celebrate the uniqueness of our global teams and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are curious problem solvers who are committed to bringing the best mobile and IoT management solutions to market. We offer careers with \#EndlessPossibilities.
   

  

 What are you waiting for? Apply today: soti.net/careers
   

  

 If you want to bring your ideas to life, apply at SOTI today.

We work closely with public authorities, universities and schools.

In this role you will be a Growth Accelerator in identifying new opportunities and partnerships with our key external stakeholders. You will continue building and developing strong relationships with government and policy bodies, ONOS, Inflibnet, private and public universities across the region to strengthen our existing position in the market.


In this role you will be the one who will develop and deliver unified community engagement and partnership strategy across India and South Asia, helping to expand the reach, visibility and impact of the Royal Society of Chemistry's activities.


As the strategic lead for community outreach, advocacy and institutional partnerships, you will bring together engagement activities into a coordinated, year\-round programme focused on delivering measurable outcomes and long\-term impact. You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Memberships, Sales and Marketing to align engagement initiatives with organisational priorities and increase awareness and use of RSC content and services, while maximising opportunities through national initiatives such as ONOS.


This is a very exciting opportunity for an experienced leader with a strong understanding of scientific publishing, research and higher education landscape across India and South Asia, including open science, open access, research funding and science policy.


**Key Responsibilities:**

* Set and own the India and South Asia community, advocacy and strategic partnerships strategy, defining regional priorities, maintaining a forward roadmap and aligning activity, resource and investment to RSC’s global purpose and long\-term goals.
* Strengthen RSC’s position in ONOS, INFLIBNET, open access and APC revenue opportunities by building priority partnerships, supporting platform and journal adoption, and working with Head of Sales on pilots, lighthouse wins and monetised partnerships.
* Oversee the planning and delivery of major events and engagement activity, including setting agendas with partners and briefing or involving RSC Senior Leadership for priority activity such as sustainability and CRSI\-related events.
* Create a collaborative team environment that encourages open communication, knowledge sharing and joined\-up delivery across internal and external partners.
* Translate global and regional priorities for open science, open access, sustainable chemistry, inclusion, research culture and scientific impact into clear plans, flagship activity and workstreams with defined owners, timelines and governance.
* Own senior engagement with research communities through structured stakeholder mapping, targeted programmes and relationship management across PhD students, postdoctoral researchers, early career researchers, authors, reviewers, academics, institutions and senior scientific leaders.
* Set the regional policy and sector insight agenda by monitoring developments across science, research, higher education, publishing and the funder ecosystem, assessing implications for RSC and producing clear recommendations, briefings and internal updates.
* Build and steward strategic relationships with government, funders, academic institutions, research networks, innovation clusters, startups, incubators, sector bodies and other priority partners through clear engagement plans and partnership objectives.
* Set the strategic engagement approach for librarians, consortia, academic influencers and state and central universities, strengthening awareness, adoption and effective use of RSC platforms, products, journals and books across priority institutions.
* Communicate priorities, expectations and decisions clearly, ensuring direct reports and stakeholders understand responsibilities, objectives and how their work contributes to the wider strategy.
* Work with relevant internal stakeholders to deliver major outreach, advocacy, partnership and market development programmes, including sustainability, DEI, women in chemistry, open science and open access activity.
* Ensure programmes are well governed and properly resourced through clear budgets, risk controls, supplier oversight, decision governance, delivery reviews, operational delivery standards and post\-programme evaluation.
* Act as the regional point of influence for community, advocacy and partnership insight, helping Editorial, Sales, Membership, Marketing and relevant Global Impact Group teams align priorities and delivery.

**Requirements:**

* Degree or Master’s level education in science, or equivalent practical experience, with significant senior\-level experience in community engagement, advocacy, policy, partnerships or scientific outreach.
* Strong understanding of the Indian and South Asian research, higher education, science policy, funder, publishing, open access, open science or chemistry community landscape.
* Proven ability to set direction, shape strategy and lead complex regional engagement, advocacy or partnership plans.
* Experience building senior relationships with academic leaders, policymakers, funders, government bodies, librarians, research institutions and sector partners.
* Strong policy judgement, communication, advocacy and influencing skills, including clear recommendations for senior audiences.
* Experience leading major programmes, including budgets, governance, procurement, supplier oversight, risk management, evaluation, impact reporting and ROI.
* Commercial awareness, including business case development, value for money, revenue growth opportunities, cost recovery, sponsorship or co\-funding where relevant.

At the Royal Society of Chemistry, we support flexibility and offer hybrid working, which means our teams come together when they need to collaborate.
 

Although this role is contractually based at our Delhi office, and therefore you will have the opportunity to work mostly from any other location in India, as agreed with your line manager. Applicants should be aware that there is an expectation that employees will attend our Delhi office once a month. Please be aware that in this role you are expected to travel across India for events or meetings with our external partners.

* **Partner Identification \& Onboarding:** 

 Map and prioritize target partners across three buckets \- Technology Alliances (chipset/edge\-hardware OEMs such as Intel, Axelera\-class silicon providers), Solution Partners (VMS platforms, adjacent Vision AI solution providers), and Channel Partners (regional/national System Integrators).

 Draft and negotiate partnership agreements, reseller/referral terms, and margin\-split models suited to each region's commercial norms.

 Create and deliver technical/commercial enablement material so partner sales teams can pitch Ikshana confidently and accurately.

 Maintain a partner\-specific CRM pipeline, track partner\-influenced ARR, and report on regional partnership performance.

 Coordinate with Product, Pre\-sales, and Marketing to ensure partner\-facing claims, integrations, and benchmarks are accurate and sign\-off ready.

title: Brand Manager - Ostocalcium

Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.

* Cross functional collaboration and Agency Management.

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:


* MBA/masters from an institute of repute.

* Strong understanding of consumer insights, market research, brand equity, and portfolio management.

title: Manager, Hotel Partner Solutions
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.  



  

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.


### **Introduction to the Team**

Travel Partnerships and Advertising helps partners, including hotels, airlines, destination marketing organizations, and more, deliver excellent traveler and B2B experiences. We create growth for our partners and the Expedia Group marketplace through competitive supply, travel media, and affiliate solutions.


As Manager—Hotel Partner Solutions, you will lead a team of analysts and technical professionals who deliver solutions supporting hotel partners and business priorities. You will connect technology decisions to partner needs, guide multi\-quarter projects, and create an environment that supports collaboration, development, and meaningful outcomes.


### **Key Responsibilities**

**In this role, you will:**

* Provide direction, coaching, feedback, and technical guidance to a team of analysts and individual contributors.
* Establish team goals, clarify roles and accountabilities, and connect daily work to business priorities.
* Lead delivery across multiple well\-defined, multi\-quarter projects.
* Serve as a technical lead for a defined domain and select appropriate technologies for business and partner needs.
* Partner with Product teams to develop and deliver roadmaps.
* Oversee operational support activities, service performance, response trends, and adherence to established procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve technology, processes, efficiency, and productivity.
* Plan team capacity and allocate financial, material, and technical resources responsibly.
* Build trusted relationships with hotel partners and internal stakeholders by understanding needs and communicating practical solutions.
* Hire, onboard, recognize, and develop team members while supporting professional growth.
* Monitor key performance indicators, communicate team status, and surface risks, dependencies, and opportunities for simplification.
* Contribute to product reviews, communities of practice, and the product development lifecycle from idea through launch and ongoing improvement.

### **Experience and Qualifications**

Required


* 5\+ years of related experience with a bachelor’s degree, or 3\+ years of related experience with a master’s degree.
* 1–3 years of people leadership experience, including coaching, feedback, performance support, and workload planning.
* Experience leading at least three multi\-quarter projects as a technical lead or equivalent individual contributor.
* Experience with multiple technology implementations and selecting technologies for specific business or partner needs.
* Bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or equivalent related professional experience; technical degree preferred, including Information Technology, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related technical field.
* Proficient communication skills and the ability to connect technical concepts with business priorities.

Preferred


* Experience supporting hotel, hospitality, travel, or partner\-facing technology solutions.
* Experience partnering with Product teams on roadmaps and product development.
* Experience supporting technology operations or service management.
Experience identifying process improvements and using metrics to evaluate outcomes.  
*

**About Expedia Group**

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Infra Tech Support Practitioner
description:
**Project Role :** Infra Tech Support Practitioner  

**Project Role Description :** Provide L1–L2 technical support for infrastructure, systems, and applications in production and development environments, both remotely and onsite, following defined operating models and processes. Act as the primary interface with users/clients to accurately diagnose issues and deliver effective resolutions across infrastructure, operating systems, networks, and application platforms, ensuring service stability and quality support.
  

**Must have skills :** Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

As an Infra Tech Support Practitioner, a typical day involves delivering first and second level technical assistance for infrastructure, systems, and applications across both production and development settings. This role requires working closely with users and clients to identify and resolve issues efficiently, ensuring smooth operation and stability of services. The position includes providing support through remote and onsite engagements, adhering to established procedures and operational frameworks to maintain high\-quality service delivery and minimize downtime.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:
  

* AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform and Azure DevOps.

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to Kubernetes, AKS clusters and related components like Istio, GitOps, Autoscaling, Helm, Kustomize etc. Need to troubleshoot issues related to Terraform during AKS Cluster deployment.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure.
  

  

ITSM: Need to work on incidents, Change Requests, RCAs, CMDB etc.
  

  

Documentation: Need to create documentation related to AKS.
  

  

Shifts and On\-call: Need to work on night shifts and on\-calls on a rotational basis, as and when required by the team.
  

  

Meetings and Calls: Need to participate in various calls and discussions with different teams as AKS SME and to share required inputs as Kubernetes / AKS SME.  

  

  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:
  

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure DevOps.


Kubernetes : In\-depth knowledge of Kubernetes concepts, architecture, and administration.
  

  

Should have in\-depth knowledge on core Kubernetes concepts like Pods, Deployments, Services, Namespaces, PVs, PVCs, Storage Classes, Role Assignments, Kubernetes Networking, PDBs, HPA etc. Need to have proficiency on working with kubectl tool. Need to have good knowledge and understanding on YAML files related to Kubernetes.
  

  

AKS : Should have in\-depth knowledge on AKS concepts like Node Pools, AKS RBAC, AKS upgradation, Node OS upgradation, AKS Monitoring, AKS Logging, Workload Identity etc.
  

  

Azure DevOps: Working knowledge of Azure DevOps , which includes Azure Repo, branching strategy, pull requests, and git commands. Must know how to use Azure DevOps through IDE tool like VS Code.
  

  

Azure : Proficiency in using Azure services, especially Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  

  

Should have good knowledge on Azure Services like VNet, Subnet, UDR, NSG, Private Endpoint, Private DNS, Managed Identity, Role Assignment, Key Vault, Storage Account , Load Balancer etc.
  

  

Terraform: Should have experience in using terraform to deploy Azure Services and AKS Cluster.
  

  

AKS Cluster Provisioning and Configuration: Deploy and set up AKS clusters with appropriate configurations using Terraform.
  

  

Monitoring and Logging: Should have good knowledge on monitoring and logging solutions to gain insights into cluster performance, application behavior, and resource usage.
  

  

Security: Should have good knowledge on security best practices for AKS, including RBAC (Role\-Based Access Control), network policies, and secure container images.
  

  

Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve issues related to AKS clusters, Kubernetes, Terraform, and infrastructure components.
  

  

Upgrades and Patches: Plan and perform AKS upgrades and apply security patches to keep the clusters up\-to\-date and secure, using in\-line or blue\-green upgradation approach.
  

  

GitOps : Working knowledge of any of the GitOps tool (Flux / ArgoCD) is preferred.
  

  

Service Mesh : Knowledge of a Service Mesh product (ex: Istio) is preferred.
  

  

Troubleshooting Skills: Ability to diagnose and resolve issues related to Kubernetes and containerized applications.
  

  

Cloud Native Ecosystem: Awareness of other cloud\-native tools and technologies such as Istio, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines.
  

  

Communication and Teamwork: Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross\-functional teams.
  

  

Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Kubernetes.
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

title: Head of International Sales
description:
**Earning a living should never cost a life.** 




  





 That's why Duratuf exists — and the one thing that limits how fast we grow is how fast we hire the right people.
 **That's your seat.** 




  





**About Duratuf** 




 We're an industrial safety company in Kolkata, with our own office and warehouse in the UAE. Our equipment keeps workers safe at 4,142\+ customers across 65\+ countries — when it works, someone gets to go home to their family. We're on our way to 10,000 protected workplaces by 2035\.
 



  





**Why this role exists** 




 This role owns that journey. You'll be the single accountable owner of the international GP number, the international sales team, the CRM, and — most critically — the international channel and distribution network that will carry Duratuf worldwide.
 



 You won't inherit a machine. You'll build one.
 



  





**What will you own end to end** 



* The number. Carry and grow a multi\-crore international GP number targeting \~5x growth over three years. Once the plan is jointly locked, you own execution end\-to\-end — no relitigating.
* The channel. Build (not just manage) our international partner and distribution network — a tracked funnel from Identified to Scaled, a growing active\-partner base each year, dormant markets reactivated, and top partners graduated to distributor tiers.
* Retention. Grow to 1,000 active workplaces with real discipline — every customer classified by buying frequency, a weekly at\-risk report, and a recovery playbook you own.
* New categories. Take every new safety product to market internationally with a country\-by\-country GTM plan.
* The team. Hire, lead, and retain the international sales team, scaling from 2–3 to 6–10 — on a real operating rhythm of weekly reviews and quarterly scorecards.



  





**Must Have** 



* 10–14 years in international B2B industrial sales, having carried a real export GP number (safety, PPE, electricals, industrial, or adjacent)
* A partner network you built — and can name, with outcomes attached
* 3–6 distributed direct reports managed, with documented quota and retention results
* Depth across at least two of MENA / SEA / Africa / LATAM / CIS
* A CRM\-led approach — you run forecast, pipeline, and coaching from the CRM, not on top of it
* Export ops fluency: Incoterms, LC/TT, shipping docs; comfort across INR and AED flows
* Margin literacy and integrity that holds under pressure



  





**What success look like** 



* GP delivered at or above plan, quarter after quarter
* A partner network that's growing, active, and paying on time
* ≥85% of active workplaces retained year on year
* Team quota attainment ≥90%, regrettable attrition under 10%
* Rolling forecast accuracy within ±10%
* Top\-20 key accounts growing ≥20% YoY
* 3–5 new countries a year that genuinely move the number



  





**Good to have** 



* Electrical safety, PPE, or broader industrial safety background
* Experience across a dual\-entity (India \+ UAE) export structure
* Familiarity with the Zoho One ecosystem
* A warm distributor network in MENA, Africa, or SE Asia
* Exposure to EOS / Scaling Up / OKR frameworks



  





**Why Join Duratuf** 



* **Work that matters** 
 — a mission you can point to without a slide
* **Global exposure without leaving Kolkata** 
 — 65\+ markets, our own UAE entity
* **AI\-first, genuinely** 
 — a paid Claude account from Day 1, AI on every req
* **Discipline, not chaos** 
 — we run on Scaling Up: quarterly priorities, weekly rhythms
* **You build it** 
 — the engine you create becomes the backbone of a much bigger team



  





 We hire on values, not just skill — Disciplined Execution · Us Before I · Result Oriented · Inclusive Collaboration · Always Innovating · Numbers that Matter.
 



  





 How We Hire
 



 Simple, fair, and fast — a first call, a detailed interview with the CEO, a values conversation, and reference checks. Every candidate hears back at every stage.
 



  





**Apply — let's talk.**

title: Corporate Talent Acquisition Lead – India
description:
**Overview:** 




  





 TekWissen Group is a workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world.
 



  





**Position: Corporate Talent Acquisition Lead – India** 




**Location: Bengaluru** 




**Work Type: Onsite** 




**Job Type: Full\-Time – Supports PAN India** 




**Function: Corporate Human Resources / Talent Acquisition** 




**Reporting To: Head of Human Resources / Senior Leadership** 




**Shift: 11 am to 8 pm IST.** 




  





**Job Description:** 




**Role Overview** 



* TekWissen is looking for a highly driven, creative, and business\-oriented Corporate Talent Acquisition Lead – India to lead corporate recruitment across the organization.
* This role is designed for a Talent Acquisition professional who goes beyond traditional recruitment.
* We are looking for someone who can build talent pipelines before positions open, understand the market before hiring begins, create innovative sourcing strategies for niche talent, and continuously improve the quality, speed, experience, and ROI of hiring.
* The ideal candidate should have demonstrated experience in building creative recruitment campaigns, Recruiterathons, Hackathons, hiring projects, talent communities, employee referral initiatives, campus/fresher programs, niche\-role sourcing strategies, and data\-driven recruitment programs.
* This individual will partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders across TekWissen's business units and will own the recruitment lifecycle from workforce planning and talent intelligence through sourcing, screening, selection, offer management, onboarding, and post\-joining hiring effectiveness.



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**1\.Corporate Talent Acquisition Leadership** 



* Own and drive end\-to\-end corporate recruitment for TekWissen across PAN India.
* Manage hiring across multiple functions and business areas, including:
* Staffing / Recruitment
* Talent Acquisition
* Corporate HR / HR Operations
* Learning \& Development
* Finance \& Accounts
* Information Technology
* Software / Engineering
* Networking / Infrastructure
* Data \& Analytics
* Back Office / Operations
* Call Center / Customer Support
* Business Support Functions
* Internships
* Graduate / Fresher Hiring
* Specialized and niche corporate positions
* Build scalable recruitment strategies based on business requirements, talent availability, urgency, and role complexity.



**2\.Strategic Hiring Manager Partnership** 



* Establish TA as a strategic business partner rather than a requisition\-processing function.
* Conduct structured weekly connects with hiring managers and business leaders.
* Understand current hiring requirements as well as upcoming workforce needs.
* Build forward\-looking hiring forecasts.
* Understand skill gaps, replacement requirements, growth plans, and future organizational requirements.
* Challenge and refine hiring requirements where appropriate.
* Provide market feedback on talent availability, compensation, competition, notice periods, and skill supply.
* Establish clear hiring priorities, timelines, and recruitment strategies for every business unit.
* Maintain continuous communication with stakeholders until positions are successfully closed.



  





**Hiring Manager Pulse** 



* Create a regular hiring\-manager pulse mechanism to understand:
* Quality of profiles
* Interview effectiveness
* Recruitment turnaround time
* Candidate quality
* Offer acceptance
* Candidate experience
* Communication effectiveness
* Areas requiring improvement



**3\.Recruitment Innovation \& Out\-of\-the\-Box Hiring** 



* We are specifically looking for someone who can rethink how recruitment is done.
* The TA Lead will be expected to conceptualize and execute innovative hiring initiatives such as:
* Recruiterathons
* Hiring Hackathons
* Talent Hackathons
* Recruitment Drives
* Mass Hiring Events
* Virtual Hiring Days
* Skill\-based hiring campaigns
* Niche Talent Campaigns
* Talent Communities
* Passive Candidate Engagement Programs
* Employee Referral Campaigns
* Campus Hiring Initiatives
* Fresher Talent Programs
* Alumni Talent Networks
* Competitor Talent Mapping
* Geo\-specific Talent Drives
* Social Recruiting Campaigns
* AI\-enabled sourcing initiatives
* Recruitment contests and sourcing challenges
* Specialized hiring projects for difficult\-to\-fill positions



 The candidate should continuously ask:
 


* “Is there a better, faster, smarter or more creative way to hire this talent?”



**4\. Niche \& Difficult\-to\-Fill Role Strategy** 



* Develop customized sourcing strategies for niche, specialized, confidential, or difficult\-to\-close positions.
* For every critical role, evaluate:
* Talent pool availability
* Competitor organizations
* Relevant industries
* Target companies
* Geographic talent concentration
* Compensation benchmarks
* Notice\-period trends
* Candidate movement
* Skill availability
* Talent seniority
* Hiring feasibility
* Create role\-specific talent acquisition plans rather than applying a one\-size\-fits\-all recruitment model.



**5\. Market Intelligence \& Competitor Mapping** 



* Build a strong Talent Market Intelligence capability for TekWissen.
* Regularly monitor:
* Competitor hiring trends
* Talent movement
* Emerging skill sets
* Salary trends
* Hiring hotspots
* Talent availability by location
* Competitor organizational growth
* Hiring volumes
* Attrition trends where information is available
* New technology and skill requirements
* Talent acquisition practices
* Industry hiring patterns
* Develop competitor and talent maps for strategically important roles.
* Provide leadership with actionable insights such as:
* Where is the talent?
* Who is hiring the talent?
* What are they paying?
* What skills are emerging?
* Where should TekWissen hire?
* What talent should we build pipelines for now?



**6\. Workforce \& Hiring Forecasting** 



* Develop forward\-looking recruitment forecasts in partnership with business leaders.
* Maintain visibility into:
* Current open positions
* Expected upcoming requirements
* Replacement hiring
* Growth hiring
* Seasonal hiring
* Fresher / internship requirements
* Critical skill requirements
* Anticipated hiring challenges
* Talent availability
* Recruitment capacity
* Create proactive talent pipelines for future requirements rather than waiting for requisitions to open.



**7\. Candidate Screening \& Selection** 



* Own the quality of candidates entering the interview process.
* Responsibilities include:
* Resume screening
* Candidate qualification
* Initial recruiter interviews
* Competency assessment
* Communication and behavioral assessment
* Compensation discussions
* Notice\-period validation
* Motivation and career assessment
* Role\-fit evaluation
* Candidate profiling
* Interview coordination
* Hiring\-manager feedback management
* For critical roles, provide hiring managers with structured candidate summaries and market context.



**8\. Spotlight Calls \& Candidate Engagement** 



* Develop a strong candidate engagement process throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Own or coordinate:
* Spotlight calls
* Candidate expectation setting
* Role discussions
* Career opportunity conversations
* Interview preparation
* Offer discussions
* Counter\-offer management
* Joining commitment
* Pre\-joining engagement
* Ensure candidates receive a consistent and professional TekWissen experience from first contact through joining.



**9\. Offer Management \& Closure** 



* Drive the complete offer process and maximize offer\-to\-join conversion.
* Monitor:
* Offers released
* Offer acceptance
* Offer declines
* Counter offers
* Dropouts
* Notice periods
* Joining commitments
* Joining conversions
* Identify patterns behind offer declines and develop corrective strategies.



**10\. Onboarding \& Post\-Hire Talent Analytics** 



* Recruitment success should not end when the candidate joins.
* The TA Lead will establish a 1–90 Day New Hire Success Measurement framework.
* Track and analyze:
* **Day 1–7**
* Joining experience
* Onboarding completion
* Documentation
* Initial engagement



  




* **Day 30**
* Manager feedback
* Role alignment
* Early performance indicators
* Employee experience
* Potential concerns



  




* **Day 60**
* Performance trajectory
* Productivity
* Manager satisfaction
* Engagement



  




* **Day 90**
* Performance
* Productivity
* Retention
* Hiring quality
* Role fit
* Hiring\-manager satisfaction
* Recruitment ROI
* Use these insights to determine which recruitment sources, recruiters, hiring channels, and selection methods produce the best employees.



**11\. Recruitment ROI \& Performance Analytics** 



* Build a data\-driven TA dashboard covering:
* Time to Source
* Time to Screen
* Time to Interview
* Time to Offer
* Time to Hire
* Offer Acceptance Rate
* Offer\-to\-Join Ratio
* Source\-to\-Hire Ratio
* Interview\-to\-Selection Ratio
* Recruitment Funnel Conversion
* Cost per Hire
* Quality of Hire
* 30/60/90\-Day Performance
* Early Attrition
* Hiring Manager Satisfaction
* Candidate Experience
* Recruiter Productivity
* Source Effectiveness
* 
* Move recruitment conversations from:
* “How many people did we hire?”
* to:
* “Did we hire the right people, from the right sources, at the right cost, with the right business outcome?”



**12\. Recruitment Process Improvement** 



* Continuously evaluate and improve the TA operating model.
* Identify opportunities to improve:
* Sourcing
* Screening
* Interview processes
* Interview turnaround time
* Hiring\-manager responsiveness
* Candidate experience
* Offer conversion
* Joining conversion
* Recruitment technology
* Recruitment analytics
* Employer branding
* Talent pipeline development
* Introduce automation, AI tools, analytics, and technology wherever they can improve recruitment effectiveness.



**13\. Employer Branding \& Talent Attraction** 



* Partner with HR and business leadership to strengthen TekWissen's employer brand.
* Develop initiatives across:
* LinkedIn
* Social recruiting
* Employee stories
* Employee referral campaigns
* Hiring campaigns
* Campus branding
* Recruitment events
* Talent communities
* Digital employer branding
* Candidate engagement
* Create compelling campaigns that make TekWissen a destination for high\-quality talent.



**14\. Campus, Internship \& Fresher Hiring** 



* Build scalable programs for:
* Campus recruitment
* Graduate hiring
* Internship programs
* Fresher hiring
* Graduate talent communities
* University partnerships
* Technical hiring events
* Assessment\-based hiring
* Develop a sustainable pipeline of early\-career talent for future organizational growth.



**15\. Recruitment Team Leadership** 



* Depending on organizational structure, the TA Lead may manage recruiters / sourcers and will be responsible for building a high\-performance recruitment culture.
* Responsibilities may include:
* Recruiter productivity
* Recruitment targets
* Funnel management
* Daily / weekly performance reviews
* Coaching and mentoring
* Sourcing strategy
* Quality control
* Recruiter capability development
* Performance management
* Best\-practice sharing
* Encourage recruiters to become Talent Advisors, not simply profile generators.



  





**REQUIRED EXPERIENCE** 




**Essential** 



* 7–12\+ years of progressive Talent Acquisition / Recruitment experience, preferably with significant corporate hiring exposure.
* Experience managing recruitment across multiple functions.
* Strong stakeholder and hiring\-manager management experience.
* Demonstrated experience with niche and difficult\-to\-fill positions.
* Experience building recruitment strategies and talent pipelines.
* Strong understanding of PAN\-India talent markets.
* Strong interviewing and candidate assessment skills.
* Experience with recruitment analytics and metrics.
* Strong communication and influencing capabilities.



  





**Strongly Preferred** 



* Experience in one or more of the following:
* Recruiterathons
* Hackathons
* Hiring Hackathons
* Recruitment campaigns
* Campus hiring programs
* Mass hiring initiatives
* Talent mapping
* Competitor mapping
* Talent intelligence
* Employer branding
* Recruitment analytics
* AI / technology\-enabled recruitment
* Talent community building
* Innovative sourcing programs
* Fresher / internship programs



  





**IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* We are looking for someone who is:
* **Creative** 
 — challenges traditional recruitment methods.
* **Business\-minded** 
 — understands why the business is hiring, not just what position needs to be filled.
* **Data\-driven** 
 — uses metrics and analytics to improve hiring outcomes.
* **Curious** 
 — constantly studies the talent market and competitor landscape.
* **Proactive** 
 — builds talent pipelines before requirements become urgent.
* **Influential** 
 — can partner confidently with hiring managers and business leaders.
* **Experimental** 
 — willing to test new ideas and measure their impact.
* **Execution\-oriented** 
 — turns recruitment ideas into measurable hiring results.
* **Candidate\-focused** 
 — understands that candidate experience directly impacts employer brand and hiring success.



  





**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** 



* The success of this role will be measured through a balanced combination of hiring delivery, quality, stakeholder experience, innovation, and business impact.
* **Hiring Delivery**
* Positions closed
* Time to Hire
* Critical\-role closure
* Hiring forecast accuracy



  




* **Hiring Quality**
* Quality of Hire
* 30/60/90\-day performance
* Early attrition
* Hiring\-manager satisfaction



  




* **Candidate Conversion**
* Screening\-to\-interview ratio
* Interview\-to\-offer ratio
* Offer acceptance rate
* Offer\-to\-join ratio



  




* **Market Intelligence**
* Talent maps created
* Competitor intelligence
* Critical\-skill availability
* Market compensation insights



  




* **Innovation**
* New recruitment initiatives launched
* Recruiterathons / Hackathons
* New sourcing channels
* Talent communities created
* Innovation\-driven hires



  




* **Business Partnership**
* Weekly hiring\-manager connects
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Forecasting accuracy
* Hiring plan adherence



  




* **Recruitment ROI**
* Cost per hire
* Source effectiveness
* Recruiter productivity
* Hiring channel ROI
* New\-hire performance



  





**SUCCESS IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS** 



* **First 30 Days — Understand**
* Understand TekWissen's business units and organizational structure.
* Meet key hiring managers and business stakeholders.
* Review existing recruitment processes and metrics.
* Understand current hiring demand and pipeline.
* Identify critical hiring challenges.
* Conduct an initial talent\-market assessment.



  




* **Days 31–60 — Build**
* Establish hiring\-manager connect cadence.
* Develop hiring forecasts.
* Build talent maps for priority roles.
* Establish recruitment dashboards.
* Identify sourcing gaps.
* Introduce targeted sourcing strategies.
* Launch at least one recruitment innovation initiative.



  




* **Days 61–90 — Transform**
* Establish a repeatable TA operating rhythm.
* Launch proactive talent pipelines.
* Implement market intelligence reporting.
* Establish 30/60/90\-day new\-hire feedback mechanisms.
* Implement recruitment ROI tracking.
* Launch a measurable innovative hiring campaign / Recruiterathon / Hackathon / specialized hiring project.
* Present a Corporate Talent Acquisition Transformation Roadmap to HR leadership.



  





**EDUCATION** 



* Bachelor's degree required.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Talent Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline is preferred.
* Relevant professional certifications in Talent Acquisition, HR Analytics, Sourcing, or related areas will be an advantage.



  





**LOCATION** 



* Visakhapatnam
* The role will support PAN\-India hiring and may require interaction with business leaders, hiring managers, candidates, universities, recruitment partners, and other stakeholders across India.



  





**WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT** 



* This is not a traditional recruitment role.
* The person joining this position will have the opportunity to help build a modern, data\-driven and innovation\-led Corporate Talent Acquisition function at TekWissen.
* We are looking for someone who can move beyond:
* Requisition → Resume → Interview → Offer → Join
* and build:
* Workforce Intelligence → Talent Mapping → Proactive Pipelines → Innovative Hiring → Candidate Experience → Quality of Hire → Performance → Retention → ROI
* If you are someone who enjoys solving difficult hiring problems, experimenting with new recruitment models, understanding talent markets, influencing business leaders, and building scalable talent strategies, this role offers an opportunity to make a significant organizational impact.



  





**Core Philosophy** 



* “Don't wait for talent to apply. Find the talent, understand the talent, engage the talent, and build the right opportunity for the talent.”



  





**TekWissen® Group is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity.**

 Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value\-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Drawing on nearly four centuries of collective experience across Wabtec, GE Transportation, and Faiveley Transport, the company has grown to become One Wabtec, with unmatched digital expertise, technological innovation, and world\-class manufacturing and services, enabling the digital\-rail\-and\-transit ecosystems.
   

  

 Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. We are lifelong learners obsessed with making things better to drive exceptional results. Wabtec has approximately 27K employees in facilities throughout the world. Visit our website to learn more!
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 The TA Partner will be responsible for the strategy, full\-life cycle recruitment and proactive pipelining of senior level talent within the Pan India region. Full life\-cycle recruiting includes consulting with hiring managers to determine critical capabilities, designing the staffing strategy, sourcing and pre\-screening candidates as well as facilitating debrief meetings to ensure the highest quality candidates are hired. The TA Partner will also be responsible for leading the campus recruitment strategy in India and collaborating on global functional projects like diversity and employer branding.
   

  

**Accountabilities:**
 Senior Level Recruitment
   

  

 Continuously build an external talent pipeline by proactively sourcing for high\-quality senior level candidates. Maintain relationships with talent for future opportunities; create and nurture relationships with external agencies/sources of talent, develop creative and alternative external sources of talent and keep on leading edge of external recruitment best practices. Ensure all SLAs and KPIs are met with a high level of performance.
   

  

 Campus
   

  

 Work with internal stakeholders to understand business priorities and talent demand in order to develop the India campus strategy. This includes collaborating with Business Leaders, HRBPs and functional leaders to ensure Wabtec’s LEAD \& intern assignments are fit for purpose as well as building relationships with Campuses and developing a strong brand on campus in order to attract top talent and drive conversion within the organization.
   

  

 Projects
   

  

 Leading projects for the region and in collaboration with other TA team members that benefit the region and / or TA function as a whole. Project can include but aren’t limited to employer branding initiatives, gender diversity, sourcing \& selection activities, etc.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
 Minimum 10 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably having worked in both corporate and agency environment.
   

  

 Demonstrated ability as a Talent Advisor with the capability to create comprehensive recruiting strategies and appropriately influence hiring managers in making sound hiring decisions.

title: Associate Manager HR
description:
**About the Organization** 




  





 At
 **eGov** 
 , we start with citizens and the everyday public services that shape their lives. A parent is bringing a child to a clinic. A family waiting for water . A streetlight that finally gets fixed. In those moments, government is not policy or process—it is lived experience. We believe everyone deserves public services that are
 **accessible, responsive, and transparent** 
 —services that work consistently, reach everyone, and respect people’s time and dignity.
 



  





 To make this possible, we partner closely with governments to strengthen the foundations on which public services run. Our core approach is offering the
 **DIGIT platform** 
 \- a Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI
 **)** 
 \- that helps create shared, reusable digital systems that enable governments to plan, deliver, and monitor public services at scale. DPI is not about a single application or program; it is about creating
 **common rails** 
 that many services, departments, and partners can use over time.
 



  





 But public services do not improve solely through technology. We work with governments on
 **strategy, institutional design, and implementation** 
 , and we help build
 **ecosystems of partners** 
 that can deliver together. By aligning policy, processes, people, financing, and digital systems, we support the state to turn intent into services that work on the ground.
 



  





 Across India, Africa, and other emerging economies, we help governments move from fragmented, project\-led digitisation to
 **durable public infrastructure** 
 that belongs to the state and quietly improves public services day after day. When this works well, citizens may never see the systems behind it—but they feel the difference in how services show up in their lives.
 



  





 We currently work in 10 countries, and more than 1 billion people and hundreds of sectoral public services systems have been built on DIGIT.
 



  





 You’ll thrive here if you:
 


* Care deeply about citizens and the quality of public services
* Believe strong state capacity is essential to inclusive development
* Enjoy working across strategy, partnerships, and execution
* Want to build systems that endure beyond individual projects



  





 We are strategists, technologists, momentum builders, and partners—but above all, people committed to
 **making public services work better for everyone** 
 .
 



  





**Why Work With Us?** 




**Make Large\-Scale Impact:** 
 Contribute to initiatives that drive significant societal change at national and global levels.

 Gain mentorship from experienced professionals across our ecosystem.

* Identify skill gaps and support learning \& development initiatives

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

 **HRBP roles \+ HR Operations**

title: HR Commercial Pilot Partner — Retention Risk Investigation & Intervention
description:
**You don't know they're going to leave.** 

  




**You just know something isn't right.** 

  






 You have an employee you really don't want to lose.
 




  






 They're valuable. They're still delivering. There hasn't been a resignation. There may not even be an obvious problem.
 




  






 But something has changed.
 




  






 Maybe their behaviour is different.
 





 Maybe their workload has become unsustainable.
 





 Maybe their engagement is slipping.
 





 Maybe they've been waiting too long for a promotion.
 





 Maybe something has changed with their manager.
 





 Maybe compensation has started bothering them.
 




  






 You don't know yet.
 




  





**And that's where the work begins.** 




  






 You start looking.
 




  






 You pull information from the HRIS. You look at performance history. You check engagement or pulse data. You look at compensation. You speak to the manager. You look at previous conversations. You search for other signals that might explain what you're seeing.
 




  






 One piece points in one direction. Another piece points somewhere else.
 




  






 So you investigate further.
 




  






 You speak to the manager again.
 




  






 You try to understand whether this is temporary or structural. Whether it's workload, compensation, career progression, management, recognition, something personal, or something you haven't even considered yet.
 




  






 Eventually, you have to speak with the employee.
 




  






 So you prepare.
 




  






 What should you ask?
 




  






 How should you approach the conversation?
 




  






 What should you avoid saying?
 




  






 How do you make sure you don't turn a sensitive retention conversation into something that actually accelerates disengagement?
 




  






 You have the conversation.
 




  






 And now you have even more information.
 




  






 But you're still left with the hardest part:
 




  





**What do I actually do about this?** 




  






 Which signal matters most?
 




  






 What is the real underlying problem?
 




  






 How serious is the risk?
 




  






 What intervention has the best chance of working?
 




  






 Do you change the workload?
 




  






 Redesign the role?
 




  






 Address compensation?
 




  






 Change something in the manager\-employee relationship?
 




  






 Accelerate a career conversation?
 




  






 Do something else entirely?
 




  






 And what happens if you get the decision wrong?
 




  






 Do nothing, and you may lose someone you could have retained.
 




  






 Act incorrectly, and you may make the situation worse.
 




  






 Meanwhile, there are other employees, other managers, other business problems and other HR priorities waiting for you.
 




  






 And then another employee needs investigating.
 




  






 And another.
 




  






 And another.
 




  






 This is the retention job HR is already being paid to do.
 




  






 The problem isn't that HR doesn't know how to retain people.
 




  





**The problem is how much manual intelligence work sits between noticing a problem and knowing what to do about it.** 




  






 Today, getting this job done can mean moving between multiple systems, gathering fragmented information, speaking with multiple people, connecting weak signals, interpreting incomplete evidence, preparing conversations, documenting what happened, deciding what action to take and then following up to see whether that action actually worked.
 




  






 The HRBP is doing the job.
 




  





**But the intelligence required to do the job is fragmented around them.** 




  






 That's the thing we're trying to change.
 




  




**What if you could move through that same situation without having to carry all of that manual intelligence work yourself?** 

  






 Imagine facing that same employee with Mindpex.
 




  






 Instead of searching across different systems for the information you need,
 
**Mindpex brings the relevant information together in one place** 

 — so you can start investigating the situation without first having to assemble the pieces yourself.
 




  





 Instead of manually piecing scattered signals together,
 **Mindpex lets you investigate the employee as one retention case** 

 — with the information and context connected around that case.
 




  





 Instead of wondering what to ask or how to approach a sensitive conversation,
 **Mindpex gives you conversation guidance and a game plan for that particular situation** 

 — so you know how to approach the conversation and what to avoid.
 




  





 So you don't walk into the conversation guessing.
 



  





**You have a game plan.** 




  






 You have the conversation.
 




  






 Then, instead of having to manually make sense of everything you just heard,
 
**Mindpex helps interpret the conversation in the context of the employee's other signals and information** 

 — so you can understand what the conversation means for the case.
 




  





 Instead of reaching the hardest question —
 **“What do I actually do now?”** 

 — and having to work out the intervention yourself,
 
**Mindpex helps identify the underlying issue, the intervention to consider, and the actions to take in that particular context.** 




  






 And instead of starting the investigation over every time new information emerges,
 
**you can keep adding context to the same case** 

 — allowing the investigation and guidance to become more refined as you learn more.
 




  





 So the job is still the same.
 



**You are still investigating the employee.** 




**You are still having the conversation.** 




**You are still making the decision.** 




**You are still responsible for the outcome.** 




  






 But the obstacles between
 
**“something has changed”** 

 and
 
**“I know what to do about it”** 

 are no longer yours to navigate manually at every step.
 




  





**Mindpex helps you make progress through the job.** 




  





**The HR professional remains the decision\-maker. Mindpex does the intelligence work around that decision.** 




  






 It helps turn scattered signals and conversations into a structured retention case — so you can spend less time piecing the situation together and more time actually doing something about it.
 




  




**That's what we're testing.** 

  






 Not whether another HR dashboard looks interesting.
 





 Not whether AI can generate another HR report.
 




  





**Whether Mindpex can actually get this retention job done better than the way you're doing it today.** 




  






 We're looking for our first
 
**commercial pilot partners** 

 .
 




  





 If you are currently employed in an HR/People role and you recognize this problem from your own work, we want to test Mindpex with you.
 



  





 This is a
 **paid commercial pilot run by your organization.** 




  






 Your organization would pay Mindpex to run the pilot on a real retention problem it is facing. The purpose is simple:
 
**test whether Mindpex can actually help your team get this job done better in practice.** 




  






 This is not a free feedback exercise, and
 
**we are not paying you to participate.** 




  






 You will be able to use Mindpex on a real retention problem in your organization and determine for yourself whether it creates enough value to become part of the way you do this work.
 




  






 If you read the situation above and thought:
 




  





**“Yes. We do this manually.”** 




  





**“Yes. This takes far more time and cognitive effort than it should.”** 




  





**“Yes. We have had situations where we had all the information but still weren't sure what to do.”** 




  






 Then we'd like to hear from you.
 




  





**If your organization is willing to pay for a commercial pilot to test whether Mindpex can solve this problem, apply below.**

title: Human Centered Change Manager
description:
**Description**
 As a Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. Leading essential change management and enablement initiatives, you will establish the groundwork for successful and enduring change adoption, using AI\-enabled delivery practices. Additionally, you will provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to members of the project team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Change Leadership:**
* Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.
* Analyze the human impact of technological changes and develop adaptive strategies to address organizational challenges.


**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**
* Proactively foster high\-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy\-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.


**Key Change Management Initiatives**
* Lead critical change management and enablement activities to facilitate successful and sustained change adoption.
* Design and implement tailored training programs for stakeholders at all levels to ensure effective utilization of Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to align user experience design with change management strategies, ensuring user\-centric adoption of Salesforce solutions.


**Oversight And Mentoring**
* Provide oversight, coaching, and mentoring to project team members, guiding them in executing change management strategies effectively.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within the project team.
* Facilitate the integration of change management processes into Salesforce.com projects.
* Work closely with Salesforce.com administrators, BAs, Solutions Architects and developers to understand system changes and ensure alignment with change management strategies.
* Support team upskilling in user experience principles to strengthen collaboration with design teams and improve the effectiveness of training, communications, and adoption strategies.


**Qualifications**
* Prosci Certification or equivalent is mandatory, with demonstrated expertise in change management and training within the context of technology implementations. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.
* Background in technology or digital transformation projects, showcasing advanced problem\-solving abilities and analytical acumen.
* Minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience in change management, with a strong foundation in Instructional Design.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI\-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is considered advantageous.


**Overview**
 The Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, is a pivotal leader who drives transformative change within organizations by prioritizing the human aspect of change and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Salesforce platform capabilities. If you are a seasoned Change Management Professional with a track record of success in guiding organizations through complex technology implementations, we invite you to apply and contribute to our mission of driving impactful and sustainable change.

title: HRIS Senior Associate -  Data, Reporting & Testing
description:
**Summary:** 




 The Indus HRIS Senior Associate – Techno\-Functional Data, Reporting \& Testing plays a critical role in enabling scalable, compliant, and audit\-ready HR data operations within Oracle HCM as the organization expands across countries, legal entities, and integrated systems. This role combines
 



 functional HR process understanding with technical HRIS execution, owning expanded responsibilities across HR reporting rationalization, country\-specific regulatory and audit reporting (including ISQM\-equivalent requirements), and complex testing efforts supporting entity onboarding and integrations.
 



 The Senior Associate operates with a high degree of independence may serve as a bridge between HR, Compliance, and IT by translating business and regulatory requirements into technical reporting logic, data validations, and testing outcomes.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




**Techno\-Functional Reporting \& Data Ownership** 



* Own and enhance HR reporting solutions within Oracle HCM (OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts), translating functional HR and regulatory requirements into technical report logic.
* Collaboration on the rationalization, standardization, and streamlining of existing HR reports by assessing business usage, aligning data definitions, and eliminating duplication across countries and entities.
* Design and support country\-specific regulatory, compliance, and audit reporting, including requirements aligned to ISQM\-equivalent control frameworks.
* Perform advanced data analysis and reconciliation, validating report outputs against Oracle HCM source data and downstream integrations.
* Define and maintain functional and technical documentation, including data definitions, report logic, transformation rules, and checkpoints.



**Testing \& Integration Validation** 




 Participate and/or lead end\-to\-end testing efforts for new country/entity onboarding, configuration changes, and HR system integrations.
 



 Develop and execute detailed test scenarios and scripts that reflect real HR business processes (hire, transfer, termination, organizational changes) and country\-specific variations.
 



 Validate integrations through source\-to\-target testing, ensuring accuracy of employee, assignment, organizational, and regulatory data.
 



 Own defect triage, root cause analysis, and retesting, partnering with HRIS, IT, and vendors through resolution.
 



 Coordinate and execute regression testing for reporting, extracts, and integrations following releases or configuration changes.
 



**Controls, Audit \& Risk Management** 



* Support HRIS control frameworks by ensuring reporting and testing processes meet documented control standards and audit expectations.
* Prepare and maintain audit\-ready evidence, including reconciliations, test results, report logic, and approvals.
* Proactively identify data and control risks introduced by new countries, entities, or integrations and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Support internal and external audits related to HR systems, reporting accuracy, and data controls.



**Stakeholder Partnership \& Functional Leadership** 



* Act as a techno\-functional SME for HR reporting and testing within the HRIS team.
* Collaborate with IT and integration teams to align functional requirements with technical solutions (APIs, extracts, downstream feeds).
* Mentor Associate\-level team members and contribute to continuous improvement of HRIS reporting and testing standards.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications:** 



* 4–7\+ years of experience in HRIS, HR technology, or HR data roles with both functional and technical responsibilities.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle HCM data structures and reporting tools.
* Demonstrated experience owning testing activities for HR processes, integrations, or multi\-entity implementations.
* Ability to translate business, regulatory, and audit requirements into technical reporting and testing solutions.
* Proven experience working in audit\-sensitive, controlled environments.
* Experience supporting multi\-country HR implementations and local regulatory reporting.
* Strong documentation, analytical, and stakeholder communication skills.
* Demonstrates the ability to effectively prioritize competing priorities and pivot focus as business needs evolve, particularly in response to regulatory deadlines, country/entity expansion, and integration\-driven dependencies.



  





**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Advanced experience with OTBI, BI Publisher, HCM Extracts, HDL/HSDL.
* Exposure to system integrations (payroll, benefits, IAM, finance, data warehouse/ODS).
* Familiarity with ISQM or equivalent quality, audit, or control frameworks.
* Basic SQL or data querying skills for validation and analysis

* 7\+ years of experience preferred in enterprise application support, enhancements, or transformation initiatives
* Experience supporting Workbrain and/or Kronos in a global environment
* Experience in production support, system enhancements, testing, and release management
* Experience working with third\-party vendors, implementation partners, and cross\-functional business teams
* Experience in workforce management, timekeeping, scheduling, attendance, and payroll\-related processes preferred

* Experience supporting incident management, problem management, and system stabilization activities

* Experience gathering and translating business requirements into practical system solutions
* Demonstrated ability to analyze processes, data, and system impacts and recommend improvements
* Understanding of integrations, interfaces, and downstream payroll impacts

* Ability to work effectively in ambiguity and manage multiple priorities

* Ability to define business requirements and collaborate across cross\-functional global teams

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Location:**

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
**Job ID:**

R0144794
**Date Posted:**

2026\-09\-17
**Company Name:**

HITACHI ENERGY INDIA LIMITED
**Profession (Job Category):**

Human Resources
**Job Schedule:**

Full time
**Remote:**

No
**Job Description:**

**The Opportunity:**

Hitachi Energy is currently looking for a Talent Partner to join their team in Bengaluru **,** India. This team seeks a skilled and motivated Talent Acquisition professional. The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast\-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible in accommodating business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask \& deliver within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills.


This role will be reporting into Talent Acquisition Manager in India. You will be responsible for supporting the development of expert services within the Country, while developing and retaining a skilled workforce in line with Global and business strategies. You will play a vital role in the Talent Acquisition function, partnering with the business and HR business partners to provide technical expertise and solutions to current and future challenges.


**Your Responsibilities**

* Delivering the talent acquisition processes required to implement global talent strategies on a local level, working with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and line managers to gain insight into the business talent needs and challenges.
* Managing the Talent Sourcing in recruitment process: planning recruitment campaigns, identifying and working on sourcing solutions and working very closely with other talent partners.
* Responsible for actively sourcing, building and maintaining network of potential candidates through pro\-active market research and on\-going relationship management; conducts assessment of potential candidates, demonstrating ability to anticipate hiring manager preferences through high offer\-to\-interview ratios.
* Identifying, initiating and managing multiple recruiting campaign, programs on social media platform.
* Liaising with external recruitment firms for specific positions as required, ensuring that they have been provided with appropriate job briefs, and are providing candidates who fulfilling the requirements.
* Identifying areas for improvement in current practices, processes, and policies, then contributing to the design, development, and implementation of new talent solutions.
* Ensuring personal and organizational compliance with local legislation and HR policies, GDPR and any other data privacy requirements, and adherence to OHS and compliance standards.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

**Your background**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, with 7 \- 10 years of professional HR experience in a high performing global organization\- preferred in manufacturing / automation /EPC industry.
* Relevant work experience in full recruiting lifecycle includes job briefing, active sourcing, developing recruitment plan, candidate outreach, offer and close.
* Hands on experience in workday will be beneficial.
* Demonstrated success with various recruiting strategies, techniques, and platforms, including the use of digital and social media.
* Strong end\-to\-end process thinking with experience in managing multiple projects.
* Proven ability to lead, consult, and influence others while maintaining a focus on customer service.
* Self\-driven, resilient, energetic, enthusiastic, and inclusive; creating or responding constructively to challenging new ideas and inputs. Fluency in English with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in both spoken \& written English language is required.

**Accessibility and reasonable accommodation**

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

  

**This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.**

  

**Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al\-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision\-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**  

  

**Background Screening and Security Checks**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre\-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

**For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security\-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.**

**The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.**
