title: Applications Engineering, Sr Engineer - PrimeTime
description:
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India


**Category** Engineering **Hire Type** Employee **Job ID** 18827 **Date posted** 09/16/2026
### **We Are**


Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You treat ambiguity as an invitation to bring clarity, not as a reason to slow down. Stepping into complex, high\-stakes moments with a steady presence comes naturally to you. You listen carefully for what's unsaid, ask the questions that unlock momentum, and align people around the real problem, not just the loudest symptom. Tight timelines and high expectations energize you because you know how to prioritize what matters, communicate tradeoffs early, and keep progress visible without creating noise.


Partnership over posturing defines how you approach customers and internal teams. The back\-and\-forth of discovery energizes you, and you naturally translate between technical, business, and everything in between so decisions get made with confidence. You don't just deliver answers. You build trust by being transparent, direct, and constructive, especially when the message is hard. When something breaks, curiosity and methodical thinking guide you as you trace causes with patience while keeping the bigger picture in view.


Constantly looking for leverage is part of who you are. Patterns reveal themselves to you, one\-off fixes become repeatable playbooks, and you leave behind cleaner processes than you found. Precision balanced with pragmatism helps you know when to go deep and when to move forward with a well\-framed assumption. Above all, you bring a collaborative intensity that is calm, driven, and generous, helping the team move faster together while keeping quality and integrity non\-negotiable.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Support Synopsys PrimeTime Static Timing Analysis tool across pre\-sale evaluations, post\-sale deployments, and ongoing customer engagements
* Drive product adoption by running competitive benchmarks, leading customer evaluations, and articulating technical advantages to design teams and engineering management
* Deliver customer training sessions, technical presentations, and hands\-on workshops that maximize user proficiency and satisfaction with PrimeTime
* Provide tape\-out support by troubleshooting complex timing issues, resolving signal integrity problems, and ensuring successful project completion under deadline pressure
* Collaborate with R\&D, product marketing, and sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence product enhancements, and shape roadmap priorities
* Develop and maintain technical documentation, best practices guides, and knowledge base resources that scale your expertise across the customer base
* Participate in advanced customer collaboration initiatives that drive innovation, uncover new use cases, and strengthen long\-term partnerships

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Accelerate customer project timelines by enabling efficient use of PrimeTime and optimizing design flows that remove timing closure bottlenecks
* Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through expert support, proactive problem\-solving, and training that builds internal capability
* Strengthen Synopsys' leadership in static timing analysis and semiconductor design solutions by delivering measurable wins in competitive engagements
* Facilitate feedback loops between customers and internal teams that drive continuous innovation in product features, usability, and performance
* Empower customers to achieve superior chip performance, power efficiency, and cost optimization that directly affect their product success
* Contribute to successful tape\-outs and high\-impact design wins for industry\-leading clients building next\-generation silicon
* Build reusable methodologies and documentation that multiply your impact across the global customer base and internal teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Deep hands\-on expertise in Synopsys PrimeTime STA tool, including advanced features, timing analysis methodologies, and real\-world application across multiple design nodes
* Strong understanding of timing corners, process variations, signal integrity issues, and how they affect timing closure in modern semiconductor designs
* Familiarity with synthesis, physical design, extraction, and ECO methodologies, and how they integrate with static timing analysis workflows
* Proficiency in TCL scripting for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience in customer\-facing roles, experience delivering technical training or presentations is a plus
* BSEE or equivalent with 3\+ years of relevant experience, or MSEE or equivalent with 4 years of experience in applications engineering, design, or verification roles

### **Who You Are**

* You collaborate naturally, valuing diverse perspectives and fostering environments where different technical viewpoints strengthen the outcome
* Proactive problem\-solving defines your approach. You work independently, manage multiple priorities without losing threads, and know when to escalate or pull in help
* Adaptable and resilient, you thrive when priorities shift, timelines compress, or technical challenges require creative thinking under pressure
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to delivering high\-quality results, you catch the edge cases and corner conditions that others miss
* You can explain a complex timing closure tradeoff to a customer VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and then turn around and debug a TCL script with an engineer
* You notice when a customer question signals a deeper workflow issue, and you address both the immediate ask and the underlying gap

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You'll join a talented applications engineering team that supports the industry\-leading Static Timing Analysis tool, PrimeTime. The team's core purpose is to drive increased product usage, ensure customer success, and collaborate closely with R\&D, marketing, and sales to foster innovation. Together, you will enable customers to build next\-generation silicon chips faster and more efficiently, playing a vital role in Synopsys' global leadership in chip design and verification.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.


At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
### **Job Description**


**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**



When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.


### **Job Description**


### **Key Responsibilities**


* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to develop and execute recruitment strategies aligned with organizational goals and workforce plans.
* Provide market intelligence, talent insights, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, including sourcing, screening, interviewing, assessment coordination, reference checks, offer negotiation, and onboarding support.
* Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Candidate Relationship Management (CRM) platforms, and advanced sourcing tools to identify and engage top talent.
* Build and maintain robust talent pipelines to support current and future hiring needs.
* Implement sourcing strategies focused on attracting diverse and high\-quality talent while optimizing time\-to\-fill and cost\-per\-hire metrics.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through proactive communication and effective stakeholder management.
* Monitor recruitment metrics and leverage workforce analytics to improve hiring outcomes and process efficiencies.
* Promote employer branding initiatives and represent the organization positively in the talent marketplace.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, employment legislation, and recruitment best practices.


**Skill Descriptors**


### **Relationship Management**


**Knowledge of relationship management techniques and the ability to establish and maintain productive relationships with business leaders, candidates, vendors, and peers.**


* Influences hiring managers and business leaders through data\-driven recommendations.
* Builds and maintains long\-term partnerships with key stakeholders and external vendors.

### **Customer/Market Focus**


**Understanding of evolving market trends and the ability to respond to customer and business needs in a manner that consistently adds value.**


* Identifies expressed and unexpressed business talent needs.
* Aligns recruiting strategies to critical business objectives.

### **Recruitment Channel Management**


**Knowledge of selecting, implementing, and managing recruitment channels to support talent acquisition objectives.**


* Utilizes multiple recruitment channels to attract top talent.
* Identifies and manages cost\-effective sourcing partners and recruitment vendors.

### **Candidate Screening**


**Knowledge of effective candidate assessment and screening methodologies.**


* Screens candidates for professional, technical, and leadership roles.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies and recruitment standards throughout the screening process.

### **Candidate Sourcing**


**Knowledge of sourcing techniques, methods, and tools to attract top talent.**


* Develops and executes multi\-channel sourcing strategies.
* Advises business leaders on talent availability and sourcing approaches.
* Benchmarks sourcing strategies against industry best practices.

### **Staffing and Recruiting**


**Knowledge of staffing strategies, recruiting processes, and talent acquisition best practices.**


* Manages complex recruitment assignments across multiple business functions.
* Consults with stakeholders on workforce planning, recruitment strategies, and talent availability.

### **Workforce Analytics**


**Knowledge of HR metrics, workforce trends, and reporting methodologies that support informed business decisions.**


* Analyzes recruitment and workforce data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Generates reports and dashboards to support leadership decision\-making.

### **Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* **At minimal 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruiting, or Human Resources.**
* Proven experience managing end\-to\-end recruitment for technical, professional hiring.
* Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
* Experience using ATS, CRM platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing technologies.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-volume recruitment environment preferred.


This position requires working onsite five days a week.



Relocation is available for this position.


**Posting Dates:**



September 16, 2026 \- September 17, 2026



Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

* Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through expert support, proactive problem\-solving, and training that builds internal capability
* Strengthen Synopsys' leadership in static timing analysis and semiconductor design solutions by delivering measurable wins in competitive engagements
* Facilitate feedback loops between customers and internal teams that drive continuous innovation in product features, usability, and performance
* Empower customers to achieve superior chip performance, power efficiency, and cost optimization that directly affect their product success
* Contribute to successful tape\-outs and high\-impact design wins for industry\-leading clients building next\-generation silicon
* Build reusable methodologies and documentation that multiply your impact across the global customer base and internal teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Deep hands\-on expertise in Synopsys PrimeTime STA tool, including advanced features, timing analysis methodologies, and real\-world application across multiple design nodes
* Strong understanding of timing corners, process variations, signal integrity issues, and how they affect timing closure in modern semiconductor designs
* Familiarity with synthesis, physical design, extraction, and ECO methodologies, and how they integrate with static timing analysis workflows
* Proficiency in TCL scripting for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience in customer\-facing roles, experience delivering technical training or presentations is a plus
* BSEE or equivalent with 3\+ years of relevant experience, or MSEE or equivalent with 4 years of experience in applications engineering, design, or verification roles

### **Who You Are**

* You collaborate naturally, valuing diverse perspectives and fostering environments where different technical viewpoints strengthen the outcome
* Proactive problem\-solving defines your approach. You work independently, manage multiple priorities without losing threads, and know when to escalate or pull in help
* Adaptable and resilient, you thrive when priorities shift, timelines compress, or technical challenges require creative thinking under pressure
* Detail\-oriented with a commitment to delivering high\-quality results, you catch the edge cases and corner conditions that others miss
* You can explain a complex timing closure tradeoff to a customer VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and then turn around and debug a TCL script with an engineer
* You notice when a customer question signals a deeper workflow issue, and you address both the immediate ask and the underlying gap

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


You'll join a talented applications engineering team that supports the industry\-leading Static Timing Analysis tool, PrimeTime. The team's core purpose is to drive increased product usage, ensure customer success, and collaborate closely with R\&D, marketing, and sales to foster innovation. Together, you will enable customers to build next\-generation silicon chips faster and more efficiently, playing a vital role in Synopsys' global leadership in chip design and verification.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

title: JBPIND - US Recruiter Salaried
description:
Company Overview
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is a subsidiary of J.B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc. a privately held diversified manufacturing company forecasting $2\.5B in annual revenue and 8,500 team members in 2026\. The eight operating subsidiaries, covering over 50 locations, are engaged in the production of commercial truck bodies, step\-vans, utility trucks, funeral coaches, limousines, pickup truck bed enclosures, precision machining, and expandable foam plastic packaging. For more information, visit www.jbpoindexter.comfor more details.
  
JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is the captive shared services unit of the J.B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc. The company, wholly owned by J. B. Poindexter \& Co., Inc.\& is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA.
  
POSITION SUMMARY
  
The US Recruiter – Salaried Roles will be responsible for managing the full\-cycle recruitment process for salaried positions across the organization’s US operations.
  
The role will partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership to understand business requirements, develop effective recruitment strategies, identify and attract qualified candidates, and drive positions through the recruitment process to successful offer and hire.
  
The ideal candidate will have strong experience recruiting for US\-based salaried/professional positions and will be comfortable managing multiple requisitions in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment. The recruiter will be expected to build strong candidate pipelines, including passive talent, while providing an excellent candidate and hiring\-manager experience.
  
Success in this role will require strong sourcing capability, stakeholder management, candidate assessment skills, organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver against recruitment metrics such as time to fill, quality of hire, pipeline health, and overall hiring outcomes.
  
KEY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Full\-Cycle Recruitment
  
* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for US\-based salaried positions, from preparing job requisition and posting it, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer, and handoff to onboarding.
* Manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously while effectively prioritising roles based on business requirements and hiring timelines.
* Follow established Talent Acquisition processes and procedures to efficiently and effectively fill salaried positions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand position requirements, critical competencies, experience, qualifications, and business needs.
* Develop and execute recruiting plans and sourcing strategies based on the requirements of each position.
* Maintain ownership of assigned requisitions and proactively communicate progress, challenges, and potential risks.


Sourcing \& Talent Pipeline Development
  
* Utilize job boards, professional networks, internal databases, referrals, and other recruiting resources to identify qualified candidates.
* Develop strong pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future salaried hiring needs.
* Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through targeted sourcing and networking.
* Build and maintain professional networks to support ongoing US salaried recruitment.
* Research and identify new sourcing channels and approaches to improve candidate generation.
* Create and maintain compelling job postings aligned with the requirements of each position.


Candidate Screening \& Assessment
  
* Review resumes and applications and evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements.
* Conduct initial phone/video screens to assess candidates' work history, education, experience, skills, career interests, compensation expectations, and overall fit.
* Assess candidates against defined competencies and job requirements and provide recommendations to hiring managers.
* Maintain a consistent and objective candidate assessment process.
* Ensure candidates receive timely communication and a positive recruitment experience throughout the hiring process.
* Coordinate and participate in video and/or onsite interviews as required.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on candidate selection and recruitment best practices.


Hiring Manager \& Stakeholder Partnership
  
* Develop strong working relationships with hiring managers and business leaders supporting salaried recruitment.
* Conduct recruitment intake discussions and establish clear recruiting plans for assigned positions.
* Consult with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process and provide market and candidate insights.
* Educate new hiring managers on Talent Acquisition processes, workflows, interview practices, and expectations.
* Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition leadership to address recruitment challenges and hiring risks.
* Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding pipeline status, candidate activity, interview progress, and expected hiring timelines.


Offer \& Pre\-Employment Process
  
* Manage the candidate offer process in partnership with the hiring manager and appropriate HR stakeholders.
* Coordinate required background checks and other pre\-employment activities.
* Maintain timely communication with candidates throughout the offer and pre\-employment process.
* Support the transition of selected candidates into the onboarding process.


Reporting \& Recruitment Metrics
  
* Maintain accurate and timely recruitment activity within the Applicant Tracking System.
* Track and report recruitment metrics including open requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview activity, offers, time to fill, and hiring status.
* Provide transparent updates to Talent Acquisition leadership, hiring managers, and HR Business Partners.
* Proactively identify barriers that may impact hiring timelines and recommend solutions.
* Maintain accurate records related to recruitment activities and candidate status.


Talent Acquisition \& Process Improvement
  
* Participate in Talent Acquisition initiatives designed to improve recruiting effectiveness and candidate experience.
* Identify opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, recruiting processes, and candidate pipelines.
* Support workforce planning and recruitment initiatives as required.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for salaried recruitment.
* Complete special projects and other Talent Acquisition activities as assigned.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Bachelor's degree
* 5 to 7 years of experience in recruitment, sourcing, Talent Acquisition, or related experience.
* Experience recruiting for US\-based positions in a fast\-paced, deadline\-driven environment.
* Experience managing full\-cycle recruitment processes.
* Strong experience sourcing and screening candidates for salaried/professional positions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and follow\-through.
* Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a Talent Acquisition team.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  
* Proven experience recruiting for US salaried/professional positions.
* Experience recruiting across multiple business functions.
* Strong passive candidate sourcing and talent\-pipeline development experience.
* Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technologies.
* Experience with Ceridian Dayforce or other comparable ATS/HRIS systems.
* Experience with LinkedIn and other professional sourcing platforms.
* Experience partnering directly with US\-based hiring managers.
* Understanding of US recruitment practices and employment requirements.
* Experience working with recruitment metrics such as time to fill, pipeline conversion, and quality of hire.


**Code of Ethics:**  

JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited, requires the highest standard of ethics in all business dealings, with customers, suppliers, advisors, employees, and authorities. This position shall actively ensure that his/her own activities and those of all employees within the project meet this obligation. JBPCO critical standards and procedures related to expected conduct are detailed on the company website. This position is expected to be familiar with these policies and ensure that they are implemented in all areas of control

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
**The Vacancy** 




  





 GB Global is the UK’s leading independent logistics and global trade management provider, employing over 1,000 colleagues across a diverse network of operational, logistics, warehousing and commercial locations.
 



  





 As our Chennai business continues to grow, we are looking for an ambitious, commercially minded HR professional to join the team and help strengthen local people support.
 



  





 This is a strong opportunity for an experienced HR Business Partner, Senior HR Adviser or aspiring HR Manager who is ready to take the next step. The successful candidate will lead day\-to\-day employee relations activity, support wider ER initiatives, and contribute to organisational change projects across the business.
 



  





 The role will be based predominantly in Chennai, with regular travel to other business locations as required. This will give the successful candidate the opportunity to build strong working relationships, understand GB Global operations first\-hand, and provide practical HR support across the business.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Lead complex employee relations casework, including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence management and appeal matters.
* Provide practical, commercially focused HR advice to senior operational leaders, balancing business needs with fair, consistent and compliant people practices.
* Coach and support managers to build confidence in handling people matters and improving day\-to\-day management capability.
* Support Organisational change, restructuring and consultation processes, ensuring clear communication, appropriate documentation and effective risk management.
* Identify, assess and mitigate employment risks while ensuring compliance with employment legislation, company policies and internal procedures.
* Keep HR policies, procedures and templates up to date, ensuring they remain legally compliant, operationally relevant and clearly understood by managers and employees.
* Use HR data, trends and management information to support decision\-making, identify recurring issues and drive continuous improvement.
* Partner with managers on recruitment activity, including understanding resourcing requirements, supporting selection processes and helping to deliver a positive candidate experience.
* Work closely with outsourced payroll providers to maintain accurate employee data, support timely payroll processing and resolve payroll queries efficiently.
* Contribute to the development of the wider Employee Relations function by improving processes, sharing best practice and supporting consistent standards across the business.



  





**What We're Looking For:** 




  




* Proven experience in an HR Business Partner, Senior HR Adviser or HR Manager role.
* Strong employee relations knowledge, with the confidence to manage complex and sensitive people matters.
* Good working knowledge of employment law and HR best practice, with the judgement to know when to escalate risk.
* Experience supporting operational, logistics, warehousing or other fast\-paced environments would be advantageous.
* Commercially aware, pragmatic and confident working with managers to find practical solutions.
* Strong communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable using HR data and systems to support accurate records, reporting and decision\-making.
* Relevant HR qualification, such as CIPD Level 5 or equivalent, or able to demonstrate equivalent practical experience.
* Flexible and willing to travel to other business locations when required.



  





**What We Offer:** 




  




* A genuine opportunity to shape the HR support model for a growing Chennai operation.
* Exposure to a varied employee relations workload, Organisational change activity and operational leadership teams.
* The chance to work in a commercially focused environment where HR has a clear role in supporting business performance.



  





 This is a hands\-on HR Manager role for someone who enjoys working close to the business, providing practical employee relations support and helping managers make confident people decisions. The successful candidate will play an important part in supporting the continued growth of the Chennai operation, while contributing to a consistent, commercially focused HR approach across GB Global.

title: Employee Relations Specialist
description:
About Us:
 



 Tata Electronics is a leading force in India’s growing electronics and semiconductor manufacturing industry, backed by the trusted legacy of the Tata Group. With world\-class facilities across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Assam, the company is driving innovation and supporting the nation’s “Make in India” vision. Today, Tata Electronics employs around 70,000 people and is rapidly expanding its footprint to shape the future of high\-tech manufacturing.
 



**TEPS Chennai** 
 , located in
 **Mahindra World City** 
 , is one of the flagship facilities of Tata Electronics, with a workforce of
 **10,000\+ employees** 
 . Known for its exceptional operational efficiency and high\-performance culture, the plant consistently delivers excellence in quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Driven by a motivated and passionate workforce, TEPS Chennai fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement. More than a manufacturing facility, it is a center of growth, learning, and opportunity—contributing significantly to Tata Electronics’ vision of building a globally competitive and technologically advanced India.
 



  





**Department \- Human Resources** 




**Job Title \- Shift ER** 




**Division \- Employee Relations** 




**Job Level \-** 
**Executive** 




**Reporting To \-** 
**ER Manager** 




  





**Job Specifications:** 




  





**Desired Educational Background** 



* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Social Work, or a related field is required.
* Master's degree in human resources or Employee Relations is preferred.
* Certification in Labor laws, compliance regulations, ER and IR is preferred



**Desired Experience** 



* 1\-3 years of experience in ER.
* Working experience in manufacturing organization (Plant Location).
* Experience in electronic manufacturing or related industries is preferred.
* Experience in green field assignments or setting up of processes, systems, policies and implementation of rollouts is an added advantage
* Experience of working with a unionized workforce is preferred



**Desired Certifications** 



* Additional certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, HR Systems, Employee Relations, and POSH will be considered an added advantage.



  





**Job Description:** 
 Shift ER
 








**Role Purpose:** 
 Shit ER is a pivotal individual contributor responsible for fostering a harmonious, compliant, and high\-performing workplace by strengthening relationships between employees, contractors, leadership, and the organization. Operating in a fast\-paced, precision\-driven electronics manufacturing environment, this role closely partners with cross\- functional departments to drive employee engagement, grievance resolution, workforce discipline, and industrial harmony. Operating at the intersection of business continuity and employee experience, ER ensures a fair, compliant and inclusive workplace by strengthening trust across the shop floor. The role champions a positive work culture through proactive employee connect initiatives, conflict resolution, welfare interventions, grievance management, and stakeholder collaboration. By fostering strong employee relationships and promoting compliance, workplace safety, and continuous improvement, ER plays a critical role in maintaining a stable, engaged, and productive workforce that supports operational excellence and sustainable business growth.
 



  





**Who is it for?** 
 This is not your typical HR role. This is for professionals who believe that strong employee relationships build stronger businesses. If you enjoy being on the shop floor, solving real workplace challenges, building trust, and creating a culture where people feel heard and respected, this role is for you. You will be the bridge between employees and the business—driving employee experience, workplace harmony, and operational excellence. If you thrive in dynamic manufacturing environments and want to make a meaningful impact on people and business every day, this is Employee Relations with
 **Heart, Hustle** 
 and
 **Heritage.** 




  





**What we Expect you to Bring:** 



* A people\-first mindset with strong shop\-floor presence and hands\-on execution.
* Ability to build trust, credibility, and meaningful relationships across all workforce segments.
* Curiosity and learning agility to understand manufacturing operations and translate business needs into people solutions.
* Strong conflict resolution, grievance handling, and problem\-solving skills with fairness and empathy.
* Sound understanding of labor laws, statutory compliance, and workplace discipline.
* Data\-driven thinking with the ability to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills across and leadership teams.
* Ownership, resilience, and the ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence.



  





**What you will get:** 



* Be a part of a TATA enterprise that’s reshaping India’s Global Electronics Manufacturing story
* A seat at the table in shaping a future\-ready manufacturing powerhouse
* Build a plant, a culture and legacy, not just a function
* The chance to build a culture of trust, fairness, and inclusion while making a measurable business impact.
* Work alongside experienced business leaders and HR professionals on transformational initiatives.
* Freedom to experiment, build and grow
* An environment that values initiative, ownership, and people\-impact



  





**Important Considerations:** 



1. This role is based at the plant (factory). It follows a six\-day workweek and will be a 100% work from office role.
2. As the plant operates 24X7, flexibility
 **to work in A, B and C shifts** 
 on a daily basis is required
3. Prior experience of managing plant / shop floor workforce is preferred
4. Ability to communicate in English and Tamil is essential



  





**Contribution areas\- Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**Culture and Engagement:** 



* Instill a values\-driven, high\-ownership culture. Create and drive programs that amplify the right intent and right behavior
* Craft engagement programs that connect head, heart and hands – whether on the shop floor or in the control room
* Organize participative employee platforms and communication vehicles that foster transparency, teamwork, and empowerment
* Act as a coach for the supervisory and managerial population to ensure people are lead with the right value system



  





**Employee Relations and Shopfloor presence:** 



* Build a key influencing presence among the shopfloor workers, supervisors, and representatives from different committees.
* Proactively flag any possible future IR issues early and work on proactive measures to fix them and maintain a harmonious climate
* Ensure high shop floor visibility and provide daily ER support to Operations Leaders
* Ensure complete compliance with labor laws, safety regulations and Tata Code of Conduct.



  





**Compliance and Statutory Readiness** 



* Support in the implementation of all labor law requirements (Factories act, CLRA, ESI, PF etc.)
* Prepare the necessary data, metrics and insights for client audits and represent the organization with the auditors
* Design and conduct vendor audits, ad\-hoc and planned inspections related to labor compliance, employee wellbeing as well as employee experience on all facilities provided (Like Canteen, transport, OHS, creche)
* Be in an anytime audit ready state by Creating and maintaining up to date all statutory registers, notices and reports



  





**HR Operations** 



* Track regular absenteeism, attrition, and engagement trends to generate real\-time insights and deploy proactive interventions
* Provide manpower planning support in alignment with planned incoming volumes
* Support the roll\-out of different HRMs systems for biometric attendance management, payroll integration, policies administration, manpower reports and daily dashboards
* Create, own and maintain cognitive dashboards for real\-time insights and tracking of trends proactively
* Administer employee benefits programs and change management initiatives and provide feedback from the ground for continual improvement of these programs



  





**Change Management** 



* Design and execute structured change interventions – awareness campaigns, townhalls, pulse checks and feedback loops to reduce resistance and build readiness
* Partner with leadership to communicate change clearly and consistently ensuring psychological safety and clarity to the workforce
* Support mindset shifts among shopfloor and supervisory teams to embrace digital tools, lean practices, and performance ownership
* Role\-model resilience, adaptability, and TATA values during transitions – setting the tone for others.



  





**External Interfaces** 



* **Recruitment Agencies:** 
 Collaborate with recruitment agencies to attract and source qualified candidates for open positions.
* **Government Agencies:** 
 Liaise with government agencies regarding employment law compliance audits or investigations.
* **Clients:** 
 Prepare, review and present key talent metrics and insights with the clients during client visits and audits
* **Vendors:** 
 Continually inspect, provide feedback and hold vendors accountable for providing services that meet the agreed standards



**Internal Interface** 



* **HR Team:** 
 Collaborate with the HR Team to ensure consistency in HR Policies and Procedures across the organization.
* **Business Unit Leadership:** 
 Build strong relationships with business unit leaders, providing strategic HR guidance, and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
* **Department Managers:** 
 Partner with department managers on talent management initiatives, performance management processes, and employee relations issues.
* **Finance Department:** 
 Collaborate with finance on budgeting and cost implications of HR initiatives (e.g., employee compensation, training programs).
* **Legal Department:** 
 Consult with the legal department on complex HR matters to ensure compliance with all legal requirements.



  





 Regards

 Standardise HR practices across the corporate office, regions and showrooms.
 



 Prepare the annual HR operations plan and budget.

 Oversee all employee processes from joining through separation.
 



 Ensure timely completion of appointment letters, confirmations, transfers, promotions, increments and relieving documents.
 



 Monitor probation and confirmation schedules.
 



 Ensure accurate documentation for employee movements and status changes.
 



 Coordinate smooth onboarding and exit\-clearance processes.

 Develop, review and update HR policies in consultation with the CHRO and management.
 



 Communicate HR policies clearly across all locations.
 



 Ensure uniform interpretation and implementation of policies.
 



 Maintain proper approval controls and policy documentation.
 



 Conduct periodic policy\-awareness programmes.
 



**Attendance, Leave and Workforce Administration** 




 Control attendance, leave, shift, weekly\-off and holiday\-management processes.
 



 Ensure attendance is closed accurately and submitted to Payroll within the defined timeline.
 



 Monitor late attendance, absenteeism, unauthorised leave and excessive overtime.
 



 Ensure showroom duty rosters comply with business and legal requirements.
 



 Resolve attendance and leave discrepancies promptly.
 



**Payroll Coordination** 




 Provide verified employee data and attendance inputs to the Payroll team.
 



 Validate new joiners, exits, salary revisions, incentives, recoveries and deductions.
 



 Ensure payroll inputs are accurate and submitted according to schedule.
 



 Review payroll exceptions and resolve employee salary concerns.
 



 Maintain maker\-checker and approval controls for all payroll\-related changes.
 



**HRMS and Employee Records** 




 Ensure the HRMS contains complete and accurate employee information.
 



 Lead HR process automation and digitisation initiatives.
 



 Maintain employee personal files, service records and statutory documents.
 



 Control access to confidential employee information.
 



 Conduct regular HRMS and employee\-file audits.
 



 Generate reliable HR data and reports for management decisions.
 



**Regional and Showroom HR Operations** 




 Guide Regional HR Managers and showroom HR representatives.
 



 Ensure HR policies and processes are followed consistently across all locations.
 



 Conduct periodic HR operational audits of regions and showrooms.
 



 Resolve escalated employee and manager queries.
 



 Support new\-showroom openings, employee transfers and workforce deployment.
 



**Employee Relations and Grievances** 




 Establish a structured employee grievance\-resolution process.
 



 Ensure employee complaints are acknowledged, investigated and closed within defined timelines.
 



 Support disciplinary enquiries and corrective\-action processes.
 



 Guide regional and functional managers in handling employee issues.
 



 Maintain confidentiality and fairness in all employee\-related matters.
 



 Coordinate with the Employee Relations or Legal team when necessary.
 



**Statutory Compliance and Audit Support** 




 Coordinate compliance relating to employment records, working hours, leave, notices and statutory registers.
 



 Work with the Compliance, Payroll and Legal teams on labour\-law requirements.
 



 Ensure timely closure of HR audit observations.
 



 Provide employee documents and records during internal, statutory and management audits.
 



 Monitor compliance requirements across different states.
 



**Separation and Full\-and\-Final Settlement** 




 Ensure resignations and terminations follow the approved process and delegation of authority.
 



 Monitor notice periods, handover, clearances and recovery of company assets.
 



 Coordinate timely full\-and\-final settlements with Payroll and Finance.
 



 Ensure relieving and experience letters are issued after completing all requirements.
 



 Conduct exit interviews and analyse reasons for attrition.
 



 Recommend corrective action to improve employee retention.
 



**HR Budget and Vendor Management** 




 Prepare and monitor the HR operations budget.
 



 Manage HR vendors such as background\-verification agencies, HRMS providers, manpower contractors and documentation services.
 



 Evaluate vendor performance, service quality and cost efficiency.
 



 Ensure proper agreements, approvals and invoice verification.
 



**HR MIS and Management Reporting** 




 Prepare weekly and monthly HR dashboards for the CHRO and management.
 



 Report employee strength, vacancies, joining, exits, transfers, absenteeism and attrition.
 



 Track regional and department\-wise employee costs.
 



 Analyse HR trends and highlight risks requiring management attention.
 



 Maintain a single, reliable source of employee data.
 



**Team Leadership** 




 Lead HR Operations Managers, Deputy Managers, Assistant Managers and Executives.
 



 Define team responsibilities, service\-level standards and performance targets.
 



 Review team productivity and quality of work.
 



 Train team members on HR policies, HRMS, documentation and compliance.
 



 Develop suitable successors for key HR operations positions.
 



  





**Qualification and Experience** 




 MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or an equivalent qualification.
 



 Approximately 15–20 years of HR experience, including at least 5 years in a senior HR operations role.
 



 Experience in large retail, jewellery, FMCG or other multi\-location organisations is preferred.
 



 Strong knowledge of HR operations, HRMS, labour compliance, payroll coordination and employee relations.

title: Workday Techno Functional Consultant
description:
**About Poshmark**
**Poshmark is the leading fashion marketplace where style comes alive through discovery, self\-expression, and human connection.** 
 Powered by a vibrant community of 165 million members, Poshmark brings real people and taste to shopping through a social experience shaped by shared discovery. Buying and selling fashion feels simple, joyful, and personal, while every item tells its own story. Poshmark empowers sellers to grow meaningful businesses, keeps fashion in circulation longer, and gives shoppers access to unique and trusted finds, from everyday pieces to one\-of\-a\-kind vintage and luxury.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly skilled and analytically driven
 **Senior Specialist II, HR Technology** 
 (Workday Techno\-functional consultant) to join our People team. In this role, you will serve as a senior subject matter expert at the intersection of HR systems and people analytics, helping to optimize our HR technology ecosystem while enabling data\-driven decision\-making across the organization.
   

  

 While you will bring deep expertise in Workday HCM—our current HR platform—your value extends beyond any single tool. You are an HR technology and people analytics professional who can build scalable reporting and analytics solutions, support workforce planning through data\-driven insights, and translate complex workforce data into actionable recommendations for HR and business leaders. You contribute to the development of analytics frameworks and predictive analyses while helping ensure that our people data ecosystem remains scalable, reliable, and adaptable as technology evolves.
   

  

 You will partner closely with HR, IT, Finance, and business stakeholders to enhance system capabilities, improve data quality, streamline processes, and deliver meaningful workforce insights that support organizational goals.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* People Analytics \& Workforce Insights
* Develop and maintain workforce dashboards, scorecards, and recurring reports that support HR and business decision\-making.
* Analyze workforce trends across headcount, attrition, recruiting, diversity, performance, engagement, and employee lifecycle metrics.
* Partner with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and business leaders to understand reporting needs and provide actionable insights.
* Build and maintain data visualizations using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Workday Prism Analytics, or equivalent platforms.
* Support workforce planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and organizational effectiveness initiatives through data analysis and reporting.
* Contribute to the development of people analytics frameworks and predictive analyses that support talent and workforce decisions.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and integrity of workforce metrics by adhering to established reporting standards and governance practices.
* HR Systems Administration (Workday)
* Administer, configure, and maintain Workday HCM modules including Core HR, Recruiting, Talent Management, Compensation, Benefits, Time \& Absence, and Helpdesk.
* Configure and support business processes, workflows, notifications, security roles, and system controls in alignment with HR policies and operational requirements.
* Develop and maintain Workday reports, dashboards, calculated fields, and composite reports.
* Support Workday biannual releases by assessing impacts, testing enhancements, and coordinating deployment activities.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve system issues while ensuring timely communication and resolution for stakeholders.
* Partner with HR Operations and IT teams to continuously optimize system functionality, user experience, and process efficiency.
* HR Data Governance \& Quality
* Maintain high standards of HR data accuracy, completeness, and consistency across HR systems.
* Conduct regular audits and validation activities to identify and resolve data discrepancies.
* Support compliance with internal controls, audit requirements, and applicable data privacy regulations.
* Document reporting definitions, system configurations, business processes, and operating procedures.
* Contribute to the ongoing development and maintenance of HR data governance standards and data quality processes.
* Support efforts to improve trust, transparency, and accessibility of people data across the organization.
* Systems Integration \& Technical Support
* Support integrations between Workday and connected systems including payroll, benefits, talent, learning, and finance platforms.
* Assist with data imports, exports, Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB) processes, and interface monitoring activities.
* Partner with IT teams and external vendors to troubleshoot integration issues and implement system enhancements.
* Participate in testing activities for integrations, system upgrades, new functionality, and process changes.
* Maintain technical documentation, configuration records, and knowledge base materials to support operational continuity.
* Process Optimization \& Stakeholder Enablement
* Identify opportunities to automate manual HR processes and improve operational efficiency through technology solutions.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable system configurations, reports, and process improvements.
* Serve as a trusted resource for HR technology questions, providing guidance and support to stakeholders across the organization.
* Deliver training, user documentation, and knowledge\-sharing sessions to improve system adoption and proficiency.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations, and continuous improvement initiatives from planning through execution.
* Build strong partnerships with HR, IT, Finance, and business teams to ensure technology solutions align with organizational needs.


**Qualifications**

title: TA Manager
description:
Insight Global is one of the world's largest staffing firms. What does that mean? We make hiring easy for our clients. Since 2001, we've expanded from a small entrepreneurial startup to over $5 billion in revenue. Our growth is driven by our award\-winning company culture, comprehensive training programs, and of course, our people.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 We are seeking a high\-energy, strategic Talent Acquisition Manager who will build and scale our internal TA engine from the ground up. This role is responsible for designing and owning the full TA roadmap for India – from internal processes and employer branding to candidate experience, campus strategy, and team leadership – while directly supporting high\-priority hiring across IT, Solutions, Delivery, and Recruiting/Sales roles. You will operate as both a builder and a doer: someone who can create the vision, design the playbook, and then roll up your sleeves to execute, iterate, and scale. This is a high\-impact leadership role for a culture\-first people leader who embodies Insight Global’s Shared Values and can build a high performing team. At Insight Global, we don’t recruit like everyone else, and we don’t want to. The right person for this role will think creatively, challenge traditional campus hiring approaches, and help redefine what great recruiting looks like at scale.
 



  





 RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  




* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment across priority hiring needs for the Hyderabad delivery center as well as campus hiring strategy. Ensure strong alignment to business demand, hiring quality, and speed across technical, delivery, solutions, and fresh graduates across sales/recruiting.
* Proven track record of building or scaling TA processes, programs, or teams from the ground up – including design, rollout, and continuous improvement of recruiting operations, tools, and governance.
* Serve as a strategic talent acquisition partner to leaders across India and the US by aligning on hiring priorities, calibrating expectations, and ensuring a consistent, collaborative approach across teams and stakeholders.
* A builder’s mindset: creative, solutions\-oriented, comfortable operating in ambiguity, and excited to design something new rather than just maintain existing processes.
* Build, execute, and continuously improve scalable campus recruiting strategies aligned to business growth. Develop and maintain strong relationships with career centers, faculty, and student organizations across target universities in India.
* Organize and lead on\-campus and virtual recruitment events such as career fairs, walk in drives, information sessions, hackathons, and branding initiatives.
* Willingness to travel within India for campus engagements and key market events as needed.
* Bring ideas, market insight, and strategic recommendations to every phase of the hiring process—from intake and sourcing strategy through interviews, offers, and conversion—so the function continues to improve and evolve.
* Build and strengthen interview process governance by helping define clear recruiting workflows, interviewer expectations, assessment standards, feedback quality, and decision\-making consistency across the hiring lifecycle. Provide market insights, talent trends, and data\-driven recommendations to support hiring decisions.
* Track and report on key recruiting metrics (time\-to\-hire, conversion rates, campus ROI, etc.)



  





 WHAT WE LOOK FOR
 


* 8\-12 years of full\-cycle recruitment experience, including significant ownership of mid to senior\-level hiring in India, ideally within high\-growth or services\-focused organizations. Experience hiring across technical (IT), Solutions, or Delivery\-based roles, non\-IT with an emphasis Sales/Recruiting roles preferred.
* 5 Years of Team Handling Experiences.
* Proven experience operating as a lead/manager and can both execute and develop hiring
* processes, influence stakeholders, and elevate how the organization attracts and selects talent.
* Strong track record of high activity, strong metrics, and operational excellence.
* Experience enhancing employer brand and talent market reputation by representing the
* company externally, shaping candidate messaging, and supporting or leading branding initiatives
* and events.
* Creative, solutions\-oriented mindset with a history of bringing new ideas, tools, and approaches
* to sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and conversion across the entire hiring lifecycle.
* Excellent communication, relationship\-building, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self\-motivated with strong organizational and project management abilities.
* Willingness to travel for campus engagement events as needed.
* Demonstrates high character, grit, and a positive, team\-oriented mindset.

title: Technical Recruiter (Contract)
description:
**Summary**
 Do you have a passion for helping others succeed? Do you genuinely believe that talent is the greatest asset of any company? As a member of Apple’s People group, you’ll help discover and develop our most important resource: our people. Together, we’ll search the world to build our collective of talented perfectionists, visionaries, and inventors. All the while, your efforts will maintain Apple as the most innovative company by striving to make us the most diverse — open to all people, all backgrounds, and all perspectives. And that’s just the beginning, because throughout Apple employees’ careers, you will continue to help them grow professionally and support them in work and life. Join the team and help build and keep the extraordinary talent it takes to make extraordinary products.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced Technical Recruiter / Engineering Recruiter to join our team in Hyderabad on a contract basis. This role is responsible for providing the highest level of recruiting partnership to Apple's business leaders and candidates through our sourcing and selection processes, performing full lifecycle recruitment while maintaining excellent relationships. You will have the opportunity to work with an amazing, robust, and agile team responsible for hiring world\-class talent. Apple has an exciting, high\-performance culture. If you are results\-driven, a self\-starter, and ready to "Think Different," come join us!
   

  

 In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in identifying, attracting, and hiring top\-tier technical talent across various high\-demand domains. You will act as a strategic partner to our hiring managers, leveraging market intelligence and data\-driven insights to build exceptional teams that drive our innovation and success. If you thrive in a fast\-paced environment, possess a keen eye for talent, and are dedicated to delivering an outstanding candidate experience, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

 This is a contract position.
   

  

**Description**
 As a Corporate Recruiter, you will be the cornerstone of our technical hiring efforts, owning and driving the end\-to\-end recruitment process for critical engineering and product roles.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
 Strategic Talent Sourcing: Proactively source, engage, and attract top\-tier technical talent from diverse channels, employing creative and effective strategies to build robust pipelines. You'll be the go\-to person for finding the right profiles.
   

  

 Full\-Cycle Recruitment \& Candidate Engagement: Manage the entire recruitment lifecycle from initial candidate engagement through offer negotiation and onboarding, ensuring a seamless, positive, and engaging experience for all candidates.
   

  

 Hiring Partner Alignment: Conduct comprehensive intake meetings with hiring managers and leaders to deeply understand hiring profiles, define success metrics, and collaboratively develop effective sourcing and hiring strategies.
   

  

 Market Intelligence \& Advisory: Provide data\-backed insights on talent market availability, competitive compensation trends, and hiring best practices to influence and guide strategic hiring decisions. Data Analysis \& Process Improvement: Analyse key recruitment metrics (e.g., conversion rates, time\-to\-source, time\-to\-hire) to evaluate pipeline health, identify bottlenecks, and proactively suggest process enhancements and optimizations.
   

  

 ATS Management \& Communication: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records within our Applicant Tracking System (ATS), ensuring smooth communication and efficient workflow throughout the recruitment journey.
   

  

 Special Projects \& Initiatives: Actively participate in and contribute to various talent acquisition and people\-related special projects, helping to shape and refine our overall recruiting strategies and employer brand.
   

  

 Continuous Learning: Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and innovative sourcing techniques to maintain a competitive edge in the talent market.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of full\-cycle recruiting experience, with a strong preference for candidates who have worked within the Technology sector
* Have a well\-developed network of candidates and/or the skills to build the network quickly and comprehensively


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience working in a global or rapidly scaling organisation.
* A passion for technology and staying abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and talent landscapes.
* Certifications in recruitment best practices or relevant recruiting tools.
* Experience with employer branding initiatives or talent marketing.
* Proven track record of successfully hiring for high\-demand, specialised technical roles such as Software Engineering (Backend, Frontend, Full Stack), Product Management, Data Science, Machine Learning, or similar.
* Demonstrated ability to quickly ramp up, manage a high volume of requisitions, prioritise effectively, and operate autonomously to consistently hit challenging hiring targets.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and consultation skills, with a proven ability to build strong relationships and partner effectively with senior Hiring Managers and Leaders.
* Expertise in utilising Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and advanced proficiency with LinkedIn Recruiter for sourcing and engagement.

 Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: HR Partner - Oakridge International School - Gachibowli
description:
Oakridge Gachibowli is a premium international day school in India. We have the proud privilege of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. We have 150\+ IB\-trained teachers with years of experience, helping us consistently achieve outstanding results and seeing our students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is a leading premium day school in India, with more than 2800 students in full time enrollment. The school has a proud legacy of 22 years educational excellence and of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. The school has 150\+ IB\-trained teachers, enabling consistent outstanding results and inspire students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. The school serves Nursery through to high school (Grade 12\) students. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 The Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is partnered with the Nord Anglia Education family, the world’s leading premium international school organisation. They currently have 81 schools in India, China, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and North, Central and South America. NAE are a fast growing, successful education company with over 50 years’ experience. The schools are amongst the most respected premium schools in their markets and are a very popular choice for parents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic role responsible for aligning HR practices with the school’s goals and educational mission. Acting as a trusted advisor to school leadership and faculty, the HRBP supports workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance development, and change management. The role ensures that HR initiatives promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing school culture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic HR Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with school leadership to understand staffing needs and workforce planning.Align HR strategies with academic and operational goals.Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 
 Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and lead recruitment for teaching, administrative, and support staff.Ensure timely onboarding and orientation of new hires.Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring practices.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement:** 
 Foster a positive work environment through proactive engagement and support.Handle employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution in a fair and consistent manner.Develop and implement initiatives that support staff well\-being and retention.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Development:** 
 Support performance appraisal processes and goal\-setting practices.Collaborate with department heads to identify professional development needs.Guide leadership and staff on career development opportunities and succession planning.
   

  

**Compliance \& Policy Implementation:** 
 Ensure compliance with labor laws, school policies, and relevant educational regulations.Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date HR documentation and records.Lead internal audits and HR reporting as needed.
   

  

 Detailed JD : JD \- HR Partner \- OIS.pdf
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. Lead offer construction and closure for senior hires, with awareness of US compensation norms where relevant. Manage recruiting capacity including agency relationships.
 



  





**Compensation and equity** 




 Run the compensation cycle end to end \- benchmarking, band construction, moderation, approval and communication \- with fluency in both India and US market benchmarks. Administer the ESOP programme: grant recommendations, board cadence, documentation and employee communication.
 



  





**Benefits and people operations** 




 Design and roll out benefits including retirement schemes and insurance for the India population, while coordinating with US\-side HR/legal on benefits parity and obligations where applicable. Own payroll governance and vendor performance across employee and contractor populations, onboarding, leave and holiday framework, and HRIS data integrity and access governance.
 



  





**Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Own worker classification policy and risk assessment across engagement models in both countries. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

title: Workforce Management Lead
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 The WFM Team Lead – Scheduling \& Intraday leads the end\-to\-end tactical execution layer of Workforce Management, integrating schedule optimisation, weekly workforce steering, real\-time operational control, and incident response under a single, cohesive leadership structure.
   

  

 This role ensures that approved capacity strategies are translated into structurally sound, compliant schedules (0–30 day horizon), proactively adjusted through weekly tactical steering, and actively protected through disciplined intraday performance management.
   

  

 Beyond operational oversight, the role operates as the Workforce Command Center lead — providing governance, decision control, and service protection during both stable and volatile operating conditions. It ensures workforce decisions are data\-informed, risk\-quantified, and aligned to service, productivity, and cost objectives.
   

  

 As part of the WFM Centre of Excellence (CoE), the role is accountable for embedding standardised workforce governance, decision frameworks, incident protocols, and execution discipline across Scheduling and Intraday functions. It drives the transition from reactive workforce administration to structured, analytics\-driven workforce control at scale.
   

  

 This position closes the loop between Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Intraday → Continuous Improvement, ensuring execution learnings systematically improve tactical and structural planning quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Capability Development
* Lead and develop Scheduling and Intraday WFM Specialists.
* Define clear accountability boundaries across tactical and real\-time scopes.
* Elevate analytical maturity beyond administrative execution.
* Coach team members in Scenario modelling, Workforce risk quantification, Structured incident response
* Build succession strength and capability depth.
* Foster a culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership.
* Tactical Planning \& Schedule Governance (0–30 Day Horizon)
* Own end\-to\-end schedule publication governance.
* Ensure schedules reflect approved capacity plans, are interval\-accurate and structurally optimised, comply with labour and contractual obligations
* Oversee scenario testing and trade\-off validation prior to release.
* Balance service protection with cost efficiency and schedule stability.
* Approve short\-term workforce interventions (OT, VTO, temporary uplift).
* Identify systemic schedule weaknesses before operational impact.
* Weekly Workforce Steering
* Lead weekly tactical workforce performance reviews.
* Identify structural and emerging risks across 1–3 week horizon.
* Drive proactive adjustments to reduce intraday volatility.
* Align closely with Forecasting and Capacity Planning on emerging shifts.
* Ensure continuous feedback loop from execution into planning assumptions.
* Intraday Performance \& Operational Control
* Oversee real\-time service level, occupancy, and productivity monitoring.
* Ensure structured and rapid deviation diagnosis.
* Guide stabilisation interventions to prevent performance oscillation.
* Maintain disciplined escalation protocols with Operations leadership.
* Safeguard service performance during peak volatility.
* Incident Management \& Command Center Leadership
* Act as the Workforce Command Center lead during operational disruption.
* Own structured workforce response to demand surges, high absenteeism events, system/tool outages, service\-level degradation
* Quantify operational risk exposure and recovery timelines.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workforce interventions.
* Ensure incidents are managed through defined protocols, not reactive decisions.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and embed systemic improvements.
* WFM CoE Governance \& Standardisation
* Enforce WFM execution standards across Scheduling and Intraday.
* Drive adoption of workforce governance frameworks, incident playbooks, tactical review cadences, decision documentation standards
* Reduce dependency on ad hoc, spreadsheet\-driven processes.
* Strengthen system\-based optimisation and automation.
* Ensure auditability, reproducibility, and structural integrity of workforce decisions.
* Contribute to maturity uplift of the WFM operating model.
* Continuous Improvement \& Execution Excellence
* Identify recurring volatility drivers.
* Improve shrinkage modelling and break optimisation logic.
* Increase automation and reporting maturity.
* Reduce emergency interventions and reactive staffing.
* Improve alignment between planning accuracy and operational execution.


**Qualifications**
 You are passionate about leading people, building teams, and making a difference in your work, while also having a strong understanding of operational teams and processes. You have experience working across global teams, across different functions and you understand how to communicate cross\-culturally. You get it done. You can identify and resolve issues independently, taking initiative even under unfamiliar or ambiguous circumstances. You’ve worked with BI tools before like Looker etc. and your Excel/Spreadsheets skills are advanced! SQL and Python skills are a plus.
   

  

* Experience as a people lead: At least 3 years of experience leading teams and 2 years in a Workforce Management role.
* Independent problem solver: Ability to identify and resolve issues independently, even in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.
* Self\-starter: Proven track record of taking ownership and creatively solving problems, while improving efficiency.
* Strong understanding of WFM: Knowledgeable in forecasting and different forecasting models, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Strong relationships with stakeholders: Ability to connect and maintain relationships with various internal teams.
* Strategic and data\-driven: Ability to think strategically, translate strategy into operational plans, and analyse and interpret data.
* Process Expert: Lean Six Sigma experience to green\-belt level, understanding how to formally document processes, automate, improve efficiency, and reduce waste and cycle times across WFM practices


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
