 • Coordinate effectively across teams and manage issues, conflict, and problems as they arise.
   

 • Build collaborative relationships with global HR functions.
   

 Health, Safety \& Sustainability • Understand the critical risks in your area and reassess hazards if the work area changes.
   

 • Know and apply the standards and procedures relevant to your role. Stop the job if in doubt, fix the problem, or warn others of danger.
 








**About you** 





**Formal Education** 




 • Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
   

 • Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.
 



**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.
   

 • Experience supporting or delivering Oracle HCM Cloud implementation projects, ideally across multiple countries spread across diverse businesses.
 



**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must
   

 • Strong technical and functional knowledge of Oracle HCM Cloud, including configuration, integrations, and data management.
   

 • Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
   

 • Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
   

 • Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.
   

 • Proficient in MS PowerPoint, Word and Excel.
   

 • Well\-developed written and oral communication, with excellent attention to detail.
   

 • Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
   

 • Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.
 




**What's on offer** 





 At Thiess, our people are the heart of everything we do. We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone can thrive \- safely, confidently and with opportunities to grow.

title: Global Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**About the Role**



Globalli is seeking an experienced Global Talent Acquisition Partner to join our People team and support hiring across our growing, multinational organization. This role will report to the HR Manager and partner closely with hiring managers across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.



This is a hands\-on talent acquisition role for someone who is comfortable working across different functions, seniority levels, countries, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands how recruiting works in a multinational environment and can adapt sourcing and hiring practices to different talent markets while maintaining a consistent, high\-quality candidate experience.



You will manage the recruiting process from role intake and sourcing through interviews, offer coordination, and onboarding handoff, while keeping hiring managers informed and ensuring our ATS and recruiting data remain accurate and current.


**What You'll Do**



Global Talent Acquisition


* Manage full\-cycle recruiting for roles across Technology, Go\-to\-Market, HR/Workforce Management, and corporate functions.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand business needs, define role requirements, establish interview processes, and develop realistic hiring timelines.
* Develop sourcing strategies based on the role, location, seniority, and local talent market.
* Source both active and passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, professional networks, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
* Conduct candidate screening and initial interviews, assess qualifications against established requirements, and provide clear candidate feedback to hiring managers.
* Coordinate interviews and maintain momentum throughout the hiring process.
* Manage offer processes in partnership with the HR Manager and hiring managers.
* Complete recruiting activities and provide a clear handoff to HR for onboarding and new hire setup.
* Maintain consistent communication with candidates throughout the process and help deliver a strong candidate experience.


Global \& Multinational Recruiting


* Recruit across multiple countries and regions, including North America, LATAM, EMEA, and APAC.
* Understand how recruiting practices, talent availability, compensation expectations, employment considerations, and time zones can differ by market.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines in both established and emerging hiring markets.
* Coordinate effectively with candidates and hiring managers across multiple time zones.
* Develop practical sourcing strategies that balance talent quality, location, and cost considerations.


Recruiting Operations \& Process


* Manage candidate activity and workflows in Greenhouse, ensuring accurate candidate records, stage movement, interview feedback, and data hygiene.
* Create and maintain job postings, candidate outreach, interview plans, and scorecards.
* Track recruiting activity and provide regular reporting on pipeline health, time\-to\-fill, offers, hiring activity, and sourcing effectiveness.
* Help identify opportunities to improve recruiting processes, candidate experience, and hiring manager effectiveness.
* Maintain organized recruiting documentation and ensure processes are followed consistently.
* Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the company and hiring needs evolve.


Employer Branding \& Talent Engagement


* Develop compelling candidate outreach and job postings that accurately represent Globalli and the opportunity.
* Help strengthen Globalli's presence in relevant talent markets and professional communities.
* Support employee referrals, social sourcing, and other initiatives that expand our talent pipeline.


**What You'll Bring**



Must\-Have Qualifications


* 3\+ years of full\-cycle talent acquisition/recruiting experience, preferably in a fast\-paced technology, SaaS, startup, or multinational environment.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting across multiple functions, such as Technology, GTM/Sales, HR/Operations, Finance, or other professional roles.
* Experience managing the recruiting lifecycle from intake through onboarding handoff.
* Experience recruiting across multiple countries or international talent markets.
* Strong sourcing experience, including hands\-on use of LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools.
* Experience working with an ATS, preferably Greenhouse, including candidate tracking, workflow management, reporting, and data hygiene.
* Strong candidate assessment, communication, and relationship\-building skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple open requisitions and competing priorities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Comfortable working directly with hiring managers and clarifying or challenging requirements when needed.
* Fluent English, written and spoken.
* Reliable internet and a professional home\-office environment.
* Ability to maintain meaningful working\-hour overlap with the New York/Eastern Time zone.


Preferred Qualifications


* Experience recruiting for a global technology, SaaS, fintech, HR\-tech, payroll, or workforce management company.
* Technical recruiting experience, including engineering, SRE/infrastructure, data, or cloud roles.
* Experience recruiting GTM roles, including Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Partnerships, or Marketing.
* Experience recruiting HR, payroll, implementation, workforce management, or other operational roles.
* Experience recruiting across North America, LATAM, EMEA, and/or APAC.
* Spanish or another widely spoken business language.
* Experience recruiting in a remote\-first or distributed organization.
* Experience working with compensation benchmarks and adapting recruiting strategies to different geographic markets.
* Experience supporting employer branding, talent communities, or recruiting analytics.

* **Hardware Failure Isolation \& Vendor Management:** Perform initial hardware\-level troubleshooting to isolate equipment, chamber failures, or fixture anomalies from actual semiconductor device failures, working directly with equipment vendors to drive rapid issue resolution.
* **Lab Operations \& Safety Compliance:** Enforce ESD, laser, and thermal safety protocols, manage hardware spare parts inventory and procurement, and maintain lab safety to ensure a safe work environment.
* **Documentation and Job order:** Documentation of SOPs for the validated reliability infrastructure. Manage and create Job order forms and SOPs for external vendors, including scope of work, technical specifications, quality criteria, and packaging TAT timelines

**Minimum Qualification::** 

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechatronics, Materials Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–4 years of hands\-on experience with test or reliability equipment, stress chamber, lab instrumentation, or automation in a semiconductor/optoelectronic test or reliability lab environment.
* Working knowledge of operating and maintaining environmental chambers (High Temp stress, humidity stress, temperature cycling) or optoelectronic test fixtures.
* Foundational skill in basic data collection, equipment diagnostic scripting (e.g., Python, LabVIEW), and identifying hardware\-level anomalies vs. true device failures.

**Preferred Qualification::** 

* Master’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechatronics, Materials Engineering, Applied Physics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with test or reliability equipment, stress chambers, or automation in a semiconductor/optoelectronic environment.
* Advanced expertise in configuring, customizing, and optimizing environmental chambers and optoelectronic test fixtures for high\-throughput reliability testing.
* Advanced scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, LabVIEW) for developing complex hardware control sequences, automated data pipelines, and real\-time performance dashboards.

**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1742013
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**On\-site Technology Senior Support Specialist**


**(Senior Associate)**

  


**Enterprise Technology (ET)**



Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.



Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

  


**The opportunity**



As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.



The On\-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.

* Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately

* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.

* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.

* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4\-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support

  


**What we offer**



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. * **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long\-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS) is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge\-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS’s value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain.

We forge meaningful supplier relationships and strengthen supplier resilience to help EY maximize long\-term value for its people, clients and communities.
   

  

 As a Talent Procurement Team member you will have the opportunity to work with a professional team of Procurement professionals in a global environment and work with colleagues on interesting sourcing projects in the GDS. * Business acumen and commercial skills to help leadership drive procurement and demand management strategies across a broad array of portfolios.

* Strong negotiator and influencer capable of supporting leadership in driving alignment with key senior stakeholders and leaders.

* The ability to drive change by building strong, trusting relationships with senior stakeholders and business partners
* Sound judgment and decision\-making abilities
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage and prioritize workload

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English
* Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization

**What We Look For**
 We are looking for a high energy individual who embraces change to ensure we can continue to strategically deliver world\-class quantitative and brand value for the global EY organization in an ever\-changing business environment.

title: Head of Strategic Business Enablement, NTAM India
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

**Role/ Department:**


Drive operating model assessment and its evolution across NTAM India to deliver the business’ strategic growth and scale objectives. Play an active role in communicating and influencing the change agenda, including leading the successful implementation and adoption of AI across NTAM India. Provide strategic local leadership across capabilities, including Investment, Product, Risk, Marketing, Research, and Wealth. Ensure strong visibility and presence of NTAM India in the local market and NT. Responsible for attracting and growing talent across NTAM India.


The individual will serve as a senior leader, representing the function in governance forums and key decision\-making bodies, while influencing strategic outcomes and fostering alignment across stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Operating Model Evolution**

* Assess operating models, technology, process, and organizational opportunities and translate insights into actionable roadmaps.
* Lead select initiatives, including current\-state assessment, and design future\-state processes that are standardized, scalable, auditable, and technology\-enabled
* Lead value discovery and business value mapping initiatives to ensure transformation investments are aligned to strategic objectives and measurable business outcomes.
* Develop business cases, define success metrics, and track value realization to ensure transformation investments deliver measurable business and client outcomes.

**Communication and Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted, proactive relationships with global senior leaders by maintaining clear communication rhythms, surfacing insights early, and translating offshore execution perspectives into strategic recommendations.
* Influence across a global matrix by framing operating model assessments in terms of business value, risk, scalability, and growth, ensuring recommendations are practical, well\-socialized, and aligned with senior stakeholder priorities.
* Communicate a compelling AI and technology\-enabled change agenda, helping senior leaders understand the “what, so what, and now what” of opportunities to improve productivity, strengthen capabilities, and support business growth.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Learning and Adoption**

* Provide local thought leadership for NTAM India on AI, data, and digital learning agenda by curating relevant trends, use cases, and best practices that can be translated into practical business adoption opportunities.
* Partner with global teams to shape and oversee targeted training programs for India partners, aligning content, timing, and audience segmentation to build digital fluency, accelerate AI adoption, and strengthen future\-ready capabilities.

**Thought Leadership**

* Serve as a senior subject matter expert on Digital Products, Data Platforms, Artificial Intelligence and Asset Management technology, partnering with business, technology and platform leaders to shape future\-state capabilities.

**Change Leadership**

* Influence enterprise\-wide change agendas by providing expertise on business process transformation, platform modernization, digital adoption, and organizational effectiveness.

**Regional Leadership:**

* Act as the senior regional leader for NTAM's capabilities in India, providing oversight, connectivity and governance across Product, Investment Risk, Marketing, Quantitative Research, OCIO, Wealth and other investment\-support functions.
* Serve as the primary India\-based partner to global functional leaders, helping shape workforce strategy, operating model decisions, location strategy, organizational design and capability expansion across Non\-COO teams.

**Capability Expansion:**

* Partner with global stakeholders to identify, incubate and scale new capabilities in India, ensuring alignment to NTAM's growth strategy, future\-state operating model and evolving business priorities.

**Talent Leadership:**

* Build and sustain a high\-performing talent ecosystem across NTAM India by strengthening leadership pipelines, succession plans, capability development, coaching, and employee engagement to support current and future business needs. Promote an inclusive, collaborative, and growth\-oriented culture that supports innovation, engagement, and career development across diverse teams.

**Skills/ Experience Required:**

* Solid track record Asset Management or Asset Servicing, with broad experience gained ideally within a global asset manager or outsourcing provider.
* Highly adaptable leader with the ability to operate across a global matrixed organization and diverse business, investment, risk and enabling functions.
* Proven track record of leading transformational change initiatives and driving adoption across global, matrixed organizations.
* Proven ability as a proactive hands\-on leader and people manager to effectively drive and execute to high standards across a diverse and increasingly complex book of business.
* Ability to build authentic and high\-performing teams while fostering accountability, collaboration, and strong partner engagement.
* Strong track record of assessing risk, identifying opportunities, communicating solutions, and driving meaningful change.
* Highly organized, detail oriented and results focused individual with a strong track record in managing teams and self to deliver on multiple initiatives both locally and globally.
* Foster an environment which encourages ownership, excellence, employee engagement, teamwork, and communication.

**Technical \& Communication Skills**

* Exceptional communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex operational, technology, risk, and investment concepts into clear business outcomes for diverse stakeholder groups.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders, build trusted partnerships, challenge constructively, and drive alignment across complex global organizations.
* Strong understanding of asset management operating models, investment lifecycle processes, operational risk frameworks, data governance, and control environments.
* Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, digital workflow technologies, and data analytics, with the ability to identify and scale practical business use cases.
* Demonstrated ability to assess emerging industry trends, technologies, and best practices and translate them into practical business opportunities and operating model improvements.
* Ability to leverage data, metrics, and insights to evaluate performance, prioritize investments, measure outcomes, and support strategic decision\-making.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively, articulate a compelling vision, and drive adoption across geographically dispersed teams.
* Strong facilitation, negotiation, and conflict\-resolution skills, with the ability to navigate competing priorities and achieve alignment across stakeholders.
* Excellent written communication skills, including the preparation of executive\-level presentations, strategy papers, governance materials, and board\-ready updates.
* High degree of commercial acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect industry trends, emerging technologies, and organizational priorities to business outcomes.

**Experience \& Education**

* Strong preference for candidates with senior\-level experience at a large global asset management firm or a leading consulting organization supporting the asset management industry.
* 20\+ years of overall experience \& minimum 10 years of relevant Asset Management experience mandatory.
* Strong asset management domain knowledge; process transformation and operating model design; AI, automation, and data literacy; business analysis and product thinking; stakeholder leadership; change management; governance and control mindset; ability to translate strategy into executable delivery.
* Strong commercial sense with demonstrated ability to take industry trends, innovative behaviors, data analytics, and automation to drive growth, scale and risk management.
* Well\-developed project management skills organized and disciplined with attention to detail and ability to execute.
* University degree in any discipline (Engineering/Finance/Investments preferred) with a post graduate MBA degree/CFA from a premier institute.

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  



  

  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

  

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub \- Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

Exceptionally convincing and persuasive written and oral skills, with the ability to present and convey complex

title: Statutory & Labor Compliance Lead
description:
**About Us:** 




 Tata Electronics is a leading force in India’s growing electronics and semiconductor manufacturing industry, backed by the trusted legacy of the Tata Group. With world\-class facilities across Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Gujarat, and Assam, the company is driving innovation and supporting the nation’s “Make in India” vision. Today, Tata Electronics employs around 70,000 people and is rapidly expanding its footprint to shape the future of high\-tech manufacturing.
 



**TEPS Chennai** 
 , located in
 **Mahindra World City** 
 , is one of the flagship facilities of Tata Electronics, with a workforce of
 **10,000\+ employees** 
 . Known for its exceptional operational efficiency and high\-performance culture, the plant consistently delivers excellence in quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction. Driven by a motivated and passionate workforce, TEPS Chennai fosters innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement. More than a manufacturing facility, it is a center of growth, learning, and opportunity—contributing significantly to Tata Electronics’ vision of building a globally competitive and technologically advanced India.
 



  




* **Department \- Human Resources**
* **Division \- Employee Relations**
* **Job Title \- Statutory \& Compliance Lead**
* **Job Level \- Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager**
* **Location \- Chennai**
* **Reporting To \- Plant ER Lead**



  





**Job Specifications** 




  





**Desired Educational Background** 



* Bachelor's degree in human resources, Social Work, or a related field is required.
* Master's degree in human resources, Labor Welfare, Labor law or Employee Relations is preferred.
* Certification in Labor laws, compliance regulations, ER and IR is preferred



**Desired Experience** 



* 7\-10 years of experience in Statutory and Labor Compliance
* Working experience in manufacturing organization (Plant Location).
* Experience in electronic manufacturing or related industries is preferred.
* Experience in green field assignments or setting up of processes, systems, policies and implementation of rollouts is an added advantage
* Experience of working with a blue\-collared (on\-roll \& contract) or a unionized workforce is preferred



**Desired Certifications** 



* Additional certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, HR Systems, Employee Relations, and POSH will be considered an added advantage.



  





**What we are looking for:** 




**Role Purpose:** 
 The Statutory \& Labor Compliance Lead is a key individual contributor responsible for ensuring the organization's compliance with all applicable labor laws, statutory regulations, and legal requirements while mitigating compliance, legal, and operational risks. Operating at the intersection of governance, risk management, and business continuity, the Statutory \& Labour Compliance Lead drives compliance excellence through proactive compliance monitoring, implementation of statutory requirements, labour law compliance, contractor compliance governance, internal and external audits, customer audits, regulatory engagement, and policy deployment. The role ensures timely statutory filings, audit readiness, adherence to labour legislation, and effective closure of compliance observations while fostering a culture of integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 



  





**Who is it for?** 
 This is more than a compliance role—it's an opportunity to build a culture of integrity, governance, and operational excellence. If you're passionate about labor laws, regulatory compliance, and creating systems that enable sustainable business growth, this role is for you. You'll partner with business leaders, customers, regulatory authorities, and cross\-functional teams to drive audit readiness, strengthen compliance frameworks, and mitigate organizational risks. If you thrive in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment and enjoy turning regulatory requirements into practical business solutions, you'll make a meaningful impact in this role.
 



  





**What we Expect you to Bring:** 



* A people\-first mindset with strong shop\-floor presence and hands\-on execution.
* Ability to build trust, credibility, and meaningful relationships across all workforce segments.
* Strong expertise in Labor Codes, Central and State Labor Laws, Factory Regulations, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Analytical and risk assessment skills with the ability to identify compliance gaps and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Sound knowledge of Contract Labor Management, contractor compliance, and vendor governance.
* Data\-driven mindset with the ability to develop compliance dashboards, reports, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Curiosity and learning agility to interpret changing legal requirements and translate them into practical business processes.
* Expertise in handling Customer, Internal and External Audits.
* Experience in liaising with Government Authorities such as Labor Department, Factory Inspectorate, EPFO, ESIC etc.,
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic manufacturing environment while managing multiple compliance priorities.



  





**What you will get:** 



* Be a part of a TATA enterprise that’s reshaping India’s Global Electronics Manufacturing story
* A seat at the table in shaping a future\-ready manufacturing powerhouse
* Build a plant, a culture and legacy, not just a function
* The chance to build a culture of trust, fairness, and inclusion while making a measurable business impact.
* Work alongside experienced business leaders and HR professionals on transformational initiatives.
* Freedom to experiment, build and grow
* An environment that values initiative, ownership, and people\-impact



  





**Important Considerations:** 



1. This role is based at the plant (factory). It follows a six\-day workweek and will be a 100% work from office role
2. The plant operates 24X7, flexibility to work in shifts based on business or operational requirements
3. Prior experience of managing plant / shop floor workforce is preferred
4. Ability to communicate in English and Tamil is essential



  





**Contribution areas\- Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Statutory \& Labor Compliance Governance** 



* Ensure compliance with applicable Central \& State Labour Laws, Factory Regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Drive implementation of Labour Codes, legal amendments, and compliance policies across the organization.
* Develop and strengthen compliance frameworks, SOPs, and governance mechanisms.
* Monitor compliance performance through periodic reviews and dashboards.



**Audit \& Regulatory Readiness:** 



* Lead customer, internal, external, and statutory audits while ensuring continuous audit readiness.
* Manage regulatory inspections and coordinate timely closure of audit observations through CAPA.
* Maintain statutory registers, licenses, records, and documentation in line with legal requirements.
* Ensure monthly and annual customer audit compliance by tracking action plans and driving timely closure of observations.



**Contractor \& Vendor Compliance:** 



* Ensure statutory compliance of contractors and vendors in line with applicable labour laws.
* Conduct periodic compliance reviews and identify risks across the contractor ecosystem.
* Drive corrective actions to strengthen contractor governance and compliance maturity.



**Compliance Risk \& Legal Governance** 



* Identify and mitigate statutory, regulatory, and compliance risks.
* Monitor legislative changes and assess business impact.
* Lead compliance investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of preventive measures.
* Provide compliance insights and reports to leadership for informed decision\-making.



**Stakeholder \& Regulatory Engagement** 



* Build and maintain effective relationships with government authorities, customers, certification bodies, and external auditors.
* Provide expert guidance to HR, Operations, EHS, Procurement, and business leaders on statutory compliance matters.
* Support customer due diligence, regulatory submissions, and timely renewal of statutory licenses and approvals.



**External Interfaces** 



* **Government Agencies:** 
 Liaise with government agencies regarding employment law compliance audits or investigations.
* **Clients/ Customer:** 
 Prepare, review and present key talent metrics and insights with the clients during client visits and audits
* **Vendors:** 
 Continually inspect, provide feedback and hold vendors accountable for providing services that meet the agreed standards



**Internal Interface** 



* **HR Team:** 
 Partner to ensure compliance with labor laws, statutory documentation, employee records, contractor compliance, and implementation of labor law amendments.
* **Plant Operations:** 
 Collaborate to ensure shop\-floor operations comply with statutory requirements related to working hours, contractor deployment, welfare provisions, and regulatory standards.
* **EHS (Environment, Health \& Safety):** 
 Coordinate to ensure compliance with the Factories Act, occupational health \& safety regulations, statutory inspections, and corrective actions.
* **Legal Department:** 
 Legal Department: Consult on labor law interpretations, regulatory notices, compliance risks, government inspections, litigation support, and legal compliance requirements.








 Regards
 



 Human Resources

 Non\-CIB
   

  

**Position Purpose** 
 : The primary responsibility of this role is to conduct comprehensive supplier assessments throughout the contract lifecycle to mitigate financial, strategic, reputational, and legal risks for BNPP.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Conduct comprehensive risk evaluations for both new supplier onboarding and the continuous monitoring of existing suppliers.
* Assess multi\-dimensional risks, including financial stability (liquidity/solvency), economic dependency, financial security, and Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).
* Evaluate compliance and operational risks, specifically focusing on GDPR, IT/Cybersecurity, and general Operational Risk.
* Identify potential financial failures or high\-risk dependencies between suppliers and the Group.
* Facilitate Risk Sourcing Committees by coordinating with Group Strategic Sourcing, Entity Procurement Heads, Compliance, Legal, and Risk departments.
* Review and analyze Group and Entity\-level risk exposure to ensure alignment with the organizational risk appetite.
* Manage the lifecycle of supplier watchlists, including the accurate entry and exit of entities based on updated risk profiles
* Collaborate with Procurement teams to define, implement, and monitor supplier remediation plans.
* Provide on\-demand supplier risk assessments to support Buyers in procurement decision\-making.
* Deliver professional risk opinions and actionable insights during critical or high\-impact supplier situations.
* Identify opportunities for process optimization to enhance the efficiency of the TPRM lifecycle.


 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Sanctions \& AML Screening: Conduct deep\-dive screening of suppliers against global sanctions lists (OFAC, EU, UN) and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML) regulations.
* UBO Identification: Perform detailed investigations into Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO) to ensure transparency and prevent conflict of interest or shell company risks.
* Regulatory Horizon Scanning: Stay updated on evolving global regulations (such as the EU Supply Chain Due Diligence Directive) to ensure KYS processes remain compliant.
* PEP Screening: Monitor and assess risks associated with Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs) within supplier ownership structures.
* Monitor real\-time alerts, adverse media, and critical information regarding the supplier landscape.
* Utilize advanced Open\-Source Intelligence techniques to detect negative news or reputational threats in multiple languages or local jurisdictions.


 Contributing Responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure the integrity of internal and external risk management tools by maintaining real\-time data updates based on performed assessments.
* Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of KYS processes, workflows, and methodologies.


**Technical \& Behavioral Competencies**
* In\-depth knowledge of Know Your Supplier (KYS), KYC, and AML (Anti\-Money Laundering) regulations.
* Proven expertise in Risk Assessment methodologies and the application of a Risk\-Based Approach (RBA).
* Advanced proficiency in Ultimate Beneficial Ownership (UBO/BO) identification and verification procedures.
* Ability to perform financial health assessments, including the review of balance sheets and financial statements.
* Experience in conducting sanctions screening, PEP (Politically Exposed Persons) identification, and adverse media monitoring.

 –

**About Global Delivery Services**

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for people with expertise in
 **Oracle GRC Senior Consultant** 
 to join our
 **EY\-GDS GRC Technology Team** 
 . This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of the service offering.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Reviews materials and supports in meetings and workshops with business stakeholders to understand and gather business / functional requirements, undertaking client assessments and building relationships with business stakeholder.
* Builds relationships and collaborates with the wider team to understand business requirements and translates these into complex technical requirements.
* Produces technical specifications to guide system architectural design and development and conducts quality assurance tasks to ensure completeness of requirements, peer reviewing the work of more junior members of the team.
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and forms recommendations for system and technical components based on understanding of business requirements, reviewing and supporting with process modelling and improvement.
* Contributes to the design and review of test cases to ensure tests adequately meet the requirements and coordinates with infrastructure and operations teams to resolve system issues, contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project.
* Provides insights on whether solutions and technologies being implemented are meeting business requirements.
* Contributes to business case development and completes RFP responses, exploring and experimenting with new and existing data to tackle defined business problems .


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Proven experience gathering and interpreting business requirements.
* Proven experience developing technical requirements and specifications, including knowledge of software engineering methodologies, reporting tools, modelling and testing.
* Proven understanding of Lean Six Sigma and Business Process Modelling and Notation.
* Knowledge on application building using Python would be an added advantage.


**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Preferably CA/MBA/B.E/B.Tech with 3 to 7 years of implementation and advisory experience on Oracle Cloud ERP/EBS security and controls.
* Ability to drive risk and control programs for Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud, with a focus on the following:
* 
+ Segregation of duty concerns in an ERP environment along with an ability to design SoD (Segregation of Duties) risk libraries, and preparation of remediation roadmaps.
+ System role\-design, build security and troubleshoot security defects.
+ Design risk control matrices by conducting workshops with business process owners.
+ Review Oracle ERP IT Application Controls (ITAC) for test of design and test of effectiveness.
+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.
+ Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks like COSO, COBIT.
+ Knowledge and audit experience across regulations like SOX, GDPR, CCPA.

* Functional knowledge on Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud Financials, Procurement, Supply chain management, Projects and HRMS is a pre\-requisite.
* Sound relevant experience in either an internal or external business analysis role and/or software / technical analysis role or similar, evidenced by adding business value through identifying, analysing and articulating problems and solutions .
* Developed technical knowledge and experience in delivering IT solutions, providing technical advice and understanding user requirements.
* Some stakeholder management experience.
* Ability to simplify data and explain trends through Excel spreadsheets, dashboards, power\-point presentations is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of Oracle GRC (Governance, Risk \& Compliance) \& Oracle Risk Management Cloud (RMC) is highly desirable.
* Working knowledge on Peoplesoft, NetSuite, MS Dynamics and Workday would be an added advantage.
* Willing to learn and work on different ERPs and CRM solutions


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 1400 \+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s shared core values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****Role Summary****
**Title:** 
 Senior Director, Learning \& Development GroupM India.
   

  

**Reporting into:** 
 Head of Talent Management GroupM India.
   

  

**Minimum work experience:** 
 At least 12 years in Talent Management or the Learning \&
   

  

 Development function.

 Talent Partners and Business Leaders in Agencies and
   

  

 Units, GroupM India Training Community, Regional Learning \& Development team, WPP India Talent team.
   

  

 Work with ‘Purposeful People’ and realize your own passion along the way. Enlisting into and supporting our Communities and Employee Resource Groups will allow you to contribute to a larger cause, creating an environment where people bring their best self and do their best work.
   

  

* Enjoy freedom of thought and autonomy of action. Create mastery of your own craft, power skills and digital transformation. Drive constant learning and development opportunities for our people in varied and extensive disciplines.
* As a senior Learning \& Development leader, you get to influence the C\-suite, the trainer’s community and high\-performance business teams. You will be challenged, inspired and supported in equal measure by the leadership.


**Role Impact**
* Designing, structuring Learning \& Development programs and initiatives:
* Conduct thorough needs analysis and consult the business on challenges, priorities, development opportunities.
* Design a high\-level learning strategy in line with business priorities.
* Align the strategy with external partners/faculty, the Regional Learning \& Development team and GroupM’s Trained Trainers.
* Customize programs for business groups in line with instructional design principles.
* Design an evaluation model to measure impact of learning on teams, clients and the overall business.
* Structure end\-to\-end long term learning programs for entry level talent.
* Execution of learning strategy:
* Lead the preparation and marketing of the learning calendar to ensure a steady stream of program delivery.
* Refresh systems and processes to run mass trainings on scale, including budgeting, scoping, scheduling and delivery.
* Spearhead the engagement with Learning Champions – upskilling, feedback, recognition.
* Facilitate mid/senior level sessions – both virtually and in\-person.
* Execute learning audit and talent management surveys, prepare debrief reports and comms to the leadership and all\-staff.
* Leverage the LMS support the delivery, reporting and overall management of learning to all employees.
* Driving a culture of high performance:
* Manage the entire performance management cycle – from goal\-setting to check\-ins, appraisals and reviews.
* Hold teams accountable on timelines and ensure completion in time for increment cycles.
* Suggest Learning \& Development solutions based on performance appraisals of identified high potential cohorts.
* Work with the GroupM Youth Executive Committee (YCO) on their development goals – projects, reverse mentoring, individual growth plans. Collaborate with Agency Talent teams to proactively retain the YCO.
* Supporting GroupM Communities and Employee Resource Groups:
* Formulate a hybrid working strategy that ensures productivity, performance, empathy, welfare and well\-being.
* Enlist into employee communities, support initiatives and programs that shape our culture. Author specific wellness solutions for cohorts such as returning moms, first time managers, parents juggling work and children,
* Partner with experts in the field of physical fitness, mental health and mindfulness at the GroupM level and customize efforts for Agencies.
* Maintain a microsite that serves as a repository for all resources for welfare and wellbeing.
* Partner with the Talent Acquisition team on the internship program for the LGBTQIA\+ group and women returning to work. Curate content for sensitivity trainings for interviewer panel and teams where interns are hired.


****Skills And Experience****
* Proficiency and expertise:
* Certified in instructional design, Train\-the\-trainer, 360 feedback tool and a recognized behavioural assessment.
* Expert facilitator for mid\-senior level cohorts.
* Confident in engaging and communicating (with proven excellence \& empathy) with business teams and employee cohorts.
* Comfortable with technology, data and has a digital\-first mindset. Knowledge of the digital world (E\-commerce, performance, programmatic, mobile, social media).
* Business understanding:
* Gradual and steady grasp on the business to be able to not only understand business needs and priorities but translate them into Learning \& Development opportunities.
* Understand roles, structures, cohorts and talent culture.
* Understand GroupM’s business goals and talent objectives.
* Able to question a brief, arrive at the problem statement, craft appropriate solutions.
* Autonomy and self\-leadership:
* Able to lead agendas independently once the direction is aligned.
* Knows when to ask for timely help.
* Able to mobilize resources to get the job done.
* Invested in self\-growth and has a keen learner’s mindset.
* Influence without Authority:
* Ability to influence and impact business teams and talent leadership
* Collaborator with external experts/faculty/partners, internal talent teams, WPP teams and cultural communities.
* Ability to navigate a complex organization structure.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and is able to take risks.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy\-policy) for more information on how we process the information you provide.
   

  

 While we appreciate all applications received, only those candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.

* Lead and manage the APAC People Operations team, providing coaching, guidance, and career development.

Hyderabad

description:

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.


The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas.As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C CoE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function.Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.


The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.

**In this role, you will:**

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions.Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.

* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery.Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team

**Knowledge \& Qualifications**

* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions.Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making.Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes.Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation.Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans.Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities.Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high\-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer\-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
   

  

 The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high\-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer\-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions


**Essential Traits**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.


**About Kroll**
 Join the global leader in risk and financial advisory solutions—Kroll. With a nearly century\-long legacy, we blend trusted expertise with cutting\-edge technology to navigate and redefine industry complexities. As a part of One Team, One Kroll, you'll contribute to a collaborative and empowering environment, propelling your career to new heights. title: Regional Operations Director
description:
****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world\-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP's AI\-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
   

  

 For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
   

  

****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
   

  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.


****About The Role****
 We are searching for a talented and enthusiastic individual to join our OpenDoor team as an APAC Operations Director. This is a full\-time position based in India. This role plays a crucial part in supporting WPP's mission to deliver consistency, delivery excellence and best in class service for Amazon in every country across its diverse businesses.
   

  

**Responsiblities**
 The APAC Operations Director will focus on six areas, working continuously with OpenDoor leaders to ensure success across each aspect for OpenDoor in APAC.
   

  

**Financial Operations**
* Own the APAC financial operations strategy, driving improvements in financial health, controls, accuracy, and process compliance across all markets.
* Establish governance frameworks and performance standards across billing, revenue recognition, PO management, commission reconciliation, and financial reporting processes.
* Partner with Global Commercial and FinOps teams to ensure consistent adoption of global standards, controls, and SOX requirements across APAC.
* Lead resolution of significant financial operational risks, trends, and recurring process failures.


**Process \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the regional operational improvement roadmap, identifying opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate, and scale operational processes.
* Ensure operational processes remain fit for purpose and aligned to evolving business and client requirements.
* Sponsor cross\-functional initiatives that improve efficiency, reduce operational risk, and strengthen governance.
* Act as the regional escalation point for complex operational challenges requiring structural or process change.


**Operational Excellence**
* Establish and monitor operational performance measures across APAC, including financial compliance, workflow adoption, PBR performance, and operational service quality.
* Lead regional operational reviews, ensuring actions, risks, and opportunities are actively managed and resolved.
* Drive accountability for adherence to agreed operational standards, policies, and ways of working.
* Provide operational performance reporting and insights to regional and global leadership teams.


**Project Management**
* Lead APAC participation in global transformation programmes, operational initiatives, and platform deployments.
* Prioritise and oversee regional operational projects, ensuring alignment with business objectives and strategic priorities.
* Coordinate cross\-market delivery of operational change programmes and process improvements.
* Ensure project outcomes are effectively embedded into business\-as\-usual operations.


**Operating Model Effectiveness**
* Partner with market and regional leaders to identify capability gaps, onboarding requirements, and opportunities to improve operational maturity.
* Support implementation of consistent onboarding, role clarity, and operational standards across markets.
* Build strong relationships with regional stakeholders to ensure Operations remains aligned to business needs while maintaining global consistency.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead and develop the APAC Operations team, setting clear priorities, objectives, and performance expectations.
* Coach and support team members to build capability, drive accountability, and encourage continuous improvement.
* Allocate resources and workload to ensure effective delivery against regional and global priorities.
* Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture focused on operational excellence and stakeholder partnership.


****Qualifications****
* Strong experience in media, business operations, financial operations, or operational leadership roles.
* Good understanding of media agency functions, delivery models, and financial processes.
* Proven track record of driving operational improvement, transformation, and organisational change.
* Experience implementing governance frameworks, controls, and performance management processes.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and challenge senior leaders.
* Excellent project and programme management capabilities.
* Outstanding communication, relationship\-building, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience leading and developing high\-performing teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.


****Life At WPP Media \& Benefits****
 Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media \& WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in\-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
   

  

 WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
   

  

 Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.
