description:
**Description**
 About LegalZoom
   

  

 LegalZoom is on a mission to help people navigate the legal system with confidence and clarity. As a leader in online legal services for over 25 years, we combine technology, attorney\-led solutions, and expertise to protect the aspirations, lives, and legacies of millions of customers. If you’re ready to contribute to a collaborative, diverse, and distributed group of creative thinkers and problem\-solvers, we can’t wait to meet you.
   

  

 Human\-in\-the\-Loop
   

  

 At LegalZoom, we operate with a human\-in\-the\-loop model, where AI enhances—rather than replaces—human judgment. We believe the strongest outcomes for our customers come from thoughtfully integrating human expertise with AI capabilities to improve accuracy, safety, and decision\-making.
   

  

 To align with our AI\-integrated operating model, our interview process will assess AI fluency, curiosity, and measurable/impactful workflow integration.
   

  

 Where we work
   

  

 Our Bengaluru office allows our employees to collaborate with teammates and offer special onsite events, lunches, and more.
   

  

**Overview**
 Our Finance team is seeking an accounting professional who is familiar with a variety of accounting concepts, business practices, and procedures. We seek an individual who embraces challenges and can rely on his/her experience, educational background and sound judgment to plan and accomplish goals.
   

  

 The General Ledger Analyst, India Finance Operations, will be responsible for supporting our US Accounting \& Consolidation team, and assisting with the establishment of our new accounting shared\-services function in Bangalore, India, which will partner and collaborate with our US Finance \& Accounting team. The successful candidate will be a self\-starter, strong communicator and thrives in a team environment. We are looking for a candidate who is eager to learn and grow within a fast\-paced technology company, to gain exposure to US GAAP accounting principles and internal controls using Oracle Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) tools.
   

  

 You will
   

  

* Report directly to the Group Manager, India Accounting Operations,
* Assist with the processing of general accounting transactions including: cash and bank reconciliations, fixed assets, leases, prepayments and accruals
* Prepare journal entries as part of the monthly close cycle
* Assist with preparation of balance sheet accounts reconciliations
* Analyze and comment on monthly, quarterly, annual variances within income statement and balance sheet line items
* Assist in the preparation of documentation in support of our internal control environment for SOX compliance
* Respond to audit requests in a timely manner
* Assist with ad hoc Oracle reports and requests from the business


 You have
   

  

* At least 2\-3 years of experience in processing and paying invoices; preferably with a major technology company
* Bachelor degree in accounting or related field required
* Strong knowledge and experience with Oracle
* Good knowledge of Indian tax
* Knowledge of ERP general ledger systems
* Must have a basic understanding of US GAAP and/or India accounting principles
* Excellent written, oral and analytical skills
* Collaboration and able to work within a team environment
* Must be proficient in Microsoft office including including intermediate to advanced Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, vlookups)


 Join us in making a difference as we build our future and help ensure access to professional legal advice to all! **Qualification – Mandatory**
 CA with 2–4 years of relevant experience
   

  

**Good To Have**

 COSO ERM certification
   

  

 ISO 31000 certification
   

  

 Other recognized Risk Management / Enterprise Risk Management certifications
   

  

**Jd**
**Detailed Job Description**
 The Manager / Assistant Manager – Enterprise Risk Management will support the design, execution, monitoring, and continuous enhancement of the organization's enterprise\-wide risk management framework.
   

  

 The role will work closely with business and support\-function leaders to identify and assess key enterprise risks, establish and monitor Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), evaluate emerging risks, and provide meaningful risk insights to senior management.
   

  

 The position requires a strong understanding of business processes, risk assessment methodologies, scenario planning, and the broader macroeconomic, geopolitical, and regulatory environment. The role will also contribute to risk reporting, governance forums, and initiatives aimed at improving the efficiency and effectiveness of enterprise risk monitoring.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Enterprise Risk Management**
 Lead and coordinate enterprise\-wide risk identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting across business and support functions.
   

  

 Support the implementation and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Risk Management framework.
   

  

 Engage with business and functional stakeholders to understand processes, identify risk exposures, assess controls, and evaluate potential business impacts.
   

  

 Facilitate periodic risk assessments and ensure timely closure or mitigation of identified risks.
   

  

 Maintain appropriate documentation and governance around enterprise risks.
   

  

**Risk Register \& KRI Management**
 Maintain and periodically update the enterprise Risk Register.
   

  

 Define, review, monitor, and track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 Ensure appropriate management review and sign\-offs for risk assessments, KRIs, and risk mitigation actions.
   

  

 Independently perform KRI assessments and conduct discussions with relevant stakeholders to understand deviations, trends, and underlying risk drivers.
   

  

 Identify trends and potential areas of increased risk and escalate significant observations through appropriate governance channels.
   

  

**Scenario \& Sensitivity Analysis**
 Perform scenario analysis to assess the potential impact of identified enterprise risks.
   

  

 Conduct sensitivity analysis for key business, financial, operational, and strategic risks.
   

  

 Develop risk scenarios based on historical events, emerging trends, macroeconomic conditions, and business\-specific vulnerabilities.
   

  

 Support management in understanding potential risk outcomes and evaluating mitigation strategies.
   

  

**Macroeconomic \& Emerging Risk Monitoring**
 Monitor macroeconomic, geopolitical, regulatory, industry, and emerging\-risk developments.
   

  

 Assess the potential impact of external developments on the organization's business, financial performance, operations, and strategic objectives.
   

  

 Translate external risk developments into relevant enterprise risk considerations for management review.
   

  

**Risk Reporting \& Governance**
 Contribute to the preparation of quarterly Risk Dashboards, risk reports, and management presentations.
   

  

 Support reporting to the Risk Committee, Chief Risk Office, and senior leadership.
   

  

 Present risk trends, KRI movements, emerging risks, scenario analysis, and key observations in a clear and concise manner.
   

  

 Ensure risk reporting is accurate, timely, and supported by appropriate data and stakeholder inputs.
   

  

**Integrated Risk Governance**
 Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, ESG, Finance, Strategy, and other relevant functions to promote an integrated approach to risk governance.
   

  

 Identify areas of overlap or interdependency between enterprise risks, compliance risks, audit observations, ESG risks, and business risks.
   

  

 Support cross\-functional initiatives related to risk governance and control enhancement.
   

  

**Automation \& Digital Enablement**
 Support initiatives to automate risk monitoring, KRI tracking, data collection, dashboards, and reporting.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to improve risk management processes through technology and data\-driven solutions.
   

  

 Demonstrate a basic understanding of AI concepts and their potential application in risk monitoring, analysis, reporting, and decision support.
   

  

 Work with relevant technology/data teams to improve the efficiency and scalability of risk reporting processes.
   

  

**Key Skills**
 Enterprise Risk Management, Risk Analysis, Business \& Process Understanding, External \& Emerging Risk, Risk Governance \& Reporting, Audit, Compliance \& Controls.

title: Accounts Executive
description:
**Location: Kalyan Nagar, Bengaluru** 




  





**Role Overview:** 




 To manage day\-to\-day accounting operations, ensure accurate and timely accounting entries, support statutory compliance, reconciliations, vendor payments, budgeting, and assist in the preparation of financial and management reports.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Accounting \& Bookkeeping** 




 · Record day\-to\-day accounting transactions in Tally.
 



 · Prepare and post journal entries, payment entries, receipt entries, purchase and sales entries.
 



 · Maintain accurate books of accounts and supporting documentation.
 



 · Ensure proper ledger classification and accounting treatment.
 



 · Review and reconcile subsidiary ledgers with the general ledger.
 



**2\. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management** 




 · Verify vendor invoices with supporting documents and approvals.
 



 · Check GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements on invoices.
 



 · Prepare vendor payment statements and payment proposals.
 



 · Reconcile vendor accounts and follow up on outstanding balances.
 



 · Ensure timely processing of vendor payments.
 



**3\. Accounts Receivable \& Collections** 




 · Record and reconcile customer/student receipts.
 



 · Monitor outstanding receivables and prepare ageing reports.
 



 · Follow up with concerned teams for collection\-related issues.
 



 · Perform customer/student ledger reconciliations.
 



**4\. Bank \& Ledger Reconciliation** 




 · Prepare monthly bank reconciliations.
 



 · Identify and resolve unreconciled transactions.
 



 · Perform inter\-company and inter\-unit reconciliations.
 



 · Reconcile major balance sheet and income statement ledgers.
 



**5\. GST \& TDS Compliance Support** 




 · Assist in GST reconciliation and return preparation.
 



 · Verify input tax credit and reconcile purchase data with GST records.
 



 · Assist with TDS calculations, deductions and reconciliations.
 



 · Support preparation of TDS returns such as 24Q and 26Q.
 



 · Ensure proper accounting of RCM transactions wherever applicable.
 



**6\. Budgeting \& Financial Planning** 




 · Assist in preparation of annual budgets.
 



 · Collect and consolidate budget requirements from different departments/cost centres.
 



 · Track actual expenditure against approved budgets.
 



 · Prepare budget vs. actual variance reports.
 



 · Highlight significant variances and support the Finance Manager in analysing the reasons.
 



 · Assist in preparing periodic forecasts and financial projections.
 



**7\. Month\-End \& Year\-End Closing** 




 · Assist in monthly closing activities.
 



 · Prepare provisions, accruals and adjustment entries.
 



 · Ensure all income and expenses are accounted for in the correct period.
 



 · Support year\-end closing and finalisation of accounts.
 



**8\. MIS \& Reporting** 




 · Prepare regular MIS reports as required by management.
 



 · Prepare ageing reports, expense reports, budget vs. actual reports and reconciliation statements.
 



 · Provide accounting data and analysis to the Finance Manager.
 



 · Support budgeting, forecasting and variance analysis.
 



**9\. Audit \& Statutory Requirements** 




 · Provide required documents and schedules for statutory, internal and tax audits.
 



 · Coordinate with auditors for routine information and clarifications.
 



 · Maintain proper documentation and audit trails.
 



 · Assist in resolving audit observations.
 



**10\. Documentation \& Internal Controls** 




 · Maintain proper accounting records and supporting documents.
 



 · Follow established finance policies and approval processes.
 



 · Ensure compliance with internal controls and accounting procedures.
 



 · Identify discrepancies and report them to the reporting manager.
 



  





**Required Skills** 



* Good knowledge of accounting principles and bookkeeping.
* Strong knowledge of Tally Prime.
* Working knowledge of GST and TDS.
* Good understanding of bank, vendor and ledger reconciliation.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel, including basic reporting and data analysis.
* Basic understanding of budgeting and variance analysis.
* Ability to analyse accounting data and identify discrepancies.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple tasks.



  





**Educational Qualification** 




 · B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.
 



 · CA Inter / CMA Inter qualification would be an added advantage.
 



**Experience** 



* **2–5 years** 
 of relevant experience in accounting and finance.
* Experience in
 **education, services, or multi\-entity organisations** 
 would be an advantage.

 "Apply\-to\-Disburse" journey for users.

 across Pan India digitally.
 



 ● Incentive Design: Manage subvention programs and promotional budgets to drive conversion
 



 without eroding margins.
 



 ● Entrepreneurial Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity and have the grit to build a vertical
 



 in a fast\-paced environment.
 



 ● Funnel Optimization: Deep\-dive into the conversion funnel—from lead generation to loan
 



 sanction—to identify and fix drop\-offs.
 



 ● Risk \& Quality: Work closely with the partners Risk team to ensure the lead quality meets lender
 



 appetite while maintaining a healthy "Approval Rate."
 



 ● Analytical Rigor: You are a "Power User" of Excel. You don't just report numbers; you find the
 



 story within them to drive strategy.
 



 What We Are Looking For
 



 ● Experience: 6–10 years of experience, ideally in a FinTech, Digital Lending, or a high\-growth
 



 E\-commerce environment. Direct experience in Auto Finance is a huge plus.
 



 Qualifications:
 



 Education: MBA in Finance, Banking or a related field.
 



 Experience: 6 to 10 years of experience in lending operations, with at least 5 years in the Two\-Wheeler
 



 finance sector.

 the unique opportunity to solve for credit under\-penetration in the automobile sector using data and
 



 technology at a scale very few companies globally can offer.
 



 Note: This role requires a balance of "feet\-on\-street" partnership hustle and "office\-at\-desk" analytical
 



 depth.
 



 To succeed in this role – you should have the following: \*
 



 ● Strong understanding of the Indian two\-wheeler market and lending landscape.
 



 ● Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, and forecasting.
 



 ● Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
 



 ● Ability to drive digital transformation and process automation in lending operations.
 



 Mandatory Skills
 



 Understanding of Two Wheeler \& Four Wheeler Financing business, Ability to analyze data, Stakeholder
 



 Management, Strong Problem Solving Skills, Strong Excel Skills
 



  





 1\. Strategic Partnerships \& Marketplace Building
 



 2\. P\&L Ownership \& Scaling
 



 3\. Data\-Driven Decision Making

As a Receptionist supporting our Technical Support team, you are the crucial first point of contact for our customers. In this high\-volume role, you will answer incoming calls, capture key details about customer issues, and perform seamless warm transfers to available Tech Support Agents. You will also ensure misrouted calls reach the correct departments efficiently while maintaining a professional and welcoming demeanor.### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Call Handling \& Intake:** Answer incoming calls promptly, maintaining a high volume of 30–40 calls daily per team member.
* **Troubleshooting Documentation:** Active\-listen to customer issues, capturing detailed, accurate notes on their technical inquiries and symptoms.
* **Warm Transfers:** Execute seamless, warm hand\-offs of qualified technical issues to available Tech Support agents with context provided.
* **Call Routing:** Direct misrouted or non\-technical calls efficiently to the appropriate internal departments.
* **Customer Care:** Act as the first point of contact, providing a professional and welcoming initial impression for all incoming callers.
* **High\-Level Escalation:** Solve complex hardware and firmware challenges, providing real\-time guidance on on\-site wiring, terminations, and device programming.
* **Agile Queue Management:** Thrive in a high\-volume environment, managing a "round\-robin" flow of emails and chats with precision and speed.
* **Emphasize Ownership, Urgency, and Positive Persistence:** Own issues that are presented to you and drive them with the urgency you would if it were you waiting for the solution. Persist in your efforts to resolve issues \- engaging with necessary resources inside and outside your team.

  

### **Skills, Knowledge \& Expertise**

 **Technical Mastery*** **Education:** B.E./B.Sc. in Electronics, Electrical, or Telecommunications.
* **Experience:** 1\+ years in a technical helpdesk or hardware support role.
* **The "Toolbox":** Solid understanding of electronic components (Relays, Resistors, etc.), low\-voltage power principles, and the ability to read circuit diagrams.
* **Networking:** Practical knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, and networking troubleshooting. **CCNA or CompTIA Network\+** certifications are a major plus.

**Communication \& Soft Skills*** **Clarity:** You can explain a complex electrical ground loop issue simply and professionally.
* **Ownership:** A "stick\-to\-it" mindset. You own the problem until the dealer’s door locks and unlocks as intended.
* **Adaptability:** Comfortable toggling between high\-level cloud software (SaaS) and "boots\-on\-the\-ground" hardware issues.
* **Communication:** Exceptional communication skills to deal with global clientele. We're looking at folks who have managed global communications in the past.

  

### **About Brivo**

  

Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category\-defining, cloud\-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single\-site businesses to global enterprises.  

  

As the unified global leaders in cloud\-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI\-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90\+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real\-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.  

  

With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber\-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.  

  

*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

Qualifications:
**To land this role you will need**:


* 7\+ years of experience as a Senior Linux Administrator.

* Experience with software development lifecycle

* Experience with virtualization technologies, such as VMware or KVM.
* Familiarity with cloud services, such as Azure, AWS is a plus.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* A proactive approach to system monitoring and issue resolution.

**Working environment:**

* 4 days' work from office.

description:

Sectigo holds six combined active leadership seats in the CA/Browser Forum and ETSI and brings two decades of delivering unparalleled digital trust.
   

  

  

  

**Simplicity at Scale.**
  

  

  

 How we show up with each other and our customers every day is just as important, and we win as \#OneSectigo by living out our core values \- Support, Excellence, Communication, Teamwork, Integrity, Growth and Openness. We are committed to investing in our diverse teams where everyone understands their role and how they support our strategic goals, we drive operational excellence through scale and efficiency, and we strive to delight our customers and become the market leader in our industry. If you aspire to join a driven team that holds each other accountable to meeting our lofty goals and you’d like to be part of our growth story in delivering a market leading user experience, we’d like to talk to you.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are looking for a talented Technical Support Specialist to join our growing global team at Sectigo.
   

  





 The
 **Technical Support Specialist** 
 is the
 **first line of support** 
 for Sectigo's growing global customer base — enterprises, partners, and organizations that rely on our industry\-leading security solutions to protect their digital infrastructure. This individual works in a structured, collaborative support environment where their networking knowledge, troubleshooting instincts, and customer communication skills are put to work every day.
   

  

  

  

 Please Note: The Reporting Manager and the Work Arrangement requirements may be modified and redesigned based on business needs to ensure operational flexibility and organizational effectiveness.
   

  





  

  

 This is a full\-time and in\-office position, working 5 days a week from our Chennai office at DLF IT Park, Manapakkam.
   

  





 Here are the core functions, responsibilities, and expectations for this role:
   

  





**Customer Support \& Engagement**



* Serve as the
 **first point of contact** 
 for inbound technical support requests submitted via phone, email, and chat.
* Deliver prompt, clear, empathetic, and professional responses to customers of varying technical backgrounds.
* Conduct structured troubleshooting conversations to quickly identify, isolate, and document customer issues.
* Guide customers step\-by\-step through technical problems using approved knowledge base articles and support workflows.
* Proactively communicate case status updates to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the resolution process.



**Technical Troubleshooting \& Issue Management**



* Apply strong
 **network and systems troubleshooting skills** 
 to diagnose and resolve common technical issues.
* Utilize internal tools, ticketing systems, and external resources to investigate reported problems efficiently.
* Prioritize and manage multiple open cases simultaneously, adhering to SLA (Service Level Agreement) response and resolution targets.
* Accurately document all findings, steps taken, and outcomes in the support ticketing system to support auditability and root cause tracking.
* Identify patterns in recurring issues and escalate trends to Team Leads for further investigation.



**Escalation \& Team Collaboration**



* Recognize when a case requires escalation and ensure a
 **high\-quality handoff** 
 to senior support staff or specialist teams, complete with:
	+ Clear problem summaries
	+ Diagnostic data, logs, and screenshots
	+ Reproduction steps and customer environment details
* Collaborate with Shift Leads, Team Leads, and cross\-functional teams to resolve customer issues efficiently.
* Participate in team meetings, quality reviews, and training sessions to continuously sharpen your skills.



**Knowledge \& Process Contribution**



* Contribute to the team's internal
 **knowledge base** 
 by documenting resolved issues, common troubleshooting steps, and customer\-facing FAQs.
* Follow established support procedures to ensure consistency, quality, and operational efficiency.
* Support continuous improvement efforts by flagging process gaps or recurring friction points to team leadership.
* Participate in additional projects and initiatives aligned with the team's goals and Requirements



 Additional tasks associated with this position may be assigned in response to company initiatives and business needs.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Education:**



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Administration, or a related technical field, or equivalent hands\-on experience is strongly recommended.



**Experience:**



* Minimum 1 year of experience in a technical support, help desk, IT administration, or network operations role.
* 1–3 years of experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience using ticketing or service desk platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, or equivalent).
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills are required. Additional language proficiency is a significant asset.
* Solid understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals and network troubleshooting methodologies is required.
* Working knowledge of DNS (Domain Name System) — record types, resolution, and common misconfigurations is required.
* Familiarity with Active Directory and directory services concepts is required.
* Experience with Windows Server and/or Linux environments is required.
* Comfort using command\-line tools for diagnostics (e.g., ping, tracert, nslookup, curl, netstat) is required.
* Understanding of web technologies including HTTP/HTTPS, web servers, and hosting platforms is required.
* Familiarity with API request/response structures and basic web security principles is required.



 The following certifications are considered an excellent fit for this role and will be given significant weight in the hiring process:
   

  




* CompTIA Network\+ or CompTIA Security\+
* Cisco CCNA (Cisco Certified Network Associate)
* CompTIA A\+ or CompTIA CySA\+
* Microsoft, AWS, or equivalent cloud/infrastructure certifications are also an asset.



**Ideal Candidate Profiles, Talents, and Desired Qualifications:**



* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with attention to detail and ability to multitask.
* Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work in different time zones, rotational shifts with Skeletal staffing on weekends.
* Superior customer service and phone mannerism required to handle support of Sectigo's customer base.
* Experience working with customers across geographies like US \& UK customers.
* Computer literacy skills, including the use of email, and word processing applications.
* Possess qualities such as integrity, curiosity, fair\-mindedness, and a persuasive, team player.
* Ability to thrive in a start\-up environment while applying existing skill sets and training to increase knowledge base.
* Must be able to work shifts, including holidays based on business needs, with possible weekends and after\-hours.
* Must be willing to carry the after\-hour support pager.


**Additional Information**

**Sectigo is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**




 At Sectigo, we are committed to providing equal opportunities throughout your career. We hire and promote the most qualified individuals based on their skills, experience, job requirements, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the countries where we operate.
   

  





 Our “One Sectigo” culture fosters a strong sense of belonging and supports a respectful, inclusive workplace free from discrimination and harassment.
   

  





**Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Our Hiring Process at Sectigo:**




 To enhance your experience, Sectigo may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools during the recruitment process. We are committed to using AI responsibly and transparently, ensuring fairness, accuracy, and human oversight at every stage.
   

  





**Global team. Global reach. Global impact.**
  

  

  

 At Sectigo, we believe doing good is good business. Our strength and our success come from our team of passionate, engaged individuals who make a difference, both locally and globally. Our commitment to engagement is rooted in an unconditionally inclusive workforce, embodying our unique perspectives, heritages, and backgrounds, all as diverse as the experiences of each Sectigo employee. Importantly, we strive to be recognized not only as the CLM leader but also for our intentional efforts to promote employees into the roles that most challenge and excite them, into experiences that allow them to grow their interests as we grow the business. We are committed to bringing a little bit of fun and a whole lot of happiness into everything we do so that our work – and our team members – reflect the positive outcomes we deliver to our customers every day.

title: System Engineer, GIOC
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Vultr is on a mission to make high\-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3\.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self\-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately\-held cloud infrastructure company.
   

  

**Vultr Cares**
* Medical Insurance stipend paid annually
* 9 Company\-Paid Holidays
* Generous Leave Policy \+ 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years \+ Anniversary Bonus each year
* Professional Development Reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Fitness membership reimbursement
* Company paid Wellable subscription


**Join Vultr**
 Vultr is expanding its India presence and is building its first
 **Global Integrated Operations Command Center (GIOC) in Chennai** 
 — the 24x7 nerve center for monitoring, triage, and first response across Vultr’s global
 **cloud, systems, network, and security operations.**
 We are seeking
 **Systems Engineers** 
 to serve as the first line of response for Vultr’s systems estate —
 **compute, storage, operating systems, and virtualization.** 
 This is a frontline operations role for engineers who thrive in a fast\-paced, alert\-driven environment and want to grow into deeper SRE, systems, and platform engineering careers. You must be comfortable working on a rotational shift model (24x7\) — including nights, weekends, and holidays, to ensure we have full coverage.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Systems Engineer** 
 is the entry point of the GIOC incident lifecycle. You monitor health signals across Vultr’s systems estate, acknowledge and triage alerts within
 **defined first\-response SLAs,** 
 execute documented runbooks to resolve common issues, and escalate cleanly to Senior Systems Engineer when an issue falls outside L1 scope. The role ensures
 **fast, accurate first response** 
 that protects customer experience and keeps incidents moving toward resolution.
   

  

 You operate from a
 **consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard** 
 , classifying and routing incidents by severity and tower while owning accurate, complete documentation of every action. Success is measured by
 **first\-response SLA adherence, triage accuracy, and runbook resolution rate.** 
 The role runs on a
 **rotational schedule** 
 to sustain 24x7 coverage.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Alert Monitoring \& First Response**
* Monitor systems\-estate health signals (compute, storage, OS, virtualization) from a consolidated single\-pane\-of\-glass dashboard
* Acknowledge alerts and incidents within first\-response SLA targets
* Perform initial review — read the alert, check recent changes, and review the CMDB before acting


**Triage \& Severity Classification**
* Classify each incident by severity and customer impact, confirming the owning tower (Systems / Network / Security / cross\-tower)
* Route and assign tickets accurately to the correct tower or escalation path
* Sustain triage accuracy at or above the GIOC go\-live standard
* Reassess severity as impact evolves, and declare higher when in doubt


**Runbook\-Driven Resolution**
* Match alert signatures to documented runbooks and execute permitted L1 actions
* Resolve common, well\-understood systems issues end to end within L1 scope
* Document every step taken, with supporting evidence, in the incident ticket


**Escalation \& Handoff**
* Escalate unresolved or out\-of\-scope issues to Senior Engineers with a clean, complete handoff (symptom
* evidence collected
* steps tried
* current state)
* Flag missing or ineffective runbooks as runbook gaps for review and continuous improvement
* Initiate and support major\-incident (Sev\-0 / Sev\-1\) bridges per the escalation matrix
* Track escalations to closure and confirm service is restored before resolving the ticket


**Operational Documentation \& Communication**
* Maintain accurate shift logs, ticket updates, and incident timelines
* Provide clear, timely status communication to stakeholders and customers per severity
* Produce thorough shift\-handover notes for seamless continuity


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify recurring alerts and noise as candidates for tuning and automation
* Contribute to and improve runbooks and knowledge\-base articles
* Participate in post\-incident reviews (PIR) and trend reviews


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Graduate/Engineer in a relevant field (B.E./B.Tech, or equivalent)
* 3–5 years of experience in systems administration, preferably in NOC/SOC, or IT operations
* Good understanding of Linux/Windows
* Working knowledge of operating systems — processes, services, and log analysis (Linux/Windows)
* Familiarity with compute, storage, and virtualization concepts — VMs, Hypervisors, and basic networking
* Understanding of incident\-management fundamentals and severity\-based triage
* Exposure to monitoring/observability tools and ticketing systems (alerting consoles, ITSM)
* Strong written communication for accurate documentation and clean escalation handoffs; willingness and ability to work a rotational 24x7 shift model, including nights, weekends, and holidays
* Proficient in English verbal and written communication


**Preferred Qualifications**
* ITIL V4 Foundation certification or equivalent ITSM knowledge
* Linux certification (RHCSA / LFCS) or a cloud\-fundamentals certification
* Scripting familiarity (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for routine automation
* Exposure to cloud platforms and GPU / high\-density infrastructure
* Prior working experience in a 24x7 NOC, SOC or Command\-Center environment
* Experience in using tools such as JIRA, Confluence, PagerDuty, and observability platforms


**Inclusion \& Privacy**
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.
   

  

 We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023\. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.
   

  

 Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

title: Diagnostic Support Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**Company Overview:**
 https://www.msxi.com/en/
   

  

 At
 **MSX International** 
 , we’ve been partnering with leading automotive companies for over 25 years, helping them enhance their retail strategies and streamline operations. Our expertise in areas like dealer performance, repair optimization, and consumer engagement positions us as a trusted partner in the evolving mobility industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
 The Diagnostic Support Engineer will be responsible for monitoring DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) and CAN (Controller Area Network) parameters at the Command Centre (CC) 24/7\. The role involves guiding customers and drivers, managing escalations, and coordinating with dealers to resolve vehicle issues efficiently.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* 24/7 Monitoring: Monitor DTC/CAN parameters at the Command Centre and raise tickets immediately when an issue is detected.
* Ticketing: Respond to triggered DTC/CAN alerts by creating internal tickets in the DMS system (with automation in phase 2\).
* Customer Assistance: Provide Level 1 (L1\) support over the phone, guiding customers/drivers to resolve minor issues.
* Critical DTCs: For vehicles with critical DTCs (e.g., "Service Now" category), guide them to the nearest dealer.
* Vehicle Breakdown: If a vehicle is immovable, or if further damage could occur, instruct the dealer to reach the vehicle’s location.
* Issue Tracking: Coordinate with dealers to ensure the issue/ticket is resolved completely and in a timely manner.
* Management Reporting: Provide daily, weekly, monthly, and ad\-hoc reports on vehicle issues and resolution status.
* KPI Tracking: Track and report KPI targets in the required format.
* Job Card Analysis: Conduct job card analysis, focusing on cost avoidance, analytics, and reporting for continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
**Qualifications:**
* Experience in customer support, vehicle service, or command centre operations.
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills for guiding customers and coordinating with dealers.
* Familiarity with DMS systems, ticketing tools, and vehicle diagnostics (DTC/CAN).
* Ability to work in a 24/7 environment and handle critical issues efficiently.
* Strong analytical skills for reporting and KPI tracking.


 Additional Information
   

  

**Location:** 
 Oragadam, Tamil Nadu
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\-2 years
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Automotive
   

  

**Working Days :** 
 6 days (Rotational week off \& National Holidays)
   

  

 MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting\-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go\-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research\-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Senior Technical Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Senior Technical Specialist to join our Professional Services team supporting the implementation, configuration, and business analysis of our ConceptOne™ platform and advanced Identity \& Access Management solutions. This role is ideal for a technically strong professional with expertise in SQL development, system configuration, business requirements gathering, and analysis. You will possess deep insurance domain knowledge and the ability to work directly with project teams to deliver scalable, compliant software configurations and data\-driven solutions.
 



 We count on your expertise to prevent defects and represent both technical and end\-user perspectives, fostering a commitment to excellence within the dynamic Insurtech landscape. Your attention to detail, analytical capabilities, and collaborative spirit are crucial for maintaining the highest quality standards in our software solutions.
 



 In this role, you will design and develop custom forms, reports, and database logic that support complex insurance workflows. You will conduct business requirements analysis, perform system configuration and customization, and implement advanced configurations. You will work closely with Business Analysts, Solution Architects, project managers, and client stakeholders to translate functional requirements into comprehensive technical solutions.
 








**What will you do in this role?** 



* Business Requirements Gathering \& Analysis
* Facilitate and elicit customer business requirements through workshops, interviews, and discovery sessions.
* Analyze and document functional and non\-functional requirements for complex insurance implementations.
* Develop comprehensive documentation including business rules, use cases, and process flows.
* Translate business needs into technical specifications and system design recommendations.
* System Configuration and Customization
* Participate in technical solution design and configuration for the ConceptOne™ platform.
* Implement configurations and customizations to support identity and access management requirements.
* Perform system configuration and customization based on detailed design documentation and insurance industry best practices.
* Implement relevant aspects of customer requirements through system configuration and advanced customization.
* SQL Development and Database Management
* Develop SQL stored procedures, functions, and queries supporting system configuration, integrations, and business logic.
* Design and implement data sources used for merge documents, form generation, and reporting.
* Manage and maintain Microsoft SQL Server databases using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Optimize database performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, and efficient data retrieval.
* Support migration and conversion of database systems and SQL dialects.
* Forms, Reports, and Document Generation
* Design and develop interactive forms and data\-driven document generation solutions.
* Ensure forms support efficient data capture, validation, and document production.
* Build custom reports and data extracts using Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar reporting tools.
* Technical Subject Matter Expert \& Implementation Support
* Serve as a technical and business domain subject matter expert across assigned implementation projects.
* Develop custom integrations with various external applications using API/SDK solutions.
* Identify risks or technical challenges early and propose solutions to project leadership.
* Work closely with project managers, business analysts, architects, and stakeholders to deliver client solutions.
* Quality Assurance \& Testing
* Develop and execute unit tests supporting system configuration and development work.
* Support system testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) during project delivery.
* Review and approve Quality Analyst test cases and test plans against customer requirements.
* Documentation \& Knowledge Management
* Document technical designs, configuration decisions, business requirements, and development standards.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry developments, best practices, and platform enhancements.
* Facilitate end\-user training sessions to ensure smooth transition and adoption of implemented solutions.



  





**What do you need to succeed in this role?** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related technical field.
* 7\+ years of experience in software implementation, database development, business analysis, or technical consulting.
* Strong experience with insurance policy administration systems, with demonstrated expertise in the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) insurance domain.
* Experience with enterprise policy administration platforms such as ConceptOne or similar systems.
* Strong SQL development experience including stored procedures, functions, query optimization, and data transformations.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Demonstrated ability to work with relational database systems and complex data models.
* Experience with reporting or forms technologies such as Appeon Infomaker, Qlik, SSRS, or similar tools.
* Experience with configuration and customization.
* Proficiency in business requirements gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to communicate effectively with technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience supporting data integrations or API\-based systems.
* Experience with XML data structures or document generation systems.
* Experience converting SQL dialects or supporting database migrations.
* AINS Certifications or other insurance industry certifications.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
**Job Description**  

Job Summary :


Specialists play a crucial role in ensuring smooth and efficient support of day\-to\-day operations. They act as frontline defenders, addressing a wide array of cases, fulfilling setup and access requests, providing prompt solutions, and ensuring client satisfaction. Their broad knowledge and problem\-solving skills make them indispensable in maintaining the NIQ Platform accessibility, reliability, and usability.


Role Definition :


Specialists are versatile members of the Global Tech Support team who handle a wide range of issues across all aspects of the applications supported. They serve as the first point of contact for clients and are responsible for SOP driven client setup and administration requests as well as initial troubleshooting and issue resolution. If a case is complex, they raise it to the next level for additional support.


Responsibilities :

* **Client Interaction** \- Specialists manage client communications, addressing queries and concerns promptly and professionally.
* **Client Access Setup –** Specialists follow standardized operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure client access is configured accurately and securely. This includes validating account details, applying the correct access levels, and confirming successful activation to minimize onboarding delays and support issues.
* **Initial Issue Troubleshooting \-** They perform initial diagnostics to identify the nature of the case and provide immediate solutions when possible.
* **Issue Resolution** \- Specialists resolve common cases and ensure that clients can continue using the applications with minimal disruption.
* **Escalation** \- For complex or unresolved cases, Specialists escalate the problem to the next level.
* **Documentation** \- They maintain detailed case records, resolutions, and client interactions to ensure continuity and knowledge sharing within the team.


Skills :

**Broad Knowledge** \- Specialists possess a broad understanding of NIQ applications, including their functionalities, user interfaces, and common issues.

**Problem\-Solving** \- They have strong analytical skills to diagnose and resolve a variety of technical problems.

**Communication** \- Effective communication skills are essential for interacting with clients and conveying information clearly.

**Adaptability** \- Specialists must be adaptable to handle diverse issues and work in a dynamic environment.


Tasks :

**Responding to Cases** \- Specialists manage incoming support tickets, prioritize them based on urgency, and provide accurate, timely responses.

**Performing Diagnostics** \- They use diagnostic tools and techniques to identify the situation.

**Providing Solutions** \- Specialists offer solutions to common problems, such as software access configuration, user errors, and minor bugs.

**Escalating Issues** \- When an issue requires specialized knowledge or deeper investigation, Specialists escalate it to the appropriate next support level.

**Example Scenario** \- A client states that they are unable to log into an application. The Specialist would:

* Verify the Issue: Confirm that the client is provisioned access properly, verify the client's credentials, and check for any obvious errors, such as email differences or URLs.
* Perform Initial Troubleshooting: Check the user status and ensure the client's network connectivity.
* Provide Immediate Solutions: If the issue is due to a common problem (e.g., password reset), the Specialist provides user directions to resolve it directly.
* Escalate if Necessary: If the issue is complex (e.g., user access is missing), the Specialist escalates it to the next support level for further investigation.


Success metrics :

* First time right ticket handling, quality communication, and solution/escalation within the expected time frame
* All NIQ technical certifications
* Handling and Closure of assigned ticket target volume
* Microsoft Dynamics compliance to stated ways of working

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree (or equivalent)
* 0\-1 year of experience (Experience preferred)
* Key Skills:
	+ Ms. Excel (Intermediate)
	+ Ms. PowerPoint (Basic)
* Problem Solving (Intermediate)
* Analytical skills (Basic)
* Active Listening, Understanding \& Empathy (Advanced)
* Email Writing skills (Intermediate)
* Fundamental understanding of the Customer Support process and techniques
* Proficient in the English language
* Basic understanding of the customer environment and NIQ tools in use
* Exchanges straightforward information
* Technically/digitally savvy

* Participate in incident reviews, root\-cause analysis, problem management, and continuous\-improvement initiatives.


 Knowledge, Training, and Zenius Bar Operations
   

  

* Create and maintain Executive Support documentation, knowledge\-base articles, standard operating procedures, and Jira canned responses.
* Deliver new\-hire IT orientation sessions for employees across India and the United States, covering technology setup, access, security, collaboration tools, and support processes.
* Support the Hyderabad Zenius Bar, including ticket monitoring, employee assistance, technician training, survey analysis, and operational reporting.

* Promote knowledge sharing, self\-service adoption, and consistent support practices across the organization.

* Mentor junior engineers and serve as an escalation point for complex technical issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience providing Executive/VIP Support.
* Ability to perform L1, L2, and L3 responsibilities and manage issues through complete resolution.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, identity and access administration, endpoint management, Windows, and macOS.
* Experience supporting Zoom Meetings, Webinars, Zoom Rooms, and conference\-room technology.

You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility
* Think and work holistically Keep it simple and practical Optimize and automate Success factors Value Decreased incidents and contacts at the service desk through proactive investigation and problem management of end user issues Increased adoption and use of a virtual assistant, by enabling more use cases through the integration of DEM technologies with the virtual agent
* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**
* Strong experience of working with virtual teams Ability to present, visually, service reports
* A high degree of problem and creative thinking skills Planning, prioritization skills, a passion for customer service and high\-quality delivery
* Demonstrate good interpersonal skills, diplomacy in dealing with customers and internal teams Good experience of at least one DEM technology (Aternity, Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack), including supporting the utilization of the technology for tangible benefit

 Nexthink, PowerShell Script Developer, Windows 10, 11 OS Knowledge.

title: Data Centre Linux & HW Engineer, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 Data Center Operations designs, installs \& maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.
   

  

 To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build \& manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations.
   

  

 The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most advance data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.
   

  

 A Data Centre Operations Tech at ADSIPL may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
   

  

 Problem Solving: Maintain a high level of system reliability by prioritizing and resolving trouble tickets efficiently, these include:
   

  

* Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
* Deep diving into Linux server issues
* XEN service virtualization troubleshooting


 Technical: Troubleshoot technical issues on various platforms ranging from Systems through Networking to Power/Mechanical
   

  

* Remediation of physical layer outages, both Systems \& Network
* Remediation or recovery of physical power issues on racks
* Participate in Data Center power \& cooling events


 Operations: Meet 24x7 On\-Call requirements and response during shift rotations.
   

  

* Install \& configure racks of hosts in line with internal SLAs
* Triage \& resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
* Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
* Physical replacement of server and network device parts
* Ensure correct rotation of parts \& spares
* Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
* Enforcing Security Best Practices at ADSIPL
* Interact with third party vendors \& contractors
* Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency


**Project Management**
* Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid\-scale projects
* Participate in internal team meetings at ADSIPL for metric analysis and project status updates
* Help build the world’s largest Cloud infrastructure in India


 Mentoring: Share knowledge and help educate less technical staff on the best practices related to all break fix issues
   

  

 Hiring: Contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the ADSIPL’s hiring process/candidate interviews
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 1\+ years of computer networking experience
* 1\+ years of Linux operating systems experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Asset Management Analyst I
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Software Asset \& License Analyst I is the front line of the software service, working the high\-volume request queues to tight turnaround targets: listed software requests within 3 days, standard SaaS provisioning within 1 day, and licence\-issue resolution for users who cannot get into the software they need. The role is measured on speed and accuracy — the queue is large enough that consistency matters more than individual heroics, and errors here surface later as compliance gaps or duplicate spend.
   

  

 The associate works one of the three IST\-anchored shifts under that shift's Level III lead, with a Level II analyst mentoring day to day. Five of these roles exist — one on APAC and two each on EMEA and NAMER. The role is deliberately bounded: anything carrying legal, privacy or commercial judgment — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases, contract events — is escalated rather than decided, and knowing where that line sits is a core competency of the job.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Listed Software Request Fulfilment
* Execute listed\-software requests via storefront and ticket queues, consistently achieving the 3\-day turnaround SLA.
* Optimize license utilization by identifying reusable entitlements before proceeding with new fulfillment or procurement.
* Validate requester eligibility against product constraints and delivery restrictions to ensure compliant fulfillment.
* Maintain real\-time accuracy of asset and entitlement records throughout the license lifecycle.
* SaaS Provisioning \& Access Verification
* Fulfill standard SaaS requests within 24 hours, verifying active user access prior to ticket closure.
* Apply precise account tiering (e.g., Developer vs. Collaborator) to match publisher\-specific license structures.
* Audit automated provisioning outputs, proactively flagging and resolving failures to prevent service gaps.
* Manage routine deprovisioning; escalate complex scenarios involving data\-loss risks to Level II analysts.
* Licence Issue Resolution \& User Support
* Resolve technical license issues—including activation and access errors—within shift\-specific resolution targets.
* Guide users through software deployment, including the configuration of hosted floating\-license pools.
* Escalate server\-side technical issues to Level III and commercial/legal inquiries to Level II with detailed context.
* Deliver clear, professional user support to drive high customer satisfaction scores (CSAT).
* Queue Hygiene, Data Handling \& Documentation
* Uphold rigorous ticket hygiene and category coding to ensure accurate reporting and trend analysis.
* Protect sensitive data by immediately transferring tickets containing keys or audit info to private queues.
* Enforce operational boundaries by escalating unlisted software and high\-risk use cases rather than self\-actioning.
* Proactively monitor intake forms to flag ageing items for handover before the shift window closes.
* Adhere strictly to SOPs while contributing improvements to the shared knowledge base.


**PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS**
 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per shift.
   

  

* Listed Software Turnaround: fulfil listed\-software requests within the 3\-day target.
* SaaS Provisioning Turnaround: complete standard SaaS provisioning within the 1\-day target, with user access verified before closure.
* First\-Time\-Right: sustain high accuracy on catalogue item, edition, quantity and tier selection, since rework here creates duplicate spend and compliance noise.
* Escalation Discipline: 100% of bounded exclusions — unlisted software, signed agreements, high\-risk use cases — escalated rather than actioned.
* Data Handling: 100% of sensitive tickets moved to the private queue on identification.
* Ticket Hygiene: correct category coding and complete records on every ticket worked.
* Customer Satisfaction: meet the shift's customer satisfaction and time\-to\-resolve targets.


**TOOLS \& SYSTEMS**
* Queue \& Ticketing: the enterprise ticketing queue system with category coding, issue tracking, and the private queue for sensitive tickets.
* Storefront \& Provisioning: the internal software storefront and catalogue, and the provisioning and automated deprovisioning platforms.
* Entitlement Records: Flexera / ServiceNow SAM for entitlement and assignment records.
* Reference \& Knowledge: the SOP knowledge base, product catalogue and publisher playbooks.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
**Mandatory**
* 1–3\+ years in IT service desk, software provisioning, asset administration or a comparable high\-volume transactional operations role.
* Demonstrated accuracy and throughput on a ticket\-based queue against defined turnaround targets.
* Basic understanding of software licensing concepts — entitlement, assignment, seat counts and the difference between installed and SaaS delivery.
* Sound judgment about the limits of the role: able to recognise a request that must be escalated rather than fulfilled.
* Comfortable working one of three IST\-anchored shifts, including the NAMER window (22:00–06:00 IST).
* Clear, courteous English communication with end users.


**Preferred**
* Exposure to software asset management or IT asset management tooling (Flexera, ServiceNow SAM).
* Experience with an enterprise software storefront or self\-service catalogue.
* Familiarity with major publisher provisioning flows and account tiering.
* Spreadsheet proficiency for tracker and reporting support.
* Foundation\-level ITIL or software asset management certification, or working towards one.

title: Human Resources Information System Specialist
description:
A Fortune 200 company building its Global Capability Centre (GCC) in India has partnered with Flexiple to hire a Human Resources Information System Specialist to own the HR technology backbone for a centre that is scaling past two thousand employees this year.
 



**The systems you would run** 



* Administer and configure the core HRIS (employee records, org structure, workflows, approvals) across every India entity the centre supports
* Own end to end data integrity for hires, transfers, promotions and exits, including audit trails for statutory reporting
* Build and maintain integrations between the HRIS, payroll, benefits and time and attendance platforms
* Manage user access, security roles and periodic access reviews in line with the parent company's global controls



**What breaks when HRIS data is wrong** 




 Payroll runs late, statutory filings get flagged, and managers lose trust in headcount numbers used for budgeting. This role exists to make sure that never happens by catching data issues before they reach downstream systems, and by building validation checks that flag anomalies automatically rather than waiting for someone to notice a mismatched report.
 



**What we need from day one** 




 Two to five years working directly inside an HRIS platform (Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Darwinbox or similar), strong Excel and reporting skills, comfort writing SOPs for a global stakeholder base, and the judgment to know when a data anomaly is a typo versus a process gap that needs escalating. Experience supporting a multinational or GCC environment is a strong plus.
 



 Based out of Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune or Remote (India), with periodic travel to other India office locations as the centre grows.
 



**After you apply** 




 The process runs HR Screening, followed by a data and systems assignment, a hiring manager conversation, and a short culture round with the India HR leadership team.
 



 One application is kept on file and considered against this role as well as future HRIS and HR technology openings that come up across Flexiple's client roster.

title: CyberArk Engineer @ Mumbai
description:
**Technical Skills:** 




  





 The L2 PIM/PAM Engineer is responsible for day\-to\-day administration, onboarding, and incident troubleshooting across enterprise Privileged Access Management platforms (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Microsoft Entra PIM). In addition to operational maintenance, this role actively validates, audits, and assesses technical controls to ensure privileged accounts adhere to strict zero\-trust and least\-privilege standards.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Implementation \& Support (L2 Operations)** 



* Handle Day\-2 operations, ticket escalations, and incident resolution for PAM components (Safe management, account onboarding, CPM/PSM failures, and policy errors).
* Onboard target systems (Windows, Linux, databases, network devices, and cloud infrastructure) into PAM vaults with automated credential rotation.
* Manage Just\-In\-Time (JIT) access requests, time\-bound approvals, and role\-activation workflows in Microsoft Entra PIM and PAM solutions.
* Monitor health checks for core PAM services (Vaults, Proxies, Discovery agents, Session Recording servers) and coordinate with vendor support or L3 teams for complex outages.
* Configure, test, and maintain custom plugins, CPM platform management policies, and connection components.



**Technical Controls Assessment \& Validation** 



* Conduct routine technical assessments to verify that credential auto\-rotation, check\-in/check\-out policies, and password complexity controls function across all onboarded targets.
* Validate that Privileged Session Monitoring (PSM) and keylogging controls capture and index administrative sessions without bypassing.
* Audit Entra PIM policies: verify mandatory MFA triggers, justification requirements, approval chains, and maximum activation duration limits.
* Perform discovery scans to identify unmanaged privileged accounts, service accounts, and shadow admins across Active Directory, cloud, and hybrid environments.
* Generate compliance evidence and remediate gaps aligned with audit standards (CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001, SOC 2\).



**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* **Core Platforms:** 
 Hands\-on experience with at least one enterprise PAM tool (CyberArk PAS/Privilege Cloud, BeyondTrust Password Safe, Delinea/Thycotic) and Cloud PIM (Microsoft Entra ID PIM).
* **Operating Systems \& Networking:** 
 Working knowledge of Windows Server (Active Directory, Kerberos, GPOs), Linux/Unix (SSH, PAM modules, sudoers), and networking fundamentals (firewall ports, DNS, RDP, SSH).
* **Scripting:** 
 Basic PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripting skills to assist with automated onboarding, discovery parsing, and API calls.
* **Security Principles:** 
 Solid understanding of Least Privilege, Zero Trust, MFA, Session Isolation, and Break\-Glass procedures.



**Preferred Certifications** 



* CyberArk Defender (PAM\-DEF) or Sentry (PAM\-SEN)
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC\-300\)
* CompTIA Security\+ or SSCP

title: Incident Manager
description:
Job description:
   

  

 Incident Manager
 
  
 



**Location:** 
 India, Mumbai
 



  
 



 The Agfa\-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business\-to\-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Whenever you read a newspaper or visit a hospital, Agfa technology is often involved behind the scenes. The Agfa\-Gevaert Group strives to be the partner of choice for imaging and information systems by delivering innovative technology, high\-quality solutions, and sustainable business practices. Agfa’s headquarters and parent company are located in Mortsel, Belgium.
 


  About the Role
 
 Agfa is looking for an experienced and service\-oriented
 **Incident Manager** 
 to join its Global IT (Information \& Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the incident management process and ensuring the rapid restoration of IT services when disruptions occur. You will play a critical role in minimizing business impact, coordinating cross\-functional resolution activities, and driving continuous improvement across the IT service landscape.
 



 As a key member of the IT Service Management organization, you will collaborate closely with internal teams, managed service providers, and business stakeholders worldwide to ensure effective incident response, SLA compliance, and clear communication during both standard and major incidents.
 


  About You (Skills Required)
 
 You excel in high\-pressure situations and have the ability to coordinate multiple teams while maintaining clear and effective communication. You combine a process\-driven mindset with strong stakeholder management capabilities and a commitment to service excellence.
 



 You possess:
 


* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong coordination and facilitation capabilities.
* A structured, process\-oriented approach to service management.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to remain calm and decisive during major incidents and service disruptions.
* A continuous improvement mindset focused on service quality and business satisfaction.


  What You'll Do (Duties \& Responsibilities)
 * Lead and govern the global Incident Management process.
* Manage major incidents and coordinate all activities required to restore services as quickly as possible.
* Organize and facilitate Major Incident bridge calls involving technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Coordinate incident resolution activities across internal teams and external service providers.
* Monitor and drive resolution of aging incidents, ensuring SLA compliance and timely closure.
* Provide clear, timely, and regular status updates to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Manage escalations and ensure appropriate engagement of technical and management resources.
* Conduct post\-incident reviews and identify opportunities for service improvement.
* Prepare and maintain incident management reports, metrIT, and performance dashboards.
* Serve as backup for the Problem Manager when required.



  
 



**What You'll Bring (Experience \& Qualifications)** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Proven track record in Incident Management roles.
* Strong understanding of ITIL Incident Management processes and best practices.
* ITIL Foundation certification or higher certification preferred.
* Technical background with a solid understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure, applications, and service environments.
* Experience working in outsourced IT environments and coordinating multiple service providers.
* Experience managing major incidents in complex, global IT environments.
* Strong reporting, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* High degree of flexibility and willingness to support major incidents that may occur outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and on\-call escalation situations, to ensure business continuity in a global 24/7 environment.



  
 



**Why Join Us** 



* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long\-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization that supports critical business operations worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams and strategic technology partners.
* Play a key role in maintaining service stability and improving the end\-user experience across Agfa's global IT environment.



  
 



 If you are passionate about service management, thrive in dynamic environments, and enjoy coordinating teams to resolve incidents, we invite you to join Agfa and make a global impact.
