title: Lead – Technical Solutions & Projects
description:
**About Inaara NeoFoods** 




 Inaara NeoFoods is building India’s first farm\-to\-formulation platform for plant derived functional nutrients for everyday food by partnering with F\&B companies (domestic as well as exports) to develop scalable, clean\-label and commercially viable food solutions. Inaara operates at the intersection of agriculture, advanced processing, applied food science and computational nutrition.
 




  





 The founding team has deep expertise across agriculture, food systems, supply chains, technology and consumer businesses. Having built and scaled successful ventures in the agri\-food ecosystem, the founders bring a unique combination of entrepreneurial vision, operational excellence and industry relationships, positioning Inaara to build a globally relevant nutrition platform from India.
 







**Role: Lead – Technical Solutions \& Projects** 




 Inaara NeoFoods is creating a category\-defining business at the intersection of food, agriculture, nutrition and technology. The opportunity involves collaborating with global experts to pioneer next\-generation, nutrient\-rich food formulations from ground\-up.
 







 We are seeking a first\-principles problem solver who is deeply driven by purpose and comfortable navigating a fast\-evolving, dynamic environment. If you are inspired by the prospect of shaping the global future of nutrition from India, you will thrive here. We value curiosity, ownership, resilience and a long\-term vision over hierarchy and established playbooks.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 Reporting to the
 **Head of Applications/R\&D** 
 and working in close strategic partnership with the Commercial
 
 team, the
 **Lead – Technical Solutions \& Projects** 
 operates across two pillars:
 






1. **Technical Core (In the Lab):** 
 A hands\-on food application scientist who anchors rapid customer prototype development at the bench, runs functional and textural characterization, leverages lab technicians, and validates pilot\-to\-plant scale\-up parameters.
2. **Customer Interface \& Project Management (Market Solutions):** 
 A customer\-facing technical consultant who translates client briefs into application roadmaps, owns projects end\-to\-end, drive timelines, demonstrates scientific and cost\-in\-use advantages to external R\&D teams to enable Sales.



  





**Location** 





 Mumbai, India
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Master’s or PhD in Food Technology, Food Science, or related field
* 5\-7 years of hands\-on formulation and application development experience
* Dual capability in bench\-top prototyping and experience managing technical projects
* Hands\-on familiarity with functional and textural characterization (texture analysis, colour, rheology)
* Experience running outsourced analytical programs through NABL\-accredited labs
* Familiarity with industrial food processing equipment and scale\-up workflows.
* Knowledge of FSSAI regulations, global food standards, labelling and nutrient\-claim requirements



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**(a) Technical Core:** 
 Bench Formulation, Prototyping \& Scale\-Up
 







* **Hands\-on Bench Prototyping** 
 : Formulate finished food prototypes across priority formats (bakery, extruded snacks, functional beverages, ready\-to\-mix powders, and plant\-based matrices)
* **Functional \& Sensory Characterization:** 
 Conduct functional, rheological, and textural characterization (viscosity, emulsion stability, texture profiling, water activity) to optimize sensory benchmarks.
* **Trial Iterations** 
 : Execute rapid reformulation cycles to troubleshoot technical issues and shortening turnaround times.
* **Pilot \& Plant Scale\-Up:** 
 Transition approved bench formulations into pilot and commercial\-scale factory trials, partnering with manufacturers to validate process parameters and line runnability.
* **Data \& Regulatory Compliance:** 
 Codify trial and formulations data, ensuring every prototype complies with FSSAI standards, export regulations, and nutritional \& clean\-label targets.



  





**(b) Technical \& Commercial Interface:** 
 Market Solutions \& Project Delivery
 







* **End\-to\-End Project Management:** 
 Own customer innovation projects across the development lifecycle \- orchestrating timelines, trial milestones, cross\-functional dependencies and risk resolution from initial brief to plant sign\-off.
* **Brief Translation \& Solution Scoping:** 
 Act as the lead technical interface for B2B client briefs; deconstruct brand targets, nutritional benchmarks, and sensory parameters into, time\-bound application sprints.
* **Client Engagement \& Co\-Development:** 
 Lead technical workshops, customer tasting sessions, and co\-creation workshops with brand teams. Articulate the functional advantages with scientific clarity.
* **Cost\-in\-Use \& Value Engineering:** 
 Model client formulation systems to demonstrate dosage efficiency, functional parity/superiority, and cost\-in\-use benefits within the customer's target cost envelope.
* **Technical Qualification \& Win\-Rate:** 
 Maximize client trial success rates by securing technical validation, sensory clearance, and factory trial approvals, delivering complete application dossiers.
* **Proactive Application Concepts:** 
 Monitor market shifts in functional foods to build proactive "push" concept kits and demonstration prototypes that enable the commercial team to unlock new clients.



  





  





**Remuneration** 



* Market Competitive
* Fixed \+ Variable

title: Facilities Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Facilities Manager to lead the setup, day\-to\-day operations, and maintenance of our new facility in KIADB Aerospace Park.
In this role, you will be the single point of contact for physical workplace management. Our workplace will be an integrated space that combines a corporate office with active engineering and testing setups. You'll oversee everything from our initial interior fit\-out and contractor coordination to daily operations, safety compliance, utility uptime, and vendor relationships. **Key Responsibilities:****1\. Construction management/coordination (Immediate Focus)*** Coordinate with interior designers, contractors, vendors, and building management during the fit\-out phase.
* Track project timelines, quality of installation, and ensure handovers meet safety and operational requirements.
* Liaise with KIADB park authorities, local utility boards, and local bodies for necessary operational approvals and utility connections.

**2\. Facilities Operations \& Infrastructure*** Ensure 100% uptime of critical building utilities: Servers, UPS systems, high\-voltage electrical panels, HVAC, plumbing, and fire suppression systems.
* Establish preventive maintenance schedules for all MEP infrastructure and specialized engineering/lab utility line support.
* Oversee workplace services including housekeeping, physical security (CCTV, access control), pest control, landscaping, and waste management.

**3\. Safety, Compliance \& Emergency Preparedness*** Ensure strict compliance with local industrial, fire safety, environmental (STP/ETP guidelines), and workplace health and safety norms.
* Maintain all statutory licenses, building approvals, and equipment safety certificates (lift safety, fire NOC, electrical inspectorate approvals).
* Implement physical security protocols and lead emergency response planning, including regular fire drills and evacuation procedures.

**4\. Vendor Management \& Procurement*** Onboard, manage, and evaluate external service providers (security, housekeeping, maintenance contractors, cafeteria/caterers).
* Negotiate Service Level Agreements (SLAs), review vendor invoices, and ensure services are delivered as contracted.
* Manage inventory procurement for everyday office and maintenance supplies.

**5\. Workplace Logistics \& Cafeteria*** Oversee pantry and cafeteria services, ensuring strict food safety, hygiene, and vendor service quality.
* Manage waste disposal systems, emphasizing segregation, scrap handling, and local environmental compliance.
* Support employee transit logistics and parking management within the campus if required.

**6\. Budgeting \& Cost Control*** Assist in preparing annual operating budgets (OpEx) and capital expenditure (CapEx) plans for the facility.
* Monitor monthly utility expenses and implement practical energy\-saving and water conservation measures.

 **What We are Looking For:*** 6 to 10 years of facility management experience. Prior experience managing facilities in KIADB, industrial parks, or hardware/R\&D environments in Bengaluru is highly preferred.
* A Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Electrical, Mechanical, or Civil Engineering (or equivalent practical hands\-on experience managing heavy MEP infrastructure).
* Hands\-on experience dealing with interior fit\-outs, vendor execution, and site handovers.
* Solid working knowledge of local statutory regulations, fire safety codes, and working with Karnataka local bodies/KIADB setup processes.
* Proactive, organized, and willing to be on the ground. You take pride in maintaining a clean, efficient, and safe working environment for engineers and staff.
* Must be proficient in English, Kannada and Hindi.

title: Director, Call Center Operations Control
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Director, Contact Center Governance, Controls \& Performance Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for establishing and leading the governance, performance management, financial control, operational risk, compliance, and quality oversight framework for Contact Center Operations. This leader serves as the first line of defense and is accountable for ensuring operational processes, customer servicing activities, technology platforms, and business controls operate effectively while supporting enterprise objectives, regulatory requirements, financial performance expectations, and customer experience goals.


The Director partners closely with Operations, Technology, Risk, Compliance, Finance, Quality, and Change Management teams to drive operational excellence, strengthen controls, improve performance visibility, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for executive performance reporting, Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), Balanced Scorecard governance, operational readiness reviews, financial analysis, technology change governance, testing of new system rollouts, and deployment of AI\-enabled controls and quality assurance capabilities.


Reporting directly to the SVP, Contact Center Operations, this position plays a critical role in protecting enterprise value, enabling scalable growth, reducing operational risk, improving financial discipline, and driving a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and data\-driven decision making.


**JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Governance, Risk \& Controls Leadership**

* Lead the overall governance and first\-line control framework for Contact Center Operations, including policies, procedures, control standards, process documentation, and governance routines aligned with enterprise requirements.
* Identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate operational, regulatory, compliance, financial, and reputational risks across Contact Center Operations.
* Oversee RCSA activities, issue management, remediation plans, corrective actions, audit responses, and regulatory examination support.
* Serve as the primary liaison for Internal Audit, Compliance, Risk Management, external auditors, and regulatory examination teams.

**Performance Management \& Executive Reporting**

* Own the Contact Center Operations performance management framework, including KPI governance across customer experience, quality, productivity, compliance, operational effectiveness, financial performance, and risk management.
* Lead monthly Contact Center Operations Management Business Reviews (MBRs), executive operating reviews, and Balanced Scorecard governance forums.
* Develop executive dashboards, scorecards, and reporting packages that provide actionable operational and financial insights.
* Drive accountability for performance improvement initiatives through structured action planning, follow\-up governance, and data\-driven recommendations.

**Financial Analysis, Accounting \& Business Performance**

* Apply accounting, financial analysis, and business performance expertise to evaluate operating results, expense trends, control effectiveness, and operational decision impacts.
* Partner with Finance and Operations leadership to analyze cost\-to\-serve, productivity, staffing efficiency, operational investments, and business performance trends.
* Develop business cases supporting automation, process improvement, technology investments, and strategic initiatives.
* Support annual planning, forecasting, budgeting, expense governance, and financial performance routines as required.

**AI, Automation \& Intelligent Controls**

* Lead the strategy and roadmap for AI\-enabled controls, automated quality assurance, and intelligent operational monitoring across Contact Center Operations.
* Leverage AI, machine learning, speech analytics, interaction analytics, automation, and advanced analytics to strengthen oversight, improve quality coverage, and detect risks earlier.
* Develop predictive monitoring, exception management, and automated control capabilities that proactively identify compliance risks, process failures, customer friction, and operational defects.
* Ensure AI\-enabled solutions operate within established governance, regulatory, compliance, risk management, and model oversight standards.

**Technology Governance \& Change Management**

* Partner with Technology and business stakeholders to ensure controls, compliance requirements, and operational readiness expectations are embedded into new systems and process changes.
* Lead operational readiness reviews for technology implementations, automation initiatives, and strategic system rollouts.
* Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), business validation, control testing, implementation governance, and post\-implementation performance monitoring.
* Ensure operational risks associated with system implementations are identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored after deployment.

**EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:**

**Education \& Certifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline required.
* CA isa must.
* Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls, financial reporting, and business performance management required.

**Experience**

* Minimum 15\-18 years of progressive experience in Operational Risk, Internal Controls, Compliance, Audit, Accounting, Finance, or Financial Services Operations.
* Experience supporting audits, regulatory examinations, enterprise risk management activities, and remediation governance.
* Experience managing operational controls within a highly regulated financial services environment.
* Demonstrated experience in accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance management.
* Experience leading executive scorecards, KPI governance, Management Business Reviews (MBRs), and performance management programs.
* Minimum 5 years of direct leadership experience managing professional teams.
* Mortgage servicing, banking, consumer lending, or financial services experience preferred.
* Experience implementing AI, automation, speech analytics, predictive analytics, or intelligent quality management solutions preferred.
* Experience leading large\-scale operational transformation or technology modernization initiatives preferred.

**Technical \& Analytical Skills**

* Knowledge of MS\-Office \& SharePoint with advanced Excel skills required.
* Strong analytical skills, including ability to develop reports, analyze and interpret data.
* Working knowledge of continuous improvement and Lean principles, with the ability to streamline processes and adapt controls as technology and ways of working evolve.


**Core Attributes**
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills required.
* Ability to work effectively with global cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to juggle multiple competing priorities and adapt to constantly changing business environment.
* Customer\-oriented individual.
* Creative problem solver with a proactive approach to mitigating operational risk.

**COMPETENCIES**

Competency Description
  

Strategic Governance \& Risk Leadership Creates sustainable governance frameworks that protect the organization while enabling operational agility, growth, and disciplined execution.
  

Financial Acumen \& Business Analysis Applies accounting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and business performance expertise to operational decision making.
  

Performance Management Uses KPIs, scorecards, MBRs, executive reviews, and action planning routines to drive accountability and measurable business outcomes.
  

AI \& Intelligent Automation Leverages AI, automation, analytics, and automated QA to improve control effectiveness, quality oversight, operational performance, and customer outcomes.
  

Change \& Technology Leadership Governs technology transformation, system rollouts, testing, readiness, and post\-implementation monitoring while maintaining a strong control environment.
  

Executive Communication \& Influence Delivers clear, data\-driven insights and recommendations that influence senior leadership decisions and cross\-functional execution.
  

Leadership \& Talent Development Builds high\-performing teams through coaching, clear expectations, development plans, accountability, and continuous learning.

**Senior Manager – Epic EMR (Offshore)**
**Location:** 
 BLR/HYD/CHN (India Delivery Center) \|
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Life Sciences \& Health Care
   

  

**Position Summary**
**Level:** 
 Senior Manager
   

  

 As a Senior Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for overall technical delivery as part of large\-scale software solutions at enterprise level. You will lead functional and technical teams on the project located across shores guiding and mentoring junior team members and collaborating to understand the functional requirements. You will respond to new sales or proposals and support end\-to\-end delivery of the project along with estimations and planning.
   

  

 You will be responsible for managing the design, development, and deployment of large\-scale system implementations at an enterprise level. You will be responsible for independently managing the team and guiding team members at different levels through their career path, work through technical leads across shores to manage implementation of the functional requirements and implement them on platforms like Guidewire and Majesco. You will own the end\-to\-end delivery of the project from estimations, planning, and execution. You would also be responsible for managing the status and end to end delivery of the final product.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Deloitte's Health Care Provider practice helps hospital and health system clients design, implement, optimize, and stabilize Epic and other electronic medical record (EMR) platforms as part of broader digital and clinical transformation programs. We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead our offshore Epic delivery teams, acting as the connective layer between onshore client\-facing leadership and our India\-based build, testing, and support teams.
   

  

 This is a delivery leadership role — you will own workstream execution, team management, and quality for one or more Epic modules/applications across engagements, while helping mature our offshore Epic capability.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead offshore delivery for Epic EMR workstreams (e.g., Ambulatory, Inpatient/ClinDoc, Cadence, Prelude/ADT, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Grand Central, Radiant, HIM, or Payer platforms) across implementation, optimization, upgrade, and application managed services (AMS) engagements.
* Manage a team of Epic analysts, builders, and testers (typically 60–80\+ FTEs), including staffing, performance management, mentoring, and career development.
* Own workstream execution — build plans, Incidents/SRs, small and large enhancements— ensuring on\-time, on\-quality delivery against client\-agreed scope and adhering to client’s processes.
* Partner with client and onshore engagement leadership to translate client requirements, workflows, and design decisions into actionable offshore work packages.
* Drive governance and reporting — status updates, RAID logs, capacity/utilization tracking, and escalation management across time zones.
* Ensure Epic build quality and compliance with client governance, Epic's own standards (e.g., Epic's Storyboard/Chronicles environment practices), and Deloitte delivery methodology.
* Support pre\-sales and proposal efforts , including offshore staffing plans, effort estimation, and delivery approach for new pursuits.
* Contribute to offshore practice development — recruiting, training curricula, reusable accelerators, and knowledge management.
* Manage stakeholder relationships across US/onshore client teams, and internal Deloitte leadership.


**Required Qualifications**
* 15\+ years of total IT/consulting experience, with 6\+ years dedicated to Epic EMR implementation, optimization, or support.
* Proven experience managing offshore or globally distributed teams on Epic engagements, including cross\-time\-zone delivery models.
* Hands\-on depth in at least one major Epic application area (Ambulatory, Inpatient, ClinDoc, Cadence/Prelude, Willow, Beacon, OpTime, ASAP, Radiant, HIM, or Tapestry/Payer), with working knowledge of adjacent modules.
* Active or recent Epic certification(s) in a relevant module (certification lapses acceptable if recency and/or depth are demonstrated).
* Experience across the full ITSM delivery activities: Incidents, SRs, changes, tasks and projects/enhancements with associated build, unit/integration/UAT testing, cutover planning, go\-live support, and post\-live stabilization activities
* Strong people leadership — staffing, performance reviews, coaching, and building bench strength in an offshore delivery center.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to onshore client and Deloitte leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (Computer Science, Health Informatics, Life Sciences, or related); Master's preferred.
* Flexibility to work overlapping hours with US client teams as needed.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior experience at a Big 4 or major healthcare IT consulting firm.
* Multiple Epic certifications or other EMR experience
* Exposure to Epic upgrades (e.g., version migrations), or multi\-hospital rollouts.
* Familiarity with adjacent healthcare IT domains: HL7/FHIR interoperability, revenue cycle, clinical informatics, or population health.
* Experience with Agile/hybrid delivery methodologies and tools (JIRA, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps).
* Prior role in building or scaling an offshore/GDC healthcare IT practice.


 \#CA\-AEN

 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. title: Chief Administrative Officer
description:
🚨 WE ARE HIRING \| CHIEF ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER (CAO)
 



  





**Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI)** 




 📍 Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



  





 Meenakshi Sundararajan Group of Institutions (MSGI) is looking for an experienced and dynamic \*Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)\* to lead the overall administrative and operational functions of our Kodambakkam campus.
 



  





 The CAO will play a key leadership role in ensuring
 **efficient campus operations, infrastructure management, safety, security, facilities, procurement, vendor management and administrative governance.** 




  





 🔹 POSITION
 



  





 \*Designation:\* Chief Administrative Officer (CAO)
 



 \*Location:\* Kodambakkam, Chennai
 



 \*Department:\* Administration
 



 \*Reporting To:\* Secretary / Management
 



 \*Employment Type:\* Full\-time
 



 \*Experience:\* 15\+ years in senior administration / institutional operations / facilities management
 



  





  🎯 ROLE PURPOSE
 



  





 The CAO will be responsible for the overall administrative and operational excellence of the MSGI campus.
 



  





 The role requires a hands\-on leader who can translate Management decisions into effective execution, establish strong systems and SOPs, lead administrative teams, ensure campus readiness and maintain high standards of
 **safety, discipline, service quality and operational efficiency** 
 .
 



  





  🔹 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





  1\. Institutional Administration
 



  





 \* Lead the overall administrative operations of the campus.
 



 \* Develop and implement administrative policies, SOPs, systems and processes.
 



 \* Ensure timely execution of Management decisions and institutional requirements.
 



 \* Coordinate effectively with the Principal, COO, HODs and functional heads.
 



 \* Monitor administrative performance and resolve operational challenges.
 



  





  2\. Infrastructure \& Facilities
 



  





 \* Oversee campus infrastructure, buildings, classrooms, laboratories and common facilities.
 



 \* Manage civil, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, DG, lift, water and other facility\-related services.
 



 \* Establish preventive maintenance systems and ensure timely breakdown resolution.
 



 \* Monitor renovation, refurbishment and infrastructure projects.
 



  





  3\. Safety \& Security
 



  





 \* Lead campus safety, security and emergency preparedness initiatives.
 



 \* Supervise security operations, access control, CCTV and visitor management.
 



 \* Monitor fire, electrical, building and workplace safety.
 



 \* Conduct regular campus inspections and ensure closure of safety observations.
 



 \* Develop and periodically review emergency response procedures.
 



  





  4\. Housekeeping \& Campus Services
 



  





 \* Oversee housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene and campus presentation.
 



 \* Monitor manpower deployment, attendance, discipline and service standards.
 



 \* Establish inspection checklists and service\-level standards.
 



 \* Ensure timely resolution of cleanliness and facility\-related complaints.
 



  





  5\. Procurement \& Vendor Management
 



  





 \* Oversee administrative procurement and vendor coordination.
 



 \* Review quotations, comparative statements, purchase requirements and service contracts.
 



 \* Develop and manage an approved vendor network.
 



 \* Monitor vendor performance, AMC contracts, service quality and timelines.
 



 \* Support cost\-effective and transparent procurement.
 



  





  6\. Budget \& Cost Control
 



  





 \* Prepare and monitor the annual administrative budget.
 



 \* Track infrastructure, maintenance, security, housekeeping and procurement expenditure.
 



 \* Identify opportunities for cost optimization.
 



 \* Ensure effective utilization of institutional resources.
 



  





  7\. Asset \& Inventory Management
 



  





 \* Maintain effective systems for asset and inventory management.
 



 \* Ensure periodic physical verification and proper documentation.
 



 \* Monitor utilization, movement, maintenance and replacement of institutional assets.
 



  





  8\. Team Leadership
 



  





 \* Lead administrative, maintenance, security, housekeeping and support teams.
 



 \* Establish clear responsibilities, accountability and performance standards.
 



 \* Conduct periodic performance reviews and support team development.
 



 \* Coordinate with HR on manpower, discipline, attendance and employee\-related matters.
 



  





 9\. MIS \& Management Reporting
 



  





 \* Prepare and present periodic Administrative MIS to Management.
 



 \* Track maintenance, safety, procurement, vendors, manpower, expenditure and pending activities.
 



 \* Maintain action trackers for Management instructions.
 



 \* Escalate critical issues and delays with appropriate recommendations.
 



  





 10\. Institutional Events \& Special Projects
 



  





 \* Provide administrative and logistical support for admissions, examinations, events, conferences, inspections and institutional programmes.
 



 \* Coordinate campus readiness, security, facilities, housekeeping and logistics.
 



 \* Undertake special projects and responsibilities assigned by Management.
 



  





 🎓 QUALIFICATION \& EXPERIENCE
 



  





 \*Essential:\*
 



  





 \* Graduate / Postgraduate degree in Administration, Management, Engineering, Law or a related discipline.
 



 \* \*15\+ years of relevant experience\*, with significant experience in a senior administrative / operations leadership role.
 



 \* Strong experience in infrastructure, facilities, maintenance, safety, security, procurement and vendor management.
 



 \* Experience managing multiple administrative and support\-service teams.
 



  





 \*Preferred:\*
 



  





 \* Experience in an educational institution, university, hospital, corporate campus or large organization.
 



 \* MBA / PG qualification in Management or a related field.
 



 \* Strong exposure to budgeting, MIS, SOP development and process improvement.
 



 \* Experience with ERP / digital administrative systems.
 



  





  KEY SKILLS \& COMPETENCIES
 



  





 \* Strategic \& Operational Administration
 



 \* Campus \& Facilities Management
 



 \* Infrastructure \& Maintenance
 



 \* Safety \& Risk Management
 



 \* Security Management
 



 \* Procurement \& Vendor Management
 



 \* Budget \& Cost Control
 



 \* Team Leadership
 



 \* Crisis \& Emergency Management
 



 \* Stakeholder Management
 



 \* Negotiation \& Decision Making
 



 \* MIS \& Reporting
 



 \* SOP \& Process Development
 



 \* Problem Solving
 



 \* Strong Execution \& Follow\-through
 



  





  📊 KEY PERFORMANCE AREAS
 



  





 The CAO will be evaluated on:
 



  





 \* Operational efficiency of the campus
 



 \* Infrastructure and maintenance performance
 



 \* Safety and security standards
 



 \* Housekeeping and campus service quality
 



 \* Procurement efficiency and vendor performance
 



 \* Budget adherence and cost optimization
 



 \* Administrative team productivity
 



 \* Asset and inventory control
 



 \* Timeliness and accuracy of MIS
 



 \* Execution of Management instructions
 



 \* Timely closure of administrative issues
 



  





 👤 IDEAL CANDIDATE
 



  





 We are looking for a \*mature, proactive and hands\-on administrative leader\* who can independently manage a large institutional environment, anticipate operational requirements, solve problems quickly and build systems that improve efficiency.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should have strong leadership, communication, negotiation, decision\-making and execution skills, along with the ability to work closely with senior Management and academic leadership.

title: Project SCM Manager - HVDC
description:
**The Opportunity**
 HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. The HVDC market for large scale transmission and offshore wind is booming as an enabler for the global energy transitions. All these projects are classified as very critical infrastructures and hence cyber security requirements, and standard compliance is very high. Hitachi Energy is seeking Project Managers – Supply Chain for Chennai location. This is a great opportunity to apply your passion for project management to manage million\-dollar projects!
   

  

 This is an individual contributor role, responsible for SCM (Supply Chain Management) in the Project, reporting to the Regional Supply Chain Manager while supporting the project director. If you like complex projects, business challenges, have a curious mind, and have a problem\-solving attitude, take the opportunity to join a World Technology Leader Company. Experience the great feeling from managing the SCM scope of large projects close to the end customer. We are interested to learn more about you and what you can contribute with so don’t hesitate to apply even though you don´t meet all requirements. A team with great cooperation and with diverse background is waiting for you to join.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
* In this role you will be Project Manager within the HVDC SCM project and responsible for the procurement activities in our HVDC projects.
* You will be part of the HVDC Project Core team for the projects you manage.
* In this role, you will coordinate across multiple global regions with engineers, controllers, project planners, logisticians, quality professionals, buyers, and suppliers to ensure that equipment is procured and delivered on time, within budget, and within standard.
* You will be responsible for ensuring that all key personnel within the project, global supply chain, the HVDC organization, and the client are aware of any risks and opportunities within project supply chain.
* During the project execution Project SCM need to ensure relentless execution with proactive planning and follow\-up all equipment delivers with our suppliers and internal stakeholders. Project SCM to solve upcoming quality constraints or deficiencies with the supplier equipment deliveries.
* Contribute to vendor list management by providing Supplier Performance data. Ensure that our suppliers comply with the laws, regulations, standards, certificates and directives that Hitachi Energy requires from their suppliers.
* You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.


**Your Background**
* You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering with preferably 12\+ years relevant work experience and master's in business administration is added advantage.
* Demonstrated ability to manage the supply chain management needs of multi\-million dollar projects.
* Strong organizational and planning skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Proactively address business demands in a fast\-paced environment.
* Ability to prioritize and allocate resources to align with department and company goals.
* Preferred CPSM or PMP certifications, Lean Six Sigma, SAP Experience, Documentation Management Systems, Power BI and proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to create strong working relationships.

description:

 Sevalaya is a registered charitable trust established in 1988, serving communities across Tamil Nadu, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Kerala, Gujarat, Rajasthan, and Telangana. Over 1 million people have benefited from Sevalaya’s work in education, healthcare, rural development, and welfare. The organization is professionally managed and guided by a committed Board of Trustees with diverse professional backgrounds and a shared passion for social development. Sevalaya operates with the philosophy of “Love All Serve All,” offering opportunities for team members to contribute meaningfully to social change. Interested individuals can learn more about Sevalaya’s initiatives through its presence on major social media platforms.

The Stores Manager will oversee day\-to\-day store operations, including inventory management, stock receipt and issuance, and maintenance of accurate records and documentation. * Minimum of a diploma or bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, commerce, or a related field is preferred.

title: FAAS -Global Treasury Services -Manager
description:
Locations: Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Houston, Los Angeles, McLean, New York, Philadelphia, San Francisco, San Jose, Seattle, Tampa, Miami, Hoboken
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

 Our Global Treasury Advisory Services team is a dedicated and market\-leading national practice, supported by treasury professionals in a diverse range of areas. Whether it’s for public or private business, financial services organizations, government agencies or not\-for\-profit organizations, we’re always ready with tailored treasury insights our clients can rely on, every time. As a Treasury Manager you’ll play a leading role in that goal, driving growth and managing delivery teams using your treasury process experience.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 It’s a highly collaborative global network, where resources, methodologies, tools and trends are constantly updated and shared to develop simple answers to complex treasury challenges. What’s more, you’ll integrate seamlessly with other EY functions to effectively provide for our clients, so you can expect to build relationships with contacts across the business. We have a broad range of capabilities to assist clients with risk management, funding and capital management, financial risk management, cash flow forecasting and other financial analytics, Treasury technology, post\-merger integration, organizational design, cash management, and finance transformation.
   

  

 As a Manager in our Global Treasury Advisory Services team, you will manage and execute these complex Treasury engagements. If you’re looking for a diverse range of responsibilities with some of the most prestigious clients in multiple markets, you’ll find that here.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 You’re likely to balance your time between personally executing client engagements, developing our business and processes, and managing a varied pipeline. That will mean working on new projects, as well as extensions for existing products, so you’ll be actively influencing a range of client relationships. We’ll also look to you to coach, support, and manage internal resources and demonstrate professionalism while working in the client environment. You will be expected to provide supervision and mentoring to staff and serve as point person for technical questions. It’s a strategic role in a rapidly growing area, where you’ll use your treasury and corporate finance knowledge and experience, as well as your understanding of our products, services and colleagues to further expand our market share, expand our solution capability, and deliver exemplary execution on client engagements. Specific responsibilities would include, but not be limited to:
   

  

* Lead and manage Treasury engagements as a senior team member to include project and resource planning, budget management, execution of work plans and client relationship management and ensure products/deliverables meet contract/work plan specifications and deadlines
* Lead the proposal development process and participate in pursuit team for prospective treasury engagements, support and lead business development and practice development initiatives
* Maintain a strong client focus by being responsive to client requests and developing/maintaining productive working relationships with client personnel.
* Collaborate with the partner and client to determine a strategy that appropriately addresses risk and manages client expectations relating to deliverables, understanding the client’s industry, key performance drivers, business trends and industry developments
* Develop and maintain strong networks, both internally and externally, and work with other service lines in providing an integrated service delivery
* Support the development of expanded client solutions in data and analysis, leveraging emerging technology and advanced analytics to deliver key insights to clients


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Handling the proposal development process for prospective treasury engagement, while supporting in the development of new services and strategies
* Supporting engagement planning, budgeting, execution and management
* Creating process flows and design documents, workshops and tools
* Overseeing end\-user training and support
* Building long\-term relationships with our clients to discover their unique goals, ambitions and needs
* Maintaining an up\-to\-date understanding of tools, practices, and trends in a wide range of areas, including in\-house cash, bank structure, communications, account G/L structure, intercompany processes, liquidity planning and payments processing. Strong analytical and technical skills
* Strong communication, presentation, client service and technical writing skills

**Digital Product \& Customer Experience**

* Design and continuously enhance customer journeys across sourcing, onboarding, credit underwriting, approval, disbursement, servicing, collections, and renewals

* Lead and mentor a team of: Product Managers, Business Analysts, Quality Assurance (QA) Teams and Vendor Delivery Teams

* Drive agile delivery practices and continuous improvement initiatives
* Manage team objectives, development plans, productivity, and performance outcomes



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



* Act as the central coordination point across stakeholders from: Information Technology, Business, Operations, Support, Compliance, Risk, Credit, Analytics and External Vendors
* Drive alignment between business priorities and technology execution
* Influence senior stakeholders and obtain consensus on key decisions
* Present product updates, risks, investment cases, and governance reports to leadership teams



  





**Governance \& Steering Committee Management** 



* Run Steering Committees, Program Governance Forums, Executive Reviews, and Product Councils
* Define and track program objectives, milestones, KPIs, dependencies, and risks
* Establish governance frameworks for monitoring delivery, operational readiness, and business outcomes
* Ensure transparent reporting of project progress, issues, and escalations
* Drive timely resolution of cross\-functional dependencies and blockers



  





**Risk, Compliance \& Audit Management** 



* Own product compliance requirements and regulatory alignment across the product lifecycle
* Ensure adherence to banking, lending, audit, information security, and data privacy standards
* Maintain proper documentation, audit trails, control frameworks, and governance processes
* Track regulatory changes and assess their impact on product journeys
* Drive closure of audit observations, compliance requirements, and control gaps



  





**Program \& Release Management** 



* Identify and mitigate project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and delivery challenges
* Develop program plans, release schedules, and implementation roadmaps
* Own release governance and go\-live readiness processes
* Oversee SIT, UAT, production validation, and deployment activities
* Ensure timely defect resolution and post\-production stabilization
* Monitor user adoption and business performance after deployment
* Drive continuous optimization and product enhancement initiatives



  





**Transformation \& Innovation** 



* Lead enterprise\-wide transformation initiatives focusing on:
* Process automation
* API\-led integrations
* AI and GenAI solutions
* Digital onboarding enhancements
* Analytics\-driven decisioning
* Cross\-sell and upsell enablement
* Process re\-engineering
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, customer experience, and business productivity.



  





**Functional \& Domain Skills** 



* Deep understanding of Vehicle Finance processes and lending lifecycle.
* Strong expertise in: Vehicle Loans, Auto Finance, Loan Origination Systems (LOS), Credit \& Risk workflows, Lending Operations
* Strong understanding of underwriting journeys, decisioning processes, approval matrices, and compliance requirements



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce implementations
* Strong understanding of:
* Salesforce objects and data model
* Workflow automation
* APIs and integrations
* Security and user management



  





**Program Management Skills** 



* Proven experience managing large transformation programs and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong project planning, governance, and risk management capabilities.
* Expertise in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery models.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong execution focus with demonstrated delivery outcomes.



  





**Experience \& Qualification** 




**Mandatory** 



* 7\+ years of overall experience in Product Management, Digital Transformation, or Program Management
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience in Vehicle Finance / Auto Finance domain
* Proven experience delivering Salesforce\-based LOS/CRM transformations
* Experience managing large cross\-functional and vendor teams
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Technology, Business Administration, or related discipline



**Preferred** 



* MBA from a reputed institution
* Salesforce LOS / CRM transformation programs
* Exposure to AI/GenAI\-powered transformation initiatives
* Vendor management and SI engagement



  





**Ideal Candidate Profile** 




 A strategic product leader with deep Vehicle Finance domain expertise, strong Salesforce implementation experience, and a proven track record of leading large\-scale digital transformation programs. The candidate should be equally comfortable defining customer experience, managing executive stakeholders, leading delivery teams, and driving measurable business impact through technology and innovation.

title: FS-RC-FSRM - CSTC-FA and R-Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: DEPUTY MANAGER
description:
**Forvia, a sustainable mobility technology leader**
 We pioneer technology for mobility experience that matter to people.
   

  

**Your Mission, Roles And Responsibilities**
**Overall responsibilities and duties:**
**Responsibilities**
 The Buyer is responsible to develop and manage the supplier panel for a specific commodity segment, selecting suppliers according to Faurecia group criteria, apply purchasing policy, and develop suppliers to continuously improve QCD performance. The Buyer identifies and leads ideas and initiatives in order to improve the global productivity and achieve or surpass financial objectives. Additional responsibilities of the buyer are:
   

  

* Improve financial performance of the Division through supplier negotiations, resourcing and productivity actions
* Monitor supplier Quality, Cost and Delivery performance and challenge supplier when supplier is falling short of targets


**The Main Responsibilities Of The Role Are**
* Develop and execute segment Commodity Strategy;
* Define and lead activities aligned to Commodity Strategy
* Responsible for delivering purchasing budget, updating forecast, reporting monthly savings
* Support Program Buyers with sourcing of new segments and supplier Panel definition
* Pursue optimally economical costs for goods/services required, in conjunction with obtaining continual long term agreement savings opportunities
* Performs continual review and evaluation of the current supply base and also new potential suppliers through cross\-functional supplier audits/visits based on the criteria provided by Group
* Facilitate continuous improvement activities with the supply base to support VA/VE savings opportunities
* ECR/EO activity – obtain quotes for engineering changes, understand and challenge supply base assumptions
* Lead supplier VA/VE activity and participate in lean manufacturing workshops
* Progress savings from inception through to implementation
* Conduct management meetings to review and improve supplier performance
* Manage and understand supplier´s tool life and monitor/secure capacity
* Other duties and specific projects as identified to support commercial targets and supplier optimization ▪ Identify savings, update forecast file and follow through to completion. Take ownership and responsibility for actions under buyer, lead activity
* Identify savings at month end and cross\-reference against productivity file to confirm completion.
* Report savings each month to Manager and confirm with Controller that they are captured.
* Charge Back validation costs via QSS database for poor quality and delivery performance.
* Follow supplier debits from forecast to debit memo to receipt of cash
* Calculate retroactive debits/credits for late identified savings, ensure they are captured at month end, follow through to cash receipt or debit execution.
* Hold monthly supplier management reviews to identify savings gaps, get up to speed on quality issues, communicate FAS intentions, understand supplier glide path to target etc.
* Interface between department and plant or Commercial Business Unit.
* Issue PO for approval for changes required/authorized
* In event of supplier disruption to plant (quality or delivery), understand root cause/scope of issue and facilitate supplier interaction to help resolve issue
* Monitors of the Supplier Global Performance Measurement in terms of quality and service of the cost via the SBG reporting structures
* Follows market trends for specific commodities and raw materials
* Prepares and deploys Commodity Strategies \& Cost Models for various commodities
* Understand all cost break\-downs and challenge supply base accordingly to ensure cost is optimized
* Have the ability to fully understand cost models and be able to provide input towards generating a cost model


**Your profile and competencies to succeed**
**Minimum education level:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering or related field.
   

  

**Experience**
* 12 years in automotive industry
* 12 years in purchasing functions
* SAP experience (preferred)


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Must have very good Excel and Word skills
* Strong communication skills
* Able to accommodate \~15% \- 20% travel (domestic \& international)
* Commitment to the highest ethical standards and willingness to adhere to Faurecia’s Code of Ethics and Code of Management
* Team Player


**What We Can Do For You**
* At Forvia, you will find an engaging and dynamic environment where you can contribute to the development of sustainable mobility leading technologies.
* We are the seventh\-largest global automotive supplier, employing more than 157,000 people in more than 40 countries which makes a lot of opportunity for career development.
* We welcome energetic and agile people who can thrive in a fast\-changing environment. People who share our strong values. Team players with a collaborative mindset and a passion to deliver high standards for our clients. Lifelong learners. High performers. Globally minded people who aspire to work in a transforming industry, where excellence, speed, and quality count.
* We cultivate a learning environment, dedicating tools and resources to ensure we remain at the forefront of mobility. Our people enjoy an average of more than 22 hours of online and in\-person training within FORVIA University (five campuses around the world)
* We offer a multicultural environment that values diversity and international collaboration. We believe that diversity is a strength. To create an inclusive culture where all forms of diversity create real value for the company, we have adopted gender diversity targets and inclusion action plans.
* Achieving CO2 Net Zero as a pioneer of the automotive industry is a priority: In June 2022, Forvia became the first global automotive group to be certified with the new SBTI Net\-Zero Standard (the most ambitious standard of SBTi), aligned with the ambition of the 2015 Paris Agreement of limiting global warming to 1\.5°C. Three principles guide our action: use less, use better and use longer, with a focus on recyclability and circular economy.


**Why join us**
 FORVIA, a global automotive technology supplier, comprises the complementary technology and industrial strengths of Faurecia and HELLA.
   

  

 With over 137 500 people, including more than 12,000 R\&D engineers across 40\+ countries, FORVIA provides a unique and comprehensive approach to the automotive challenges of today and tomorrow. Composed of 6 business groups and a strong IP portfolio of over 12,400 patents, FORVIA is focused on becoming the preferred innovation and integration partner for OEMs worldwide.
   

  

 In 2025, the Group achieved a consolidated revenue of 26\.2 billion euros prior to IFRS 5\. FORVIA SE is listed on the Euronext Paris market under the FRVIA mnemonic code and is a component of the SBF 120 index.
   

  

 FORVIA aims to be a change maker committed to foreseeing and making the mobility transformation happen. www.forvia.com

title: Finops Analytics  - Assistant Vice President
description:
The
 **FinOps Analytics** 
 is a under technical leader responsible for driving cloud cost optimization, building cost‑observability platforms, and enabling proactive cloud financial governance. In addition to core FinOps responsibilities, this role now incorporates
 **Agentic AI architecture, governance, and cost‑control capabilities** 
 as organizations shift from traditional dashboards to autonomous optimization systems.
   

  

 Agentic AI introduces autonomous AI agents capable of analyzing data, making decisions, and executing actions at scale—requiring new guardrails, real‑time cost management, and AI\-centric FinOps frameworks.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Cloud Architecture Optimization \& Technical Advisory
* Conduct reviews of high‑spend cloud services to identify inefficiencies.
* Recommend code‑level and infrastructure changes—including serverless patterns, right‑sizing, and storage tiering—to reduce spend.
* Ensure engineering teams adopt cost‑efficient design standards to prevent cloud and on\-prem “tech debt.”
* FinOps Data, Analytics \& Cost Transparency
* Build cloud cost observability and on\-prem analytics frameworks that provide real‑time usage and spend insights.
* Develop forecasting models, dashboards, anomaly‑detection systems, and financial models to support cloud budgeting.
* Integrate data from cloud providers, usage logs, telemetry, and AI agent activity streams.
* Governance, Policy Automation \& Cloud Financial Controls
* Implement tagging standards, cost attribution, chargeback/showback frameworks, and compliance policies.
* Manage FinOps governance foundations promoting visibility, accountability, and cross‑team alignment.
* Agentic AI Responsibilities


 Agentic AI introduces autonomous, reasoning‑capable AI agents that perform tasks, invoke APIs, spin up compute, and make resource decisions independently—requiring a new layer of FinOps oversight.
   

  

**Design \& Integrate Agentic AI Workflows into FinOps**
* Architect and integrate Agentic AI systems that autonomously analyze cloud usage, detect inefficiencies, and propose or execute optimizations.
* Incorporate multi‑agent systems capable of proactive anomaly detection, predictive optimization, and autonomous corrective actions within the cloud and on\-prem ecosystem.


**Real‑Time AI Agent Cost Visibility \& Ownership**
* Establish per‑agent cost attribution, including owner tags, budget identifiers, and full traceability of every model invocation or API call.
* Build telemetry pipelines (e.g., OpenTelemetry with cost metadata) capturing cost\_per\_call, decision logs, and tool usage for all agents.


**Budgeting, Guardrails \& Autonomous Spending Control**
* Design dynamic and iterative budgeting models, replacing static annual budgets with daily/weekly limit enforcement for agentic workflows.
* Implement policy\-driven controls (e.g., budget throttles, automated revocation, execution guardrails) to manage microtransaction\-level spend driven by autonomous agents.
* Govern agent estates using enterprise\-grade tooling (e.g., Microsoft’s Foundry Control Plane) to enforce identity, security, and auditability for AI agent actions.


**AI Optimization Agents \& Execution Automation**
* Leverage or build Citi AI optimization agents (e.g., Azure Copilot Optimization Agent) that automatically analyze performance, compare SKU alternatives, and generate execution\-ready automation scripts.
* Oversee the safe implementation of agent\-suggested optimizations by validating performance impact and compliance before execution.


**FinOps for LLM, Multi\-Agent \& RAG Architectures**
* Manage the cost implications of LLM inference, multi\-agent collaboration, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) workflows, where token usage and replication can multiply costs significantly.
* Optimize model selection, context length, inference endpoints, and caching strategies to reduce unnecessary LLM consumption.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Stakeholder Leadership
* Partner with FinOps Champions, engineering teams, and business stakeholders to translate cloud and AI cost goals into actionable backlogs.
* Promote organizational alignment via shared ownership of cloud and and on\-prem AI spending across finance, engineering, and operations.
* Communicate complex On\-prem, cloud, and AI cost insights clearly to executives and product teams.
* Continuous Cloud \& AI Optimization Strategy
* Drive ongoing cloud and agent\-driven optimization initiatives to reduce waste, prevent cost overruns, and maximize ROI.
* Develop long\-term cloud, AI, and automation strategy including SKU optimization, licensing, GPU provisioning, and model lifecycle cost management.


**Required Qualifications**
* Exposure to cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP) with hands‑on cost optimization experience.
* Good knowledge of FinOps principles, cost models, and cloud financial governance.
* Understanding of LLMs, multi\-agent architectures, RAG workflows, and AI operational cost models.
* Ability to design secure, monitored, and budget‑controlled environments for autonomous agents.

description:
**Who we are looking for**

In this role, you will work with State Street teams from around the globe to lead Reconciliation team supporting State street Middle Office and back office services. You will have responsibility to oversee and deliver all day\-to\-day deliverables of the Reconciliation management team in a fast\-paced, flexible and exciting environment. The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationship with business operations teams and IT and to maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to all the clients.


**Why this role is important to us**

This is a varied operational and managerial position with a senior level of responsibility within the Reconciliation team. This Reconciliation Officer/Assistant Vice President acts as a Primary contact point for all internal/external clients. The team is responsible performing Cash, Position and Non\-Core reconciliation and support various functional teams to resolve the exception within SLA. The candidate should be a hands on manager who is required to ensure the teams under their responsibility undertake delivery to both internal and external clients, ensure timely response to client initiated queries, and escalation of any unresolve matters to manager for best resolution.

* Oversee and provide day to day management of Reconciliation Management team for responsible Reconciliation unit/client
* Drive Reconciliation process excellence though proactive management of the exception lifecycle
* Responsible for service delivery and client sentiment, including direct client contact
* Support a strong risk management and control environment
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations.
* Conduct high\-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work\-processing issues, make suggestions to streamline operations and implement.
* Liaise with colleagues in region or divisions globally where required for client issue resolution
* Perform an review function of Reconciliation process to identifying operational trends, issues and areas for improvement.
* Perform work independently within scope of established guidelines and according to specific procedures.
* Support and proactive manage on Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models
* Communicate effectively on issues / problems to the Client and to SSC management and ensure a proper and timely follow\-up to ensure resolution.
* Provide guidance, support and development opportunities to the members of your team
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze on the spot.

**What we value**

* Extensive asset management experience, including investment operations, reconciliations and fund accounting.
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working in a variety of asset management disciplines.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Hands\-on experience with reconciliation tools like TLP/IntelliMatch and proficiency in manual reconciliation processes.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to audiences of different sizes and levels of seniority
* Must be self\-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
* Good team working skills.
* Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in finance, business, technology or equivalent with 15\+ yrs. of relevant industry experience
* Proven experience in client communication and interaction at all levels
* In depth understanding of Middle or Back Office operations, end\-to\-end processes of Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, ETFs, and other investment vehicles. Should be proficient in multiple asset classes including derivatives, bank loans, fixed income, OTC products, etc., and have a deep understanding of their life cycles.
* Understanding of key technology within the support of investment management operations, TLM/TLP and Intellimatch.
* Experience of driving organizational change, with an understanding of change management principles, techniques \& tools.
* Experience in leveraging technology solutions including low\-code tools, SQL, Python or similar is advantageous
* Strong MS Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint skills necessary

**Additional requirements :** Working from office 4 days a week

title: Lead, Client Service Operations
description:
Client Service Operations (CSO) enables Kroll's business units through operational excellence, standardized processes, and centralized support services. As part of CSO, the Business Support Services (BSS) function provides high\-quality business enablement services that enhance operational efficiency, improve consistency, strengthen governance, and elevate the internal stakeholder experience.
   

  

 Business Support Services operates as a centralized shared services organization supporting internal teams across a broad range of operational activities including business administration, sales support, document production, presentation services, workflow coordination, reporting, operational data management, and business process support. Through a customer\-centric approach and continuous improvement mindset, the team enables business units to focus on delivering value to clients.
   

  

 The Lead, Business Support Services is responsible for the day\-to\-day management and successful delivery of one or more Business Support Services offerings. The role provides operational leadership by ensuring service requests are delivered accurately, within agreed service levels, and in accordance with established quality standards. The Lead is accountable for managing a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts, overseeing workload allocation, monitoring operational performance, conducting quality reviews, and acting as the primary operational contact for assigned stakeholders.
   

  

 In addition to ensuring consistent service delivery, the Lead is expected to identify opportunities to improve processes, strengthen governance, enhance team capability, and drive operational excellence across their service portfolio.
   

  

**Day\-to\-day Responsibilities**
* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of assigned Business Support Services offerings, ensuring work is completed within agreed service levels and quality expectations.
* Manage day\-to\-day operational activities, balancing workload, priorities, and resource allocation to ensure efficient service delivery.
* Monitor work queues, request volumes, turnaround times, and service performance, taking proactive action to address delivery risks.
* Ensure business continuity through effective workload planning and resource management.
* Support transition of new services and operational activities into the Business Support Services operating model.
* Establish and maintain high standards of quality across all team deliverables.
* Conduct quality reviews of complex or high\-risk deliverables and ensure corrective actions are implemented where required.
* Monitor quality trends, identify recurring issues, and implement actions to reduce rework and improve delivery consistency.
* Ensure compliance with Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational controls, data handling requirements, and governance standards.
* Support audit requests and ensure operational documentation is accurate and maintained.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Analysts and Senior Analysts to achieve operational and professional development objectives.
* Allocate work based on business priorities, individual capability, and team capacity.
* Monitor individual and team performance against established goals and provide regular coaching and feedback.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing capability development within the team.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable, and customer\-focused team culture.
* Serve as the primary operational point of contact for assigned business stakeholders.
* Build strong working relationships through proactive communication, responsiveness, and reliable service delivery.
* Manage stakeholder expectations by providing regular updates on service requests, priorities, and operational performance.
* Resolve operational issues and escalations in a timely and professional manner.
* Support service reviews by providing updates on performance, challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through process standardization, simplification, and automation.
* Lead implementation of process improvements that enhance productivity, quality, and stakeholder experience.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, templates, knowledge articles, and operational guidance materials.
* Monitor operational metrics and identify trends to support informed decision\-making and continuous improvement.
* Promote a culture of operational excellence and continuous learning within the team.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams across Client Service Operations to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Work closely with leadership to support operational planning, resource management, and service expansion initiatives.
* Share best practices across Business Support Services to promote consistency and standardization.


**Key Performance Indicators**
* Service Delivery: SLA achievement, Turnaround time, Queue management, Delivery throughput
* Quality: Quality scores, Rework rates, Process compliance, Audit readiness
* Operational Performance: Productivity, Capacity utilization, Workload balancing, Operational efficiency
* Stakeholder Experience: Stakeholder satisfaction, Escalation resolution, Responsiveness, Service adoption
* People: Team engagement, Performance management, Training completion, Capability development
* Continuous Improvement: Process improvements implemented, Standardization initiatives, Automation opportunities identified, Knowledge management contributions


**Essential Traits**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, Operations, Management, or a related discipline.
* 6–8 years of experience in Client Service Operations, Shared Services, Business Operations, Business Support Services, or Professional Services.
* Minimum 2 years of experience leading or coordinating operational teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing service delivery within a shared services or operational support environment.
* Strong operational leadership and service delivery management.
* Experience managing teams within a shared services or business operations environment.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Experience with workflow management, reporting, and operational governance.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Monday.com, SharePoint, ServiceNow, or similar workflow tools.
