description:
Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head
 



 Company: AVPL International
 



 Location: Gurugram, Haryana
 



 Department: Supply Chain, Procurement \& Administration
 



 Employment Type: Full\-Time
 



 Experience: 10\+ Years
 



 Payroll: AVPL International
 



 Industry Preference: Drone / UAV / Aerospace / Defence / Advanced Manufacturing
 



 About AVPL International
 



 AVPL International is a technology\-driven organization operating in the Drone \& UAV ecosystem, working across drone manufacturing, technology, training, and related applications.
 



 We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head who can lead end\-to\-end supply chain, procurement, vendor management, logistics, inventory, and administration operations.
 



 The ideal candidate will have strong experience in the Drone/UAV industry, sound knowledge of drone technology and components, and an established pool/network of reliable vendors and suppliers.
 



 Role Overview
 



 The Supply Chain Management \& Admin Head will be responsible for developing and managing a robust and cost\-effective supply chain for AVPL's drone\-related operations.
 



 The person will be expected to build, maintain, and leverage a strong vendor ecosystem, ensure timely availability of critical components, optimize procurement costs, and ensure smooth administrative and operational functioning.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Supply Chain \& Procurement
 



 • Lead the complete Supply Chain Management and Procurement function.
 



 • Develop and implement strategic sourcing and procurement plans.
 



 • Ensure timely procurement and availability of materials required for drone manufacturing and operations.
 



 • Manage the complete procurement cycle from requirement identification to vendor selection, negotiation, purchase, delivery, and quality coordination.
 



 • Develop alternate sourcing strategies for critical components to minimize supply\-chain risks.
 



 • Identify opportunities for cost reduction, localization, and process improvement.
 



 2\. Vendor Management \& Vendor Network
 



 • Build, develop, and maintain a strong and reliable vendor pool across India and international markets.
 



 • Leverage existing industry relationships to identify and onboard reliable suppliers quickly.
 



 • Develop vendors for drone components, electronics, mechanical parts, batteries, motors, sensors, flight controllers, frames, payloads, communication systems, and other relevant components.
 



 • Evaluate vendors based on quality, cost, capacity, lead time, reliability, and delivery performance.
 



 • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, MOQ, lead times, and commercial agreements.
 



 • Maintain a strong database of approved and alternate vendors for critical materials.
 



 • Continuously identify new suppliers and develop alternate sources to avoid dependency on single vendors.
 



 • Monitor vendor performance and take corrective action where required.
 



 3\. Drone / UAV Industry Knowledge
 



 • Possess a good understanding of the Drone/UAV ecosystem and its supply chain.
 



 • Understand the basic functionality and sourcing requirements of major drone components.
 



 • Have knowledge of components such as:
 



 o Motors \& ESCs
 



 o Flight Controllers
 



 o GPS/GNSS
 



 o Batteries \& BMS
 



 o Propellers
 



 o Frames
 



 o Sensors
 



 o Communication/Telemetry systems
 



 o Cameras \& Payloads
 



 o Electronic and mechanical components
 



 • Work closely with R\&D, Engineering and Production teams to understand BOMs, specifications, component requirements, and sourcing alternatives.
 



 • Stay updated with developments in the drone industry, component suppliers, and emerging technologies.
 



 4\. Inventory \& Logistics Management
 



 • Establish effective inventory\-control systems for critical components and finished products.
 



 • Monitor stock levels, consumption, lead times, and reorder requirements.
 



 • Minimize excess inventory, dead stock, material wastage, and stock\-outs.
 



 • Oversee warehousing, transportation, dispatch, and logistics operations.
 



 • Ensure timely movement of materials between vendors, warehouses, manufacturing units, and project locations.
 



 5\. Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • Lead overall administration and facility\-management activities.
 



 • Manage office, warehouse, manufacturing/facility infrastructure, security, housekeeping, transportation, and other administrative services.
 



 • Manage administrative vendors and service providers.
 



 • Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of facilities and operational locations.
 



 • Monitor administrative budgets and optimize operational expenses.
 



 • Ensure compliance with internal policies, safety standards, and applicable statutory requirements.
 



 6\. Team \& Stakeholder Management
 



 • Lead and develop the Supply Chain, Procurement, Stores, Logistics, and Administration teams.
 



 • Coordinate closely with R\&D, Production, Engineering, Finance, Projects, Sales, and Management.
 



 • Establish clear KPIs and performance metrics for procurement and supply\-chain teams.
 



 • Prepare and present MIS and management reports related to procurement, inventory, vendor performance, and logistics.
 



 Key Skills Required
 



 • Strategic Procurement \& Sourcing
 



 • Supply Chain Management
 



 • Strong Vendor Development
 



 • Established Vendor Network / Vendor Pool
 



 • Vendor Negotiation \& Commercial Management
 



 • Inventory \& Warehouse Management
 



 • Logistics Management
 



 • Material Planning
 



 • Cost Optimization
 



 • Vendor Performance Management
 



 • Team Leadership
 



 • Administration \& Facility Management
 



 • MIS \& Reporting
 



 • Strong stakeholder\-management and negotiation skills
 



 Ideal Candidate Profile
 



 The best\-fit candidate will:
 



 • Have 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, or related functions.
 



 • Have strong hands\-on experience in the Drone/UAV industry.
 



 • Have a good understanding of drone technology, components, manufacturing, and the UAV ecosystem.
 



 • Bring an established and extensive vendor pool/network, particularly for drone components and technology products.
 



 • Have strong relationships with suppliers and the ability to quickly source critical components.
 



 • Have experience managing procurement for electronics, mechanical components, batteries, motors, sensors, and other high\-tech products.
 



 • Have experience working with manufacturing, R\&D, engineering, or technology\-driven organizations.
 



 • Demonstrate strong negotiation and cost\-optimization capabilities.
 



 • Have experience managing teams and multiple vendors simultaneously.
 



 • Be highly proactive, commercially aware, and capable of building a scalable supply\-chain ecosystem.
 



 Preferred Industry Background
 



 Priority 1: Drone / UAV / Unmanned Systems
 



 Priority 2: Aerospace / Defence / Robotics
 



 Priority 3: Electronics / EV / Automotive / Advanced Manufacturing / Engineering \& Technology
 



 Education
 



 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field.
 



 MBA/PGDM in Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, or related specialization will be an added advantage.
 



 Key Hiring Priority
 


* Drone Industry Experience \+ Drone Component Knowledge \+ Strong Existing Vendor Pool/Network \+ Strategic Procurement Expertise will be the key differentiators for this position.) is preferred.

title: Commissiong Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading all site construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Construction Management
   

  

* Support on\-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non\-conformances, and site technical queries.


 Commissioning Management
   

  

* Plan and manage pre\-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.


 Environment, Health, \& Safety (EHS) and Quality
   

  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit\-to\-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project\-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.


 Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
   

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning\-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.


 Documentation and Compliance
   

  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as\-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility\-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high\-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.


 Typical Experience Profile
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 5\+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high\-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization


 Working Conditions
   

  

* Site based role
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high\-pressure commissioning periods
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary


******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:** 
 Yes

title: Commissioning Manager HVDC
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Job Description Summary
   

  

 The HVDC Construction and Commissioning Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading all site construction, installation, testing, and commissioning activities for High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) projects. This role ensures that project execution is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with technical specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Construction Management
   

  

* Support on\-site construction activities for HVDC converter stations, substations, cable systems, and associated infrastructure with primary responsibility of managing commissioning.
* Coordinate site managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to achieve commissioning milestones.
* Oversee installation of major equipment such as converters, transformers, valves, reactors, GIS/AIS equipment, cooling systems, and control/protection systems.


 Technical Leadership
   

  

* Oversee commissioning of HVDC converter systems, transformers, valves, switchgear, smoothing reactors, cooling systems, AC/DC yard equipment, and control/protection systems.
* Lead troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for issues encountered during testing and energization.
* Ensure technical compliance with design documents, grid code requirements, contractual specifications, and industry standards.
* Support engineering teams in resolving design changes, non\-conformances, and site technical queries.


 Commissioning Management
   

  

* Plan and manage pre\-commissioning, commissioning, energization, and performance testing activities for HVDC systems.
* Coordinate system integration and interface testing between electrical, control, protection, telecom, and SCADA systems.
* Ensure commissioning procedures, test protocols, and acceptance criteria are developed, reviewed, and approved.
* Lead troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during testing and energization.
* Support handover of commissioned systems to the client and operations team.


 Environment, Health, \& Safety (EHS) and Quality
   

  

* Promote and enforce a strong safety culture across all site activities.
* Ensure compliance with EHS regulations, permit\-to\-work systems, lockout/tagout procedures, and project\-specific safety requirements.
* Ensure all construction and commissioning work meets applicable quality standards, codes, and contractual obligations.


 Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting
   

  

* Serve as the main point of contact for commissioning\-related matters with the client, project management, OEMs, and grid operators.
* Participate in progress reviews, readiness assessments, and milestone meetings.
* Report commissioning progress, issues, risks, and recovery plans to project leadership.
* Support final acceptance testing, handover, and project closeout activities.


 Documentation and Compliance
   

  

* Ensure site documentation is complete and up to date, including inspection records, test reports, punch lists, and as\-built documentation.
* Verify compliance with grid codes, customer specifications, and applicable international standards.
* Support factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), and final project documentation closure.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Extensive experience in HVDC, substations, power transmission, or large utility\-scale electrical infrastructure projects.
* Strong experience in both construction management and commissioning of high\-voltage electrical systems.
* Proven knowledge of converter stations, protection and control systems, testing procedures, and energization processes.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience managing large, complex EPC or turnkey HVDC projects.
* Knowledge of LCC and/or VSC HVDC technologies.
* Experience working with multinational teams, contractors, and clients across multiple geographies.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications, and commissioning procedures.


 Typical Experience Profile
   

  

* 10\+ years of experience in power transmission, substation, or HVDC projects
* 5\+ years in a site leadership, construction management, or commissioning leadership role
* Demonstrated experience with high\-voltage equipment installation, testing, and energization


 Working Conditions
   

  

* Site based role
* Work may involve remote project locations, outage windows, and high\-pressure commissioning periods
* Availability for field troubleshooting and critical milestone support is necessary

 STAR KIDZ Footwear is part of Ojas Footwear India Pvt. Ltd., a leading manufacturer of kids’ footwear for ages 1 to 13, offering products for all children. * Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Production Management, Industrial Engineering, Footwear Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Experience with lean manufacturing, 5S, or other continuous improvement methodologies is an advantage.
* Ability to work on\-site in Bahadurgarh and adapt to a fast\-paced, growth\-oriented manufacturing setting.

The role also involves identifying process improvements, supporting risk and advisory teams with claims insights, and ensuring compliance with regulatory and company guidelines.

* Relevant bachelor’s degree in insurance, finance, business, or a related field; professional insurance certifications are an advantage.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to work collaboratively with clients, insurers, and internal teams.
* Attention to detail, organizational skills, and proficiency in using claims management or insurance\-related software.
* Previous experience in insurance broking, risk advisory, or claims management roles is highly beneficial.

title: Regional Vice President
description:
**SRMB STEEL \| JOB DESCRIPTION.** 




**Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Location:** 
 Kolkata, West Bengal ( Region head: East \& NE ).
 



**Company :** 
 SRMB STEEL.
 



**Reporting to :** 
 President and Chief Sales \& Marketing Officer.
 



**Grade / Level :** 
 Vice President.
 



**Experience** 
 :
 **15 to 20 years in steel Industry, from Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only.** 




  





 SRMB Group is one of India’s respected steel and construction\-materials companies, with a turnover of over ₹2,500 crore, 3,000\+ employees and a strong manufacturing base.
 



 We are looking for an experienced
 **Regional Vice President.** 




  





**Responsibilities** 




  




* Own the regional P\&L. Deliver volume, contribution margin and counter share for the region under the national framework.
* Lead the Zonal Head. Set targets for 3 to 4 Zonal Heads, run the review cadence, and build a 60\-plus team that performs.
* Drive district and counter execution. Take share at the counter through disciplined district plans, reach and range, not through price wars.
* Manage cost and productivity. Hold fixed cost and team productivity to plan, so the region grows profitably as it scales.
* Lead the West Bengal model (East \& NE). For East \& NE, drive the 2X West Bengal play through the two Bengal Zonal Heads and make it the template other regions follow.
* Develop the market and the team. Grow the channel, the counters and the next line of leaders across the region.



  





**Qualifications** 




  




* **15 to 20 years** 
 from
 **Tier 1 or Tier 2 brands only** 
 .
* MBA preferred across all regions.



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* Must have led a team of at least 60, with 3 to 4 direct reports at Zonal Head level.
* Proven regional P\&L ownership, with growth delivered on contribution margin, not tonnage alone.
* Deep command of district and counter\-level execution and counter\-share gain.
* A leader who builds teams and the next line of leaders, and runs on data and a clear review cadence.
* For East \& NE, a strong track record in the eastern market and the ability to drive the West Bengal 2X model.



  





**Preferred Skills** 




  




* Experience operating under a unified national market framework.
* Experience in managing multiple regions or diverse state markets.



  





**Pay range and compensation package** 




  





 As per the Industry.
 



  





**Additional Role Context** 




  





*Why this role exists* 



* The Regional VP runs a region of steel sales end to end: the P\&L, the Zonal Heads, and the district and counter execution that turns strategy into share.
* All four regions run under one national market framework, so growth is comparable, disciplined and margin\-led rather than a set of local styles.



  





*The national market framework (one scope)* 



* Every region operates on the same three pillars, under one scope.
* Contribution margin. Growth is measured by contribution, not tonnage alone. The region is run to protect and grow margin.
* Fixed\-cost and team productivity. Output per member and return on fixed cost are managed as hard numbers, so the region scales efficiently.
* Counter share. Share of the counter, won district by district, is the true measure of market strength.
* East \& NE leads the model. West Bengal must lead the framework, targeting 2X sales growth and competitive dominance through rigorous district and counter\-level execution, with two dedicated Zonal Heads for North Bengal and South Bengal.



  





*Regional scope* 




  




* Region / Indicative states / Special mandate.
* East \& NE: West Bengal, Odisha, Bihar, Jharkhand, Assam and the North East, Sikkim – Lead the model: West Bengal 2X, two ZHs for North and South Bengal.



  





*Measurable indices and scale of growth* 




  




* Targets are indicative and to be locked per region with the CSMO..
* Index / What it measures / Target .
* Volume growth – Regional steel tonnage – \+25 to 35% YoY (WB: 2X).
* Contribution margin – Region contribution and margin – Grow margin YoY under one framework.
* Counter share – Share of counter throughput – Top 2 or 3 in priority districts.
* Reach – Active billing counters – Rising quarter on quarter.
* Team productivity – Tonnage and contribution per member – Improve YoY, fixed cost held.
* Collections – DSO and overdue share – Within norm, overdue under 5%.

title: Market Access Manager
description:

**Location**

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

title: Daglig leder til Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave
description:
Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave er en hyggelig privat institution med omkring 20 dejlige skovbørn, hvor der er masser af hjertevarme, glæde og fællesskab.
   

  

 Institutionen blev grundlagt i 1970 og har i dag base i Stenløse Egedal Kommune. Hver dag, året rundt kører vi på eventyr i skov og ved strand i vores trofaste bus ”Rumle”. Vi bruger alt vores tid ude, og vores mål er at lære børnene at færdes i naturen, vise dem hvor givende naturen er, med bl.a. læring om respekt for dyr og plantelivet.
   

  

 Nærvær og indlevelse, glæde og latter er det centrale omdrejningspunkt i vores hverdag. Vi sætter en ære i at alle har haft en god dag, når de går hjem.
   

  

 Du vil blive leder for en dynamisk og engageret personalegruppe med hver deres kompetencer, som har et tæt samarbejde – både blandt hinanden, men også med forældregruppen og bestyrelsen. Vores værdier og menneskesyn udspringer af anerkendelse og respekt over for hinanden – store som små, og at møde barnet der hvor det er, og bidrage til selvværd og selvudvikling hos det enkelte barn. Vi bruger alle rammerne i naturen til at skabe læring, sjov og glæde. Vi har særlig fokus på leg, bevægelse, kreativitet og sociale fællesskaber samt børneyoga og mindfulness.
   

  

 Personaleledelse, administration og samarbejde
   

  

 Stenløse Private Skovbørnehave består af en personalegruppe på 4 personer og mellem 20 og 30 skønne skovbørn. Du skal have overblik, være struktureret og god til at samarbejde. Jobbet indebærer en række administrative opgaver, herunder budgetansvar, ugeplanlægning, ventelistehåndtering, opfølgning, personale\- og forældresamtaler, svare henvendelser på mail og telefon mv. Økonomi og administration vil foregå i tæt dialog med bestyrelsen og Landsorganisationen Danske Daginstitutioner – LDD som vi er medlem af.
   

  

 Arbejdet vil være fordelt således, at der i gennemsnit er 2 faste dage om ugen til kontor og de resterende dage er du med i skoven.
   

  

 Profil
   

  

* Du er uddannet pædagog og har gerne erfaring ledelse fra tidligere job.
* Du skal kunne lide at færdes i naturen og har flair for udelivet.
* Du har økonomisk overblik, arbejder struktureret og har it\-forståelser.
* Du skal kunne bevæge dig i krydsfeltet mellem at være på børn og være leder.
* Du besidder empati og kan skabe tryghed og omsorg for det enkelte barn og gruppen som helhed.
* Du kan udvise ansvarlighed overfor børnehavens værdier og koncept.
* Du kan samarbejde med åben dialog, forståelse og tydelig kommunikation.
* Du kan inspirere og er god til sparring og opbygge et positivt samarbejdsklima.


 Vi søger dig, som har lyst til at indgå i et spændende og givende job, hvor du vil få stor indflydelse på, at vores børn får den bedste start på livet ved at gå i en skovbørnehave.
   

  

 Stillingen er på 37 timer og til besættelse snarest muligt. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Frist for ansøgning er 14\. oktober 2026\.
   

  

 Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, kan du ringe til vores formand Cecilie Wium\-Tellefsen på 28 15 95 13\.
   

  

 Din ansøgning sendes til formand@skovboernehave.dk, og du bedes vedhæfte CV, uddannelsespapirer, kursusbeviser, udtalelser, referencer og/eller andre relevante papirer.
   

  

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

title: Sizing Analyst
description:
**Department:** 
 Sales
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata / Gurgaon
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Salary:** 
 10\-12 LPA
 



  





**About Triphos** 




 Triphos Power is a full\-stack battery\-as\-a\-service company focused on commercial and industrial (C\&I) customers. We finance, own, deploy, operate, and maintain battery storage systems, backed by our own in\-house Energy Management System (EMS) — putting us at the intersection of system integration, battery portfolio management, and technology. Our target is 100 MWh across 30–40 C\&I sites in Year 1, scaling to a gigawatt\-hour\-plus portfolio within three years. We're backed by the promoter family of Rupa \& Co. and Neo Metaliks, giving us capital strength, distribution expertise, and a warm C\&I customer pipeline from day one.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Every Triphos proposal starts with a number: how much battery a site actually needs, and what it saves the customer. The Sizing Analyst owns that number. You'll work directly with C\&I clients to pull the load, tariff, and consumption data we need, clean it into something usable, and run the sizing and feasibility analysis behind every deal. Your output is the package the customer decides on — a full sizing report, a savings analysis, and a financial model with a clear ROI case. As we push toward 100 MWh across 30–40 sites in Year 1, this analysis is what separates a deal that closes and performs from one that doesn't.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own the client data pipeline end to end — work through the data questionnaire with C\&I clients, understand exactly what's needed from each site, and follow up until it lands
* Clean, structure, and validate large, messy client datasets into analysis\-ready inputs
* Run sizing and optimization analysis to determine the right battery configuration for each site
* Determine which use case fits each client best — peak shaving, time\-of\-day arbitrage, renewable integration — based on what the data actually shows
* Research and interpret state tariff orders, electricity bills, penalty structures, and open access regulations to ground every analysis in real numbers
* Build savings analyses that quantify what the customer actually stands to gain
* Produce the full BESS feasibility analysis report for each site
* Communicate directly with clients throughout — chasing data, clarifying assumptions, and keeping the process moving
* Contribute to automating and streamlining the analysis process as we scale



  





**Key Requirements / Skills** 



* 0–3 years of experience
* BSc or higher in Operations Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related quantitative field
* Strong expertise in Excel, Python, SQL, or similar analytical tools
* Strong with numbers, with a solid grounding in optimization, statistics, and sharp problem\-solving instincts
* Basic electrical knowledge, or willingness to pick it up quickly



  





**Who We're Looking For** 




 Your analysis drives real investment decisions on both sides, so we want someone who feels that weight and checks their work accordingly.
 


* Meticulous — you go through data line by line because you know what rides on it
* Mathematically sharp, with the instinct to spot a number that looks wrong
* A clear communicator who builds rapport with clients and gets the data you need fast
* Comfortable working directly with C\&I customers
* High ownership and hands\-on, in a small, fast\-moving team



  





**How to Apply** 



* Send your resume and a note under 200 words on why you think you are the right fit to hr@triphospower.com.

title: Market Access Manager
description:
**Department** 
 : Rare Disease \& Public Care
   

  

**Location** 
 : Kolkata
   

  

**Company: Novo Nordisk India Pvt. Ltd**
**Your impact begins here**
 As Market Access Manager, you will strengthen how Novo Nordisk engages payers, shapes therapy access and manages key accounts across your market. You will connect commercial strategy with market access execution — identifying external opportunities, building account\-based plans and helping secure formulary presence for our portfolio. By bringing together insight, cross\-functional collaboration and practical action, you will help ensure that more people living with serious chronic diseases can access the treatments they need. Your impact starts today.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* A Master's degree, preferably within a quantitative or management discipline, from a well\-recognised institute.
* 5\+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry.
* Direct experience in at least two of the following areas: Pricing, Outcomes Research, Health Economics, Brand Value Communications, Advocacy Development, Payer Engagement, Market Access, Customer Insight Gathering, Customer Value Proposition Development, or Negotiation and Business Acquisition.
* Experience building relationships and networks with healthcare decision\-makers, including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders.
* A track record of delivering business objectives in alignment with multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* The ability to analyse complex issues, apply strategic thinking and implement tactical plans.
* Experience articulating complex market access topics clearly and persuasively to key decision\-makers.
* Commercial, business or medical experience at a managerial level, with the ability to work effectively within cross\-functional teams.


**Useful, But Not Essential**
* Exposure to areas beyond your direct experience listed above.


**What You'll Do**
* Shape therapy access strategies for new and existing launches by identifying market opportunities, planning account\-based approaches and ensuring budget allocation for Novo Nordisk therapy areas.
* Manage national key accounts — including ESI, Railway, CGHS and Army — driving aligned actions across commercial functions to strengthen product presence and formulary inclusion.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Key Account Managers on state tenders, tracking product cycles across institutional accounts and providing regular updates on tender and account status.
* Train and support Key Account Managers on account management practices, collaborating with Sales, Marketing and People \& Organisation to build capability.
* Serve as the single point of contact for therapy access knowledge, connecting global materials and up\-to\-date product information with local teams and institutional partners.
* Support the institution team in filing tenders by providing accurate, current documentation and product information.


**Who You'll Work With**
 You will join a market access team within Rare Disease \& Public Care, working at the intersection of commercial strategy and payer engagement. Your closest partners will be colleagues across Marketing, CMR, Sales, Key Account Management and medical functions within the affiliate.
   

  

 Externally, you will build and maintain a broad network of stakeholders with influence on market access outcomes — including government bodies, payers, policy makers and key opinion leaders. You will also connect with regional and global market access colleagues to share learning and align on priorities.
   

  

 The role is cross\-functional by nature. You will bring different perspectives together, create clarity around account priorities and help teams move from insight to action across therapy areas.
   

  

**What You Can Expect Here**
 You will work in an environment where your expertise in payer engagement and account strategy directly shapes commercial outcomes. The role offers the opportunity to deepen your market access skills, collaborate across functions and contribute to work that expands treatment access for people living with serious chronic diseases.
   

  

 You will be trusted to take ownership of your accounts and priorities, supported to develop new capabilities and encouraged to share your perspective. Cross\-functional collaboration, honest feedback and a focus on results define how the team works together.
   

  

**Start now**
 Your impact begins today. If you are ready to strengthen therapy access and help more people benefit from Novo Nordisk's portfolio, apply for the Market Access Manager role by 24 September 2026\. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.
   

  

 We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

**Designation:** 
**Sr. Manager/ AGM – Logistics**

**About The Role**
 This role owns end\-to\-end execution of Bayport's outbound and inbound logistics operation — from raw material import through SEZ export compliance, carrier management, international transit, and final delivery with proof of delivery — while also owning full financial control of the freight and 3PL spend that flows through the department. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who has run high\-volume international parcel/express operations before and can bring immediate rigor, carrier relationships, and operational and financial discipline to a fast\-scaling, compliance\-intensive environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* International Carrier \& Freight Management: Own the relationship and performance of FedEx, UPS, Emirates and other carrier partners — rate negotiation, annual contracts, service\-level management, escalation handling, and carrier score carding across air, sea, and surface.

* 3PL Vendor Bill Audit \& Financial Control: Own the checking and audit of all 3PL/carrier vendor bills against contracted rates and actual service delivered and drive timely payment and reconciliation in coordination with Finance and the vendor — this is a named, direct accountability of this role, not a shared or informal responsibility.
* End\-to\-End Operational Ownership: Drive the full flow from production handover through packing, carrier dispatch, in\-transit visibility, destination customs, last\-mile delivery, and signed proof of delivery (POD).
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop the Logistics Manager and the wider team covering domestic/non SEZ vendor operations, SEZ compliance, night operations, MIS/sea freight/refund \& reship, and Atlanta linked shipping — building capability and accountability at every level.
* Performance \& MIS Reporting: Own a KPI\-driven daily/weekly/monthly MIS reporting cadence — cycle time by stage, on\-time pickup/delivery, freight cost, exception and lost\-shipment tracking, and POD closure — with full visibility to the Head of Supply Chain \& Logistics.
* Cost \& Network Optimization: Continuously identify opportunities to reduce cost per shipment, improve carrier mix, and eliminate avoidable delays or rework across the network.
* Business Expansion \& Vendor Development: Identify and onboard logistics partners in new geographies as Bayport's brands expand into new international markets.
* Cross\-Functional Coordination: Partner closely with Production Planning, Material Planning, and Vendor Management to tighten the handover from production to logistics and resolve root\-cause issues jointly rather than in isolation.
* Exception \& Escalation Ownership: Personally own resolution of high\-impact exceptions — customs hold, lost shipments, delivery disputes — ensuring timely closure and clear communication.
* Marketplace Logistics: Build the roadmap and business case for bringing marketplace last mile fulfilment in\-house


**What Success Looks Like (First 6–12 Months)**
* A fully visible, stage\-wise logistics dashboard covering the complete order lifecycle — inbound through final delivery, not just packing\-to\-carrier\-handover
* A clean, current, reconciled 3PL vendor billing process with no payment disputes or aged discrepancies with Finance
* Measurable improvement in on\-time pickup and on\-time delivery percentages across all three carriers
* A formalized, audit\-ready SEZ and customs compliance process with clear ownership and turnaround times
* A functioning POD/exception closure process with defined liability and resolution timelines
* A stable, accountable, well\-led Logistics team operating on clear KPIs and a regular performance cadence


**Required Experience**
* 10–15 years in international logistics/parcel\-express operations, with substantial experience managing outbound and inbound volume through global carriers
* Prior experience with FedEx, DHL, UPS, or a comparable global express/parcel carrier is strongly preferred — this significantly shortens the learning curve for Bayport's carrier\-heavy, SLA\-driven model
* Demonstrated experience with export/import compliance, customs documentation, duties/tariffs, and ideally SEZ or bonded\-warehouse environments
* Direct experience auditing 3PL/carrier invoices and managing reconciliation with Finance
* Track record of leading and developing operational teams of meaningful size, with a hands\-on, floor present leadership style
* Experience building or owning KPI dashboards and driving performance through data, not just tenure or relationships


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Logistics, Engineering, or related field; Master's degree or equivalent is a plus
* Six Sigma / Lean or equivalent process\-improvement certification is an advantage


**Key Competencies**
* Operational and financial rigor under time\-sensitive, SLA\-driven conditions
* Strong carrier and vendor negotiation skills, with working knowledge of duties, taxes, tariffs, and IOR procedures across key international markets
* Direct, transparent communication style with the ability to hold a team accountable while developing them
* Proficient in logistics software, MS Office Suite, and ERP systems
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-scaling, still\-formalizing process environment — able to build structure, not just follow it

title: Plant Head
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Plant Head will be responsible for the overall leadership, management, and operational performance of the manufacturing facilities of Vidya Wires Limited and ALCU Industries Limited. The role encompasses end\-to\-end responsibility for production, quality, maintenance, supply chain coordination, cost optimization, safety, compliance, people management, and continuous improvement initiatives to ensure achievement of business objectives.
 



 The incumbent shall drive operational excellence by maximizing productivity, ensuring customer satisfaction, maintaining statutory compliance, and fostering a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and innovation.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Strategic Leadership \& Business Planning** 



* Develop and implement plant strategies aligned with the organization's business objectives.
* Prepare annual operating plans, budgets, capacity plans, and production forecasts.
* Drive business growth through process optimization, productivity enhancement, and cost reduction initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and implement corrective actions to achieve operational targets.
* Support expansion projects, new product development, and technology upgradation initiatives.



**2\. Production \& Operations Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end manufacturing operations across all units.
* Ensure adherence to production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Optimize machine utilization, manpower productivity, and resource allocation.
* Minimize downtime, rejection, rework, and process losses.
* Ensure effective implementation of production planning and control systems.
* Coordinate with the sales, procurement, stores, and logistics teams for seamless operations.



**3\. Quality Management** 



* Ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal quality standards, and applicable industry requirements.
* Drive quality improvement initiatives to reduce defects and customer complaints.
* Monitor process capability and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Lead internal and external quality audits.
* Ensure compliance with applicable quality management systems such as International Organization for Standardization standards and customer\-specific requirements.



**4\. Maintenance \& Engineering** 



* Ensure preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance of all plant equipment and utilities.
* Improve equipment reliability, availability, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
* Lead capital expenditure projects, plant modifications, and equipment installations.
* Ensure uninterrupted availability of utilities including power, compressed air, water, and other critical services.
* Drive energy conservation and asset lifecycle management initiatives.



**5\. Supply Chain \& Inventory Management** 



* Coordinate with procurement and stores teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials and consumables.
* Optimize inventory levels and reduce carrying costs.
* Monitor material consumption, yield, and wastage.
* Ensure effective warehouse management and dispatch planning.



**6\. Cost Management \& Profitability** 



* Prepare and manage plant operating budgets.
* Monitor manufacturing costs and implement cost\-control measures.
* Identify opportunities for waste elimination and process improvement.
* Improve overall plant profitability through operational efficiencies.
* Drive value engineering and lean manufacturing initiatives.



**7\. Health, Safety \& Environment (HSE)** 



* Ensure strict compliance with all safety, health, and environmental regulations.
* Promote a zero\-accident culture across all manufacturing facilities.
* Conduct regular safety audits, risk assessments, and emergency preparedness drills.
* Ensure compliance with applicable environmental norms and pollution control requirements.
* Investigate incidents and implement corrective actions.



**8\. Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable labour laws, factory regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Liaise with government authorities, auditors, customers, and certification agencies.
* Ensure compliance under the provisions of the applicable laws including:
* Factories Act and applicable state factory rules
* Environment, Health and Safety regulations
* Industrial relations and labour laws
* Fire and electrical safety requirements
* Legal metrology and other industry\-specific regulations



**9\. People Management \& Industrial Relations** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop departmental heads and plant employees.
* Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Drive employee engagement, performance management, and succession planning initiatives.
* Maintain healthy industrial relations and proactively address employee grievances.
* Coordinate with the HR department for manpower planning, training, and workforce development.



**10\. Continuous Improvement** 



* Drive implementation of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, TPM, Kaizen, and 5S initiatives.
* Lead digital transformation and automation projects.
* Benchmark plant performance against industry standards.
* Encourage innovation and continuous improvement across functions.



  





**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)** 



* Production achievement against plan
* Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
* Capacity utilization
* Cost per unit produced
* Rejection and rework percentage
* Customer complaint rate
* On\-time delivery performance
* Machine downtime
* Inventory turnover ratio
* Energy consumption per unit
* Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR)
* Employee attrition and absenteeism rates
* Audit and compliance scores



  





**Educational Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Industrial, or related discipline).
* MBA in Operations Management is preferred.
* Six Sigma Certification is preferred.



  





**Experience** 



* Minimum 15–20 years of experience in manufacturing operations.
* At least 5–8 years of experience in a senior leadership role as Plant Head, Operations Head, or Manufacturing Head.
* Experience in wire, cable, copper, aluminium, metal processing, or related manufacturing industries is preferred.
* Proven track record in managing multiple manufacturing units.



  





**Required Competencies** 




**Technical Competencies** 



* Production planning and control
* Lean manufacturing and TPM
* Quality management systems
* Cost management and budgeting
* Supply chain management
* Maintenance management
* Industrial engineering
* ERP/MRP systems
* Statutory compliance and factory operations



**Behavioural Competencies** 



* Strategic thinking
* Leadership and team building
* Decision\-making ability
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Communication and negotiation skills
* Change management
* Conflict resolution
* Result orientation
* Stakeholder management

title: Fabrication & Production supervisor
description:
Company Overview:
   

  

 If a culture of excellence, innovation and ownership is what you’re searching for, consider putting your experience in motion at Flowserve. As an individual contributor, or as a leader of people, your enterprise mindset will ensure Flowserve’s position as the global standard in comprehensive flow control solutions. Here, your opportunity for professional development and industry leading rewards will be supported by our foundational commitments to the values of people first, integrity and safety. Thinking beyond opportunity and reward, at Flowserve, we are inspired by working together to create extraordinary flow control solutions to make the world better for everyone!
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Production Supervisor leads day\-to\-day operations within the fabrication shop and final packaging area, ensuring safe, efficient, high\-quality production that meets customer delivery commitments. This role is responsible for supervising shop\-floor personnel, coordinating production activities across work centers, managing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement through Lean and operational\-excellence practices.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Supervise fabrication shop and final packaging operations to achieve production, quality, safety, and on\-time delivery targets.
* Plan, prioritize, and schedule production activities across multiple work centers based on workload, capacity, material availability, and delivery commitments.
* Assign daily work to shop employees according to skill level, certifications, workload, and production priorities.
* Maintain and regularly update the shop\-floor skill matrix; identify training needs and coordinate employee development activities.
* Ensure compliance with Flowserve safety policies, safe work practices, and applicable environmental requirements.
* Promote a strong safety culture by conducting regular safety discussions, identifying risks, and ensuring corrective actions are implemented.
* Ensure production processes comply with ISO 9001 and ISO 14001 requirements, including adherence to documentation, traceability, inspection, and record\-retention procedures.
* Monitor and manage key operational KPIs, including utilization, efficiency, productivity, scrap, rework, quality performance, and schedule adherence.
* Analyze production losses, quality issues, and daily shop\-floor constraints; implement corrective and preventive actions using structured problem\-solving tools.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and Operational Excellence initiatives, including AMEF/FMEA, Value Stream Mapping, 5S/6S, SMED, standard work, visual management, and continuous\-improvement activities.
* Apply statistical process\-control principles to monitor process performance, identify variation, and improve product quality.
* Support inventory management activities, including material availability, WIP control, inventory accuracy, and coordination with planning and supply chain teams.
* Ensure appropriate use of ERP systems, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Project, and other production\-planning tools for reporting, scheduling, and daily operational management.
* Review and interpret technical drawings, work instructions, manufacturing procedures, inspection plans, and customer specifications.
* Ensure fabrication and assembly activities comply with applicable engineering and industry standards, including API 610, ASME, AWS, and other relevant requirements.
* Support and oversee API and non\-API pump manufacturing processes, ensuring that approved procedures and quality requirements are consistently followed.
* Conduct training for shop employees on safety, quality, procedures, technical requirements, Lean practices, and standard work.
* Partner with Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, and Maintenance teams to resolve operational issues and improve overall plant performance.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant manufacturing experience, including experience supervising shop\-floor operations.
* Demonstrated experience in fabrication shop operations and final packaging activities.
* Working knowledge of CNC programming and machining/manufacturing processes.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous\-improvement tools, including AMEF/FMEA, VSM, 5S/6S, SMED, and root\-cause analysis.
* Experience with production planning, capacity management, work\-center scheduling, and inventory/WIP management.
* Strong understanding of quality systems, process control, and ISO 9001/ISO 14001 requirements.
* Familiarity with API 610, ASME standards, and preferably AWS welding standards.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, work instructions, and manufacturing procedures.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Office applications, ERP systems, and Microsoft Project or comparable scheduling software.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem\-solving, and team\-development skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in pump manufacturing, including API and non\-API pump production processes.
* Experience implementing Lean, Operational Excellence, or continuous\-improvement initiatives in a manufacturing environment.
* Exposure to statistical process control, quality tools, and structured corrective\-action methodologies.
* Knowledge of welding, fabrication, assembly, testing, and packaging processes for industrial equipment.


 Flowserve is a world\-leading manufacturer and aftermarket service provider of comprehensive flow control systems. Join a company whose people are committed to building a more sustainable future to make the world better for everyone. With 16,000\+ employees in 50\+ countries, we combine our global reach with local presence. Our team challenges themselves to approach each situation with ingenuity and creativity to help provide our customers with the most innovative flow control products and services. We support 10,000\+ customers worldwide, creating products to meet the needs of our customers who are supplying energy, fresh water, pharmaceuticals and other essentials to consumers, businesses and governments globally. We invite you to put your talents and career in motion at Flowserve.
   

  

**Req ID** 
 : R\-20747
   

  

**Job Family Group** 
 : Operations
   

  

**Job Family** 
 : OP Manufacturing Leadership
   

  

 EOE including Disability/Protected Veterans. Flowserve will also not discriminate against an applicant or employee for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing their pay or, in certain circumstances, the pay of their co\-workers. Pay Transparency Nondiscrimination Provision

You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an email to employment@flowserve.com. In order to quickly respond to your request, please use the words "Accommodation Request" as your subject line of your email. For more information, read the Accessibility Process.

title: Sr Technical Consultant - Splunk Admin
description:
**Scope**
 We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Major Incident Manager (8–12 years) to lead and oversee the management of high\-severity incidents across complex IT environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in IT operations, ITIL\-aligned service management, and cross\-functional coordination, ensuring minimal business impact and rapid restoration of services.
   

  

**Our Current Technical Environment**
* Incident management in multi\-cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Experience with hybrid infrastructure (on\-prem \+ cloud).
* Understanding of cloud\-native monitoring tools (CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Operations Suite).
* Exposure to containerized platforms (Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker).
* Familiarity with DevOps/SRE practices (CI/CD, automation, “observability as code”).
* Managing incidents in SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of cloud security, compliance, and governance impacts during incidents.


**What You’ll Do**
* Major Incident Leadership: Serve as the primary owner and decision\-maker for all high\-severity incidents, coordinating across multiple technical teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* End\-to\-End Incident Management: Manage the complete lifecycle of major incidents—from identification and logging to resolution and closure—ensuring adherence to SLAs and operational best practices.
* Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely, clear, and accurate updates to senior management, business leaders, and external stakeholders during critical incidents.
* Root Cause Analysis \& Continuous Improvement: Lead post\-incident reviews, identify systemic issues, recommend preventive measures, and implement process improvements to reduce recurrence.
* Process Governance: Define and enforce incident management processes, policies, and best practices across the organization, ensuring compliance with ITIL frameworks.
* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Guide and mentor Major Incident Managers, L2/L3 support teams, and other operational staff on effective incident handling and crisis management.
* Proactive Risk Management: Collaborate with monitoring, infrastructure, and cloud teams to identify potential service\-impacting risks and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
* Reporting \& Metrics: Maintain dashboards, KPIs, and metrics to track incident trends, team performance, and continuous service improvement.


**What We Are Looking For**
* 5– 8 years of experience in IT operations, service management, or incident management roles, with significant exposure to major incident handling.
* Deep understanding of ITIL processes, especially incident, problem, change, and service continuity management.
* Proven experience managing high\-impact, enterprise\-wide incidents in complex, multi\-cloud or hybrid IT environments.
* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and crisis coordination skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities under high\-pressure situations.
* Demonstrated leadership experience, with the ability to drive cross\-functional teams during critical incidents.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring, ticketing, and alerting tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, Splunk, OpsGenie, SolarWinds).
* Preferred Skills:
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) and hybrid infrastructure.
* ITIL Intermediate or Expert certification.
* Knowledge of automation, orchestration, and incident management dashboards.
* Experience in stakeholder reporting to C\-level executives.
* Exposure to compliance, audit, and regulatory requirements for IT operations.

* Manage the day\-to\-day operations of the property and ensure smooth and efficient functioning.

* Maintain records of income, expenses, and leases.
* Coordinate with facility management, housekeeping, security, engineering and other service teams.
* Establish and monitor operational standards, SOPs and service levels.
* Conduct regular property inspections and ensure timely resolution of identified issues.

* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of buildings, equipment, utilities and other assets.

* Monitor AMC contracts and ensure service providers meet agreed standards.

* Monitor compliance with lease terms, property rules and applicable operational requirements.
* Coordinate property handover, fit\-outs, inspections and exit formalities where applicable.

* Prepare and monitor the annual property operating budget.
* Control operational expenses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Prepare and manage budgets for property operations.
* Monitor utility expenses, maintenance costs and other property\-related expenditures.
* Review vendor invoices and ensure expenditure is within approved budgets.
* Prepare periodic MIS reports covering operational and financial performance.



  





**e) Stakeholder Management** 



* Prepare periodic operational, financial, maintenance and compliance reports.
* Provide management with updates on property performance, risks, incidents and improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with internal departments including Finance, HR, Legal, Procurement, Projects and Administration.

* Planning, coordination and execution.
* Vendor and contract management.
* Budget and cost management.
* Statutory and regulatory compliance.
* Health, safety and security management.
* Negotiation and Relationship management.
* Problem\-solving and decision\-making.



  





**Education Qualifications** 




 Graduation in any discipline.
 



 Professional certification in Facilities/Property Management will be an added advantage.
 



  





**Experience** 




 6 to 8 Years of experience in property management, facilities management, real estate, hospitality, commercial buildings, residential projects or a similar environment. Experience in managing large properties, multiple vendors and multidisciplinary teams will be preferred. Experience in liasoning with Governmental Organization’s will be preferred.

title: QA Manager (Australia Migration GSM)
description:
**Job description:** 




 The Quality Assurance Manager is a senior function within ACET Migrations responsible for owning the full documentation quality lifecycle across Australian migration services. This role ensures every client file lodged by ACET Migrations meets the required accuracy, compliance, and regulatory standards set by Australian immigration authorities. The QA Manager leads the quality team, drives process consistency, and holds accountability for submission outcomes across all visa categories.
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 1\. Setting the Quality Standard
 



 –Builds a clear system for how documents should be checked and approved
 



 –Sets the rules and targets the QA team works toward
 



 –Makes sure everyone on the team knows what good looks like and works to reach it
 



 –Steps in to help any team member who is struggling or unsure
 



 2\. Checking Files Before Submission
 



 –Reviews every file before it is sent to the immigration authority
 



 –Makes sure each file meets current Australian immigration requirements
 



 –Gives final approval — nothing gets lodged without QA sign\-off
 



 3\. Keeping Up With Immigration Rules
 



 –Stays on top of any changes to Australian immigration laws and guidelines
 



 –Updates the team quickly whenever rules change
 



 –Makes sure the team is always working with the most current requirements
 



 4\. Improving How Things Work
 



 –Creates clear step\-by\-step processes for the team to follow
 



 –Spots where things are going wrong and fixes them properly
 



 –Makes sure the same mistakes do not keep happening
 



 5\. Reducing Errors and Rejections
 



 –Tracks where errors and rejections are coming from
 



 –Investigates every rejection to understand why it happened
 



 –Puts steps in place so the same issue does not happen again
 



 –Works toward getting files right the first time, every time
 



 6\. Reporting to Leadership
 



 –Keeps track of how each team member and the overall team is performing
 



 –Prepares clear reports on submission quality, errors, and trends
 



 –Shares findings and suggestions with senior management regularly
 



 7\. Working With Other Teams
 



 –Works alongside case managers, migration agents, and operations staff
 



 –Makes sure quality is not just a QA job — it runs through the whole business
 



 –Gets involved in cases that are complicated or carry higher risk
 



 8\. Training the Team
 



 –Runs training sessions to help the team improve their documentation skills
 



 –Teaches the team about any new immigration rules or process changes
 



 –Builds a team culture where everyone cares about quality, not just the QA Manager
 



 9\. Protecting Client Information
 



 –Makes sure all client data is handled safely and kept private
 



 –Follows all legal and company rules around data protection
 



**MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 –Has a relevant degree
 



 –Has 3 to 5 years or more working in Australian migration services
 



 –Has led a QA or compliance team for at least 2 to 3 years
 



 –Knows Australian immigration visa types and what each one requires
 



 –Has used case management or CRM systems before
 



 –Experience across PR, work visas, and student visas is a bonus
 



 Work Location: In person

This role goes beyond traditional MIS reporting: you will directly **extract data from the data warehouse using SQL**, reconcile across sources, and translate operational and financial signals into **decision\-ready insights** for Finance and senior stakeholders. title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst  

  

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.

  

  

As a values\-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.

  

  

As a Senior Financial Analyst at ICON, you will provide critical insights to support strategic decision\-making and drive financial performance across the organization.

  

  

**What You Will Do:**

You will take ownership of finance and financial management deliverables, applying your expertise to complex challenges.
  

  

Key responsibilities include:


* Conducting comprehensive financial analysis, including variance analysis, forecasting, and budgeting, to support business planning and decision\-making.
* Developing and maintaining financial models to analyze trends, assess financial performance, and project future financial outcomes.
* Preparing and presenting detailed financial reports and recommendations to senior management, highlighting key findings and actionable insights.
* Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to gather data, understand business drivers, and provide financial support for various initiatives and projects.
* Monitoring financial performance against budgets and forecasts, identifying discrepancies, and proposing corrective actions as needed.
* Ensuring accuracy and consistency in financial reporting and analysis, and maintaining a strong understanding of accounting principles and financial regulations.
* Staying current with industry trends, best practices, and regulatory changes to continuously improve financial analysis and reporting processes.
  

  

**Your Profile:**

You will have a strong foundation in finance and financial management, with the experience to work independently and guide others.
  

  

Required qualifications and experience:


* Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business administration, or a related discipline
* Extensive experience as a financial analyst, with a strong background in financial modeling, analysis, and reporting.
* Proficiency in financial analysis tools and software, including advanced Excel skills; experience with ERP systems is a plus.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial data and provide actionable insights.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex financial information clearly and effectively to stakeholders at all levels.
* Exceptional organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
  

  

Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.

  

  

**Rewards \& Benefits**

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.

  

  

Benefits may include:


* Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
* Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
* Retirement and pension plans
* Life assurance and disability coverage
* Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
* Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways
  

  

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

  

  

Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.

  

  

**Inclusion and Accessibility**

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.

  

  

If you require reasonable accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know or submit a **request** .

title: MSET QR Strats Capital Market Specialist , Manager, Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Department Profile**
 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Equity businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, Strats to risk management.
   

  

 The Quantitative Research (QR) group designs, builds and maintains the models which drive the equity trading engines at Morgan Stanley. Our systems are used globally by both internal trading groups and clients of the firm. We utilize systematic, data\-driven approaches to understand how markets work and put those ideas in action. The team spans the disciplines of finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, machine learning and data analysis, with many team members well versed in multiple areas. We are looking to hire highly talented, creative individuals who are enthusiastic about research; and enthusiastic about making a contribution to a leading\-edge team, in an intellectually stimulating environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work closely with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research teams.. The successful candidate will be a fast\-learning, detail\-oriented, proactive, and self\-motivated individual responsible for analyzing, calculating, and reviewing free float for global equities. The role involves reviewing company filings, exchange disclosures, shareholder data, vendor feeds, and other public sources to assess float\-relevant ownership changes and their impact on shares outstanding, investable market capitalization, index weights, and benchmark treatment. The candidate will also monitor corporate actions, support client and internal queries, and produce high\-quality written analysis explaining complex float cases, methodology interpretation, and market impact.
   

  

 The expected working hours will be 7:30 am (local time) to 4:30 pm (local time)
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Responsible for analyzing, calculating, and reviewing free float for global equities in line with equity benchmark methodology and index implementation rules.
* Review company filings, exchange disclosures, regulatory announcements, shareholder data, vendor feeds, and other public sources to identify float\-relevant ownership changes.
* Assess the impact of strategic holdings, government ownership, founder/promoter holdings, cross\-shareholdings, employee trusts, lock\-up shares, treasury shares, foreign ownership limits, and other restricted holdings on free float.
* Perform detailed float calculations and determine investable shares, float factors, shares outstanding, and resulting index weight impacts.
* Monitor corporate actions such as M\&A, spin\-offs, placements, buybacks, secondary offerings, rights issues, IPO lock\-up expiries, restructurings, and share class changes to assess their impact on float and index treatment.
* Partner with global teams to respond to client and internal queries related to free float, shares outstanding, index weights, corporate actions, and equity benchmark methodology.
* Produce high\-quality written analysis, emails, and presentations explaining complex float cases, methodology interpretation, and market impact.


**Core Requirements**
 We are looking for a confident and outgoing individual, who has exceptional attention to detail and takes initiative.
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in the financial services industry, with direct experience in equity markets, index products, benchmark methodology, corporate actions, or market data.
* Strong practical understanding of free float methodology, shares outstanding, investable market capitalization, float factors, and index weight calculations.
* Experience reviewing company filings, shareholder structures, ownership disclosures, exchange announcements, regulatory filings, and vendor data to determine float eligibility.
* Ability to analyze complex ownership structures, including promoter/founder holdings, government stakes, strategic investors, crossholdings, employee ownership plans, lock\-up shares, treasury shares, and restricted securities.
* Demonstrated experience calculating free float and assessing the impact of float changes on index membership, index weights, size classification, style classification, and market representation.
* Strong knowledge of corporate actions that affect float, including M\&A, spin\-offs, IPOs, lock\-up expiries, placements, buybacks, rights offerings, share conversions, and reorganizations.
* Experience with Asia and EU/EMEA equity markets is a plus, particularly in relation to corporate actions, ownership disclosures, float assessment, and index methodology application.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with a strong control mindset and ability to manage time\-sensitive calculations accurately.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills are required. Experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet, corporate action vendors, SQL, Python, or data visualization tools is a plus.
* Degree in quantitative or finance\-related disciplines such as Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Economics, or Finance.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
