title: Deputy Manager Finance
description:
**Qualification \& Experience** 




**Education:** 
 CA/ CMA qualification would be preferred with significant financial controllership and statutory compliance responsibilities.
 



**Experience:** 
 1–4 years of relevant experience in financial controllership, accounting, payments, statutory compliance, audit management, and financial governance.
 



**Preferred Experience:** 
 Prior experience in FMCG, manufacturing, consumer goods, food processing, or a similar operating environment would be advantageous
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Financial Controllership \& Governance** 



* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of books of accounts and financial records.
* Establish and maintain a robust financial control framework across key business processes.
* Ensure adherence to accounting policies, internal financial controls, delegation of authority, and standard operating procedures.
* Review key balance\-sheet accounts and ensure timely reconciliation and closure of outstanding items.
* Identify financial and process risks and implement appropriate preventive and detective controls.
* Drive strong financial discipline and governance across functions.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.
* Continuously review and strengthen finance processes to improve control effectiveness and operational efficiency.



**2\. Accounting \& Financial Closing** 



* Oversee periodic book closure processes and ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
* Review general ledger entries, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and other key accounting areas.
* Ensure timely completion of bank, vendor, customer, intercompany, and balance\-sheet reconciliations.
* Review ageing of open items and drive timely resolution of long\-pending balances.
* Ensure financial statements and management reports are prepared accurately and in accordance with applicable accounting standards and organisational policies.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely availability of information required for financial closure.



**3\. Payments \& Accounts Payable Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end payment processes, ensuring timely and accurate payments to vendors, employees, statutory authorities, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure all payments are processed in accordance with approved policies, contractual terms, delegation of authority, and internal controls.
* Review payment proposals and ensure appropriate supporting documentation and approvals.
* Monitor vendor ageing, outstanding liabilities, advances, debit balances, and other exceptions.
* Ensure effective maker\-checker controls and segregation of duties across payment processes.
* Resolve vendor payment issues and coordinate with procurement and business teams for timely closure of discrepancies.
* Drive process improvements to enhance payment accuracy, turnaround time, and control effectiveness.



**4\. Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure timely and accurate compliance with applicable direct and indirect tax requirements, including GST, TDS, income tax, and other relevant statutory obligations.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory returns and payment of applicable taxes and duties.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and records to support statutory filings and assessments.
* Coordinate with tax consultants, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders on compliance matters.
* Monitor changes in accounting, taxation, and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation.
* Support responses to notices, assessments, queries, and other communications from statutory authorities.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar and ensure zero instances of missed statutory deadlines.



**5\. Audit Management** 



* Lead and coordinate statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and other financial or compliance\-related audits.
* Act as the primary point of coordination between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure timely availability of accurate data, documentation, schedules, and explanations required during audits.
* Track audit observations and drive timely closure of identified gaps and corrective actions.
* Analyse recurring audit observations and implement sustainable process improvements to prevent recurrence.
* Ensure audit readiness throughout the year rather than relying solely on year\-end preparation.



**6\. Internal Financial Controls \& Risk Management** 



* Design, implement, document, and periodically test internal financial controls across key finance processes.
* Identify control gaps, financial risks, fraud vulnerabilities, and process inefficiencies.
* Recommend and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access controls across financial systems and processes.
* Support risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation plans are established and monitored.
* Promote a strong culture of financial accountability, compliance, and ethical conduct across the organization.



**7\. Treasury \& Banking Coordination** 



* Coordinate with banks for payment processing, account administration, and other banking requirements.
* Monitor cash positions and support effective cash\-flow management.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliations and closure of outstanding reconciling items.
* Maintain appropriate controls over banking access, authorized signatories, and payment approval mechanisms.
* Support working\-capital optimization through effective monitoring of payables, receivables, and cash requirements.



**8\. Financial MIS \& Reporting** 



* Prepare and review periodic financial reports and management dashboards covering financial performance, cash flows, working capital, compliance, payments, audit status, and key control indicators.
* Provide timely and accurate financial information to management for decision\-making.
* Track key finance metrics and highlight significant exceptions, risks, and emerging issues.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, control weaknesses, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support management reviews with clear financial insights and actionable recommendations.



**9\. Process Improvement \& Automation** 



* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate finance processes.
* Drive improvements in accounting, payment processing, reconciliations, compliance tracking, and reporting.
* Leverage ERP systems, digital tools, and automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, transparency, and control.
* Develop and maintain SOPs for critical finance processes.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of best practices across the finance function.

title: Manager/Deputy Manager – Index Operations
description:
**Role Overview** 

  





 We are seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented professional to join our Index Operations team as Manager / Deputy Manager. The role involves end\-to\-end ownership of index operations activities, including daily index maintenance, corporate action implementation, index reviews and rebalancing, operational risk management, quality assurance, and stakeholder coordination.
 



 The ideal candidate will possess strong knowledge of equity and fixed income markets, index methodologies, corporate actions, and capital market operations. The role requires the ability to manage critical production processes, drive operational excellence, support technology initiatives, and contribute to the scaling and automation of index operations.
 



  




**Key Responsibilities** 
**Index Maintenance \& Calculation** 

 ·      Ensure accurate and timely execution of daily index maintenance activities across all assigned indices.
 



 ·      Monitor index calculation processes and validate Price Return, Total Return, and customized index
 



 outputs.
 



 ·      Ensure timely dissemination of index levels, constituent reports, and client deliverables.
 



 ·      Investigate and resolve operational exceptions, data discrepancies, and production issues within
 



 defined timelines.
 



 ·      Monitor operational controls and recommend enhancements to strengthen process governance.
 



  




**Corporate Actions \& Adjustments** 

 ·      Track and evaluate corporate action announcements, including bonus issues, stock splits, rights issues,
 



 mergers, demergers, special dividends, and other market events.
 



 ·      Determine and implement appropriate index adjustments in accordance with index methodologies.
 



 ·      Validate corporate action processing and maintain accuracy across all impacted indices.
 



 ·      Coordinate with data vendors, product teams, and technology teams to ensure timely and accurate
 



 implementation.
 



 ·      Participate in methodology interpretation and impact assessment of complex corporate actions.
 



  




**Index Reconstitution \& Rebalancing** 

 ·      Execute periodic index reviews, reconstitutions, and rebalancing activities across equity and fixed
 



 income indices.
 



 ·      Validate index compositions, constituent changes, share updates, and calculation outputs prior to
 



 implementation.
 



 ·      Prepare and review client communication files, consultation outputs, and index review reports.
 



 ·      Support new index launches, custom index implementation, and methodology enhancements.
 



**Data Management \& Quality Control** 

 ·      Perform data validations, reconciliation checks, and operational quality reviews.
 



 ·      Establish and enhance controls to mitigate operational and data risks.
 



 ·      Identify root causes of operational incidents and drive corrective and preventive actions.
 



 ·      Maintain high standards of data integrity across index calculation and dissemination processes.
 



 ·      Support audits, regulatory requirements, and governance reviews as required.
 



  




**Stakeholder \& Client Support** 

 ·      Collaborate with Product, Technology, Market Data Vendors, and Client Service teams to ensure
 



 smooth operational delivery.
 



 ·      Support client queries, data requests, and operational investigations.
 



 ·      Act as a key point of contact during index launches, rebalancing events, and production incidents.
 



 ·      Build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate operational efficiency.
 



  




**Process Improvement \& Automation** 

 ·      Identify opportunities for automation, workflow optimization, and operational scalability.
 



 ·      Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production rollouts.
 



 ·      Drive continuous improvement initiatives across index operations processes.
 



 ·      Maintain process documentation, SOPs, operational runbooks, and control frameworks.
 



 ·      Mentor and support junior team members where applicable.
 



  




**Experience** 

 4–8 years of experience in:
 



 o  Index Operations / Index Services
 



 o  Capital Markets Operations
 



 o  Asset Management Operations
 



 o  Mutual Fund Operations
 



 o  Market Data Operations
 



 o  ETF / Passive Investment Operations
 



  




**Domain Knowledge** 

 Strong understanding of:
 



 o  Equity and Fixed Income Markets
 



 o  Index construction methodologies and maintenance processes
 



 o  Corporate actions and index adjustment methodologies
 



 o  Index rebalancing and reconstitution processes
 



 o  Market data management and validation frameworks
 



 o  Passive investment products including ETFs and Index Funds
 



  




**Technical Skills** 

 ·      Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (mandatory)
 



 ·      Experience handling large datasets and performing data validations
 



 ·      Exposure to VBA / Macros strongly preferred
 



 ·      Knowledge of SQL and/or Python will be an added advantage
 



 ·      Familiarity with data feeds, file processing, and automation workflows is desirable
 



  




**Competencies** 

 ·      Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
 



 ·      High attention to detail and accuracy
 



 ·      Ability to manage multiple critical deliverables under tight deadlines
 



 ·      Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 



 ·      Proactive approach towards process improvement and automation
 



 ·      Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams
 



  




**Qualifications**

 ·      MBA, CFA, FRM, CA, or equivalent professional qualification will be an added advantage.

title: Associate, Private Markets and Alternative Operations
description:
**About This Role**
 Since 2000, BlackRock has delivered Investment Accounting and Middle Office services, supporting a diverse client base with approximately $2\.7 trillion in assets across 250,000 positions. Our team processes over 300,000 trades and reconciles more than 1 million transactions annually across 1,700 portfolios. To enhance scalability, mitigate risk, and deliver exceptional client experiences, we established Outsourced Platform Services (OPS).
   

  

 At the heart of our outsourced services are the functional teams that support our clients’ portfolios, assets \& transactions daily.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 BlackRock’s
 **Outsourced Platform Services (OPS)** 
 provides global middle\- and back\-office support for BlackRock Solutions’ outsourcing business, encompassing trade support, transaction servicing, collateral management, data governance, payments, corporate actions, reconciliations, alternative operations, and investment accounting—delivering operational excellence worldwide.
   

  

**Global Client Alternative Services (GCAS),** 
 a specialized team within Tech \& Ops under OPS, ensures the integrity of cash and position data for middle\-office clients and delivers comprehensive outsourcing solutions for Aladdin clients investing in Alternatives and Private Markets. The team drives global collaboration on strategic initiatives and oversees all aspects of Private and Alternative assets, including client engagement and daily IBOR reconciliation to manage risk and client exposure.
   

  

 This role demands expertise in reconciliation, exception management, and client service, complemented by strong problem\-solving, data analysis, and process improvement skills. Additional responsibilities include maintaining documentation, supporting management initiatives, and driving operational efficiency.
   

  

**Role Responsibility**
* Apply deep expertise in loan and private markets—including project finance, structured credit, real assets, and syndicated loans—to engage effectively with stakeholders, agents, borrowers, counterparties, and high\-profile clients.
* Interpret and analyze complex legal documentation, translating key provisions into actionable insights to ensure operational clarity.
* Facilitate settlement processes across a broad spectrum of instruments, including syndications, secondary trades, CLOs, restructurings, private markets, infrastructure debt, renewable power, real estate debt, and trade claims.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to maintain the accuracy and integrity of the Investment Book of Record (IBOR).
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of portfolios and deal documentation to uphold control standards and ensure regulatory compliance.
* Lead initiatives focused on process automation and control enhancements to improve efficiency and mitigate operational risk.
* Investigate and resolve cash, position, and transaction discrepancies promptly and accurately.
* Demonstrate proficiency in loan systems as an added advantage.
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and adherence to deadlines.
* This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of private markets and operational innovation, contributing to BlackRock’s mission of delivering scalable, risk\-aware solutions for global clients.


**Experience**
 The ideal candidate will have 3–6 years in loan operations or similar expertise in settlements, reconciliations, and documentation\-driven transactions. Strong understanding of private credit, real assets, and project finance.
   

  

**In Addition, We Are Looking For The Following Qualifications**
* Exceptional communication and client service skills, with the ability to foster strong relationships.
* Comprehensive understanding of banking and investment management, including experience in alternatives such as Private Credit, bank loans, credit strategies, registered funds, financial institutions, and a diverse range of investor types.
* Proven ability to perform effectively under pressure in high\-volume, high\-risk environments with minimal margin for error.
* Highly self\-motivated and collaborative, demonstrating a proactive approach to taking on additional responsibilities.
* Strong capability to prioritize and manage multiple requests while maintaining focus on overarching objectives and deadlines.
* Sound decision\-making skills, with the ability to make well\-informed judgments based on available information and seek clarification or assistance when necessary.
* Comfortable working within dynamic teams that embrace varied perspectives and problem\-solving approaches.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related applications; familiarity with loan\-centric systems is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of trading instruments and settlement processes.
* Excellent analytical and organizational skills, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in execution.
* Demonstrates initiative and a commitment to contributing beyond defined responsibilities to support team and firm\-wide goals.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Sustainability Consultant
description:
**Role Overview** 
  

  

 The candidate should be well versed in ESG, sustainability reporting, ESG ratings and assessments, with demonstrated experience of working with corporate clients to strengthen ESG disclosures, improve performance against leading ESG assessment frameworks and support sustainability\-related business decisions.
   

  

 Candidates with experience in sustainability consulting, ESG reporting/advisory, ESG ratings or corporate sustainability functions would be preferred.
   

  

**Job Requirements** 
  

  

 \* Strong understanding of ESG principles, sustainability issues, ESG governance frameworks and global sustainability reporting and disclosure standards.
   

 \* Demonstrated experience in sustainability reporting and disclosures aligned with frameworks such as GRI, BRSR/BRSR Core, IFRS S1 \& S2, ESRS, CSRD,  CSDDD SFDR, EU Taxonomy, Integrated Reporting Framework, TCFD and SASB, among others.
   

 \* Hands\-on experience in ESG ratings and assessment frameworks such as S\&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA), CDP and EcoVadis. Exposure to MSCI ESG and Sustainalytics methodologies would be an advantage.
   

 \* Experience in conducting ESG rating gap assessments, including question\-level assessment of existing practices, policies, disclosures, quantitative performance and supporting evidence.
   

 \* Ability to identify improvement opportunities and develop prioritized ESG rating and disclosure improvement roadmaps based on assessment requirements, peer practices and sector benchmarks.
   

 \* Experience in developing Sustainability Reports, ESG Reports and Integrated Reports, including report structure, content development, management approach disclosures, performance narratives and case studies.
   

 \* Ability to conduct peer benchmarking and ESG maturity assessments across companies and sectors covering policies, targets, commitments, ESG KPIs, governance mechanisms and disclosure practices.
   

 \* Strong understanding of ESG data requirements and data management, including development of data collection templates, KPI definitions, calculation methodologies, data validation and supporting documentation.
   

 \* Ability to analyze ESG performance and translate quantitative and qualitative information into meaningful insights and recommendations for management.
   

 \* Experience of working with companies across multiple sectors from an ESG / sustainability perspective. Exposure to sectors such as Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals, Power, Oil \& Gas, Metals \& Mining, Infrastructure, FMCG and Financial Services would be preferred.
   

 \* Ability to track and interpret evolving Indian and global ESG regulations, reporting requirements and rating methodologies, and assess their implications for clients.
   

 \* Ability to engage with multiple client stakeholders including Sustainability, EHS, HR, Procurement, Finance, Investor Relations, Company Secretariat, Operations and Corporate Communications.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage client workstreams, coordinate data collection, conduct stakeholder discussions and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality assignments.
   

 \* Ability to prepare and deliver high\-impact presentations and recommendations to client management and internal committees.
   

 \* Experience in reviewing and guiding the work of junior team members while ensuring analytical rigor and quality of deliverables.
   

 \* Support preparation of proposals, technical approaches, pitch presentations and client discussions for sustainability reporting and ESG ratings opportunities.
   

 \* Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge reports, articles, webinars, seminars and conferences to showcase Crisil’s capabilities in ESG and sustainability.
   

  

**Experience** 
  

  

 At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in Sustainability / ESG, preferably in consulting, with demonstrated experience in:
   

  

 \* ESG / Sustainability Reporting
   

 \* ESG Ratings and Assessments
   

 \* ESG Gap Assessment and Benchmarking
   

 \* ESG Data Analysis and Management
   

 \* Client and Project Management
   

  

 Candidates should have independently managed significant workstreams or assignments and should be comfortable interacting with senior client stakeholders.
   

  

**Qualification** 
  

  

 \* MBA / Master’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Management, Climate Change, Energy, Finance, Economics or related discipline; or
   

 \* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering or another relevant discipline.
   

  

 Relevant certifications in GRI, Integrated Reporting, IFRS Sustainability, ESG, climate change or sustainability reporting would be an advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skill Set** 
  

  

 Core skills: ESG Reporting \| ESG Ratings \| S\&P Global CSA \| CDP \| EcoVadis \| GRI \| BRSR \| IFRS S1 \& S2 \| ESRS \| CSRD \| CSDDD SFDR \| EU Taxonomy \| Integrated Reporting \| ESG Benchmarking \| ESG Data Analysis
   

  

 Consulting skills: Client Management \| Project Management \| Stakeholder Engagement \| Business Development \| Report Writing \| Research \& Analysis \| Presentation Skills
   

  

 Tools: Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

**Associate / Sr. Associate, Accounts Payable (Stavpay experience is mandatory)**
**About Cerberus**
 Founded in 1992, Cerberus is a global leader in alternative investing with approximately $55 billion in assets across complementary credit, private equity, and real estate strategies. We invest across the capital structure where our integrated investment platforms and proprietary operating capabilities create an edge to improve performance and drive long\-term value. Our tenured teams have experience working collaboratively across asset classes, sectors, and geographies to seek strong risk\-adjusted returns for our investors. For more information about our people and platforms, visit us at www.cerberus.com.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Cerberus is seeking an Analyst to join our Accounts Payable team. This team is responsible for processing all payments for the firm and ensuring expenses are appropriately allocated to the management company and funds. Expense categories which are allocated to the funds relate to the funds’ operations, including legal, auditing, payroll (and benefits), consulting, research, and administration expenses. In addition, allocated expenses may include amounts for sourcing, acquiring, holding and disposing of the Funds’ investments.
   

  

 You will be responsible for assisting in the full life cycle of an expense including reviewing and allocating invoices in the Accounts Payable software, routing invoices through approval workflow, executing wire payments, and assisting in the expense allocation close process including preparing, reviewing, and analyzing all expenses booked, and understanding the related allocation methodologies of these expenses to the funds.
   

  

**Responsibilities/Deliverables**
* Vendor Management and Onboarding: Oversee the vendor onboarding process, ensuring all documentation is collected and verified. Maintain accurate vendor records and promptly address vendor inquiries or issues.
* T\&E Auditing and Expense Reimbursements: Conduct comprehensive audits of employee travel and expense reports to ensure adherence to company policies. Process expense reimbursements accurately and in a timely manner.
* Reconciliations: Conduct daily reconciliations of accounts payable transactions and resolve discrepancies. Collaborate with other departments for accurate financial reporting. Post accounts payable transactions and book reclassification entries as required.
* Invoice Processing: Review and process invoices, ensuring proper coding and approval. Monitor and manage the accounts payable inbox, responding to inquiries and resolving issues as necessary.
* Payment Processing: Prepare and process payments to vendors, maintaining accuracy and timeliness. Monitor payment schedules and manage cash flow efficiently.
* American Express Program Administration: Administer the American Express program, including card issuance, expense tracking, and reporting. Ensure compliance with company policies and resolve any related issues.
* Concur Administration: Manage the Concur expense management system, including user setup, policy configuration, and troubleshooting. Provide training and support to employees on using Concur.
* Expense Compliance Training: Lead training sessions on expense compliance, ensuring that employees understand company policies and procedures related to travel and expense reporting.


 Cerberus Capital Management, L.P. 2
   

  

* Concur Administration: Oversee the Concur expense management system, including user setup, policy configuration, and troubleshooting. description:

 Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: IBKR), a member of the S\&P 500, is a global financial services company headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in over 15 countries. Through its affiliates, Interactive Brokers provides automated trade execution and custody of securities, commodities, foreign exchange, and prediction markets on over 170 markets in numerous countries and currencies.
   

  

 For more than four decades, Interactive Brokers has focused on technology, automation, and innovation to provide clients worldwide with a sophisticated, unified platform to manage their investment portfolios. We serve individual investors, hedge funds, proprietary trading groups, financial advisors, and introducing brokers.
   

  

 Our culture is driven by problem\-solving, efficiency, and continuous improvement. We look for individuals who are intellectually curious, collaborative, and motivated to contribute to technology that helps simplify and enhance access to global financial markets. Interactive Brokers has consistently been recognized as a top broker by respected industry sources including Barron’s, Investopedia, Stockbrokers.com, and others.
   

  

**Job Description And Responsibilities**
 Interactive Brokers (IBSSI) is hiring an Accounts Payable Analyst, whose primary responsibility will be to manage our licensed Optical Character Recognition (“OCR”) software that reads and processes global invoices for IBSSI and its affiliates. Invoice processing is time\-sensitive, and this position owns the first step in the accounts payable process: ensuring invoices are properly recorded in our systems and routed for approval upon receipt, while resolving exceptions to minimize manual intervention. As a global brokerage firm, this role also requires handling exchange\-related invoices and entering them into our fee reconciliation system. Additionally, you will maintain and update the global supplier database in GEP Quantum, ensuring seamless integration and accuracy of supplier data. In this role, you will also process employee reimbursement claims, address vendor and internal queries, and participate in testing new software releases to optimize performance.
   

  

 This position is ideal for someone who thrives on developing automated solutions, enjoys independent problem\-solving, and is motivated to streamline processes for maximum
   

  

 efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee Accounts Payable OCR software and daily workflows, ensuring timely and accurate invoice review, fee reconciliation, and tax setups in compliance with regulatory standards to support prompt vendor payments.
* Manage and maintain the global supplier database in GEP Quantum and Oracle E\-Business Suite.
* Handle bank account verification to safeguard against fraudulent transactions and ensure payments are directed to the correct accounts.
* Review and process employee reimbursement claims in OnBase while ensuring adherence to company policies and guaranteeing timely disbursements.
* Address and resolve queries from vendors and internal departments via email and phone communication.
* Identify opportunities for continuous process optimization to improve efficiency and accuracy in operations.
* Participate in testing new software releases to ensure seamless integration and consider training courses on new features and best practices.

* Educational Qualification: A master's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field is essential.

* Fluency in English is required, and any additional language is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work well within a team.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Scope of this role**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented, highly analytical Financial Planning \& Analysis Partner II to join our finance team. The Financial Planning \& Analysis Partner II will primarily assist with financial forecasting, budgeting, modeling, and variance analysis to support strategic decision\-making across the organization. The ideal candidate should have strong financial modeling skills, data analytics skills, and excellent communication abilities.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
- Drive the monthly forecasting and annual planning related activities which include the following:

* Planning \& Budgeting; current year and mid/long\-term rolling corporate estimates and forecasts including cash forecasting. Serve as a thought leader to drive process improvement and create documentation to set precedence.
* Performance tracking against operating plans and KPIs; identifying risks and opportunities, driving accountability.
* Business intelligence, insight identification, and decision analytics for business partners and executive teams.
* Execute financial close and reporting processes in partnership with controllership, commercial, and accounting teams. Also, look for opportunities related to process improvement and drive change.
* Analyze financial performance, highlight trends and variances against budget and forecast with qualitative comments. Variance analysis of actuals vs forecast with key highlights/call outs to the management.
* Foster strong relationships with stakeholders, promoting effective communication and collaboration
* Lead and partner with cross\-functional business teams in delivering analytics, data, and insights to drive key business decisions and support negotiations.
* Actively partner with global leaders to drive standardization, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Actively drive automation of reporting at the corporate level; support the FP\&A organization through an end\-to\-end enterprise transformation.


**A Little About You**
 A successful FP\&A Analyst should be detail\-oriented, and have a strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify and strengthen areas of business risks. They should help develop and maintain the right reporting models (completeness and accuracy) and adapt to business needs/strategic and growth mindset. This requires a lot of diligence and an attitude to take on new tasks while being solution\-oriented.
   

  

* Strong work ethic, self\-motivated work style, attention to detail, effective communicator
* Ability to organize multiple responsibilities and deliver results in an accurate and timely manner while adapting to changes in priorities.
* Ability to influence and strategically partner with individuals of various educational and technical backgrounds, both inside and outside the organization
* Strong business acumen and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and present data
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines under pressure
* Self\-starter with a strong sense of urgency and follow\-up skills.


**Qualifications**
* Qualified CA or MBA in finance from Tier 1 or Tier 2 colleges
* Prior FP\&A Experience required (2\-5 years minimum) FP\&A/ reporting/data analytics experience across revenue, expense, cash or capex.
* Sound fundamentals on financial knowledge, analytical/data modeling ability, and sound understanding of the media ecosystem including some understanding of Nielsen’s products and services
* Ability to develop constructive relationships with executives and colleagues across the organization
* Experience with analytics tools such as SAP Analytics Cloud, Power BI, Google Data Studio, and spreadsheet tools (excel, Google Sheets) is required.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Manager- Finance FP&A
description:
This is a core Financial Planning \& Analysis role housed within the CEO Office \& Strategy team. You will own the planning, forecasting, performance\-reporting and profitability agenda for the business, and act as the financial conscience in leadership discussions – the person who can say, with evidence, what the numbers mean and what should be done about them.
   

  

 The role is deliberately hands\-on and full\-stack. You will build the models, write the queries, design the dashboards, close the variance analysis and then present the story to the CEO and leadership team. It combines classic FP\&A depth with modern data tooling, and it requires someone who is as comfortable in a DAX measure and a SQL join as in a P\&L, a cash flow and a month\-end close.
   

  

 Given the exposure to confidential financial information and the technical accounting judgement involved, a qualified Chartered Accountant is a mandatory requirement for this position.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Budgeting, Forecasting \& Planning**
* Own the annual operating plan and budget end to end – timelines, templates, assumption sets, bottom\-up build\-up with function heads, consolidation, review cycles and final leadership sign\-off.
* Run the rolling forecast process (monthly / quarterly) covering revenue, gross margin, operating cost, EBITDA, working capital and cash, with clear documentation of assumptions and bridges to the prior view.
* Build and maintain driver\-based financial models that link operational volumes and activity to financial outcomes, rather than growing lines by a percentage.
* Prepare long\-range plans and multi\-year business projections to support strategic, capacity and investment decisions.
* Run scenario, sensitivity and what\-if analyses (best / base / downside) and quantify the financial impact of strategic options for leadership.
* Performance Reporting, Variance \& Business Partnering
* Own the monthly MIS and management reporting pack – P\&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPI dashboards and management commentary – delivered accurately and on the committed calendar.
* Perform detailed budget\-versus\-actual and forecast\-versus\-actual variance analysis; explain movements by driver (volume, price, mix, cost, phasing) and not merely by line item.
* Act as finance business partner to sales, operations, delivery and support functions – challenge spend, validate business cases and help function heads manage to plan.
* Prepare material for monthly and quarterly business reviews, board packs, investor updates and lender or auditor requirements.
* Maintain an early\-warning view on performance risks and opportunities, and drive corrective action with the relevant owners.
* Profitability, Cost \& Cash
* Analyse profitability at every meaningful cut – project, product, customer, channel, region, service line – and identify where value is being created and destroyed.
* Build and refine unit economics, contribution margin and cost\-to\-serve models; support pricing, discounting, bidding and make\-versus\-buy decisions with quantified analysis.
* Drive cost control and efficiency initiatives: opex and overhead analysis, vendor and category spend review, headcount and manpower cost planning, and tracking of savings actually realised.
* Monitor working capital – receivables, payables, inventory and advances – and support cash flow forecasting and liquidity planning.
* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals and new investments using NPV, IRR, payback and ROCE; track post\-implementation performance against the approved case.
* Accounting Workflows, Close \& Controls
* Work closely with the accounts and controllership team through the month\-end and year\-end close – accruals, provisions, cut\-off, cost allocations and revenue recognition – to ensure reported numbers are complete and correct.
* Apply a strong working understanding of end\-to\-end accounting workflows (order to cash, procure to pay, record to report, fixed assets, payroll) when interpreting, reconciling and challenging data.
* Reconcile management reporting to the statutory books and clearly explain the bridge between the two.
* Ensure reporting and analysis respect applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IFRS as relevant), internal control requirements and audit expectations.
* Support statutory audit, internal audit, tax and compliance requirements with analysis, schedules and explanations as required.
* Strategy \& CEO Office Support
* Convert open\-ended questions from the CEO and leadership into structured analyses with clear, defensible recommendations.
* Prepare business cases, decision notes and financial evaluations for new initiatives, markets, partnerships and organic or inorganic growth opportunities.
* Track strategic priorities and enterprise KPIs across functions, flag deviations early and drive closure with business owners.


**Candidate RequirementsQualifications – Mandatory**
* Essential: Chartered Accountant (CA) – qualified and in good standing. This is a non\-negotiable requirement; applications without CA qualification will not be considered.
* Essential: Minimum 5 years of post\-qualification experience in FP\&A, business finance, management reporting, controllership or a CEO / MD office finance role.


**Technical Skills**
* Essential: Full\-cycle FP\&A ownership – budgeting, rolling forecasting, variance analysis, MIS, profitability analysis and driver\-based financial modelling.
* Essential: Strong command of accounting standards, month\-end close processes and the link between management and statutory reporting.
* Essential: Practical understanding of relational data structures, keys, joins and granularity
* Essential: Confident presentation skills in PowerPoint for board, investor and leadership audiences.
* Preferred: Hands\-on experience with Oracle (NetSuite) ERP
* Preferred: Experience in a multi\-entity, multi\-currency or multi\-geography reporting environment.


**Behavioural Attributes**
* High ownership – takes a problem from question to answer to action with limited direction.
* Rigorous attention to detail; a number presented to leadership must be right and must be defensible.
* Commercial mindset – interprets numbers in terms of business decisions, not just accounting outcomes.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain financial analysis to non\-finance stakeholders.
* Able to influence and challenge senior stakeholders constructively, without direct authority.
* Absolute discretion and integrity when handling confidential financial and business information.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and short turnaround requests.


**What Success Looks Like In The First Year**
* The annual budget and rolling forecast run on a clear calendar, with assumptions documented and forecast accuracy improving cycle over cycle.
* There is visibility on cost leaks and a clear action plan to address those
* The monthly MIS closes on time, reconciles to the books and is explained by driver rather than by line item.
* Leadership reviews run on a single, automated and trusted set of dashboards instead of competing spreadsheets.
* Profitability by project, customer and service line is visible, understood and actively managed.
* Recurring manual reporting effort is materially reduced through better data models and automation.

title: Head of Treasury
description:
Head – Treasury
 



  





 Job Purpose
 



 The Head – Treasury will own the company's overall treasury strategy, including funds mobilisation from domestic and international debt markets, investment of surplus liquidity, and management of interest rate, currency, and liquidity risk.
 



 The role is accountable for optimising the cost of funds, ensuring robust liquidity and ALM management, maintaining full regulatory compliance, and building deep relationships with banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, rating agencies, and other market participants.
 



 The role leads the entire Treasury function and is a key member of the Finance leadership team, working closely with the CFO on funding strategy, capital structure, and Board/ALCO reporting.
 



 Other Quantitative / Qualitative Parameters \- Financial
 


* Cost of Borrowing (COB)
* Cost of Funds (COF)
* Borrowing mix
* Investor diversification
* LCR/ALM support
* Overall Treasury P\&L impact



 Research
 


* Interest rate outlook
* Market dynamics
* Peer/competitor benchmarking



 External Agencies
 


* Banks
* Mutual Funds
* Insurance Companies
* Corporates
* Financial Institutions/DFIs
* Exchanges
* Depositories
* Rating Agencies
* Trustees



 Job Context \& Major Challenges
 



 Treasury at Bajaj Auto Credit Limited is responsible for mobilising and deploying funds at optimal cost, managing asset\-liability risk, maintaining regulatory liquidity buffers (LCR), hedging interest rate and currency exposure, and sustaining relationships with a broad base of lenders and investors, all while supporting the growth of the company's lending book.
 



 The Head – Treasury owns this mandate end\-to\-end: setting the borrowing strategy in consultation with the CFO, leading negotiation and closure of funding transactions across NCDs, CPs, bank lines, and ECBs, and building a resilient, diversified funding base that can flex with business growth.
 



 The role also carries full accountability for the team's output, for regulatory and audit compliance, and for representing Treasury at ALCO, RMC, and Board levels.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* Funding Strategy and Market Execution
* Own the overall borrowing strategy and calendar, in consultation with the CFO.
* Mobilise funds through private placement/public issue of NCDs and CPs, and through bank lines.
* Raise External Commercial Borrowings (ECBs) from overseas lenders and DFIs, maintaining strong global banking relationships.
* Time market entry to minimise cost of borrowing; track interest rate movements, credit spreads, and investor appetite.
* Decide and adjust the borrowing mix (short vs. long tenor, bank vs. market) to meet cost and diversification objectives.



 Relationship Management and Investor Diversification
 


* Build and sustain senior\-level relationships with banks, mutual funds, insurance companies, corporates, FIs, and international lenders.
* Continuously widen and deepen the investor base across domestic and international markets.
* Manage the rating agency relationship and credit rating review process.



 Liquidity and Investment Management
 


* Direct investment of surplus funds in G\-Secs, T\-Bills, and other approved securities to meet LCR requirements.
* Work with the ALM/Cashflow teams to plan liquidity, minimise negative carry, and optimise returns on surplus funds.



 Risk Management and Hedging
 


* Own the interest rate and currency hedging strategy (OIS, IRS, futures, and other derivatives) for the borrowing book.
* Ensure MTM, valuation, and reporting of the debt and investment portfolio are accurate and timely.
* Build and maintain a robust risk management framework covering credit, market, and liquidity risk.



 Team Leadership and Operations
 


* Lead, mentor, and manage the Treasury team (Debt Markets, Investments, Treasury Operations).
* Oversee end\-to\-end execution, settlement, and documentation of all borrowing and investment transactions per SOPs.
* Drive automation and digitisation of Treasury systems and processes.



 Compliance and Governance
 


* Ensure full compliance with RBI, SEBI, FEMA, NHB, and FIMMDA guidelines applicable to Treasury operations.
* Ensure Treasury is fully prepared for statutory, internal, and concurrent audits.
* Present funding, investment, and risk positions to ALCO, RMC, the Board, and senior management.
* Provide accurate data for central MIS (COB, COF, budgets, projections).



 Critical Skill Sets
 


* Strong background in financial modelling and analysis.
* Deep expertise in domestic and international debt capital markets.
* Strong track record reading and acting on interest rate and market movements.
* Demonstrated leadership managing a mid\-to\-large treasury/finance team.
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder\-influencing skills, including at CXO/Board level.
* Strong existing network across banks, DFIs, mutual funds, and rating agencies.



 Major Challenges in the Role
 


* Securing funds at optimal cost in volatile domestic and global markets.
* Balancing currency, interest rate, and liquidity risk across a growing book.
* Reading market direction early enough to act on it.
* Structuring innovative funding solutions (securitisation, structured debt, bond arbitrage) where standard instruments fall short.
* Continuously diversifying the investor base to avoid concentration risk.
* Staying ahead of evolving regulatory requirements across RBI, SEBI, and FEMA.



 Education \& Experience
 


* MBA (Finance), CA, CFA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification.
* 10–13 years of relevant experience in corporate treasury, debt capital markets, or NBFC/banking treasury.
* At least 5\+ years in a leadership role managing borrowings, investments, ECBs, and full treasury operations.
* Prior experience presenting to ALCO/Board\-level forums preferred.



 Key Result Areas (KRAs)
 


* Funds Mobilisation from Domestic \& International Markets
* Mobilise funds via NCDs/CPs and bank lines.
* Raise ECBs in compliance with RBI/FEMA.
* Monitor fund inflows/outflows against business demand.
* Plan rollovers ahead of redemptions.
* Optimise short/long\-term and bank/market mix.
* Lead emergency fund mobilisation when required.



 Liquidity \& Investment Management
 


* Set investment strategy for G\-Secs/T\-Bills/approved securities to meet LCR.
* Manage surplus liquidity to minimise negative carry.
* Coordinate with ALM/Cashflow teams.
* Drive returns through efficient fund deployment.



 Relationship Management \& Investor Diversification
 


* Maintain senior relationships across banks, MFs, insurers, corporates, FIs, and DFIs.
* Grow and diversify the investor base.
* Manage rating agency engagement.
* Present funding propositions to CFOs/Treasury Heads/CIOs of counterparties.
* Structure innovative funding deals where useful.



 Risk Management \& Hedging
 


* Hedge interest rate risk via OIS/IRS/futures.
* Hedge FX exposure on foreign borrowings.
* Build and maintain the risk management framework.
* Ensure accurate MTM/valuation.
* Present risk positions to ALCO/RMC/Board.



 Execution \& Team Leadership
 


* Ensure clean end\-to\-end execution and settlement of all deals per SOP.
* Lead and develop the Treasury team.
* Drive automation/digitisation of Treasury systems.
* Ensure documentation and disclosures meet statutory norms.



 Compliance \& Governance
 


* Ensure adherence to RBI/SEBI/NHB/FEMA requirements.
* Keep Treasury audit\-ready (statutory, internal, concurrent).
* Maintain governance to avoid penalties/reputational risk.
* Ensure accurate, timely regulator reporting.



 MIS, Reporting \& Market Intelligence
 


* Produce MIS on borrowings, investments, COB/COF, and benchmarks.
* Present Treasury updates at management/ALCO/Board reviews.
* Track domestic/global market developments and share insights with leadership.

description:
**Job Description**
**Job summary**
 As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real\-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities.  As a Credit Risk Management and Analytics Senior Associate, you help us measure, monitor, and communicate credit and market risk across marketable\-securities\-backed lending, capital markets, and derivatives activity. You work with partners across risk, lending and trading solutions, lending teams, investors, and finance to help ensure collateral frameworks, stress testing, and risk appetite measurement are robust and timely. You join a global, delegated coverage model spanning multiple regions, where we actively manage risk through proactive analytics and high industry standards. You will guide decision\-making by translating fast\-moving market events into practical risk insights and clear recommendations.

* Support deal execution by constructing lending values for new/complex asset classes, structures, and strategies.

* Monitor global markets and develop expertise in market dynamics, scenario construction, and event interpretation.

**Job Description**
**Job Title**
 eDiscovery Operations – Sr Counsel
   

  

**Description**
 Legal Discovery Management (LDM) is an internal organization within the firm's Litigation Department.
   

  

 As a Senior Counsel in Legal discovery operations team you will support and facilitate the legal discovery process, including the identification, preservation, collection, review, and production of information relevant to litigation matters, regulatory inquiries, and internal investigations.
   

  

 Duties will include but will not be limited to: performing custodial/data source research and identification, along with the preservation, collection, disposition, and/or secure delivery of data within pre\-defined Service Level Agreements; acting as liaison between LDM and its partners, participating in end\-to\-end eDiscovery projects and programs with a focus on process improvement; managing various projects with multiple stakeholders; coordinating project milestones and deliverables; working directly with all staff levels from analysts to senior management, and delivering results on both near\- and long\-term initiatives.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Act as a point\-of\-contact for legal teams, advising and coordinating discovery activities.
* Respond to and fulfill eDiscovery requests across various data sources, including but not limited to electronic communications, voice, structured and unstructured data sources.
* Coordinate the discovery lifecycle among all collaborating parties, including the firm's internal attorneys, outside counsel, vendors, and the firm's internal discovery IT group.
* Conduct early matter outreach, discovery planning, budgeting, custodian scoping, tracking, status reporting, managing to timelines and overseeing production requests.
* Coordinate with internal IT and business partners, and external vendors in support of request fulfillment, including restoration of data with appropriate chain\-of\-custody documentation, where required.
* Oversee day\-to\-day case details for certain matter types. Maintain a level of understanding of the business uses for the systems from which data is being requested and proactively address questions related to fulfilling such requests.
* Act as a liaison between the eDiscovery team and global systems and data center contacts, including but not limited to tape operations areas/data centers and third parties, to manage various legal discovery requests.
* Facilitate the flow of documents and knowledge throughout the discovery process: direct documents into the appropriate workstreams and transmit questions, answers, and information to/from the managed review vendor and internal or external counsel.
* Support the continuous improvement of eDiscovery operational processes globally, including request processing, research, preservation, collection, disposition, delivery, and control.
* Draft and/or review process management documentation, maintain organized updates and detailed matter/project notes and documentation.
* Data\-driven problem solving and decision making; manage and appropriately escalate delivery impediments, risks, issues, and changes associated with process enhancement initiatives.


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Law Graduate / J.D. from an accredited law school. Attorney must be licensed to practice law and a member in good standing in the state/jurisdiction in which the position is based or otherwise in compliance with the in\-house counsel registration rules of that state/jurisdiction.
* Minimum 5\+ years of discovery experience at a financial services provider, consulting firm, discovery vendor, or top\-tier law firm, with cross\-EDRM hands\-on and advisory experience.
* Understanding of firm change management processes and procedures (SDLC, etc.) and experience working in a secure environment with sensitive data, including PII.
* Familiarity with Electronically Stored Information ESI investigation procedures, preservation, disposition, recovery, and analysis of data from a variety of electronic communication, voice, and unstructured systems (e.g., M365 Purview, MS Exchange, Connected Archive, Lotus Notes, Robocopy, OnTrack, Hard Drives, Ascent, Digital Safe, NICE, Cisco, SharePoint), backup tape infrastructure (ArcServe, TSM, TDP, NetBackup), structured data systems, databases and/or EDRM (eDiscovery Reference Model), or litigation support\-related experience.
* Project Management, ITIL, ACEDS, PMP background.
* Familiarity with, knowledge of, or understanding of legal chain\-of\-custody requirements, regulatory processes, and basic Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
* Self\-motivated, highly flexible, organized, and team\-oriented, with the ability to track multiple workstreams and manage confidential and/or sensitive, time\-critical, and competing priorities and projects. title: Data Protection Officer
description:
**Primary Purpose** 




 To own, maintain and improve our data protection and privacy compliance framework, ensuring lawful, fair and transparent processing of personal data across our processing sites in the UK, EU, India, Philippines, US and Canada.
 



  





**Main Responsibilities:** 




 The Data Protection Officer is responsible for proactively managing and improving our data protection compliance framework, driving privacy accountability and lawful processing across the organisation, partnering with IT, Operations, Engineering, HR, Procurement and business stakeholders to embed practical data protection controls and support compliant growth.
 


* Own and maintain the data protection governance framework, including policies, standards, procedures and supporting documentation.
* Maintain and manage the Record of Processing Activities (ROPA), ensuring processing activities, data flows, systems, suppliers and international transfers are accurately documented and kept up to date.
* Lead and produce Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs), EU Standard Contract Clauses (SCC) and other privacy risk assessments for new and changed processing activities and transfers.
* Review, negotiate and advise on client and supplier data processing agreements (DPAs), privacy clauses and international data transfer provisions.
* Monitor compliance with applicable privacy and data protection legislation across our processing sites in the UK, EU, India, Philippines, US and Canada, escalating gaps and driving remediation actions.
* Provide practical guidance on lawful bases for processing, data subject rights, retention, minimisation, privacy by design and cross\-border transfers.
* Support the management of personal data breaches, including triage, risk assessment, notification decision\-making, client communications and post\-incident review.
* Work with supplier owners and procurement teams to assess third\-party privacy risk and ensure appropriate due diligence and contractual controls are in place.
* Develop and deliver data protection training and awareness to employees and support responses to client privacy questionnaires, audits and compliance requests.
* Define and report privacy KPIs, incidents, risks, audit findings and action plans to senior leadership, while working with IT, Operations, Engineering and wider business units to identify risks and scale good practice.



  





**Professional skills/ experience:** 



* 5\+ years in data protection, privacy compliance or information governance with hands\-on responsibility for operational privacy activities.
* Proven experience reviewing and negotiating client and supplier DPAs and advising on practical contractual privacy requirements.
* Strong experience producing DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs and supporting data subject rights, retention and international transfer compliance.
* Working knowledge of UK GDPR, EU GDPR and broader international privacy requirements across the UK, EU, India, Philippines, US and Canada.
* Professional certification such as CIPP/E, CIPM, EU GDPR Practitioner or equivalent privacy qualification desirable.
* Able to translate privacy risk into business impact and influence stakeholders at all levels.



  





**Personal Qualities** 



* Problem solver.
* Great with people, can build trust and rapport across the entire organisation.
* Good communicator with clients and internally.
* Team Player commitment and flexible.

title: Senior Manager Group Insurance
description:
TORQ Commodities is a diversified physical commodities supply chain and trading company operating across Asia, Africa, and Europe, with capabilities spanning procurement, shipping, logistics, and global commodity trading. The business works across complex trading and operational environments where insurance plays a critical role in protecting assets, managing exposure, and supporting commercial continuity.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to join a business with broad international operations and take ownership of group insurance matters across a varied and fast\-moving risk landscape. You will work across insurance, trade, logistics, legal, finance, and commercial stakeholders, helping ensure the Group's coverage remains aligned to its activities while supporting effective claims handling, renewals, and contract review.
   

  

 As Senior Manager Group Insurance, you will oversee TORQ Group's insurance portfolio with particular responsibility for marine and cargo risks, complex claims, policy renewals, and insurance\-related contract review. The role is suited to someone who brings strong commercial judgement, a hands\-on approach, and the ability to operate confidently across jurisdictions and functions while helping strengthen insurance processes across the Group.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Manage and coordinate TORQ Group's insurance portfolio to ensure that business activities, assets, stock, liabilities, and people are appropriately insured
* Maintain complete and accurate records of policies, endorsements, certificates, coverage limits, deductibles, warranties, and renewal dates
* Monitor policy conditions, warranties, and notification requirements to protect the Group's ability to recover under its policies
* Coordinate premium payments, reconciliations, refunds, and policy adjustments with Finance and other relevant teams
* Provide insurance documents required by customers, suppliers, lenders, landlords, and other contractual counterparties
* Manage insurance requirements arising from the international and domestic movement, storage, and handling of commodities
* Review imports, exports, cross\-border trades, inland movements, warehousing, and multimodal shipments from an insurance perspective
* Work with Trade Operations, Logistics, and Trading teams to ensure that shipments and inventories are declared correctly and adequately insured
* Review cargo values, declarations, policy limits, and supporting documents to reduce uninsured and under\-insured exposures
* Assess the insurance implications of Incoterms, title and risk transfer, warehousing, freight, and chartering arrangements
* Own insurance claims from first notification through settlement, recovery, and closure
* Assess available coverage, define claims strategy, and ensure timely notification
* Collect, review, and organise the evidence and supporting documents required for each claim
* Coordinate surveyors, loss adjusters, investigators, lawyers, and other specialists as required
* Negotiate with insurers and brokers, respond to queries, challenge coverage or settlement positions where appropriate, and pursue timely resolution
* Manage salvage, recovery, and subrogation matters where applicable, and maintain a complete audit trail
* Manage claims involving multiple jurisdictions, overseas insurers and brokers, shipping lines, warehouses, freight counterparties, and external counsel
* Interpret policy wording, exclusions, deductibles, warranties, and coverage positions
* Present TORQ's position clearly and commercially to insurers, brokers, and advisers
* Drive disputed, delayed, and technically complex claims forward, escalating material issues when necessary
* Work closely with the Head of Marine Operations throughout insurance placement and renewal exercises
* Gather and validate underwriting information, exposure data, and claims histories
* Prepare insurance submissions and supporting information for the market
* Review quotations, policy wording, exclusions, warranties, deductibles, limits, and sub\-limits
* Participate in negotiations with brokers and insurers, and benchmark coverage and premium terms
* Identify coverage gaps and recommend practical improvements or alternative solutions
* Identify insurable risks arising from new products, markets, geographies, contracts, logistics structures, and business activities
* Work with Legal, Trade Operations, and commercial teams on insurance and indemnity provisions in sales and purchase contracts, logistics, warehousing, freight, chartering, processing, and financing arrangements
* Flag adverse insurance provisions, uninsured exposures, and contractual obligations that require additional cover
* Recommend appropriate insurance solutions and practical risk\-mitigation measures
* Maintain effective working relationships with insurers, brokers, and specialist advisers
* Coordinate with surveyors, loss adjusters, investigators, marine consultants, claims advisers, and external lawyers
* Monitor service delivery, maintain momentum on open matters, and escalate performance or responsiveness concerns when required
* Provide accurate management information and strengthen insurance processes across the Group
* Maintain clear reporting on policies, premiums, notified and outstanding claims, settlements, recoveries, exposures, and renewals
* Analyse claims trends and recurring loss events, and recommend practical preventive measures
* Improve insurance processes, documentation standards, and internal awareness across relevant TORQ teams


**Requirements**
**Qualifications**
 MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification from a recognised institution, or an LLB or equivalent legal qualification from a recognised university or law school.
   

  

 ACII, Insurance Institute of India qualifications or an equivalent recognised insurance certification would be an advantage.
   

  

**Experience**
 Five to seven years of relevant post\-qualification experience, including at least five years gained after completion of the MBA or legal qualification.
   

  

 Relevant experience gained in one of the following backgrounds: a leading insurer, particularly in commercial, marine, liability or claims functions; a reputable insurance broker managing complex corporate accounts or claims; a commodity trading company, import\-export house, shipping or logistics business, or large corporate insurance function; or a reputable law firm with meaningful experience in insurance, marine matters, claims or insurance disputes.
   

  

**Knowledge and Technical Exposure**
 Marine and cargo insurance, international trade and shipping, Incoterms and cross\-border transactions.
   

  

 Commercial policy interpretation, claims documentation, surveys and loss adjustment, subrogation and recovery.
   

  

 Trade credit, liability, property and corporate insurance programmes.
   

  

 Commodity, import\-export, warehousing, logistics and supply\-chain risks.
   

  

**Core Competencies**
 Strong analytical ability and commercial judgement.
   

  

 Confidence in interpreting policy wording and contractual provisions.
   

  

 Excellent negotiation, written communication and stakeholder\-management skills with senior internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

 High attention to detail, disciplined documentation and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
   

  

 Eligibility to work in India.

description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, or another quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP\&A), consulting, or a related function.
* Experience executing full\-cycle FP\&A functions including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and modeling within a multinational company setting.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Advanced proficiency in spreadsheets and SQL, and demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools/LLMs to automate workflows or enhance data analysis.
* Ability to take initiatives, navigate ambiguity and work in an unstructured environment.
* Distinctive problem\-solving skills with a proven track record of building complex financial models and identifying non\-obvious trends in large datasets.
* Excellent teamwork, communication and presentation skills; can craft and deliver a message with credibility to influence executive leadership.


**About The Job**
 Business Finance’s purpose is to create economic value for Google to fuel innovation. We balance the roles of trusted advisor and guardian to reveal opportunity, manage risk, and optimize investment. We establish a seat at the table and drive impact through a grounding in hard data, an independent point\-of\-view, a bias to action, a collaborative approach, and a focus on the development of our people.
   

  

 In this role, you will ensure that the company makes sound business decisions. As a Business Finance Analyst for the India market, you will be a strategic partner to the India leadership team, primarily focusing on Ads Sales and its supporting functions. Your work, from sophisticated financial modeling to tracking core performance metrics, will be the foundation upon which our leaders make critical strategic decisions.
   

  

 This role offers a unique vantage point into one of Google's most significant markets. You will not only manage the "rhythm of the business" (reporting, forecasting, and target setting) but also exercise thought leadership to shape the long\-term financial strategy and operational excellence of the India business.
   

  

 The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward\-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Support India’s critical business finance operations for Large Customer Sales (LCS) Ads business such as business reporting, forecasting, target setting, analysis, and budget management.
* Provide management with insights and recommendations into drivers of business, market trends, risks, and opportunities leading to business enhancing and product actions.
* Engage in deep analyses to generate the insights and recommendations.
* Be a strategic enabler for our AI transformation, elevating the quality and scale of our deliverables while accelerating operational efficiencies.
* Act as a liaison to connect central Finance teams and the local teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.
