title: Visa Officer
description:
***Job Title: Case Officer***




***Department : Operations \- Business Immigration***




***Reporting To: Senior Case Officer / Operations Manager***




***Employment Type: Full\-Time***




  





**Position Summary:\-** 




 The Case Officer \- L\-1A Business Immigration is responsible for managing L\-1A business immigration cases from initiation through petition filing. The role involves evaluating client
 



 eligibility, understanding business operations, coordinating with multiple internal departments,
 



 drafting immigration documentation, reviewing supporting evidence, maintaining client
 



 communication, and ensuring that complete, high\-quality petitions are prepared for submission
 



 to USCIS. The Case Officer acts as the central coordinator between clients and internal teams
 



 to ensure every case is accurate, compliant, and submitted within prescribed timelines.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:\-** 




  





**1\. Client Eligibility Assessment \& Case Initiation:\-** 



* Conduct initial assessment of prospective L\-1A cases to determine eligibility based on business structure, ownership, managerial capacity, qualifying relationship, and operational requirements.
* Analyze the client's existing business model, industry, organizational hierarchy, and expansion objectives to determine appropriate case strategy.
* Review available documentation and identify additional evidence required for successful petition preparation.
* Explain documentation requirements and procedural timelines to clients during the onboarding stage.



  





**2\. End\-to\-End Case Management:\-** 



* Manage assigned L\-1A petitions from document collection through final filing.
* Prepare and maintain case plans, document trackers, and internal progress reports.
* Monitor timelines and ensure milestones are achieved within scheduled deadlines.
* Coordinate all internal activities required for timely petition preparation.



  





**3\. Document Collection \& Client Coordination:\-** 



* Collect corporate, financial, operational, employment, and legal documentation from clients.
* Regularly communicate with clients regarding pending documents and clarification requests.
* Verify the completeness, authenticity, and consistency of documents received.
* Maintain organized digital case files and document repositories.



  





**4\. Business Analysis \& Documentation:\-** 



* Develop a comprehensive understanding of the client's Indian business, including operations,



 products or services, management structure, revenue model, and future expansion plans.
 


* Draft company profiles, business summaries, organizational descriptions, managerial narratives,



 and operational documentation relating to the Indian entity.
 


* Review business records to ensure all supporting evidence accurately reflects the client's actual



 business operations.
 


* Ensure documentation aligns with USCIS requirements and overall petition strategy.



  





**5\. Coordination with Business Plan Team:\-** 



* Coordinate with the Business Plan Team to provide complete business information required for



 preparation of U.S. business plans.
 


* Share operational data, financial inputs, organizational information, hiring plans, investment



 details, and business objectives.
 


* Review draft business plans to ensure consistency with the petition narrative and supporting



 documentation.
 


* Coordinate revisions whenever inconsistencies or additional requirements are identified.



  





**6\. Drafting Immigration Documents:\-** 



* Prepare L\-1A immigration documentation, including support letters, organizational explanations,



 management narratives, job descriptions, company summaries, qualifying relationship documents,
 



 and other supporting materials.
 


* Draft explanatory letters and supporting documents required for petition preparation.
* Ensure all drafted documentation is internally consistent and factually accurate.



  





**7\. Internal Coordination:\-** 



* Coordinate with the Graphics Team for preparation of organizational charts, company structure



 diagrams, office layouts, marketing materials, presentation graphics, and other visual evidence
 



 supporting the petition.
 


* Work closely with document preparation, quality control, legal, and management teams



 throughout the case lifecycle.
 


* Facilitate timely resolution of documentation queries across departments.



  





**8\. Quality Control \& Documentation Review:\-** 



* Perform comprehensive quality checks of all petition documents before submission.
* Review drafted documents for accuracy, completeness, formatting consistency, grammar, and



 compliance with internal quality standards.
 


* Cross\-verify information across all supporting documents to eliminate discrepancies.
* Ensure financial records, corporate documents, organizational charts, employment records, and



 business plans remain consistent throughout the petition
 



  





**9\. Petition Preparation \& Filing:\-** 



* Assemble complete L\-1A petition packages in accordance with USCIS filing requirements.
* Prepare Form I\-129 and all applicable L classification supporting documentation.
* Verify that all mandatory forms, exhibits, supporting evidence, and filing documents are included



 prior to submission.
 


* Coordinate final review and filing of petitions with senior management.



  





**10\. Case Documentation \& Compliance:\-** 



* Maintain complete electronic and physical case records throughout the lifecycle of each petition.
* Ensure all confidential client information is handled in accordance with company policies.
* Update internal case management systems with accurate case progress and documentation



 status.
 


* Stay informed regarding USCIS policy updates, L\-1A regulations, filing requirements, and documentation standards.



  





**Required Skills:\-** 



* Strong understanding of U.S. L\-1A Business Immigration processes.
* Excellent business analysis and documentation skills.
* Strong drafting and technical writing ability.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* High attention to detail with strong quality control capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously.
* Strong communication and client coordination skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and document management software.

Control process and financial risk management for an entire Tax and compliance unit as per local country law and corporate finance objectives/ standards, providing solutions to address the deviations and managing the implementation of such solutions. Prepare, review, file i.e. handle all tax related compliances and responsible for taxation matters with in the country as per country local law.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead global e\-invoicing implementation ensuring compliance with country\-specific VAT/GST regulations and statutory invoice requirements for airline operations.
* Assist in preparing monthly financial Tax statements of outstations, identifies the drivers of financial Receivables and payable of TAX, GST.
* Compute as per local legislature and ensure the payment of due taxes and filing of tax returns on timely basis.
* Prepares corporate income Tax Return for airline. Assist in complying and verifying the Payroll related taxes i.e. Income Tax, Social Security Taxes, Labor related levies and its payment to respective authority on timely manner.
* Review internal controls and implement the corrective action. Co\-ordinate and ensure accruals accounting related to tax has been performed by respective stations. Perform accounting related to tax and maintain delivery accurate GL schedules.
* Prepare and update regularly Comprehensive Compliance checklist for all applicable taxes to ensure tax payments and filing on timely basis.
* Review of Taxation contracts and compare the rates vs actual invoice by conducting the self\-audit for consultancy contracts.
* Assist in implementing Audit finding results from Internal and External audit and perform self\-check to ensure audit criteria are being met, implement best practices in our work to simplify the process compliance.
* Assist on significant indirect tax litigation and advisory matters, coordinating with external tax consultants and Finance Manager where necessary.
* Conduct monthly impairment review of financial accounting with oracle financials.
* Identify the reason for Variances vs. Budget and control Cost by proper business plan.
* Prepare and arrange period Tax Health check on Quarterly basis for all stations and provide summary to HO tax unit.
* Prepare updates on tax related activities performed and pending on quarterly basis for India stations and submit to head officer tax unit
* Assist Tax and Compliance Manager in collating information related to internal and external audit within the country and inform station finance.
* Prepare forecast for preparation of tax budget.
* Assist in research for tax related issues for new station setup and closely work with management on obtaining prior approvals for appointing consultants for tax related matters and ensuring company registration is done in line with tax legislations.
* Follow up on all tax matters/issues pending unfiled returns, any notices received from authority, address them to resolve and close
* Responsible for leading all tax litigation in direct tax and indirect tax in absence of FM — Taxation.
* Provide accurate, timely and risk based direct tax advice to relevant stakeholders.
* Complies with the accounting standards remains as per country law and in reporting.

title: Sr. Operation Executive (Ahmedabad)
description:
**Position:** 
 Senior Operations Executive / Case Officer
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Location:** 
 Ahmedabad, Gujarat
 



**Working Days:** 
 Monday–Saturday
 



**Working Hours:** 
 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM
 



  





**About Phoenix Business Advisory** 




 Phoenix Business Advisory is a business migration and advisory firm providing immigration, business migration, and expansion solutions across New Zealand, Australia, USA, and UAE.
 



  





 We are looking for a Senior Operations Executive / Case Officer to manage client cases, documentation,
 



 follow\-ups, and coordination while ensuring cases are processed accurately and within timelines.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Manage and coordinate client cases from initial documentation through the relevant processing stages.
* Review client documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with internal requirements.
* Prepare and maintain case files, trackers, checklists, and documentation.
* Coordinate with clients for pending documents, information, and case updates.
* Ensure timely follow\-ups and movement of cases through different stages.
* Coordinate with internal teams, consultants, legal professionals, and other stakeholders.
* Monitor case deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
* Identify documentation gaps or case\-related issues and escalate them appropriately.
* Maintain accurate records and provide regular case\-status updates to management.
* Follow company SOPs, quality standards, and confidentiality requirements.



  





**Requirements \& Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Law, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of relevant experience in immigration, visa processing, case management, business advisory, legal services, or related industries.
* Strong documentation and case\-management skills.
* Good knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets and documentation tools.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify errors.
* Good organizational and time\-management skills.
* Ability to handle multiple cases and deadlines simultaneously.
* Strong follow\-up, coordination, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive client information.



  





**Preferred Experience** 



* Experience or exposure to New Zealand, Australia, USA/L\-1, UAE immigration, business migration, investor migration, or visa processing will be an advantage.



  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Opportunity to work with an international business migration and advisory firm.
* Exposure to international immigration and business migration processes.
* Opportunity to work closely with experienced operations and leadership teams.
* Career growth within the operations function.
* Professional and growth\-oriented work environment.

title: Analyst - Customs & Logistics
description:
Responsible for Customs Clearance \& Inland transportation /delivery of and all Import \& Export Consignment. by Air \& Sea from various ports in India.
   

  

 Regular Coordination with Customs Broker / shipping line /Freight forwarder for import/ Export shipments
   

  

 EXIM activities \& import of capital goods under various duty\-free schemes \& issuance of Licenses under various import/export promotion schemes in coordination with various government agencies. Overall, responsible for various export / import / logistics and licensing activities.
   

  

 Customs Clearance, EPCG License, Project Import license, Customs, Duty Drawback, various Exports Incentives etc., under Concessional Imports Duty Exemption under various customs notification and FTA, compliance of all customs matters.
   

  

 Maintaining Liaising with Sr. Govt. Official.
   

  

 Initiate for various Cost\-effective project.
   

  

* Knowledge of Import \& Export Consignment customs Clearance Air \& Sea.
* Follow up with shipping line Freight forwarder for regular import/ Export shipments and with CHA for import clearance.
* Good knowledge of Export under self\-sealing process \& factory stuffing container.
* Coordination for Import/ Export Transport from port to Plant and Plant to Port.
* Knowledge of Durable packaging material re\- import duty free and time line of Tracking.
* Responsibility of Service provider invoice processing and Service validation
* Knowledge of Direct Port Delivery (DPD)Import customs clearance.
* Knowledge of customs duty calculation and payment processing
* Knowledge of registration of EPCG, Advance license \& preparation Bond/BG
* Knowledge of BG/Bond cancellation with customs
* Finalization of provisional BOE and Shipping bill from customs
* Knowledge of Customs clearance of capital goods/ Machinery under various duty\-free schemes like, EPCG License, Project Import license \& Advance license.
* Knowledge of Duty Drawback, various Exports Incentives etc., under Concessional Imports Duty Exemption under various customs notification and FTA,
* Knowledge of statutory compliance under various Custom laws, FTP rules, procedures and regulations including compliance with Customs duty and Import incentive scheme,
* Good communication Skill of drafting the reply letter to Customs \& Liaison with Government Bodies like customs, DGFT, IGST department etc. .
* Dealing with Custom authorities for the assessment/Examination \& litigation proceedings in close co\-ordination with local CHA.


* Any Graduate preferably with MBA in Import /Exports.
* Work Experience\-( 8\-10 yrs )
* \+5yrs Customs Operations and additional working knowledge on HS classification / FTA analysis
+ Industry Type \-Automotive, Engineering, Electronics, industry
+ Worked in any CoE environment, Operations / FTA HS Classification (preferred)
